Title: 9 The Links, St Andrews
Description: Sitting only a few feet away from the 18th Green of the Old Course and Royal and Ancient Club House,  this luxury residence with incredible views from its two balconies dates back to 1872. There are five bedrooms and seven bathrooms in the bright and airy home. With a 24 hour concierge service, this is a truly luxury exclusive accommodation at the best address in golf.

Title: Mary's Meanders
Description:
Mary’s Meanders award winning tours are noted for their warmth, inclusiveness and going that extra mile. As a female led company, we particularly appreciate the needs of solo female travellers.
We are acknowledged experts in the jet setting world of Outlander, including our fully immersive tours based in our “home from home” in the countryside. 
Our bespoke Ancestry tours and research are hugely popular and this individual approach feeds through into all our tours. Family groups are a speciality .

Title: Abbey - The Destination Experts
Description: Established in 1978 Abbey- The Destination Experts is an award-winning Destination Management Company with offices in Edinburgh, London and Dublin. It offers a comprehensive range of services for groups and for the individual travelers in Scotland, England & Wales as well as in Ireland.

Title: Abacus Mountain Guides
Description: "Abacus Mountain Guides started providing mountain adventures in November 2000. IFMGA Mountain Guide Mike Pescod started the business with Winter Mountaineering and Climbing Instructor Donald King. Abacus Mountain Guides offers bespoke trips and courses in hill walking, scrambling, rock climbing, winter climbing and mountain biking, based on your customers aspirations and past experience. We use only local, qualified and experienced guides and instructors who can deliver expert coaching and guiding, and provide the perfect door to door experience for your customers"

Title: Absolute Escapes
Description: Absolute Escapes provides award-winning walking and self-drive holidays across the UK & Ireland. Using first-hand knowledge and meticulous attention to detail, our small team crafts exceptional holidays for our clients. We are proud of our first-class reputation for providing outstanding holidays and delivering the highest standards of customer care. Our passion for exploration and the great outdoors is at the heart of everything we do.

Title: Apex hotels
Description: From city stays and celebrations to business trips and everything in between, there’s a place for you at Apex. Expect comfortable spaces, thoughtful touches and genuinely warm service - creating the kind of stay where you can relax, be yourself and feel like you belong from the moment you arrive.

Title: Archerfield House
Description: One world class Spa, two links golf courses of Championship standard, and a wide choice of historic and contemporary secluded accommodation, all just 40 minutes from Edinburgh along the spectacular East Lothian coastline. Across the house, lodges and cottages the site can accommodate up to 137 people.

Title: Ardanaiseig Hotel
Description: Just a stone’s throw from the banks of Loch Awe, our hotel gives you a stunning base from which to experience the full beauty of the Highlands. Find out what makes our nineteenth-century manor house so special.

Title: Argyll Hotel
Description: The landmark hotel in Dunoon town centre provides high quality rooms with stunning views. Located on the West Coast, an hour from Glasgow, Dunoon is an ideal location to explore all the West of Scotland and the Islands have to offer. The hotel has 33 individually styled rooms and two award-winning restaurants. A great option for small groups and FITs.

Title: Arnold Clark
Description: Arnold Clark Car & Van Rental is part of the Arnold Clark Group, Europe's largest independently owned car retailer. We deliver a fully professional, personalised service, as shown by our 5-star Trustpilot rating, and our dedicated account managers ensure tailored rental solutions for short, medium, or long-term hire. Competitive rates are available across an extensive range of vehicles, including nine-seaters, 4x4s, automatics, estates and saloons. With locations across the UK and at all major airports, we deliver seamless onward travel.

Title: Auchrannie Resort
Description: Auchrannie is one of Scotland's leading resorts. Two four-star hotels, thirty five star self-catering lodges, perfectly complimented by three award winning restaurants, two swimming pools, activity centre, children's facilities and destination spa. All located on Scotland's most accessible island, the stunning Isle of Arran.

Title: Invercarse Hotel
Description:
Traditional hotel situated in quiet residential area of the city. Just 5 minute by taxi, or bus brings you straight to the heart of Dundee City Centre. Attractions of interest such as world renowned architect Kengo Kuma’s V&A Museum of Design, Captain Scott’s historic ship RSS Discovery, McManus Art Gallery, Dundee Contemporary Arts, Dundee’s Jute Museum - Verdant Works and some unique cafes, restaurants, green space and boutique shopping.
Enjoy outstanding river views from the public rooms inside the hotel, free ample coach and car parking. Complimentary WiFi, delicious seasonal food and friendly local staff.
68 rooms throughout the hotel, we cater for groups, corporate, leisure and FIT.

Title: Best Western Woodlands Hotel
Description: Situated on the East Coast of Scotland and set back from the bustling seaside town of Broughty Ferry, this 65 bedroom hotel with leisure facilities is warm and welcoming. Conveniently located close to Dundee city centre it has a geographical location which puts 90% of Scotland within a 90-minute drive.

Title: Imperial Hotel
Description: The Imperial Hotel is nestled between the main street and Loch Linnhe. With some fine views over the loch and the surrounding hills, it's a picture perfect base. The 35 well appointed rooms are blesses with individual charm and character with many enjoying the loch views.

Title: Blair Athol Distillery
Description:
Offering a variety of tour options from our Signature Tour lasting approx. hour to our Allt Dour or Managers Tours where you are able to draw directly from a cask. Children over the age of 8 are welcome on tour.
The Mash Tun Bar is Pitlochry’s ‘must see’ whisky bar with a variety of drams and cocktails on offer. 
We have an array of event spaces and a dedicated team to cater to your requirements.

Title: Blair Castle
Description: Blair Castle - jewel of Highland Perthshire, perfectly placed on the main route into the Highlands and in the Cairngorms National Park 5-star VisitScotland accredited visitor attraction (2024/25). The Castle is the ancient seat of the Dukes and Earls of Atholl and home to the Atholl Highlanders, Europe's last remaining private army. Explore seven centuries of history with our extensive self guided tour which takes in up to 30 rooms full of treasures and stories and personalities of their former occupants and the extensive gardens. All groups will receive a personalised welcome and introduction to the Castle and family history, with some time left to explore at their own pace.

Title: Bonnie Wee Golf
Description: Established in 2003, Bonnie Wee Golf provides luxury golf & sightseeing vacations to incoming golfers to Scotland. We work with a number of agents from around the world. Should you require a ground handler with expert knowledge of Scottish golf tourism please feel free to contact us

Title: Bowhill House
Description: Experience magnificent  Bowhill House and Country Estate in the Heart of the Scottish Borders.  Group tours are available all year and offer visitors the chance to experience the beautiful House and the Buccleuch Art Collection.  Stroll through the Gardens, visit the tearoom and gift shop.  Stunning five star visitor attraction.

Title: Bunk Campers
Description: Established in 2007, Bunk Campers are Scotland’s largest campervan rental company with depots close to Edinburgh & Glasgow airports. We offer a wide range of modern, well maintained campervans and motorhomes for hire – from budget camping cars, VW Campervans to large motorhomes for up to 6 people.

Title: Caledonian Discovery
Description:
This is a wonderful way to discover the Great Glen between Inverness and Fort William, as we provide walking, cycling, canoeing and themed holidays, while cruising the Caledonian canal. Each comfortable barge has six twin ensuite cabins, a saloon area, a crew of four, (including a chef and local guide) and its own bicycles and canoes. We move to a new location each day and on return from exploring the area the accommodation, with power showers and meals, is ready and in place to welcome you home.
From November to March our barge remains near Fort William offering self-catering accommodation for up to 14 people.

Title: CalMac
Description: Sail through dramatic landscapes to some of the most idyllic islands in the world. Bursting with History and Culture, spectacular Scenery and wildlife, combined with first class local produce, there are un-tapped riches of opportunities to explore. from day excursions to tours, Visiting the islands has never been so accessible...

Title: Capercaillie Escapes
Description: We specialise in creating bespoke self-drive, escorted and small group itineraries for trips across Scotland. We aim to keep our clients in the driving seat, whilst we take care of the detailed planning of their trip. From a few days to a few weeks, our first-hand local knowledge and experience of Scotland alongside our network of great transport, accommodation, activity and dining hosts mean each personalised itinerary enables an immersive and authentic experience to fit the client’s specific interests and budget.

Title: Carlton George Hotel
Description: Located in the heart of Glasgow city centre, the Carlton George is the perfect base for your visit.  Whilst featuring complimentary mini bars, king-size beds, free Wi-Fi and a rooftop restaurant, the hotel prides itself on delivering a unique and warm welcome to Scotland.

Title: Cashel Travel
Description: Cashel Travel was founded in 2000 as a DMC specialising exclusively in the UK and Ireland. Our expertise means that you can be confident that we understand what works (and where!) We manage incentive travel, organise confrences, group tours, clan tours and luxury vacations throughout the UK and Ireland!

Title: Cawdor Castle
Description: Cawdor Castle is a 600 year old iconic fairy-tale castle that attracts over 70,000 visitors a year. With one of the finest  woodlands in Europe, 3 stunning gardens, a golf course and high quality shops, Cawdor appeals to groups and over 80% of our visitors come from overseas.

Title: City Circle UK Ltd
Description: City Circle provides top-quality coach services to the leisure corporate and tourism markets. Our reputation for quality of service, attention to detail amd a willingness to "go that extra mile" to exceed customer expectations is unparalleled in the industry. All our coaches are fully carpated throughout, with climate controlled air-conditioning, reclining seats with arm and foot rests, multi-screen DVD player and hot & cold drinks facilities. Our policy is to renew our vehicles frequently and as a consequence our fleet age range is less than 3 years of age. The drivers are all in our corporate style uniform making them easily available

Title: Armadale Castle, Gardens and Museum of the Isles
Description: Discover 1500 years of Highland history at the last ancestral home of the Macdonalds of Sleat.  Groups can experience the romantic castle ruins, explore the fascinating Museum of the Isles, and wander through beautiful historic gardens with stunning sea views.  Visitors can also dine in our lovely café and shop in two gift shops. Pre-booked groups enjoy discounted entrance tickets.

Title: Classic Scotland
Description: Classic Scotland operate private tours all led by a registered Blue Badge Guide. Every tour is customised and personally planned at a pace to suit your clients. Free 24-hour itinerary planning. Group sizes from single travellers to 40 +. Inclusive accommodations from beautiful bed and breakfasts to 5-star castles. Specialist interest tours; golf; whisky; literature, family history. Departures all year. Multi-lingual guides. Fully insured, licensed and bonded operator.

Title: Columba Hotel
Description: Nestled on the north pier, The Columba Hotel offers those visiting vibrant Oban a charming retreat. This grand hotel is steeped in victorian charm and character  but boasts 49 modern, well equipped rooms offering travellers the best of both. A 3 star property that precisely offers 5 star standards with 3 beautiful dining optionson site, you are spoiled for choice.

Title: Corriegour Lodge Hotel
Description: Situated in one of the most beautiful sections of the Great Glen, this is a Highland retreat to savour. With outstanding views over Loch Lochy and a restaurant that offers mouthwatering cuisine, Corriegour Lodge Hotel is the perfect central base for your clients to tour the Highlands.

Title: Crannog Cruises
Description: Cruise down Loch Linnhe and enjoy breath taking views  of Britain’s highest mountain, Ben Nevis. Watch for wildlife too.Regular departures throughout the day; trips last up to 90 minutes; entertaining commentary; great all-weather viewing lounge; up to 125 passengers; full bar and snacks onboard;coach drop off point

Title: Crieff Visitor Centre
Description:
Crieff Visitor Centre is easily accessible with free onsite parking.
 
As the home of world-renowned Caithness Glass, visitors can enjoy watching the skilled craftsmen at work, before meandering around our retail areas - Gift Shop, Caithness Shop, Art and Collectables and Garden Centre. You will also receive a warm welcome in our family-friendly Restaurant. We use the best local produce and offer great value for money whether you’re looking for breakfast, lunch or just a coffee. Dog friendly.

Title: Cruise Loch Lomond Ltd
Description:
As an award winning cruise operator we have been voted one of the top 'must do' excursions voted by customers with our travel trade partners. With our friendly crew, beautifully maintained boats and live commentary on board we enjoy welcoming our travel trade partners back year on year.   
We offer flexibility and reliability guaranteeing exclusive use of a vessel that suits clients times and itineraries. The company operates cruises from Tarbet and Luss on the A82 road and both sites have ample coach parking, toilets and coffee shops.

Title: Dalwhinnie Distillery
Description: Dalwhinnie Distillery, the highest in Scotland, is conveniently located at the heart of the Cairngorm National Park. The single malt distillery has been awarded "Best Distillery Tour" for 2017 and visitors can expect a warm welcome and unique whisky and chocolate experiences. Good parking and easy access for coaches.

Title: Dine
Description: Situated in Edinburgh's financial district, Dine is a luxury brasserie with affordable prices. Inventive menus are designed by award-winning chef Stuart Muir using fresh, local, seasonal and sustainable produce. Wether it's a quick bite with colleagues, a lingering networking lunch, gourmet dinner or corporate event, Dine offers something for everyone.

Title: Discover Scotland Tours
Description: Your clients are guaranteed a warm welcome when they come on board our award-winning tours. Our friendly customer service team and driver guides are the best. Tours range from 1 to 6-days in length for FIT’s and small groups up to a maximum of 16 people. Day tours can easily reach Loch Lomond, Stirling Castle, Inveraray, Loch Ness, Glencoe, the Highlands. See the world-famous Glenfinnan Viaduct, better known as the ‘Harry Potter bridge’.

Title: Discovery Point
Description:
Home to the Royal Research Ship Discovery, built in Dundee for the 1901 British expedition to the Antarctic, with Captain Scott and Ernest Shackleton. Walk in the footsteps of famous explorers aboard this unique wooden ship and uncover over 120 years of inspiring stories. Enjoy 360-views of Dundee's skyline and the River Tay in the Discovery Dome, the latest addition to Discovery Point museum's extensive galleries.
Free coach parking.
Group discounts for 15+ pax.
Translation cards available.
Flexible terms.

Title: Douglas Hotel
Description: Adjacent to ferry terminal, the Douglas Hotel is the perfect base for the discerning traveller. Super friendly and multi award winning.  A personalised level of service in luxury and comfort, hotel staff will ensure access to the huge variety of activities available on Arran, whether they be sporting, cultural or historical.

Title: Drumlanrig Castle
Description: Immerse yourself in history and famous art at majestic Drumlanrig  Castle.  A five star visitor attraction, Drumlanrig offers stunning scenery in a 90,000 acre estate.  Group tours are available throughout the  year.  A  visit to the craft shops, Castle tearoom and perfectly manicured gardens all guarantee  a fantastic day out.

Title: Dryburgh Abbey Hotel
Description:
Clients can enjoy comfortable lounges, 38 beautifully appointed bedrooms, bar and dining areas offering lovely views of the river, heated swimming pool and sauna leisure facilities, tantalising menus created using locally sourced produce, a hearty full Scottish breakfast, 10-acres of private grounds by the River Tweed and easy coach parking.
Dryburgh is situated centrally to Newcastle and Edinburgh (1-hour drive).
The Scottish Borders boasts a wealth of historic Abbeys, castles, gardens, scenic towns, beautiful local Tweed and Cashmere.

Title: Sonas Collection/Duisdale House
Description: An elegant country house hotel overlooking the Sound of Sleat on the Isle of Skye, Duisdale House Hotel offers a refined Highland retreat in a secluded setting. Ideal for group stays or exclusive use, it features stylish accommodation and acclaimed 2 AA Rosette dining focused on local produce, alongside inviting public spaces. A perfect base for exploring Skye’s landscapes, wildlife and coastal scenery.

Title: Dunvegan Castle
Description:
Any visit to the Isle of Skye is incomplete without savouring the wealth of history offered by Dunvegan Castle - the oldest continuously inhabited castle in Scotland and ancestral home of the Chiefs of Clan MacLeod for 800 years.
Groups can enjoy pre-booked tours of the castle, delight in its formal gardens, enjoy great coffee and light refreshments at the Cafe or browse in one of its four shops, where we have special offers for groups.

Title: Eat Walk Edinburgh
Description: Foodie walking tours of Edinburgh, enjoy the quirky history of the city while sampling food and drink in up to six venues. Tours last 3-3.5 hours. Up to 10% commission payable on group bookings. Bespoke tours can be arranged. Tour presently available in English, Spanish, Italian and Japanese. Other languages are available on application.

Title: Edinbane Self Catering
Description: On the Croft at Edinbane “ 2 restored stone cottages and a Gypsy caravan –the units are perfect for individual occupancy or group booking.  Thirteen miles from Portree, 8 from Dunvegan, 45 minutes from the Skye Bridge. A perfect base to spend time to explore all that Skye has to offer – Walking, birding, marine excursions, artisanal gems. Nearby restaurants include the Edinbane Lodge, 3 Chimneys, Edinbane Inn and many other great “finds”. Shiatsu Massage and Reiki available on request.

Title: Edinburgh Hardrock Cafe
Description: Hard Rock Cafe Edinburgh will deliver what you want, when you want it.  Our delicious menu is freshly prepared on the premises. We offer a wide selection of group menus and we can cater up to 100 people, our bar is also available for our popular “Shake it Up” classes.  For further information please contact our sales team.

Title: Edinburgh Room Rentals Ltd
Description: Edinburgh Room Rentals offers a wide variety of city centre accommodation in Scotland’s Capital City, advertising a large database of private rooms and apartments which are ideally place for all city attractions and amenities . Price match guarantee on all accommodation to ensure the best prices, locations and booking deals!

Title: Edinburgh's Festivals
Description: Every year during their festivals Edinburgh becomes the world’s cultural melting pot, with citizens of the city and the country joined by artists and audiences from every corner of the globe in celebration of culture and creativity. Second only to the Olympic Games in terms of attendances, and on a par with a FIFA World Cup - but happening every year in Scotland’s majestic capital city - we offer a bespoke service to travel trade colleagues and ask you to get in touch to find out more about our world famous festivals.

Title: Enterkine House Hotel
Description: Enterkine House Hotel is privately owned property, located in the heart of Ayrshire countryside and only 45 minutes drive from Glasgow.  Various private dining rooms for groups of 8 - 220 guests.  Scottish menu`s with piper & music throughout the evening gives guests a true Taste of Scotland.  (Alternatively a gourmet menu of choice)  14 individually designed bedrooms over a variety of price scales allow us to work with individuals budget.

Title: Esplanade Hotel
Description: Resting on Dunoons traffic free promenade, The Esplanade hotel boasts of foyer unintruded views of the Clyde. Our stunning 3 Star waterfront retreat has 65 beautiful rooms many of which share these views. Relax on our first floor sunterrace while taking in the breathtaking views. With our delicious restaurant and our well stocked whisky cellar, you don't need to venture far!

Title: Europcar Chauffeur Service
Description: Europcar Chauffeur Service - Experts in organising and planning of bespoke private sightseeing tours of Scotland. Anything from Whisky, Golf, Castles or Film locations tours we can cover them all. Let your clients sample the very best of Scotland in the most modern chauffeur drive fleet in the country.

Title: European Waterways
Description: Six night all-inclusive cruises aboard the 8 passenger hotel barge Scottish Highlander. Attentive crew of 4. Gourmet meals, fine wines, open bar, many single malts! From $3,590/£2,090/€2,490 per person sharing a twin/double ensuite cabin. Charters for families/friends for 6 to 8 passengers from $26,000/£15,000/€18,100. Golfing and biking activity cruises also available.

Title: Exclusively Scotland
Description: Exclusively Scotland design high-end bespoke itineraries for small to medium-sized groups in Scotland. We have expert knowledge of the best accommodation, transport options and unique activities, and add the personal touch to every programme. Our dedicated staff are available 24 hours a day – throughout your client’s stay in in Scotland!

Title: Fenton Tower
Description: Fenton Tower can accommodate up to 13 overnight guests with dining capacity for 32.   Our guests experience a truly bespoke service, from enquiry to the day they depart, and are made to feel as if they are at home in their very own Scottish castle.  For more information or to book please contact the manager.

Title: Festival Theatre, Kings Theatre & The Studio
Description: Located centrally in Edinburgh, Festival, King’s Theatres & The Studio provide a huge variety of entertainment options, from big musicals to theatre, opera and dance, in summer hosting the Edinburgh International Festival, and each December hosting Scottish Ballet’s Christmas ballet.  To speak with one of our group booking representatives about group discounts and other perks, see contact details.

Title: Fraser Suites Glasgow
Description: 99 serviced apartments located in the heart of Glasgow's merchant city comprimising studio, one two and two bedroom residences for one night or more. Services include 24 hour reception, daily maid service, continental breakfast, fitness suite and mid week city centre shuttle bus.Competitive rates for long and short stays.

Title: HMS Unicorn
Description: Launched in 1824 HMS Unicorn is the most original old ship in the world. Experience life on board an early 19th century warship at this unique visitor attraction. A must-see interactive attraction. Fun family day out, friendly tours and Ideal for group bookings. Only 1 hour from Edinburgh and Aberdeen.

Title: Geek's Guide To Scotland
Description: Sherlock Holmes, Jekyll and Hyde, Harry Potter, James Bond, Trainspotting. Visiting film locations and writers haunts, we explore why Edinburgh is such a cultural hub and its connection to some of the most famous stories of all time. In English, Japanese and Spanish languages with private customised walking tours available.

Title: Gilmerton House
Description: Gilmerton House is located in the heart of East Lothian just 30 minutes from the centre of Edinburgh. Set within 100 acres of gardens and woodland, this secluded luxury retreat offers a high level of accommodation for up to 26 guests across 13 bedrooms together with a wide selection of reception rooms including the stunning 17th Century Music Room, which can accommodate dining for up to 50 guests. With a focus on flexibility and exclusivity within a warm and relaxed atmosphere, this is a perfect venue for private retreats, corporate days, incentives, Christmas parties, filming, golf and shooting groups, and much more.

Title: Glamis Castle
Supplier Types: Activity|Agritourism/Farms|Ancestral|Events|Exclusive Use|Food and Drink|Luxury|Private Tours|Responsible|Visitor Attraction|Walking Tours|Weddings
Description:
Over 650 years of historic stories
Found in the very heart of Angus in Scotland, Glamis Castle has been the ancestral seat to the Earls of Strathmore and Kinghorne since 1372. Once the inspiration for William Shakespeare’s Macbeth, Glamis is renowned for its rich history and famous visitors, from Mary, Queen of Scots to James V.
Glamis Castle was the childhood home of HM Queen Elizabeth The Queen Mother. Her younger daughter, HRH Princess Margaret, was born here and was also frequent visitor during her childhood, alongside her elder sister HRH Princess Elizabeth.

Title: Gleddoch - Hotel, Spa & Golf
Description: Newly refurbished for Spring 2016 to include a brand new spa facility, Gleddoch offers an ideal location to explore the surrounding area. Boasting 75 rooms, full leisure facilities, 18-hole golf course and stunning views of the Clyde Estuary. Only 10 minutes from Glasgow Airport makes for an ideal first/last night touring stopover.

Title: Glenkinchie Distillery
Description: Explore our Victorian distillery, the Lowland Home of Johnnie Walker, set within the abundant farmland and sweet-scented wildflowers of East Lothian, a mere 15 miles from Edinburgh. Glenkinchie offers a range of authentic and immersive experiences daily. Glenkinchie Distillery is open all year. Please enquire for seasonal opening times and public holiday closures.

Title: The Singleton of Glen Ord Distillery
Description: The Singleton Distillery is the nearest distillery to Inverness and Loch Ness. The new Singleton whisky visitor experience, which relaunched in July 2022 welcomes you into a world of taste and flavour. Offering a range of experiences, including a travel trade exclusive group tour for upto 32pax and FIT rate offered on our flagship distillery tour.

Title: Gleneagles
Description: Located just one hour from Glasgow and Edinburgh airports with its own railway station. Gleneagles offers the perfect retreat for those looking for relaxation, fun and adventure. The 850-acre estate eptomizes the rugged natural beauty for which Scotland is famed and offers guests a glorious playground of country pursuits and activities.

Title: Glengoyne Distillery
Description:
Described as Scotland’s most beautiful distillery, Glengoyne is nestled in a miniature glen, 14 miles north of Glasgow. Home of world-renowned Glengoyne Highland Single Malt Whisky since 1833.

This award-winning distillery is open year-round, offering a warm welcome to visitors for guided distillery tours, tutored whisky tastings, and VIP experiences.   

An excellent choice for Travel Trade with preferential rates for groups and FITs.
Maximum group size 42pax. Morning and afternoon availability.  

Direct contact for all group and FIT queries: bookings@glengoyne.com

Title: Glory Days
Description:
Glory Days, based in Edinburgh, are specialists in Event Packages / Tours, Incentive Travel, and Destination Management services worldwide.

Proud to be the official Royal Edinburgh Military Tattoo Travel Office, we offer official Packages and Tours for this event, with exclusive money can’t buy experiences. 
The Travel Office concept brings together 20 years of experience. Our staff are knowledgeable and can tailor a package to suit all needs.  We recently launched our “Scotland Travel Office” for your Scotland Travel needs.

Title: Greatbase
Description: Greatbase let out luxury self-catering properties in central Edinburgh for short-term lets (holiday, festival, relocation and corporate rentals) all our properties are specially selected for their character, quality and location, and we greet all our guests upon arrival. Utilities, linen and a few basic essentials are included in the rental.

Title: Gullane Golf Club
Description:
Gullane G.C. is one of Scotland's most prestigious member clubs. Laid out over prime seaside land, the three links golf courses are simply known by number reflecting their age.

Gullane offers a unique range of golfing experiences combining great golfing conditions and a truly spectacular environment.

Title: Go 2 Scotland
Description: We are a Chinese tour operator based in Scotland, providing a wide range of services for hotels, tickets, transportation as well as Chinese speaking guides, specialising in Chinese government and business delegations.

Title: Gray Line Scotland Ltd
Description: Our one day tour program departs daily from Edinburgh with 7 different sightseeing tours to offer, from the dramatic Highlands of Scotland to the beautiful North East of England we have a wide selection to suit all tastes.

Title: Hart Holidays
Description: Specialist tour operator for FIT self-drive holidays to the Scottish islands and all across Scotland. Holiday packages to the Outer Hebrides, Skye, Mull, Islay, Arran, Orkney, Shetland; ferries included. You can book our "Scotland by Car Hotels", B&Bs and self catering cottages through one easy reservation centre. Tailor made response to individual requests.

Title: Hawkswood House & The Roundel
Description: Hawkswood House and The Roundel are exclusive use 5 star properties set in the picturesque hamlet of Peat Inn, just a few miles from St Andrews. Beautifully appointed and sumptuously equipped to appeal to the most discerning of guest.

Title: Heart of Scotland Tours
Description: 5 star operator of both scheduled tours and group packages. We have a unique and comprehensive program of tours from 1 to 7 days in length. Maximum group size is 29 people, for a more personal and friendly experience with local guides. We also offer custom-made tours for small groups.

Title: Highland Experience Tours
Description: We are the best way to experience Scotland. Our 5 Star scheduled and bespoke tours showcase the best that Scotland has to offer. Our passionate Scottish guides ensure that all our guests get the most from their experience. We get off the beaten track and show you the real Scotland.

Title: Highland Explorer Tours
Description: From day trips to extended tours that include accommodation, our passionate team with over 30 years of experience exploring and showcasing the best of Scotland are dependable and curious. We can tailor-make special interest tours or large conference group tours, as well as able to support with events and transfers, making your time management easier. If you need some inspiration, our team can also plan your itinerary and arrange visits based around your ideas, group size and budget, using our expert local guides to help you get the most out of your time in bonnie Scotland.

Title: Historic Environment Scotland
Description: We are the largest operator of visitor attractions in Scotland with over 70 properties throughout the country including Edinburgh, Stirling and Urquhart Castles. Our Explorer Passes offer your clients (group or FITs) unlimited access to all these attractions over flexible time periods and at the same time give you commission on each sale.

Title: Holiday Inn Express Dundee
Description: City centre location over looking the River Tay, The Holiday Inn Express Dundee offers 95 double, twin and accessible rooms. All rates include breakfast with hot options, scott's porridge oats, wide range of teas and coffees, pastries, croissants, yoghurts and fresh fruit. Wifi is available throughput the hotel at no cost and the adjacent parking is free between 6pm and 8am

Title: Hopetoun House
Description: Hopetoun is a place of outstanding natural beauty with Scotland's finest stately home at its heart and has been home to the Hope family since 1699. Explore the historic ancestral home, the 150 acres of gardens surrounding the house or relax in the licensed tea room. As a five star visitor attraction Hopetoun is the perfect location to visit, we offer guided tours for groups,  or as an exceptional hospitality venue. Situated only 30 minutes from the centre of Edinburgh and 15 minutes from Edinburgh Airport.

Title: Hotel du Vin
Description: Set in a tree-lined Victorian terrace in the stylish West End of Glasgow, One Devonshire Gardens is a five star luxury boutique hotel. With 49 stunning bedrooms and suites the hotel has an enviable reputation for service and style. Discover one of Scotland's finest hotels, perhaps hold a small meeting or special private dinner, or simply take afternoon tea in one of the two private walled gardens.

Title: House for an Art Lover
Description:
Set within the magnificent grounds of Glasgow’s Bellahouston Park and inspired by the designs of Charles Rennie Mackintosh, House for an Art Lover combines art gallery and exhibition space, events venue, café, multipurpose artists studios and magnificent visitor attraction into one unique and inspiring venue.


Originally designed by Mackintosh as an elegant country retreat for a person of taste and culture, today, more than 110 years later, House for an Art Lover exists to stimulate public interest in art, design and architecture. Through its studios, exhibitions, scholarships and access to learning for all ages, it has widened Mackintosh’s original vision to make House for an Art lover a house for everyone.

Title: Kelpies at The Helix
Description:
The Kelpies – one of Scotland's finest visitor attractions – are the world's largest equine sculptures, towering 30m over the Forth & Clyde Canal. Trade discounts are available on pre-booked guided tour tickets. Join our guides and discover the art, history and engineering behind the Kelpies.
 
Or book onto The Kelpies Experience and be part of a guided aerial exploration of the sculptures with an exhilarating climb to the horses mouth via a network of cables, ladders and suspended platforms: www.kelpiesexperience.co.uk

Title: Kingsbarns Distillery and Visitor Centre
Description:
Enjoy a visit to one of Fife’s newest visitor attractions between St Andrews and Crail.  Open throughout the year, with daily tours, where kids go free with paying adult.
Enjoy a tour of our working distillery and visit our café serving hot drinks and daily specials.

Title: Kilted Cousins Family Trees
Description:
Kilted Cousins offers Scottish genealogy services and has worked with numerous happy clients worldwide to research their family history.
 
A personal family history report and/or ancestral tour makes a trip very special. We can work with you and other partners (local drivers, guides etc), to create personal packages to suit.

Title: Kinnettles Castle
Description: Set in 44 stunning acres amidst the rolling Angus countryside and steeped in rich history, Kinnettles Castle provides a dramatic, luxurious and inspiring setting for an incredible getaway. With fairy-tale turrets, stunning monochrome interiors and grand gardens, Kinnettles Castle is an extraordinary venue with quaint surprises at every turn.

Title: Leapark Hotel
Description: A hidden gem, The Leapark is situated perfectly between Glasgow and Edinburgh and offers travellers a superb base to explore. Our 45 rooms are all tastefully decorated with all the facilities you will need and more. With 3 dining experiences available you will be spoiled for choice

Title: Links Golf St Andrews
Description: Imagine someone who takes the strain out of arranging your client’s golf vacation, takes golfers anywhere in the British Isles, someone who customises the whole tour, arranges accommodation, transport and guaranteed tee times on the best courses in the country. That's what the friendly and knowledgeable staff at Links Golf St Andrews will do.

Title: Link Tours
Description: Delivering customised private tours throughout Scotland. LinkTours are flexible, attending with care to personal & cultural requirements. Pick up and return to your chosen locations. Tours are available as an individual or private group, letting you discover and experience Scotland at your own pace.

Title: Little's Chauffeur Drive
Description: “It has been our passion at Little’s to create bespoke sightseeing tours since 1966 and we believe there is no better way to experience Scotland. Our expert Tour Designers will create an itinerary perfectly tailored to your clients’ interests. Experience the beauty of the Highlands; delve into the history of the Scottish castles; indulge in the many whisky tasting tours; venture to the breath taking islands; and explore the many wonders Scotland has to offer. Our dedicated and specialised chauffeurs are here to give your clients a five-star service wherever they want to go, and they will share their insider knowledge and hidden gems.”

Title: Machrihanish Dunes
Description: Award winning resort on the beautiful Kintyre Peninsula featuring two four star hotels,eight self-catering cottages, five casual and fine dining F&B outlets, UK Top-100 championship links golf courses, spa, fitness centre and numerous historic, nature and other attractions and activities including whisky tours and field sports.

Title: MAD GOAT offbeat tours of Scotland
Description: MAD GOAT- Offbeat Tours of Scotland, is the answer for travellers who are inquisitive explorers. We provide tours in English, Portuguese, Polish and Italian. Our tours are private which means that you are in charge, but of course we will advise you on the places that you can’t miss!

Title: Mercure Hotels
Description: Jupiter Hotels have six properties under the Mercure brand and one Holiday Inn. From Inverness to Dumfries, Ayr to Edinburgh, you will find the perfect location in the countryside, the city, or by the sea. Each hotel has complimentary wi-fi and our own restaurants which can cater for large groups.

Title: McTours Ltd
Description: Guided motorcycle tours geared towards riders seeking luxury accommodation, brilliant roads, wonderful scenery and interesting stops.  A range of motorcycles available for hire. Some of our tours return to the same hotel each night enabling non biking partners and family members to also enjoy a vacation without needing to ride.
Address Line 1: Pit Lane, 8 Mossland Drive, Hillington Park,

Title: McKinlay Kidd
Description:
McKinlay Kidd is an award-winning tour operator offering tailor-made self-drive, fly-drive and train holidays in Scotland and her islands. We pride ourselves on helping visitors see destinations differently. From island-hopping to castle stays and classic car touring, we never send customers anywhere we haven’t been ourselves.
New for 2019 we are offering a range of guided small group rail tours. With the services of an expert tour leader and a maximum of 15 people per tour, personalised service is guaranteed.
Recent accolades include ‘Best Specialist Tour Operator’ in the 2017 Telegraph Travel Awards and ‘AITO Tour Operator of the Year’ in 2016, based on over 500 independent customer reviews.

Title: Mercat Tours Ltd
Description: Providing award-winning storytelling since 1985. Mercat tours will captivate your guests with passion, humour and flair promising a unique and lasting memory. They have an extensive scheduled tour programme with daily depatures and exclusive access to the Blair Street Underground Vaults in Edinburgh. They also provide whisky tasting and coach tour guides with foreign language expertise.

Title: Barony Castle Hotel
Description: Behind the impressive stone facade of Barony Castle lies a modern hotel offering fantastic facilities as a hotel, conference or wedding venue. Set in an idyllic 25 acres of gardens and mature woodland, the castle offers magnificent views over the surrounding countryside.

Title: Mini Mack Tours
Description: Mini Mack Tours provide guided tours in and around Edinburgh. All private tours are led by two brothers, Rowan & Andy Mackie in a Mini Cooper. We visit and experience the local UNESCO landmarks of the city as well as the hidden areas most visitors don't get to experience.

Title: Morag's Lodge
Description: Morag’s Lodge offers multi-award winning quality budget accommodation for independent travellers,families,and Backpackers.On the Great Glen Way and just minutes’walk from stunning Loch Ness, Morag’s is the hub in the Highlands! Home-made meals available, lively bar, bike hire,self-catering,free wifi,and “Highland Hospitality” at its best!

Title: Go!Explore Scotland
Description: We are Scotland’s experts in Motorhome and Campervan Rental with 30-years of experience both as a rental and holidaymaker in and around Scotland. We are located in the outskirts of Glasgow city and can easily transfer you from Glasgow, Edinburgh and Glasgow Prestwick. Motorhomes are all current models and are fully equipped with all of the essentials that you may require including outdoor furniture. We have models ideal for everybody, this year we have added Automatic Transmission and Luxury models.

Title: Mount Stuart
Supplier Types: Cruising/Shore Excursions|Food and Drink|Luxury|Private Tours|Visitor Attraction
Description: Mount Stuart House & Gardens is situated on the Isle of Bute, less than 90 minutes from Glasgow Airport. The ancestral home of the Marquesses of Bute, direct descendants of the Stuart Kings of Scotland, Mount Stuart features magnificent Victorian Gothic architecture and design set in 300 acres of gloriously maintained gardens. Group facilities: free coach parking, guided or self-guided house access, Gift Shop and Café with private seating available. Recently featured on TV with Alan Cumming from the US Traitors.

Title: Muirfield Executive Travel Limited
Description:
Muirfield Executive Travel specialises in providing bespoke golfing holidays to Scotland’s Golf Coast and beyond, plus the traditional country pursuits of fly fishing, shooting and hunting that Scotland provides in its truely dramatic splendour.

Our team are passionate about sport and delivering first class customer service to all.

Title: National Museum of Scotland
Description: Trace the fascinating story of Scotland, explore a world of treasured collections and life-changing innovations, or just stop by for tea: you can do it all under our spectacular roof just minutes from Edinburgh’s Royal Mile. The five-star National Museum of Scotland is the most visited attraction outside London. It has welcomed more than five million visitors since the completion of a £50 million transformation in 2011. The museum offers free general admission as well as special exhibitions, shops, cafés and restaurants. Most hop-on-hop-off city tour buses make a stop outside the museum and there are free guided public tours available every day which your individual clients can join.

Title: Neidpath Castle
Description: The perfect surprise destination for visitors to the Borders.  Open exclusively for private groups, offering a unique insight into castle architecture and local lore since the 14th century.  We offer tours; teas by a roaring fire; or a medieval banquet and ceilidh, all tailored for you.

Title: Nevis Range Mountain Experience
Description: Since opening in 1989 Nevis Range has been welcoming guests to indulge in their mountain pursuits right here in the heart of the Highlands. As a business, we offer year-round mountain access to 200,000 skiers, snowboarders, climbers, bikers, hillwalkers and sightseers! Throughout the year, as we transition between our winter and summer seasons our team adapt from offering snow sports activities to our summer programme of mountain biking and hillwalking.

Title: New Lanark World Heritage Site
Description: The fascinating history of New Lanark World Heritage Site is brought back to life in an award-winning visitor centre. With a passport ticket you can explore all of these fantastic exhibitions; The Annie Mcleod Experience, Mill workers' houses, Robert Owen's House and school, working textiles machinery and Scotlands largest roof garden!

Title: NorthLink Ferries
Description: NorthLink Ferries operate three state-of-the-art vessels daily between Aberdeen, Scrabster, Orkney and Shetland. These ships have brought new standards of speed, safety and comfort to the Northern Isles ferry routes. So come explore the dramatic landscapes, fascinating wildlife, ancient heritage, legendary hospitality and much much more.

Title: Old Course Hotel
Description: The Old Course Hotel borders the famous 17th "Road Hole" of the Old Course, ensuring spectacular views across the West Sands and town of St. Andrews. A luxurious resort with sumptious guest rooms and suites, superb dining, stunning Kohler Waters Spa and championship heathland golf course. The Duke's - a "must visit" destination.
Address Line 1: Old Course Hotel Golf Resort & Spa

Title: Off Beat Bikes
Description: Cycle hire for all. Clients can enjoy the Great Glen Cycle Route, a trip to the Outer Hebrides or a day cycle ride. We have bikes, panniers, racks and routes suitable for everyone. Get in touch to discuss your clients needs; we’ll be happy to help.

Title: Outdoor Explore
Description: Outdoor Explore offers bespoke, private adventure tours in Perthshire and beyond. Mainly offering kayaking (on lochs, rivers & sea) but also cycling (touring and mountain biking), hill walking, archery, wildlife tours. Open all year round, exploring truly hidden gems in the area. Packages, transport and conjunction with hotels, and food providers in the area also available upon request.

Title: Old Town Chambers
Description: Old Town Chambers opened in 2013. It Boasts 50 luxury serviced apartments ranging  in size from studio apartments to 3 bedrooms. All apartments are located on the Royal mile, less than a five minute walk from Edinburgh Castle.

Title: Royal Collection Trust
Description:
Royal Collection Trust, a registered charity and a department of the Royal Household, cares for the Royal Collection and manages the public opening of the official residences of The King including the Palace of Holyroodhouse and The King’s Gallery in Edinburgh, Scotland.
We offer group, special and private morning or evening visits. With free coach parking, discounted group rates, a café and shop to ensure a magnificent visit for groups. For more details, please contact us or visit our website.

Title: Poolewe Hotel
Description: Poolewe Hotel is a 16th-Century coaching inn situated on the shore of Loch Ewe. 12 en-suite bedrooms enjoying spectacular views of either the sea or mountains.  Ideally located for walking, touring, taking part in lots of activities on offer or simply relaxing. Visit the world famous Inverewe Gardens (less than a mile away), sample excellent food on offer in the bar and restaurant. Ample parking, free WiFi, dogs welcome.

Title: Rabbies Trail Burners
Description: Award winning operator of both scheduled tours and group packages. We have a unique program of guaranteed departure tours for FIT's from 1 to 16 days in length. Maximum group size is 16 people, for a more personal and friendly experience. We also offer custom-made tours and transfers for groups.

Title: Raemoir House
Description:
Raemoir House is a private hire exclusive use Mansion House and Estate, the perfect retreat from everyday life, where its full complement of staff provide bespoke experiences tailor-made to your requirements, whether private or corporate. Nestled in 14 acres of private and secluded parkland in the heart of Royal Deeside, less than half an hour from Aberdeen and its international airport, is Raemoir House. Dating from the 17th century Raemoir is a welcoming and truly authentic Scottish hideaway and is magnificent in stature.

Our 18 ensuite bedrooms, sleeping 34 guests, are individually decorated to allow all the comfort and relaxation expected of such a grand House.

Title: The Royal Scottish Shipping Line
Description: A unique offering of a super yacht in the west coast of Scotland which is the only one in the country in this tonnage (199T). Whole ship of per cabin charter with 6 luxury cabins, whisky viewing room and first class chef.

Title: Royal Botanic Garden of Edinburgh
Description: The Royal Botanic Garden Edinburgh and its three regional Gardens Benmore, Dawyck and Logan represent one of the world’s largest living collections of plants. The Royal Botanic Garden Edinburgh is world renowned for its horticultural excellence.    Dawyck in the Scottish Borders is home to some of Britain’s oldest and tallest trees.  In Dumfries & Galloway lies Logan with an exotic plant paradise warmed by the Gulf Stream and Benmore, near Dunoon, is a magnificent mountainside Garden steeped in history.

Title: Royal Scottish Country Dancing Society
Description: Scottish dancing to live music is an energising and colourful spectacle that will add to any occasion. We can provide anything from a short dancing display to hosting an entire evening of Ceilidh dancing, ensuring that your guests take home happy memories and an unforgettable experience of Scottish culture.

Title: Sandgrouse Travel & Expeditions
Description: Sandgrouse Travel & Expeditions are an Edinburgh based luxury tour operator. We create clients tailor-made 'luxury' and 'incentive group' travel around Scotland. Our trips offer much more than just box ticking. We are passionate about Scotland and use our first-hand knowledge and inside connections to create your unique experimental travel.

Title: Scot Mountain Holidays
Description: Scot Mountain Holidays offers lodge based all inclusive small group walking holidays across the Highlands and Islands. Guests are either accommodated at our family home, Fraoch Lodge in the Cairngorms National Park or a suitably located Lodge for further afield trips. Our trips vary from hard-core winter hiking and camping adventures to easy grade summer walking holidays. Our newest product is our Highland Wilderness Glamping Trips (pictured). They bring together the traditional role of the Highland Pony with the recent development in heavier but more luxurious camping equipment. Hiking with ponies by day, hot tipi wild camping by night!

Title: Scotlands Gardens
Description:
Scotland’s gardens offers the opportunity to include in your programme some of Scotlands most remarkable and beautiful gardens .
The programme includes over 6000 gardens of all sizes and types several only occasionally open to the public.

Title: Scottish Equestrian Hotel
Description: A unique experience in Scotland. The most luxurious trail ride overnight in Spas and Castles experience. The stunning Borders countryside on horseback make your way along old Drovers tracks past ancient castles to arrive in historic Selkirk. All abilities, 5 star operator (2024/25).

Title: Scottish Terrier Tours
Description:
At Scottish Terrier Tours we provide personal and friendly tours for small groups ( up to 6 persons )
Cities, Culture, History, Nature and Sports are all waiting for You! We have many suggestions for what to do and see but if you have somewhere special in mind we can do that too! Our luxury Mercedes MPV is fully air conditioned, leather interior and has an on board cooler for complimentary snacks and drinks. Teddy our terrier is available to come along – just ask!

Title: Service Course
Description:
Service Course offer unique road cycling holidays in Scotland. Each tour is organised and delivered by GB performance coaches, and fully-supported by their pro support team of ride guides, mechanics, physios and Tour Manager.
As clients enjoy Scotland's open roads, spectacular scenery, and local culture, they will receive expert advice every pedal of the way, helping them to progress as a rider. After a hard days' ride clients can unwind in luxurious surroundings as we on only use the best accommodation that Scotland has to offer. Typically Service Course take groups of around 10 riders on 3-5 day established routes, however we also create bespoke trips.

Title: Sheraton Grand Hotel & Spa, Edinburgh
Description: Located in Edinburgh’s West End, our 5-star hotel offers 269 twin and double bedrooms, many with castle views, making it ideal for individual leisure travellers and groups. Easily accessible from Edinburgh Airport in under 30 minutes, the hotel provides 120 on-site parking spaces and dedicated coach parking. Guests can enjoy award-winning One Spa, including the iconic rooftop hydropool, dine at One Square restaurant with stunning castle views, and benefit from 12 flexible meeting and event spaces on-site.

Title: Sloans Bar
Description: In the heart of the city centre, Sloans is Glasgow's Oldest bar & Restaurant. Catering for functions from 2 - 100 for a sit down meal, up to 200 for drinks/buffet. Set menus as well as bespoke booking options on request. Contact our Events team for a package that suits your group.

Title: Solway Tours
Description: Solway Tours offer private guided historic and cultural tours all over Scotland.  We specialise in bespoke group excursions and we can arrange day and multi day tours including researching family ancestry. As historians we are passionate about sharing with guests the history of our great nation along with amazing scenery.

Title: Speyside Cooperage Visitor Centre
Description: A unique opportunity to witness the ancient craft of coopering. Our introductory film is followed by guided visit to the viewing gallery to watch our coopers shape, shave and char casks at lightning speed. Booking is essential, tours run Monday to Friday on the hour between 9.00am and 3.00pm.  Picnic areas and ample parking on site.

Title: Speyside Wildlife
Description: Speyside Wildlife has over 30 years of experience in organising wildlife-watching experiences, tours and holidays in the Cairngorms, Scottish Highlands and Islands. We have an Evening Mammal Watching Experience deep within the Cairngorms National Park which can be booked exclusively for groups, guided wildlife watching days or fully inclusive holidays. Our guides' enthusiasm is infectious and they're happy to take time so your guests can enjoy their wildlife experience to the full.

Title: Spirit of Scotland Show
Description: A Taste of traditional Scottish culture and entertainment show.  An unforgettable evening of traditional Scottish dance, storytelling and music, located in the centre of Edinburgh. The welcoming atmosphere invites you to sing along or simply enjoy the music and poetry while you sample the national dish.

Title: Stirling Court Hotel
Description: Set amidst 300 acres of beautiful Parkland, the Stirling Court Hotel at the University offers a home from home environment. Centrally located, the centre offers award winning business facilities, quality accommodation and superb cuisine. The campus boasts exceptional sports facilities along within several shops and the Macroberts Arts Centre.

Title: Stirling Walking Tours
Description:
We offer private walking tours of Stirling Old Town & Castle, Wallace Monument and Bannockburn battlefield with local expert guides. An entertaining mix of storytelling and history. Perfect for FIT and Groups.
Flexible Dates and Times
Exclusive Private Tours 
Friendly Local Guides
We work with travel agents from all over the world. We offer a range of tours to suit tour groups visiting Stirling. 
 Established in 2013, all our expert local guides offer entertaining and engaging tours. Our walking tours are a must do on any visit to Stirling!

Title: Strathmore Hotels
Description: Strathmore Hotels is an established group of 7 three star hotels, each full of character in great locations around the UK; Fort William, Oban, Speyside, Perth, Harrogate and the Lake District. Reduced group rates are available for 20 people or more plus you will get one free place!

Title: Stirling Venues
Description: Stirling Venues is the largest single-site summer accommodation provider in central Scotland, offering more than 2,000 beds a night across our stunning 330 acre resort which is just 40 minutes from both Edinburgh and Glasgow.

Title: Strathspey Railway Company
Supplier Types: Exclusive Use|Food and Drink|Tour Operator|Transport|Visitor Attraction|Weddings
Description: Offer your clients a scenic heritage rail journey with the Strathspey Railway, Aviemore to Broomhill, in the Cairngorms National Park. Group-friendly rates for 20+ passengers, easy coach parking, and flexible options for groups and events. A 1 hour 40 minute return journey, typically steam hauled. From £22.50 per adult for a return journey, single fares available, with optional upgrades including refreshments or Afternoon Tea. Located 45 minutes from Inverness Airport. Advance booking required. Exclusive hire for weddings or events available.

Title: Sublime Scotland
Description: Sublime Scotland is a family run 5* private tour operator. Multi-Day Tours throughout Scotland with experienced local guides Susan or John. Travel in luxury with a flexible itinerary and see the places others do not see. We offer tours for solo travellers, couples, family or friends up to 4 passengers. Lovers of history, nature, great food and adventurous exploring.

Title: Sweeney's Cruises
Description: Sweeney's Cruises are the largest capacity operator in Scotland, offering a variety of cruise and waterbus options from 4 locations on Loch Lomond: Our main base in Balloch village, Luss, Balhama and Loch Lomond shores. Private cruises, events and weddings also available

Title: Hostelling Scotland
Description: SYHA Hostelling Scotland is the perfect accommodation choice for group travel offering shared accommodation, private rooms, communicable spaces and dining areas serving breakfast, lunch and dinner.  Perfect for Special Interest,  Activity and Youth Travel or family gatherings.  Contact our central,  experienced and knowledgeable staff for rates and quotations.

Title: Tartan Lodge
Description: Old world charm and contemporary elegance are interwoven in our boutique hostel set within a former 19th century church on Alexandra Parade, Glasgow. Tartan Lodge provides affordable accommodation for budget and business travellers in mind, with all en-suite private rooms or shared dormitories. 24 hour reception, guest kitchen, dining room and free WIFI throughout.

Title: Tartan Rover
Description: From Edinburgh to Glencoe via the Trossachs, returning via Loch Awe and Appin I offer your clients a magical 12 hour round trip tour of Mountains, Glens, Lochs and Moors, in a comfortable 7 seater Mercedes MPV. Lunch and tea included. Local Scottish guide.

Title: The Black Watch Castle and Museum
Description:
Immerse yourself in the Five Star museum that shares the story of the iconic Black Watch Regiment from 1725. Select handpicked Scottish gift from the Museum Shop and indulge in our award winning café where you will find a delicious selection of hot and cold food. We serve breakfast, lunch and afternoon tea and source our produce from local suppliers.
Our unique and compelling location can provide private dining experiences, exclusive use of the Castle, group and bespoke tours with catering package to your specifications

Title: The Lovat Loch Ness
Description: The only 4 star property on Loch Ness offering 29 unique bedrooms with beautiful views. Station Road restaurant open Tuesday – Saturday offering a 3 course Table D’Hote menu and a 7 course Tasting menu. Free car parking, free WIFI, ground floor accommodation and a lift available.

Title: The Edinburgh Address
Description: Edinburgh Address offer a collection of unique houses and apartments across Edinburgh city centre, a wide selection to suit your guests - for business or leisure. Let us help you create a unique holiday experience with optional booking extras such as a professional chef or a bespoke whisky tasting all in the comfort of an Edinburgh Address apartment.  Commissionable rates available.

Title: The Glasshouse Hotel
Description: With its striking architecture, central location, and 65 contemporary guestrooms, The Glasshouse is a great base for exploring the city of Edinburgh. This multi award-winning boutique hotel is a favourite with guests visiting for a city break, a business trip or a romantic getaway thanks to its feeling of privacy and space. The hotel's one-of-a-kind, two acre roof garden is an unforgettable experience, giving guests a spectacular view across Edinburgh.

Title: The Green Hotel
Description: Our 2 parkland courses, The Bruce & The Montgomery, are located in Kinross, within an hour’s drive of most cities in Scotland.

Title: The Highlander Inn
Description: With 5 en-suite bedrooms in the main building as well as 1 additional house within 25 metres of the main building.  With our whisky bar, club room, outdoor patio, lounge with private parking.  A great little place to visit as we are located on the Speyside Way loved worldwide by walkers.

Title: The Highland Tour Company
Description:
The Highland Tour Company is a family run business situated in Edinburgh.  We have a wealth of experience in carrying out tours in Scotland and have a real passion for our homeland. 
We can accommodate all needs and get you there in style and comfort.  So come with us and we will show you Scotland with a bespoke highland experience.

Title: The Majestic Line
Description: Discover the beauty of the West Coast of Scotland, Orkney and the Hebrides aboard our four small cruise ships.  With a maximum of twelve guests on board in six or seven ensuite cabins, our cruises access the most idyllic areas not available to larger vessels, providing wonderful hospitality and a menu based on local speciality produce.

Title: The National Trust for Scotland
Description: Our award-winning portfolio of 60 top Scottish heritage attractions includes grand Scottish castles, magnificent gardens, and the UK’s most famous historic battle sites. Visit The Battle of Bannockburn, winner of ASVA Best Visitor Attraction Experience 2014, Culloden Battlefield, Culzean Castle and Inverewe Garden and enjoy multi-lingual interpretation, tax-free shopping, group-friendly cafés and coach parking. Our group rates can save you 40% on standard admission. Our venues are ideal for incentive travel, from fine dining, tutored whisky tastings and murder mystery evenings, to outdoor events and mini highland games.

Title: The National Piping Centre & The Pipers' Tryst Hotel
Description: Come and try the bagpipe experience. Scotland's home of bagpiping offers a simple introduction to playing the pipes within this historic building. Guests will be welcomed by a Scottish bagpiper and given a tour of the Museum of Piping. A full demonstration will follow along with an opportunity to learn, play and have fun with this challenging instrument. Guests can also shop, dine and reside in The Pipers' Tryst Hotel. Bespoke packages made to suit all ages, time scale and group budgets. A unique experience in the heart of Glasgow.

Title: The Real Mary King's Close
Description: The Real Mary King's Close is a five-star visitor attraction located in the heart of Edinburgh's Old Town. Imagine a warren of streets frozen in time, where centuries of stories are just waiting to be told. Explore Edinburgh's underground streets, discover the city’s dark past, and find out what it was really like for the people who lived, worked, and died on the Close. A truly unique location, a must-see on any trip to Edinburgh. Standard 1 hour tours run every 15 minutes.

Title: The Royal Yacht Britannia
Description: Step aboard The Queen’s former floating palace and walk in the footsteps of royalty. A Royal residence for over 40 years, The Royal Yacht Britannia sailed over 1 million nautical miles with the Royal Family. Now a five-star visitor attraction in Edinburgh, you can tour the last Royal Yacht and discover stories of life at sea for both the Royal Family and the 220 Royal Yachtsmen who served on board. Enjoy stunning waterfront views in the Royal Deck Tea Room and visit our fabulous gift shop. Private early morning and evening tours also available. Group discount for groups of 20 or more.

Title: The Scotch Whisky Experience
Description: Enjoy a tutored whisky tasting, as you explore the glass vault of our world-famous whisky collection, considered one of the seven wonders of the Scotch whisky world. Located next to Edinburgh Castle, we’re one of the UK’s top five-star visitor attractions, with an award-winning restaurant. Whether you’re a whisky novice or enthusiast, our tours and whisky tastings are always interactive, educational and fun! Selected tours available in 20 languages (including BSL & ASL). Fully accessible. Open 364 days.

Title: The Steamship Sir Walter Scott Ltd
Description:
A special experience for Groups to Enjoy!
Classical Steamship cruises (200Pax)
Panoramic cruises on Lady of the lake (65pax)
Generous Group Discounts
Tailor made Itineraries
Live Onboard commentary 
Free coach parking
Complimentary cruise for organisers and Drivers
Lochside Dining 
Katrine gifts for that special gift

Title: The World Famous Frankenstein
Description: Set in the historic old town of Edinburgh our 3 floors have been remade in the image of Dr Frankenstein’s laboratory. We can cater for functions of all sizes, from 2 - 90 for sit down meals up to 200 for drinks/ buffet. Set menus as well as bespoke options on request. Contact our dedicated sales team for a package that is right for you.

Title: Thistle DMC
Description: Thistle DMC offers a complete range of destination management services for Leisure and Corporate groups. We have excellent relationships with the travel trade and we own and operate a fleet of 20 deluxe coaches. Our team work closely with you to deliver a travel programme to exceed your expectations.

Title: Timberbush Tours
Description: Timberbush Tours is one of Scotland’s longest-running tour operators, with 27 years delivering award-winning experiences for FITs and groups. We run scheduled 1–4 day Highland & Island tours year-round from Edinburgh, Glasgow and Inverness, plus bespoke private touring, corporate hire and itinerary planning. Travel in luxury Mercedes-Benz and MAN coaches (10–53 seats) with expert Driver-Guides and storytellers. Trade commission starts at 20% on standard day tours and 15% on extended tours; final rates confirmed on enquiry.

Title: Sonas Collection/Toravaig House hotel
Description: A contemporary 11-bedroom boutique hotel set on the Sleat Peninsula on the Isle of Skye, Toravaig House Hotel offers a stylish and intimate Highland escape. Ideal for group stays or exclusive use, it features elegantly designed rooms, a restaurant celebrating local and seasonal produce, and warm, welcoming spaces. Perfectly located for exploring Skye’s dramatic landscapes, whisky distilleries and coastal walks.

Title: Tours et Detours d'Edimbourg
Description:
French walking tours in Edinburgh for FITs and Groups. There are a range of tours available from Classical Historical to themed tours including Harry Potter, Textile, Spooky and more. Family and Private tours also available. Also offering some tours in Spanish in Edinburgh for FIT.

Guides for group airport transfers, panoramic tours and day trips can be provided.

They also act as a central hub to book tours and activities with selected trusted partners in Glasgow, Inverness and the Highlands. Email to receive their B2B product catalogue.

Title: Tour Skye
Description:
At Tour Skye we offer 1-day and multi-day trips, as well as bespoke private tours of Scotland, operating with a fleet of 9 to 16-seat vehicles. Our team of tour guides and professional Green Badge guides are hand-picked for their knowledge and passion for the Scottish history, nature and heritage. 
We have several tours starting from Inverness, the Isle of Skye, Edinburgh and Glasgow, as well as shore excursions, and a wide range of tour itineraries and duration, to cater for everyone.

Title: Traquair House
Description: Over 900 years old Traquair has played host to 27 Scottish monarchs including Mary Queen of Scots. Today it remains a unique family home open to the public and offers a wide range of unique experiences from our free roaming tour to an exclusive guided tour with the Lady of Traquair.

Title: Uniquely Scotland
Description: We specialise in bespoke self-drive & train holidays and also private driver guided tours for small groups of up to 6 people around Scotland, providing a holiday package personally designed for on your particular interests, timescale and budget. Our exclusive Culinary Adventure Tour comes with a 5% discount -save £150 - if booked before 15th April 2015

Title: Village Hotel Edinburgh
Description: Situated just outside the city centre and a short walk to the Botanic Gardens, this is the hotel with everything under one roof: 120 comfortable bedrooms, large onsite car parking, a cool swimming pool and huge gym, a buzzing Pub & Grill with great food, ice-cold beers and big-screen live sport, a Starbucks Coffee Shop, and fantastic event spaces for everything from meetings to social celebrations. We celebrate our easy coach parking and group friendly check-in.

Title: Village Hotel Glasgow
Description: Situated just outside Glasgow city centre near the SECC, Village Hotel Glasgow offers 120 bedrooms, including 23 Double Double rooms, Public House bar and Verve Grill restaurant, private dining space, as well as full leisure facilities including 20-metre pool, and plenty parking.  Parking and WiFi are complimentary.

Title: Village Hotel Aberdeen
Description: Situated just 5 miles West of Aberdeen city centre, Village Hotel Aberdeen offers 148 bedrooms, including 12 Double Double rooms, Public House bar and Verve Grill restaurant, private dining space, as well as full leisure facilities including 20-metre pool, and plenty parking.  Parking and WiFi are complimentary.

Title: West Park
Description: West Park Campus is ideally located just five minutes from Dundee city centre overlooking the River Tay offering a central base to explore Scotland. Private en-suite rooms are part of a 6 or 10 bedroom flat with a self catering kitchen/lounge area and are available between June and August.

Title: Wild Scotland
Description:
Wild Scotland is a membership organisation representing wildlife, adventure and activity tourism operators in Scotland.  
Our members offer a wide range of activities and experiences from wildlife watching and walking holidays to white water rafting and bushcraft and survival. Through being a member, they are committed to Best Practice and adhere to the Wild Scotland Code of Conduct which relates to four key principles: responsibility, sustainability, care and excellence. 
We continually aim to inspire visitors about Scotland’s natural environment and to connect them with a trusted network of tourism businesses that uphold the highest standards and provide some of the most inspiring experiences that Scotland has to offer.

Title: Wilderness Scotland
Description: Scotland’s leading adventure travel company offers an inspiring range of group departures and bespoke luxury holidays. Specialising in both active adventure and experiential travel, we offer unique opportunities to explore the stunning Highlands and Islands of Scotland. Whether you're into hiking, cycling, and kayaking or prefer spending time with a local storyteller and being fitted for a kilt, there's something to suit everyone's interests. Rated Europe’s No.1 Adventure Travel Company by National Geographic magazine. Please contact us to find out more.

Title: Willow Tea Rooms
Description:
Established in 1983, the Willow Tea Rooms offers a traditional tea room experience in a Mackintosh inspired setting in Glasgow city centre, within walking distance of Glasgow Central and Queen Street train stations. 
Our new Edinburgh tea room is located on Princes Street, with panoramic views of Edinburgh Castle throughout and only a short walk from the Johnnie Walker Experience, the National Galleries of Scotland and Waverly train station.
With over 30 years’ experience welcoming large groups and FIT travellers, we provide efficient service, flexible group menus (can cater up to 50 guests) and competitive rates for both. Complimentary places are offered for drivers and guides.  All dietary requirements can be catered for.

Title: Thirlestane Castle
Description:
Thirlestane Castle is a magnificent 16th century castle set within the beautiful Lauderdale Estate in the Scottish Borders.
Historic home of the Duke of Lauderdale, the Castle is one of the oldest and finest in Scotland and still remains home to the Maitland family today. 
Exclusive use, guided tours and an impressive setting for weddings, corporate events and private dining.
Facilities:
- Afternoon Tea and lunches available
- Gift Shop
- Coach Parking
- State Rooms & rustic spaces 
- Gardens and Parkland for outdoor activities
- Luxury apartments with eight ensuite bedrooms for up to 16 people

Title: Finest Journeys
Description: Finest Journeys has been delivering luxury vacations with extraordinary and enriching experiences since 1984. Originally known as In Quest of the Classics based in San Diego Ca, the business re branded in 2014 to more accurately reflect what we do – we create journeys for travelers in Europe featuring the finest hotels, guides and experiences. Over the past 30+ years we have delivered memorable and outstanding Scottish journeys for thousands of discerning travelers on journeys of discovery.

Title: Magna World Ltd
Description: Magna World Ltd, a global DMC based in Scotland, specializes in creating unforgettable travel experiences for visitors worldwide. From Scotland’s breath taking landscapes to its rich cultural heritage, we ensure every journey is tailored to inspire and delight.

Title: Inverness Kart Raceway
Description: Inverness Kart Raceway is a five star awarded Activity Centre.  IKR for short is a purpose-built, fully modernised, indoor go-karting arena.  We are also a Social Enterprise with 100% of profits going to a local youth charity. We can cater for groups of all sizes, please contact us for details.

Title: Haggis Tours
Description: Guaranteeing an unforgettable experience in Scotland.  Based in Inverness we provide Bespoke Motorcycle Tours and Motorcycle Hire.  We provide all helmets and clothing as required along with bikes and tour itineraries.  We can guide you or leave you to explore our tours at your own pace.

Title: Scotscraig Golf Club
Description:
Welcome to Scotscraig GolfClub - the 13th oldest golf club
in the world. 
Scotscraig Golf Club offers visiting golfers an unforgettable experience at one of Scotland’s most respected courses.
Established in 1817 and a six-time former Open Qualifier venue, Scotscraig Golf Club combines the exhilaration of playing a traditional loop of heathland and links holes with a memorable welcome and post-round hospitality surrounded by fascinating golfing memorabilia.

Title: Blythswood House
Description: Located in Glasgow city centre, Blythswood House offers great value for money summer accommodation, ideal for individuals, families and groups looking to explore the city. The accommodation is spacious and fully furnished, and is made up of a number of self-catering flats with single en-suite bedrooms

Title: ScotRail ltd
Description:
ScotRail is the national rail operator for Scotland and covers the whole country. Our lines include such world-famous routes as the West Highland Line, Kyle Line, Far North Line & Borders Railway. 

We deliver over 90 million passenger journeys each year, run over 2000 train services daily and connect our passengers with great experiences, unforgettable journeys and new adventures.

•Discounts up to 30% for group bookings
•Onboard catering & wifi
•Fee free transaction & seat reservation

Title: Alba Game Fishing Ltd
Description: The only company covering fishing experiences across all of Scotland. Individuals, families, groups and corporate events.

Title: DoubleTree by Hilton Glasgow Central
Description: Nestled in the heart of the city centre, DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel Glasgow Central boasts 300 elegant guest rooms and suites. De-stress with a workout and a swim in our Juvenate Leisure Club,  take it easy with a drink in Cask Bar or dine in our sophisticated Brisket restaurant featuring fine beef from The Buccleuch estate. Host an event in one of our 11 flexible function rooms at this Glasgow hotel and let us help you make your event a success!

Title: The Rutland Apartments
Description: Offering bespoke and luxurious city centre apartments situated comfortably next to Edinburgh’s main shopping area with access to all tourist attractions. Cosseted by enviable views of Edinburgh Castle and with the historic beauty of the Capital right on its doorstep, it’s the ideal base for exploring Edinburgh.

Title: Browns Brasserie & Bar
Description:
Brown’s is housed in the iconic 130 year old ex-General Post Office building, the GPO headquarters until 1969, when it became the Post Office. Now it’s a stylishly decorated, relaxed brassiere and bar, perfect for morning coffee, lunch, dinner or cocktails in between exploring the many delights of Glasgow.  Our menu offers contemporary British brassiere dishes. We use only the best quality ingredients, and where possible, work with local suppliers. 
The venue is directly across from the City Chambers allowing ideal drop off spot for coaches and beautiful views over George Square.

Title: Cringletie
Description:
Cringletie is a 28-acre historic estate with a luxurious 13 bedroom castle-style hotel including an award winning 2 AA Rosette Restaurant just outside of Peebles in the Scottish Borders. 
Cringletie a historic 28-acre estate originally established in 1666 and features a listed Walled Garden from that era. The existing house - designed as a private residence by renowned architect David Bryce - was built in 1860, replacing the original house. It became a hotel in 1970.

Title: Abbotsford, the Home of Sir Walter Scott
Description: Abbotsford, the home that Sir Walter Scott built in his beloved Scottish Borders in the early 19th century, is the enduring legacy of one of the world’s greatest writers.  On the banks of the River Tweed, his Scottish Baronial creation lies at the heart of the stunning landscape which inspired the poetry and novels that introduced Scott – and Scotland – to the world.
