Our 5 star ‘Palace of the Imagination’ offers wonderful facilities – visitor centre, restaurant, nature walks, accommodation and of course Abbotsford House itself – a museum for living in.

Title: Glenfinnan House Hotel
Description: Located in the heart of the Scottish Highlands, Glenfinnan House is situated in its own grounds overlooking Loch Shiel, Ben Nevis and the Glenfinnan Monument.  This award winning establishment is renowned for its fine cuisine and hospitality and is ideal for a quiet retreat, romantic break, a walking/cycling or sightseeing holiday.

Title: Scottish Highland Trails
Description: Bespoke tours of Scotland from the Lowlands to the Highlands & Islands for individuals, couples, families and small groups.  General interest tours focusing on history and heritage; also whisky and food & drink tours a specialty.  Itineraries are flexible and tailored to your clients interests and budget. Self drive or chauffeur drive with professional, qualified STGA Blue Badge guides.

Title: The Castle and Gardens of Mey
Description: Set on the stunning Caithness coast, The Castle & Gardens of Mey is a spectacular historical site. The Castle offers a great day out for all the family with a tearoom, gift shop and animal centre. Guided tours are available to see how The Queen Mother spent her time here.

Title: NC500 Moto Experience
Description: NC500 Moto Experience is a motorbike hire company based in Inverness, in the Highlands of Scotland. Our aim is to provide a self-guided motorbike touring package by offering motorbikes and riding gear, to allow you to climb aboard for an unforgettable road trip. The memories will last a lifetime.

Title: Spirit Journeys Worldwide
Description: Spirit Journeys Worldwide is a tour operator/DMC based in Inverness, Scotland. We have 30 years’ experience in travel and have access to exclusive properties/guides/rates/tours that will make your clients travel a trip to remember. We offer bespoke tours for FITs, groups, weddings, events, golf, culinary, walking and much more.

Title: The Scottish Crannog Centre
Description:
The Scottish Crannog Centre is a unique, award-winning and interactive living history museum at Kenmore on the shores of Loch Tay and features an authentic reconstruction of an Iron Age loch dwelling based on excavation evidence from the 2,500 year old site of Oakbank Crannog at Fearnan, Loch Tay.
 
Costumed guides take visitors on a journey back through time into Scotland’s rich and exciting prehistory.

Title: Lochend Chalets
Description: Our award-winning, family-run for over 40 years self catering estate in the heart of Scotland has 17 chalets and 1 cottage.  Spectacular views over the Lake of Menteith, peaceful surroundings and perfect tour base for seeing Scotland.  95% TrustYou rating, TripAdvisor 5 Stars and over 50% repeat business.

Title: Caledonian Sleeper
Description: Caledonian Sleeper offers a unique overnight rail service between London and major Scottish destinations including Inverness, Glasgow, Edinburgh, and the Highlands. Guests can choose to travel in private rooms—ranging from Caledonian Double and Club rooms with ensuite showers to economical seating—arriving refreshed without airport queues or extra hotel nights. The Club Car serves locally sourced Scottish dishes. New for 2026, the service now calls at Birmingham International, providing direct links to Aberdeen, Fort William, and Inverness.

Title: Fairways Scotland
Description: Fairways Scotland specialise in luxury golf tours around Scotland. Whatever the desired trip, our professional and dedicated team is on hand to expertly craft a tour that is exclusive to your clients and ensure they have a truly unforgettable experience. From touch down to tee off we have everything covered, therefore if you need a ground handler with local knowledge please get in touch and we will be happy to help.

Title: Dundee Contemporary Arts
Description: DCA is an internationally renowned centre for contemporary art that enables audiences, artists and participants to see, experience and create. With two beautiful large-scale gallery spaces, two thriving cinema screens, a busy print studio, an award-winning learning programme, and a packed programme of events, workshops, classes and activities aimed at all ages and abilities, DCA is one of the most successful arts organisations in the UK.

Title: Pitlochry Dam Visitor Centre
Description: SSE's Pitlochry Dam Visitor Centre showcases the rich history of hydro electricity in the north of Scotland and how it transformed lives. On display are a number of fascinating artefacts that show how generations of homes have been transformed by electrical appliances. Visitors will meet the visionaries, such as Tom Johnston, who saw the untapped potential of hydro power in Scotland as well as hear the stories of the Hydro Boys and Tunnel Tigers. Café and Gift Shop on site.

Title: Palladium Executive Hire
Description: At Palladium Executive Hire we specialise in tours all over Scotland, we can accommodate from small groups to families in our range of Luxury Cars from our Mercedes V Class (7 seater).  Or if you require something more elegant for 2 or 4 passengers we can supply one of our Rolls Royce Phantom's, Bentley Flying Spur or one of our Mercedes S or E Class. Tours can compromise of anything from half day, full day or longer if required. Our Tours can be specified around your special interests such as Whisky, Golf and City.

Title: St Hilda Sea Adventures
Description:
St Hilda Sea Adventures provides small ship cruising and wildlife holidays on the beautiful West Coast of Scotland. Their cruises, among the breathtakingly beautiful islands, sea lochs and mountains of the Inner and Outer Hebrides, are truly unforgettable adventures for groups and solo travellers.

Their four, small cruise ships are St Hilda (maximum 6 passengers), Seahorse II (maximum 11 passengers), Gemini Explorer (maximum 8 passengers) and Speideren (maximum 8 passengers). St Hilda is a traditional, wooden ex-Tall Ship. Seahorse II is an ex-Norwegian Ferry. Gemini Explorer is an ex-Cruising Lifeboat. Speideren is an ex-Norwegian rescue ship. All four ships have been converted to cruise the western islands of Scotland in comfort and style.

Title: Loch Lomond & Cowal Way
Description: The Loch Lomond & Cowal Way is a truly outstanding 57 mile tourism path based in the south west Highlands of Scotland, and less than 1 hour’s drive from Glasgow International Airport. Known as “Scotland in 57 miles” this Scotland’s Great Trail offers outstanding scenery, engaging heritage, an abundance of wildlife and Scottish hospitality. Over 100 service companies - including a National Park, historic sites, accommodation, eating places, shops and outdoor activities

Title: Select Travel Service
Description: Look after groups only inbound to Scotland (UK and Ireland). Several senior staff members are Scottish and we have operated group trips to Scotland for over 30 years. Excellent at special interest groups. Faith based groups, performing groups, garden groups and some very specialist subjects for both leisure and MICE. All offers are nett so you can add your own commission!

Title: Waldorf Astoria Edinburgh - The Caledonian
Description:
Waldorf Astoria Edinburgh - The Caledonian has embodied the best in Scottish hospitality for over 100 years. Situated on Princes Street, the hotel nestles in the shadow of the historic Edinburgh Castle.
With two exquisite restaurants – The Pompadour by Galvin and Galvin Brasserie de Luxe – luxurious bedrooms with the most castle facing views of any hotel in Edinburgh, Waldorf Astoria Edinburgh is the perfect for groups, conferences and events providing a magical setting for a special visit.

Title: Doubletree by Hilton Dunblane Hydro
Description: Only 40 minutes from Edinburgh and Glasgow, 15 minutes from historic Stirling, DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel Dunblane Hydro, a Victorian style hotel, offers 200 guest rooms nestled in a 10 acre estate in the countryside. Dining is available in The Kailyard by Nick Nairn and private dining is also available with menus from our famous Scottish chef. The hotel has a choice of bars and lounges with stunning views, WiFi, a breakfast buffet, indoor pool, whirlpool, beauty treatments, and fitness room.

Title: National Mining Museum Scotland
Description: Just 8 miles from Edinburgh is the Lady Victoria Colliery, the finest surviving Victorian colliery in Europe, here we tell the story of coal for Scotland. Through two floors of exhibitions, interactives and 4 tour options, retrace the footsteps of thousands of miners and their families. Our café is open 7 days a week and offers a superb range of hot and cold snack, speciality coffee and freshly baked cakes. Upon request we can offer catering for up to 100 people this includes a hot buffet.

Title: Carberry Tower Mansion House and Estate
Description: A 30-bedroom luxury castle hotel within easy reach of Edinburgh city centre, including four exclusive four-bedroom Estate Houses. Ideal for group stays or full exclusive use, it features an on-site restaurant and elegant event spaces for Scottish evenings and private dining. Set in extensive grounds, the venue is perfect for outdoor activities such as mini Highland Games, archery and laser clay shooting.
Address Line 1: Carberry Tower Mansion House and Estate

Title: Ballindalloch Trust
Description: Stunning Ballindalloch Castle, family home of the Macpherson-Grants since 1546, is situated on the A95 between Aviemore and Elgin, and welcomes both groups and individual visitors.  Open Easter until 30 September, daily except Saturdays, ample car and coach parking, tearoom (50+ covers), golf course, distillery tours (max 8 persons), home of the Aberdeen Angus cattle breed. Enquiries for private dinners, fishing, shooting, product launches, film and photo shoots are also welcome.

Title: Walking Tours in Scotland
Description:
Walking Tours in Scotland is a unique walking tour company built by locals, operating tours in Edinburgh, Glasgow, St Andrews, Inverness, Stirling, Aberdeen & Oban. We're a small company with a big mission; giving visitors the chance to visit UK's cities and towns with local, passionate guides.
 From walking tours to step-on guides, our team are ready to help you organise the most memorable experiences for your clients. To arrange a tour, please send us an email with your requirements.

Title: Tennent's Brewery
Description:
Wellpark Brewery in Glasgow is home to more than 450 years of brewing tradition and award winning beers. Our new tour takes you behind the scenes to discover how we make Tennent's so special.

We've been part of Scotland and its culture for generations. This is a chance to learn about the rich heritage of one of the country's most loved brands as well as about the production processes that have taken place at Wellpark from through the centuries up to today.

Follow us from the very origins of brewing at Wellpark, to present day support of and passion for Scottish music and football. As well as a rare collection of vintage and retro Tennent's packaging, there's a chance to watch your favourite Tennent's adverts from over the decades and also a shop to buy exclusive Tennent's goodies... And to top it all off, there might even be a cheeky wee taste of Scotland's Favourite at the end of the tour for you. Tasty.

Title: Mackays Hotel
Description: Our award-winning hotel has been lovingly cared for by the same family for over 60 years. Located on the shortest street in the world, high standards, 30 comfortable bedrooms, self-catering accommodation and the finest locally sourced cuisine from our AA Rosette restaurant awaits you at Mackays Hotel in Wick.

Title: Perle Oban Hotel
Description: Perle Oban Hotel is a luxury hotel in the heart of Oban. This property has experienced a multi-million pound renovation and features a restaurant, bar and café. Each of the 60 rooms contain luxury touches such as Bose sound systems, Egyptian cotton sheets and L'Occitane toiletries

Title: Loch Melfort Hotel
Description:
A unique 4-star Country House Hotel by the sea – roaring log fires and spectacular coastal scenery to explore.
Set in 17 acres of gardens and beach on the romantic coast of Argyll in the Scottish Highlands, it is the perfect place to relax and unwind. We offer a range of 30 comfortable and luxury rooms, most with fantastic sea views.
Fine dining and Bistro style dishes are available in our Restaurant – we source fresh and local produce, well-cooked and well-presented by our excellent team of chefs.

Title: Hilton Glasgow
Description: Situated in the heart of Glasgow city centre just 15 minutes from Glasgow International Airport, Hilton Glasgow offers landscape views from our 319 guest rooms. Host your next meeting or event in our impressive event spaces for up to 1,000 delegates. Start your day right in Morblas with a Scottish breakfast featuring local specialties and in the evening indulge on a variety of seasonal dishes. Spend your evening in Connich Bar or unwind at our LivingWell Health Club with an indoor pool and spa.

Title: Library of Innerpeffray
Description:
Small, special and a heritage treasure trove: Scotland’s first lending library is a museum with a difference.  Our elegant 18th century building, beside the River Earn in gorgeous rural Perthshire lets you step back in time. In our utterly unique Borrowers’ Register, visitors from all over the world find their ancestors. 
We offer bespoke, personal tours for lovers of history, culture and of course, books.  Perfect for small tours, study trips and people looking for ‘something different’.

Title: Livingston Lodge Hotel
Description: Just 13 miles from Scotland’s capital Edinburgh, in the heart of Livingston, The Livingston Lodge Hotel has 20 en-suite hotel rooms with shower and free Wi-Fi internet access. Free and ample on- site parking is also available. The Livingston Lodge Hotel incorporates the Phoenix I Restaurant which serves oriental fusion cuisine, guests can also dine at the local award-winning Oscar’s Bar and Grill.

Title: Exquisite Tours
Description: We offer luxury guided day tours and long distance transfers from Edinburgh and Glasgow. Using our new 2017 Mercedes V-class with full leather trim and complimentary soft drinks. All day trip prices include admission to attractions for guests and prices start from £400 per day max group size 7 persons.

Title: Delta Hotel
Description:
A modern 4 star hotel with full leisure facilities, restaurant, bar and complimentary parking.
Ideal for touring Edinburgh with easy access to Edinburgh Zoo, Edinburgh Castle, Palace of Holyrood House, Royal Yacht Britannia and all the main tourist attractions of Edinburgh.

**Only 2 miles from Edinburgh International Airport**

Title: Macdonald Resorts & Hotels
Description: Macdonald Hotels & Resorts brings you elegance, style and unique personal service. We are a collection of over 40 individual hotels throughout the UK, Ireland, Spain and Portugal. Individual not only in location, from bustling city centres to picturesque countryside, but also in style, from boutique hotels to country houses and spa retreats.

Title: Ecosse-Ev
Description:
Ecosse EV - Scotland's First Tesla Electric Rental Service

Ecosse EV has launched a Tesla Electric Chauffeur Drive and Self Drive Hire service in Central Scotland which will serve Edinburgh and Glasgow airports and leading Scottish hotels.

We take pride in providing Premier customer service, because we want you to have the ultimate experience, nothing is too much trouble for our friendly professional team.

Title: A. D. Rattray's Whisky Experience & Whisky Shop
Description: A. D. Rattray's Whisky Experience & Shop is a unique 5 star visitor attraction. Drop in for a free informal visit or book our private tasting room for a guided tasting of Scotland’s finest whiskies or craft gins. Larger groups can use our venue on an exclusive use basis or our tasting hosts can bring the experience to you, providing private tastings or drink receptions at another venue. Our range of whisky and gin gifts can be personalised for your event and delivered throughout the UK.

Title: Nc'nean Distillery
Description: Ncn’ean is a young independent whisky distillery on the Morvern peninsula. Focused on creating new flavours and sustainable production, the distillery is open Monday-Friday. We offer one tour per day of around 15 people (larger tours available on request). These include cupcakes, cocktails and, on some tours, lunch.

Title: Ibis Styles Glasgow Centre George Square
Description:
We're ideally located at the heart of Glasgow city centre. Just a short walk away from iconic attractions such as Buchanan Galleries, The Style Mile, The Glasgow Concert Hall and the Hydro Arena or you clients can head to the Merchant City for some arts and culture. 
We welcome adhoc groups on a bed & continental breakfast basis. Dinner options are available at a supplement with one of our preferred local restaurants.We offer complimentary WiFi, teas/coffees and pastries/fruit all day every day.

Title: Lip na Cloiche Garden & Nursery
Description: Lip na Cloiche is a densely-planted coastal garden and nursery on a steep slope with stunning views over Loch Tuath, the Isle of Ulva and the Teshnish Isles. The mild climate permits many exotic and unusual varieties to flourish. Interest is added by the incorporation of driftwood and found objects. A wide range of herbaceous perennials and shrubs are on sale, all propagated on site, together with crafts and cards made from beachcombed materials..

Title: Easdale Island Museum
Description: Easdale Island Folk Museum is situated on Easdale Island near Oban in Argyll on the west coast of Scotland. The island gained in prominance during the 18th century with the rise of the slate industry after the Earl of Breadalbane set up the Marble and Slate Quarrying Company of Netherlorn to exploit the local Easdale Slate.The folk museum has well designed displays depicting a range of topics from the slate industry, army volunteers, education, and public health to geology, boats, and entertainment.There are genealogical records for the Kilbrandon and Kilchattan parish as well as rent books, Masonic records, and a map of Easdale Island circa 1881 on hard copy.

Title: Ellister Lodge, Islay
Description:
Ellister Lodge is a modern, elevated house with superb views over Loch Indaal. With comfortable, well-appointed accommodation and excellent facilities, 
near Islay's pretty seaside village of Port Charlotte. 3 double/twin rooms each have their own shower/bathroom. A study/bedroom sleeps two, with its own cloakroom. Ellister Lodge has a large family kitchen/dining room with both electric and solid-fuel Esse cookers, a wood-burning stove, extensive decking, access ramps and parking for four cars.

Title: Carradale Golf Club
Description: Carradale Golf Club, founded in 1906, is regarded by many as one of the Golf Course gems in Scotland yet fairly unknown.  Located on the east coast of the Kintyre peninsula with panoramic views across the Kilbrannan Sound towards the Isle of Arran. Although only a 9-hole course, it is a tricky course with small greens and natural hazards which can test even the experienced golfer. It has been described as the ‘most sporting nine-hole course in Scotland’. The 6th hole (Pudding Bowl) has recently featured on the Signature Special Hole Golf website.

Title: Platinum Golf Scotland
Description: Platinum Golf Scotland is an inbound Golf Tour Operator providing luxury golf holidays to Scotland. Our vast knowledge of the golf tourism industry helps provide the perfect golfing holiday at the same time as showcasing all the Heritage, History and Hospitality Scotland has to offer. We also provide golf and whisky tours for those clients who wish to indulge in a whisky experience as part of their golf holiday.

Title: The Galley of Lorne Inn
Description: The Galley of Lorne Inn is one of the highest rated Inns on Tripadvisor for the Argyll area.  Located between Oban & Lochgilphead, just 2 hours drive from Scotland's central belt, guests can base themselves here for a romantic break, an adventure holiday or just a relaxing escape from life's everyday hustle and bustle.  With 7 cosy bedrooms, a restaurant with lounge bar alongside a traditional public bar, the Galley is a great choice for a touring holiday of Scotland.

Title: Sandford Country Cottages
Description: Luxury 1, 2 and 3 bedroom cottages and apartments in a courtyard setting which is part of a 'B' Listed Arts and Crafts house. Only 5 miles from Dundee and 10 miles from St Andrews our location is ideal for visiting the new V&A museum opening 2018, golfing, cycling, walking sightseeing, eating out and shopping. Peaceful countryside setting with views of the River Tay. Visit Scotland 5 Stars (2024/25) and over 50% return visitors.

Title: Northern Supercar Hire Ltd
Description:
Northern Ferrari Hire offers a range of Supercars on a self-drive basis. The supercar range includes Ferrari, Aston Martin, Lamborghini, Audi and others. Cars can be hired for any period from 24 hours to weeks. Fully comprehensive insurance is included, and cars can be delivered and collected from destinations throughout the UK.

Northern Ferrari Hire was established in 2006, and has an excellent reputation as an industry leader in customer care.

Title: Glasgow Green Apartments
Description:
At Glasgow Green Apartments we have a portfolio of 12 apartments offering 1, 2, or 3 bedrooms allowing us to cater for up to 6 colleagues in our 3 bedroom apartment.
Each of our apartments are modern, spacious, fully furnished, and all within easy reach of the city centre, the cities motorways, and business districts.

Flexible payment options
Unlimited fast fibre WiFi
Parking
SMART TV's & Heating
Personal meet and greet
Welcome Pack

We offer a personal, direct and a friendly service.

Title: HAMILTON & INCHES
Description:
Hamilton & Inches is Edinburgh’s foremost destination for fine jewellery, luxury watches and handcrafted silver. As all our pieces are produced by our in-house workshops, we would be delighted to take you on a private behind-the-scenes tour to share this destination steeped in history. 
Home to a team of highly skilled craftspeople, we continue to offer a range of specialist in-house services, and as an official Rolex retailer, are proud to be the only Rolex accredited service centre in Edinburgh.

Title: Seafari Adventures (Oban)
Description:
Seafari Adventures are Oban's 5* Visit Scotland (2024/25) marine wildlife tour operator. Based in Easdale, 16 miles south of Oban we have a fleet of powerful RIBs which are purpose designed and built to ensure you maximum viewing opportunities.
Tours depart throughout the day visiting the Gulf of Corryvreckan, home of the World's Third Largest Whirlpool.  Porpoise, dolphins and whales feed in and around these food rich waters along with seals and Sea Eagles.

Title: Scone Palace
Description:
Scone Palace, abundant in history and heritage. We invite you to walk in the footsteps of our ancient ancestors and stand where once 42 of our Scottish kings were crowned on the famous Stone of Scone, also known as the Stone of Destiny. Explore the vast grounds in which the Palace sits, rich in their own magnificent history. This splendid historic location caters for both group and FIT visitors, exclusive use, private dining and events. Fishing, shooting, product launches, film and photo shoot location enquiries are invited. 
In addition, luxury self-catering accommodation in the west wing and exclusive use of the private wing of the Palace are also available.

Title: Active Outdoor Pursuits
Description:
Active Outdoor Pursuits delivers memorable outdoor experiences for schools, youth groups, educational travel providers, tour operators and destination management companies. 
We can support packaged itineraries, programme planning and trade-rate discussions. Options include day activities, multi-day river and mountain journeys, and residential multi-activity programmes. Delivery is backed by AALA licensing, qualified instructors and more than 25 years’ experience.. Packaged itinerary and programme-planning support. Residential programmes from 2–4 nights, with longer options available. Trade pricing discussed directly and tailored to programme requirements. Month-by-month availability supplied on request by the office team. Full technical equipment provided for programmed activities.

Title: Iain Burnett Highland Chocolatier
Description: The Highland Chocolatier is a 4 Star Visitor Attraction awarded the Best Food & Drink Visitor Attraction in Scotland. Chocolate Tours & Tastings can be reserved for 2-50 people. Discover the small Chocolate Exhibition, relax in the Chocolate Lounge or browse the Chocolate Shop to taste why Iain Burnett's is one of Europe's most awarded Master Chocolatier's. Iain's Velvet Truffles have twice been awarded Best Truffle in the World!  On the main road 5 minutes off the A9 in beautiful Grandtully.

Title: Crieff Hydro
Description: Arguably the most comprehensive family resort in Scotland, 4 star Crieff Hydro is centrally located in its own 900 acre estate with an unrivaled range of leisure pursuits for all ages. Choose from over 40 on-site leisure activities and take advantage of inclusive daily childcare for 2-12 year olds in the 700m2 kids club. Extensively redeveloped from top to bottom, Crieff Hydro is only an hours drive from both Glasgow and Edinburgh.

Title: JacTravel
Description:
Helping travel businesses grow through destination expertise.
Celebrating 50 years, JacTravel is a leading European Destination Management Company providing Group and FIT travel services to the international travel trade. With offices in Dublin, Edinburgh, Palma, Cluj, and London, supported by a global remote team, we’ve been a specialist brand of WebBeds since 2017.
We support your group and FIT business, offering competitive rates for accommodation, guiding, transportation, and more—whether it’s a city break, touring itinerary, or special interest programme.

Title: Peebles Hydro
Description: If you’re looking for a charming hotel in Peebles, look no further than Peebles Hydro.  Peebles Hydro is in the heart of the Tweed Valley in the Scottish Borders, and has been welcoming guests for over 150 years. The hotel has 30 acres of grounds too – perfect for a stroll before dinner. Your whole group can dine together in one stunning dining space; there’s also a cosy bar and a modern swimming pool.  The Hotel has recently undergone a full refurbishment and offers 132 ensuite bedrooms.  The capital city of Edinburgh is only 24 miles away making this the perfect place for a day trip.

Title: Murray Park Hotel
Description: The Murraypark is a modern yet homely hotel offering 21 rooms a bar, restaurant, beer garden and free access to their sister hotel's leisure facilities. In the morning, a full Scottish breakfast is available and guests can sample local produce. Hearty meals and snacks freshly prepared by their Head Chef are available for lunch and dinner. Each room has an en-suite bathroom with bath and shower over.  Crieff Golf Course is a 10 minute walk away from The Murraypark and the Auchengarrich Wildlife Centre is a 15 minute drive away. Stirling Castle can be visited a 45 minute drive away.

Title: Ballachulish Hotel
Description: Welcome to the Ballachulish Hotel, a friendly, cosy place to stay. Having recently undergone a full refurbishment, all the 53 bedrooms at the Ballachulish Hotel offer modern decor, inspired by all that the West Highlands has to offer. With free wifi, a private carpark and all the home comforts you would expect in a hotel break, the Ballachulish Hotel is a great place to stay and explore the local area. With munros on our doorstep, views as far as the eye can see and the use of leisure facilities at our sister hotel, Isles of Glencoe. Soak up the views of Loch Linnhe while tucking into the the finest seafood. Locally sourced and lovingly prepared by our chefs, our FISH restaurant is the perfect spot to enjoy a relaxing dinner.

Title: Electric Bikes Scotland Cycle Centre
Description: At EBS Cycle Centre we provide a range of bikes (traditional/electric/tandem/cargo)  for hire.  Also included are all accessories such as helmets, baskets, pannier bags, maps and disposable poncho's.  All bikes are serviced by our in-house technician.  We also offer a full drop off/pick up service from hotels etc.  Cycling would be a great way for travellers to explore the local area and beyond as we have a 26 mile green circular cycle route round the city as well as other routes in the area.

Title: Kilted Piper Tours
Description: Kilted Piper Tours offers premium private tours throughout Scotland led by native Scot and bagpiper Graeme Clive. Specialising in bespoke heritage experiences, we create personalised itineraries exploring clan history, whisky, and Scotland's most iconic destinations. Popular with clients from Canada, USA, Australia and worldwide seeking authentic cultural connections. Graeme guides all tours in traditional Highland dress. Based in Largs, serving departures from Glasgow, Edinburgh, and St Andrews. Tours accommodate up to 8 guests; larger groups on application.

Title: The Aberdeen Altens Hotel
Description: Ideally located just 2.5 miles south of Aberdeen city centre and 10 miles from Aberdeen International Airport, The Aberdeen Altens Hotel is a great base for groups to explore Aberdeen and Aberdeenshire.  We offer spacious rooms all with ensuite bathrooms and fast free WiFi.  Our leisure facilities include a gym, indoor pool, sauna and steam room.  We have an informal Bar and Restaurant. We have ample complimentary car parking suitable for several coaches.

Title: The Corner House Hotel
Description: The Corner House Hotel is a well-established, family-run hotel based in the centre of the small Scottish town of Annan. The hotel is a traditional sandstone building with all the modern amenities our guests would require. Located just off the M74, our location is ideal for visitors to Dumfries and Galloway, the Central Belt (Glasgow and Edinburgh), Gretna Green and beautiful Solway Coast. We are a popular destination for a number of outdoor activities such as cycling, fishing, walking and golfing. With 18 en-suite Bedrooms all with flat screen TV’s, tea and coffee facilities. Guests and visitors have access to our seamless WiFi in all areas of the hotel.

Title: Springkell
Description:
At Springkell we would love to welcome your guests for lunch, for tea, for dinner, to stay and/or to take a tour of our fabulous 16 acre gardens.  Just 2 miles from the M74, in Dumfries-shire, with lots of free parking Springkell has evolved from an exclusive use Wedding Venue into a Luxury Hotel that also offers exclusive use events including Weddings. 
Privately owned we pride ourselves in a very personal service and delicious food.  Our chefs are superb and we are Five Star Rated on TripAdvisor and Facebook.

Title: Galloway Cycling Holidays
Description: South West Scotland, a cyclist paradise of quiet roads coast and rolling hills. We are one of the premier cycling holiday company in Scotland, with some of the best routes, the most comfortable hotels and B&Bs and some of the finest cafes to stop at. You are guided by cue sheet, map and smartphone app or lead by us through miles of quiet lanes. Stay at our hub in the Artist town of Kirkcudbright and pick your routes every day. Or a tour of 3 to 10 days with your luggage taken ahead. You will love it.

Title: Gretna Hall
Description: Gretna Hall, Historic Marriage House was built in 1710 as a manor house for the Johnstone family. Now part of the Gretna Green - Sine 1754 family business, it boasts 97 en suite bedrooms, Anvil restaurant, along with a comfortable bar & lounge with a real open fire. Situated in the heart of Gretna Green on 10 acres of landscaped gardens it is ideally located just off the M6/M74 making it the perfect location for coach travel for an overnight stay, lunch stop or a four night break.

Title: The Kings Arms Hotel
Description:
The Kings Arms Hotel and Courtyard Restaurant is an ideal base in Dumfries & Galloway. We offer a warm welcome to: Golfers, Cyclists, Motor-Bikers, Bird Watchers, Walkers.  Golf Itineraries can be arranged by the Golfing proprietor - enjoy our exclusive Play the Best Deal rates - 2 nights Dinner BB & 1 round of golf on Southerness/Powfoot & Dumfries & County courses, subject to availability.
Central to the '7 Stanes' for Mountain Biking trails, plus coastal & natural trails. A chance to see wildlife such as Barnacles and Red Kites. Great access for walks on Merrick or Screel.

Title: Dumfries Museum and Camera Obscura
Description: A treasure house of history in Dumfries and Galloway, Dumfries Museum tells the story of the land and people of the region, from fossil footprints to Victorian technology. The world's oldest working Camera Obscura is on the top floor of the windmill tower. From it, you can see a fascinating panoramic view of Dumfries and the surrounding countryside. The Museum holds frequent special exhibitions, and has a Museum shop. The Camera cannot operate in wet weather, please check for opening times.

Title: Robert Burns Centre Dumfries
Description: Situated in the town's eighteenth century watermill on the west bank of the River Nith, the Robert Burns Centre tells the story of Robert Burns' last years spent in the bustling streets and lively atmosphere of Dumfries in the late eighteenth century. The exhibition is illuminated by many original manuscripts and belongings of the poet. In the evening, the Centre is a film theatre, showing the best in contemporary and world cinema. Café and shop.

Title: Robert Burns' Ellisland Farm
Description:
Ellisland was built in 1788 by Robert Burns' for his family and is considered the 'Poets Choice' for it's idyllic walks and scenery of the Nith. Little has changed since Burns' lived here and it is considered one of the most authentic Burns sites. 
When you visit you can see the landscape that inspired Burns as well as the room where he wrote the likes of his famous 'Auld Lang Syne'. We also have a museum section containing some of Burns' items and an informative video.
From 2022 onwards the trust is offering a specialist 'Dram and Bannock' tour led by a local story teller. This involves local food and drink and an expert guide, the minimum number in a group is 10. Visits begin with our 15 minute introductory movie, then a visit to the museum that houses many of his possessions and then visit the kitchen and spence of Robert's house.

Title: Caledonian Railway
Description:
Located just off the A90, 30 minutes from Dundee and 40 minutes from Aberdeen, the Caledonian Railway is an entirely volunteer operated Heritage Steam Railway based in the small town of Brechin on the East Coast of Scotland.
We offer a wide variety of services perfectly suited for group visits, with group discounts and private charters available. We have a range of catering options provided by our café at Brechin station, including Afternoon Teas and Light Lunches, all made using locally sourced ingredients. Free on-site car and coach parking also available at Brechin station.

Title: Cuil an Daraich Guest House
Description: The Cuil An Daraich Guest House offers a warm, friendly home from home atmosphere. Situated just 5 miles from Pitlochry we enjoy peaceful countryside views whilst being within easy reach of Pitlochry itself. We have a variety of rooms catering for solo travellers to family groups, which are all ensuite with a range of modern facilities. The breakfast room has views over the River Tay, breakfast is a combination of continental and cooked offering something for everyone. We are also pet friendly.

Title: St Andrews Luxury Travel
Description: St Andrews Luxury Travel offer a premium transport service for all types of clients. The main services that we offer include airport transfers, private client tours throughout Scotland, golf transportation, gallery visits, distillery tours and festive shopping trips to the Christmas markets of Edinburgh and Glasgow. Our aim is to offer all our clients a top of the range service.

Title: Airport taxi transfers
Description:
Professional airport transfers service from Edinburgh and Glasgow Airport to central Scotland and the Highlands. Online booking and payment for national and international customers .
Day tours to the Kelpies, Braveheart , castles , St Andrews and Outlander film locations with free pickup from your hotel or airport.

Title: Duns Castle Estate
Description: Duns Castle is a private home dating from 1320 and an idyllic venue available for exclusive-use bookings (sleeps 23 in 12 rooms and seats 60 for dinner). The 1200-acre estate, 1 hour south of Edinburgh, features its own nature reserve, extensive forest trails and 6 holiday cottages (sleeping a further 26 guests). The star property of HomeAway’s recent global marketing campaign, Duns Castle was awarded "Venue of the Year" and "Customer Experience of the Year" at the 2017 Scottish Event Awards.

Title: Go Golf Scotland
Description: Bespoke Golf Trips to Scotland including Whisky Tours and visits to Castle, Cities and glens throughout Scotland

Title: Buxa Farm Chalets & Croft House
Description: One of three Norwegian style semi-detached wooden chalets and recently renovated croft house, self-catering accommodation. Waterfront properties on 20 acres of unspoilt land, under the Rural Stewardship scheme to preserve bird life. Central location to all tourist attractions. Open all year. Free Hi-speed satellite Wi-Fi. Perfect for group bookings (2-20) and parking for cars and/or coaches. VisitScotland four star Award, VisitScotland Children Welcome Award (2024/25). TripAdvisor Certificate of Excellence 2022. Booking.com 9.7 award.

Title: Crowne Plaza Edinburgh - Royal Terrace
Description:
This 4-star luxury hotel is on a quiet tree-lined street, 550 yards from Edinburgh Waverley Rail Station and Princes Street. It has a modern gym.The en suite rooms have a flat-screen satellite TV, free Wi-Fi, and music. Some rooms look out towards the Firth of Forth, and many overlook the hotel's own beautiful gardens.
The modern Terrace Brasserie has access to the gardens and offers casual, bistro-style cuisine made with the freshest local produce. A snack menu is served in the bar.

Title: ScotBeer Tours
Description: Unique beer experiences telling the story of Scotland through beer from the 12th century through today's craft beer renaissance. Once the largest exporter of bottle beer in the world, Scotland's brewing heritage is second to none and today's brewers are producing some of the finest beers in the world. ScotBeer Tours collaborates with breweries, specialist bars and restaurants to deliver walking tours, tasting masterclasses, brewery tours and multi stop bus itineraries.

Title: Forth Boat Tours
Description:
Our daily tours include magnificent views of the new Queensferry Crossing, the Forth Road Bridge and the world-famous UNESCO World Heritage Forth Railway Bridge. 
In addition, your clients can take in the beautiful panoramas of the Edinburgh skyline, the Kingdom of Fife and the historic island of Inchcolm with its medieval Abbey.  As part of the tour we stop at the island to drop off and pick up visitors.

Title: Robert Burns House Dumfries
Description:
In this simple sandstone house in a quiet Dumfries street, Robert Burns, Scotland's national poet, spent the last years of his brilliant life. He died here in 1796 at the age of thirty-seven. The house gives us a picture of how the poet and his family lived in the late eighteenth century and is now a place of pilgrimage for Burns admirers the world over.
Your clients can see his desk and chair in his study, the famous Kilmarnock editions of his work and many original manuscripts & belongings of the poet.   

Bespoke tours can be arrange in advance (depending on availability) to the Robert Burns Mausoleum on request.  These can include a guided talk. 

Gift shop on site

Title: Caledonia Park
Description: Welcome to Caledonia Park – a new brand and a new beginning at Gretna Gateway. We’re committed to creating the best designer shopping experience in Scotland, and to being a strong partner in our local community. We’re investing in a dramatic refurbishment, and today we unveil a beautiful new brand to match. Now, as we look ahead to the creation of the Star of Caledonia next year, we’re excited to make our own mark on South Scotland as Caledonia Park. We hope to see your visitors very soon!

Title: Ambassador Hotel
Description: Welcome to the Ambassador Hotel, a 26-room boutique residence situated in the heart of Glasgow’s popular West End and minutes from Byres Road. Just 1 mile from the city centre, our accommodation provides a convenient base for your clients stay in the city. We’re within easy reach of the M8 motorway and underground stations, perfect for those staying for both business and leisure who need easy access to transport links but don’t want to compromise on comfort. Free On site car park

Title: Albion Hotel
Description: The Albion Hotel provides fantastic 3-star accommodation just one mile from Glasgow city centre. Our location affords us the best the area has to offer with Byres Road and the West End a short stroll away, whilst enjoying tranquil surroundings for the ultimate in relaxation.

Title: Kelvingrove Hotel
Description: Set in the heart of trendy Finnieston and less than 1 mile from the city centre, the Kelvingrove Hotel provides superb 3-star accommodation close to all of Glasgow’s amenities. Having been awarded a TripAdvisor Certificate of Excellence, you can be sure your clients will receive the high quality hospitality in our friendly, family-run hotel, allowing them to truly relax and enjoy the city at its best.

Title: Acorn Hotel
Description: The Acorn Hotel is a boutique, 3-star residence perfectly situated between Glasgow City Centre and the West End. Just a stone’s throw from the picturesque Kelvingrove Park, our hotel is one of the best for weekends away, theatre breaks or longer stays.

Title: The Clydeside Distillery
Description: Glasgow's stills are flowing again at the Clydeside Single Malt Scotch Whisky Distillery. Come down to the Queen's Dock and watch our craftsmen distil pure new spirit by hand, the time-honoured way. You'll find more than you'd expect, with so many of Scotland's finest single malts to enjoy in our Whisky Shop and Whisky Tasting. You can even immerse yourself in Glasgow history as you wander around our fascinating Dockside Story.

Title: Blervie House
Description:
Blervie House offers a unique five star experience providing all the benefits of the twenty-first century but the elegance of bygone era. 
With a Silver Green Tourism Award and 12 rooms accommodating up to 23 people situated on a rural estate thirty minutes from Inverness Blervie makes the perfect base for exploring Loch Ness, the Cairngorms National Park, Culloden and the Malt Whisky trail. 
Blervie is perfect for FIT travellers, small groups. Dining, Whisky Tasting, Piper all available by pre-arrangement.

Title: Roseisle Luxury Campervans
Description:
At Roseisle, we take pride in the fact that we have become one of Scotland's leading luxury campervan and motorhome hire companies.
With one of the best fleet of vehicles in the country, all of which are manufactured in Germany, under 18 months old and maintained to the highest standard, our customers are always guaranteed a comfortable and stylish campervan.
Our 5* rating on Trustpilot and social media reviews are a testimony to the standard of service and quality of vehicles we offer.
Our mission is to help create a truly remarkable Scottish experience, one which you will wish to repeat or share with others.

Title: 1st Class Chauffeuring Scotland Ltd
Description:
'Highlands and Speyside whisky tours accompanied by a guide with EWA approved  diploma in Single Malt Whisky.' High quality chauffeur service, ideal for sightseeing tours, golfing parties, weddings and all other special occasions.  Some tour options: Queensferry crossing with views of the Forth Rail Bridge, The Hermitage, Black Linn Falls, Cathedral town of  Dunkeld, Lunch (optional) in Dunkeld House Hotel, Queen's View, Kenmore, Taymouth Castle, Edinburgh. 
Linlithgow, the Kelpies, Wallace monument, Callander, Bracklinn Falls, Doune Castle, Lake of Menteith, Edinburgh and the West Coast of Scotland.

Title: Di Maggio's Restaurant Group
Description: Di Maggio's Restaurant Group has been in business for over a quarter of a century and owns 16 venues in Glasgow, 5 in Edinburgh and 3 in Aberdeen. From contemporary Italian to authentic Spanish tapas, Grill restaurants to French cuisine, all venues are available to hire for private dining or corporate events, with maximum capacity of 350. Our dedicated Events team are here to consult and advise on suitable venues and to ensure that the perfect menu is created for any event within your budget.

Title: L.R.Executive Travel
Description: L R Executive Travel boasts 20 years experience providing chauffeur and travel services across Scotland. Operating Executive Mercedes 16 seat Mini Coaches, and Luxury Volkswagen People Carriers, Range Rover & VW 4x4, LR Executive Travel offers personal and corporate touring in Scotland. Vehicles are high specification and discreet, and our services include; golfing tours , fishing/hunting holidays, and Castle's, Lochs and Glens tours. LR Executive can also provide a Driver/Guide service.

Title: Cobble Tales Architecture Tours
Description:
Private ARCHITECTURAL walking tours lead by local architecture graduates. 3 hour Itineraries in Old Town, New Town and Dean Village of Edinburgh. Designed for urban explorers, architecture lovers and inquisitive minds. We speak in Mandarin, French, Russian and Lithuanian upon request. Maximum booking up to 40 guests.
Custom prices for large groups, can arrange catering in places of architectural merit to suit the tour.

Title: Willowgate Activity Centre
Description: Willowgate is based on the shores of the River Tay, the centre offers a mix of off the shelf and bespoke / private tours and experiences. These including Kayaking or Paddleboarding your way through Perth City Centre, taking part in traditional Scottish activities, throwing axes or taking part in laser clay shooting. The centre also offer activities offsite around Scotland to meet the needs of your guests.

Title: Blue Kiwi Photography
Description:
Blue Kiwi Photography is pleased to announce the new Glencoe Photography Tour. 
Our Glencoe Photography Tour offers some fabulous photographic opportunities that will delight professional and amateur photographers of all levels.

Capture the mighty Falls of Falloch and the still waters of the Rannoch Moor, finishing the day at the mystical Glencoe Valley before sampling fresh local cuisine at an award-winning Scottish Highland restaurant.

Title: Belmond Royal Scotsman
Description:
Departing from Edinburgh, Belmond Royal Scotsman takes just 40 guests to the heart of the Highlands, on journeys of two to seven-nights.

Life on board is relaxed yet indulgent with inclusive excursions, private en-suite cabins, world-class cuisine and beverages included. An intimate, country-house atmosphere prevails, making life on board an unparalleled pleasure.

Charter the train for the ultimate celebration or event and tailor each moment to your liking.

Title: Manderston
Description: Manderston is a stunning example of Edwardian architecture, the supreme country house in Scotland of it’s era. A house on which no expense was spared, with opulent staterooms, a silver staircase, marble hall, acres of formal gardens and magnificent stables. Today Manderston opens it’s doors to the public for visits and private events. Whether you want to visit for a guided tour or book Manderston exclusively for your event you can be sure that a warm welcome awaits you within an impressive, country mansion.

Title: The Angus Hotel
Description:
One of Blairgowrie’s premier leisure hotel's is one of only four in Perthshire with a modern fully equipped leisure club and indoor pool. Relax and unwind in a very informal family owned hotel that offers an excellent combination of professional service, comfort and customer care.
All 89 en suite bedrooms are supremely comfortable and there are copious amounts of relaxing communal space, with a lift providing easy access to all floors. Our restaurant offers outstanding, freshly cooked cuisine.

Title: Bowhunter Archery
Description: Located 10 miles East of Inverness, Bowhunter Archery is a dedicated Field Archery Centre that welcomes all visitors. Our fun 3D Target Zones include: Dinosaurs, Dragons and Zombies and we have a Combat Archery arena for enjoyable group fun activities. Sessions are pre-bookable from 1 to 2 hours and are led by our friendly Archery GB Instructors and include full instruction and equipment.  Open all year round, 9am - sunset. Have a look at our website or contact us to book your Archery Adventure!

Title: PREMIER SUITES PLUS Glasgow
Description: PREMIER SUITES PLUS Glasgow is a luxury alternative to choosing a hotel, whether you are here for Business or Leisure our apartments offer you the space and comfort with that 'home from home' experience.  Walking distance to all shops, bars, restaurants and retail, and close by to all means of transport.

Title: The Cairndale Hotel & Spa
Description:
Perfectly located in the heart of historic Dumfries, just 90 minutes from Glasgow and Edinburgh, The Cairndale Hotel & Spa is the ideal base for exploring Dumfries & Galloway, the Borders, and South West Scotland.
Following a £2 million transformation, this family-owned four-star hotel was named Best Independent Hotel in Scotland and is home to Scotland’s only 5 Bubble Luxury Spa (The Good Spa Guide’s highest rating).
The hotel features 86 refurbished bedrooms, elegant lounges, a stylish new restaurant The Oak, and event facilities for up to 300 guests.
With a world-class spa, bespoke treatments, nearby castles, walking routes, and flexible group packages, The Cairndale blends luxury, service, and authentic Scottish hospitality.

Title: Glenwhan Gardens
Description: Glenwhan Gardens is a beautiful 12 acre garden set round two lakes, with beautiful and spectacular views to the Isle of Man, Luce Bay and the Mull of Galloway.  This garden contains plants from all over the southern hemisphere, which are able to flourish due to the influence of the Gulf Stream.  A Tearoom using locally sourced products where possible, and from our own Herb Garden, caters for all tastes. Next to the tearoom there is a small plant nursery.  There is also a woodland tree trail and 20 acres of moorland walk, containing 120 species of wildflowers.

Title: The Bonham Hotel
Description:
Set in a secluded crescent amidst Edinburgh’s stately West End, The Bonham was created from three Victorian townhouses and boasts 49 individually-styled bedrooms.  As well as dynamic events space, a sophisticated restaurant, a stylish bar and superb location for accessing both Edinburgh’s Old and New Town districts.
Nestled beside the famous Princes Street, awash with bustling cafes and upmarket boutique shops, The Bonham is within walking distance of the Royal Mile, as well as the world-famous attractions of Edinburgh Castle and St Giles’ Cathedral.

Title: Friars Carse Hotel
Description:
Set in 45 acres of woodland extending to the banks of the River Nith, the hotel offers guests a warm welcome. Guests will arrive into the magnificent paneled entrance hall with its elegant staircase. There is a well-furnished and spacious lounge with views over the garden and river, a comfortable bar and a paneled room with full-size snooker table. The Whistle Restaurant, which takes its name from a Burns
poem, serves excellent local cuisine with an extensive wine list.
All of the 21 en suite bedrooms have remote control television, telephone, hairdryer and tea/coffee making facilities, with a lift to all floors.

Title: Kinmount Leisure
Description: Luxury Self-catering accommodation at Kinmount Castle, set in three acres of glorious garden grounds, with lakes of water lilies and views to the Lakeland Hills across the Solway Firth. This superb, architect-designed conversion has transformed the Victorian servants’ wing of splendid Kinmount House into a delightful courtyard cluster of seven holiday cottages and apartments, with barbecue and patio areas. Retaining a wealth of original features and details, and possess tremendous atmosphere and charm, which makes it an ideal marquee wedding venue with ballroom included.

Title: Eat walk Glasgow
Description: Our food walking tours of Glasgow visit 5 locations tasting locally sourced food with 3 of the stops also having drink tastings. The local guide will talk about the history of the city as the group walk between venues. All stops on the tours have table resevations with seating and toilet facilities. We can cater for most dietary needs. We can offer these tours as private tours at a time suitable to your client and also guided in German or French. Tours run throughout the year, please check our website for details.

Title: Skaill House
Description:
SKAILL HOUSE SESSIONS ORKNEY MUSIC & STORY TELLING
Join Skaill House for an unforgettable evening of local music and captivating tales from some of the island's most beloved musicians & storytellers.
AN EVENING WITH THE 12TH LAIRD AT SKAILL HOUSE
Delve into the fascinating world of Skaill House with "An Evening with the 12th Laird." Join Major Malcolm Macrae, the 12th Laird of Breckness Estate, for an intimate journey through the history and heritage of this iconic Orkney estate.

Title: Aura Journeys Scotland (Edinburgh)
Description: Aura Journeys are an established provider of Chauffeured Private Day Tours and Luxury Transfers in Scotland. Journeys are completed using Luxury Mini Vans with an experienced Scottish local in traditional Tweed Suit and Cap, with complimentary Wi-Fi and Water. Services available from Edinburgh and Glasgow, journeys are private with door to door service tailored to your request. We work with you to create an outstanding experience for travellers building your and our reputation for high end bespoke travel in Scotland.
Address Line 2: Third Floor – 3 Hill Street, New Town

Title: Johnstons of Elgin
Description:
Johnstons of Elgin have been experts in the world's finest fibres for over 225 years, crafting exquisite luxury products in our own Scottish mills. 
Visitors can enjoy an immersive experience at our 5 star Quality Assured (2024/25) Elgin mill, where our family business has worked with natural, renewable, biodegradable fibres since 1797. 
On site, your clients can explore our latest collections, including women's, men's, and children's clothing and accessories, or dine in our Taste our Best accredited (2024/25) restaurant tucked inside one of Johnstons of Elgin’s oldest buildings

Title: Heathergems
Description: Heathergems Viewing Gallery & Shop. Watch our skilled crafts people sand, shape, & lacquer the heather stems and fashion them into jewellery. Uniquely Scottish and is a beautiful reminder of our landscape. Heathergems are handcrafted from the stems of heather in a process developed over the last 50 years. Nowhere else in the world will you find this range of jewellery being produced. Due to the nature of the process no two Heathergems are the same making it a very individual, personal gift

Title: Ticket To Ride - Bike Hire
Description:
Ticket To Ride are cycling and walking experts and have been helping people explore the Scottish Highlands and islands by bike and hike since 2007. We're based in Inverness and offer unrivaled quality of: cycle hire, cyclist transport, walker transfers and baggage transport.
Our small team are all keen cyclists and walkers and we love to share our knowledge of and passion for the Scottish Highlands and islands.
We are keen to partner with tour operators to offer self-guided cycling and walking packages.

Title: New Woll Estate & The Woll Golf Course
Description: In the heart of the Scottish Borders New Woll Estate is the perfect destination for an active or relaxing break –  With 4 star self-catering properties overlooking its own private golf course it is one of Scotland’s most popular golf resorts. Guests staying on the Estate play golf for Free! But you don’t have to golf, with award winning dinning in the restaurant, horse riding nearby, walking, cycling, shooting & fishing there is plenty to do!

Title: Edinburgh Scottish Evening
Description: Enjoy an informative and inspiring evening of traditional Scottish entertainment! Join us in the heart of Scotland’s capital city for our essential introduction to Scottish culture. You will be guaranteed a warm welcome and a lively evening! You will sample some of Scotland’s finest culinary offerings during a delicious four course meal. This is your chance to try haggis, Scotland’s national dish, served to the stirring sounds of the bagpipe in the traditional way. Experience the dramatic Address to a Haggis, the famous poem written by Rabbie Burns. Sit back and be entertained by some of Scotland's best professional actors. Listen and join in with Scottish songs and be introduced to some of the countries memorable characters and stories.

Title: The Glenmorangie House
Description: Set amongst the rolling barley fields of Easter Ross, this Highland hideaway, Glenmorangie House, is more of a country house than a hotel. For over 25 years it has welcomed the world to its door, developing an international reputation for Highland hospitality along the way. The house is a magnificent reflection of everything that the word ‘Glenmorangie’ stands for – a retreat to peace and calm, a place for cherished moments.  Come and see for yourself what we mean by ‘Tranquillity Restored'.

Title: Knockando Woolmill
Description: Knockando Woolmill is a small historic mill set in the Spey Valley. Continually operating for over 230 years, it is the oldest mill still operating on mainland Scotland. Visitors to the site can see the restored Victorian machinery, witness products being created, browse in the on site shop, and sample fresh coffee and cakes in the coffee shop. Set in the heart of Speyside, and on the malt whisky trail, the mill is in an excellent location to offer something a little different to your groups.

Title: Dunalastair Hotel Suites
Description: Dunalastair Hotel Suites is a contemporary, boutique, five-star hotel with 32 spacious suites, located in the square of Kinloch Rannoch, in the Scottish Highlands. Over 200 years since it first began life as a small village inn, the new hotel which opened in May 2017, has been further revamped in 2025 under the new ownership of Loch Rannoch Estate. All rates include onsite parking, wifi, full Scottish breakfast, bathrobes and slippers. Additionally, guest can benefit from the Loch Rannoch Hotel leisure facilities for a small fee.

Title: Best Scottish Tours
Description: We are an award-winning small tour company specialising in comprehensive tour packages of Scotland for over 20 years providing a range of inspiring packages that get you off the beaten track. Your tour will be a personal experience, travelling in a maximum group size of 8 people, enabling you to enjoy the trip of a lifetime. Our Scottish tour guides, really make the itinerary come to life.  They will be on hand all through your tour, giving you an insight into our wonderful country that a guide book just can’t convey.  Trust our friendly guides to show you around and see Scotland through their eyes.

Title: Rob Roy Tours Ltd
Description: All year guaranteed departures, walking tours, unique coach tours.  Outlander series, natural history and unforgettable self guided railway adventures - that won Germany's top travel trade award 2017! - all very reasonably priced.

Title: The Old Manse of Blair
Description: The Old Manse of Blair is a beautiful heritage listed, 200 year old Georgian Mansion in Highland Perthshire, accredited 5* by VisitScotland (2024/25). The property is nestled into the hillside of a Caledonian pine forest by Blair Castle and House of Bruar. You'll find many visitor attractions including distilleries, glorious walks and scenic views including the village of Blair Atholl featured in the ITV drama Queen Victoria. The property is presented in a contemporary style with Highland charm.

Title: Aikwood Tower
Description: Aikwood Tower is a 500-year-old grade A-listed Peel Tower in the Ettrick Valley. Following an award-winning restoration and five-star renovation, we offer some of the most luxurious accommodation in the Scottish Borders. Available for exclusive use on a catered or self-catered basis, we sleep ten guests in five en-suite bedrooms. We pride ourselves on providing thoughtful Scottish hospitality at its best for clients worldwide, creating a warm and welcoming home from home.

Title: The Orde Food Company
Description: The Orde Food Company is a multi-faceted hospitality and events company providing a range of quality and luxury services to the Tourism sector. Our family owned and run business works alongside historical venues, destination marketing companies, event management companies and for over 30 years has catered events across the private & corporate sectors for National and International brands as well as discerning private clientele.

Title: The Paper Mill
Description: The Paper Mill is an award winning bar and brasserie situated in a picturesque, riverbank location. We are 1.5 miles from the Edinburgh City Bypass, close to several world class attractions, and have on-site parking. Our spacious private dining area is a stylish spot for lunch or dinner for up to 45 guests. We serve fresh, seasonal Scottish produce.  Our bar is stocked with a wide range of Scottish craft beers, gins and whisky.

Title: Ridelines
Description:
Ridelines provide all things mountain biking in the Tweed Valley, only 1 hour from Edinburgh. You can arrange high quality mountain bike experiences, for riders from beginners to the enthusiast, including: Skills courses for riders of all abilities, Private tuition for groups and individuals, Guided rides, Team building, corporate, and other large group excursions.
Our highly qualified and experienced staff will ensure a safe, fun and rewarding experience in the beautiful Scottish Borders.

Title: MTB Private Hire
Description: MTB Private Hire is an Edinburgh based business that offers a premium transport service. We offer Airport Transfers, City & Resort Transfers, Trips & Tours. We only use premium vehicles such as Mercedes Benz (or similar) All drivers are dressed in business attire, drivers are also friendly and helpful with great local knowledge.

Title: Floors Castle & Gardens
Description: Built by leading architect William Adam in 1721, Floors Castle is Scotland’s largest inhabited Castle and home to the Duke of Roxburghe. The Castle is filled with outstanding works of art & the famous Belgian tapestries. Enjoy breath taking views of the River Tweed before discovering the beautiful gardens with colourful herbaceous borders, fruit trees, traditional glasshouses and stunning Millennium Garden. Private tours are available as well as bespoke estate event & activity packages.

Title: Lochcarron of Scotland
Description: Located in the heart of the Scottish Borders, our Lochcarron Visitor Centre, Selkirk offers a unique insight into how we create our authentic Scottish tartans. During a Mill Tour, experience first-hand, the sight and sound of how we make our tartans, dye our yarns, design the patterns, warp, and weave the fabric. The tour finishes in our shop which perfectly showcases our beautiful, hand-crafted, Scottish-made products and gifts that can be purchased and taken home.

Title: Helensburgh Private Hire
Description: Based near Glasgow Airport, we provide both the business and pleasure travellers who pass through Glasgow Airport with a reliable and value for money Taxi service. We can provide a variety of vehicle types including Saloon Cars, Estate Cars and People Carriers (minivans). Our saloon cars and estate cars are ideal for smaller groups, while our people carriers can accommodate up to 8 passengers with a large amount of luggage. Helensburgh Private Hire is an excellent solution for passengers seeking onward travel from Glasgow Airport to any destinaton in Scotland. We can also provide online booking and also secure online payment through paypal, alternatively we can accept cash or in car card payments.

Title: The Glasgow Food and Drink Tour
Description:
'We offer food and drink experiences in Glasgow’s leafy west end and stylish merchant city. On our tours, guests experience Glasgow’s thriving food and drink scene at 6 independent venues. Along the way they will learn the history and culture of the city. Guests will enjoy Scottish fare like Haggis, Gin, Seafood and Whisky on their culinary experience.
Not only can guests join our standard tours, we can offer private and bespoke tours from 2 -50 people throughout the year and arrange hotel pick ups. We thrive on providing your clients with a personal and enlightening tour.'

Title: Glascotours
Description: Design a unique private tour in Scotland with your clients preferences and interests to the forefront.  Whisky, golf, castles, food and drink, heritage, ancestral, film locations, battlefields and, of course, the beautiful Scottish scenery.  Clients can explore it all from the comfort of a spacious people carrier carrying up to six guests, with luggage.  Glascotours can offer total flexibility in the itinerary offering your guests the freedom to stop and start as they wish during the tour. Accessible from Glasgow and Edinburgh Airports

Title: Theatre Royal Dumfries
Description:
Scotland's oldest theatre, established in 1792, hosts productions from both the in-house amateur dramatic company, The Guild of Players and external companies.

Bespoke tours can be arrange in advance (depending on availability).  We have exhibitions on the history of our theatre.

Title: Andrew Carnegie Birthplace Museum
Description:
Philanthropist, steel tycoon, writer, lecturer, entrepreneur - Andrew Carnegie was one of the great Scots of the 19th century. 
Carnegie left a legacy which continues today, as his birthplace cottage testifies he came from humble beginnings. Adjacent to the cottage is the Art Deco style museum hall, built by his widow Louise Carnegie in 1928. 
Explore the cottage and follow the family’s journey to America where he made his fortune. Discover why he became known as the father of philanthropy.

Title: The Scottish Textiles Showcase
Description:
A haven for the discerning shopper, we are located in the centre of Edinburgh just by the Royal Mile. Our store is a treasure trove of gorgeous Scottish blankets, Harris Tweed® coats and knitwear sourced directly from wool mills and artisans over Scotland. 

Private visits hosted for small groups and private shopping. Client’s learn about Harris Tweed®, Shetland Fair Isle, cashmere and tartan and sheep!  Our products are all made in natural fibres: wool, cashmere and alpaca.

Ideal for the luxury market and special interest groups - knitting groups, weaving groups, Scottish culture, sustainable living.

Title: Arniston House
Description: Arniston Estate is a working estate that is a wonderful example of thriving country lifestyle set within a short commute to the exciting and amazing city of Edinburgh. Just 2 miles from the rail station or 25 minutes by car, Arniston House offers the perfect blend of a countryside retreat a stone’s throw from the attractions and excitement of Edinburgh. With 4 holiday cottages, a range of activities on offer, event and more, a visit to Arniston is one you don't want to miss.

Title: Once Upon a Whisky
Description: “Explore off-the-beaten bars in Glasgow and Edinburgh through an in-depth whisky tour. Join us for a comprehensive exploration of the world of whisky, showcasing craft distilleries and independent bottlers. Once Upon a Whisky has been awarded the regional best food and drink experience by the Scottish Thistle Awards, and we are the No. 1 whisky tour in Glasgow as voted on TripAdvisor. Tours and events are available daily in English and Spanish. We can cater to any group size between 4 and 50 people.”

Title: St Andrews for Golf
Description: A dynamic and modern Travel Company with a team of highly skilled and driven PGA Golf Professionals. We are on hand to cater for all your requirements effectively, efficiently and precisely at all points of your contact with us. Specialising in the provision of: Golf Vacations to St Andrews, and throughout Scotland. Authorised Providers of Guaranteed Old Course Packages. PGA Instruction & Experiences at The Home of Golf, including the unique, Play with the Pro on The Old Course St Andrews.

Title: The Four Sisters Boatel
Description: Moored in the Lochrin Basin, just minutes from Princes Street and Edinburgh Castle, The Four Sisters Boatel is a four star, luxury, self-catering houseboat. The accommodation includes free Wi-Fi access and stylish bedrooms. The Four Sisters features a fully-equipped kitchen with a breakfast bar. The property features a lounge area which includes seating for 6 people. The 2 separate cabin bedrooms are elegantly decorated, and there are 2 double bedrooms and a children’s bunk bedroom.

Title: Tasting Scotland Gourmet Journeys & Events
Description: Tasting Scotland Gourmet Journeys & Events is a DMC that specializes in Food, Culinary & Whisky Tours and Tasting Events for the luxury market across Scotland. Day Tours, Short Breaks, Vacations, Expert-Guided, Self-Drive. FIT, Groups. Personalized itineraries are expertly curated by Brenda Anderson, World Food Travel Association Ambassador for Scotland. Executive transportation and 4-5 star accommodation. Recent Winners of the ‘Best Luxury Food & Drink Tour Operator - Scotland’.

Title: Stills and Hills
Description: Scotland is world famous for its whisky, fascinating history and beautiful scenery. And there is no better way to explore it than on a personalised tour with a local guide. Whether its following a Highland Whisky Trail, visiting a favourite distillery, tasting the finest single malts or hiking through the glorious Scottish countryside – Stills and Hills can help plan the perfect trip for your clients. From half day trips to multi-day holidays all tours are unique and customised to our guests.

Title: Òran Mór
Description:
Formerly Kelvinside Parish Church, Òran Mór, Gaelic for ‘great melody of life’ or ‘big song’, is a thriving arts & entertainment venue in the heart of Glasgow’s West End.
Òran Mór offers a Whisky Bar with over 270 malt whiskies, 2 restaurants, Private Dining Room, Live Music venue, Night Club, and our stunning Auditorium with mural ceiling by Alasdair Gray.
Òran Mór also hosts the now internationally recognised ‘A Play, A Pie and A Pint’ lunchtime Theatre, producing over 40 new plays per year.

Title: Novotel Edinburgh Centre
Description: The 4-star Novotel Edinburgh Centre hotel is located in central Edinburgh, close to the Royal Mile, Princes Street and Edinburgh Castle. We invite you to experience one of our newly upgraded Superior, Executive and Suite rooms. After an active day exploring Edinburgh, take advantage of our refurbished heated pool, gym and spa. To kick start your evening, join us at the Tap Kitchen & Bar for a cocktail or craft beer.

Title: Clan Armstrong Centre and Gilnockie Tower Reiver Centre
Description: Gilnockie Tower is a stunning example of a Scottish pele tower. Built some 500 years ago, it was home to Johnnie Armstrong, a notorious border reiver. In 1530 this powerful chieftain was hanged by a Scottish king, his story romanticised by Sir Walter Scott. It has five floors, including vaulted chamber, banqueting hall and spiral staircase. The entrance stone is thought to be two thousand years old. Once a roofless ruin, the place has been completely refurbished and is open as a clan and visitor attraction.

Title: The Cuillins Self Catering
Description: This modern self-catering Studio is located in a private cul de sac just a few minutes’ walk from the centre of the village of Tarbert where guests can access the bars, seafood restaurants and shops located around Tarbert’s idyllic harbour wall.  Whether you are stopping over on business, just passing through, or you plan to use the studio as a base to explore the village and surrounding areas, we are confident Cuillins has everything you need for a comfortable and enjoyable stay.

Title: The Machrie Hotel & Golf Links
Description: Whether you’re just looking to explore the stunning island of Islay, home to some of the world’s finest whiskies, birdlife, seafood and dramatic coastal seascapes. Or you’re taking on the challenge of our championship links golf course, The Machrie Hotel and Golf Links, An 18th century converted farmhouse, sits on seven miles of pristine beach.  The hotel boasts 47 stylish rooms, suites and lodges. Each room has been tastefully decorated, many with fabulous views over the fairway towards the Atlantic Ocean.

Title: Tigerlily
Description: Tigerlily is an award-winning boutique hotel with chic rooms, an elegant bar, nightclub and a restaurant. In Edinburgh's city centre, the hotel on George Street has beautiful rooms with a flat-screen TV and Bluetooth speaker. Guests can also enjoy luxurious White Company toiletries and free WiFi. At Tigerlily in Edinburgh we take pride in our seasonal menus and work closely with our suppliers so we know we’re offering the best food possible.

Title: The Peat Inn Restaurant with Rooms
Description: The Peat Inn, by St Andrews, dates from the 1700s and is, today, a luxury Restaurant with Rooms in peaceful rural surroundings. Renowned for its warm welcome and casual elegance, guests can enjoy an exquisite dining experience in the Michelin starred restaurant, in a setting full of character.

Title: The Seafood Ristorante
Description: The Seafood Ristorante is one of Scotland's most iconic dining venues. Located over the beach, just behind the Royal & Ancient Golf Club in St Andrews. The glass cube hangs over the water allowing diners to enjoy unparalleled panoramic views over St Andrews Bay and West Sands Beach. We use locally sourced and sustainable produce supplied fresh daily, to create our beautiful and delicious menus which are elevated with an inspired Italian twist, relating to the owners Italian family background.

Title: Four Seasons Campers Ltd
Description: Offering luxury all-inclusive campervan rental from our fleet of 18 modern new VW California Ocean campervans. Four Seasons Campers is Scotland’s largest and friendliest family-owned VW Campervan hire company. Based near Loch Lomond we are perfectly situated close to both Glasgow and Edinburgh airports and offer a flexible transfer service to all airports and train stations across Scotland. Our all-inclusive competitive pricing includes unlimited mileage in the UK with free additional drivers. Extensively equipped with a 24 hour on call service during their hire.

Title: Strathaven Hotel
Description: Situated on the edge of the historic market town of Strathaven in South Lanarkshire, our 18th century country house offers boutique accommodation, fantastic dining and event spaces. We recently completed a stunning transformation of our restaurant, bar, private event spaces and some accommodation and the other bedroom refurbishments will follow soon. Our hotel is a welcome retreat for both leisure and business guests. With 22 bedrooms, free parking and wifi, it is the perfect base to escape and relax.

Title: We Love Fragrance
Description:
We Love Fragrance offers engaging, year-round, indoor unisex perfume-making experiences for groups of 10+, led by fragrance professionals with over 22 years’ experience.  Guests create and take home their own bespoke Eau de Parfum, a unique scented keepsake and lasting reminder of their time in Scotland.
Based in Glasgow and operating throughout Scotland, We Love Fragrance delivers 2 to 3-hour workshops and pop-up perfume bars, travelling to client venues including hotels, castles, conference centres and exclusive venues. Trusted by global brands including Amazon, Fremantle and H&M, we welcome delegates from around the world for conferences, incentive programmes, team building and client entertainment.

Title: Gourock Golf Club
Description: Gourock Golf club is a well laid out and maintained course on the west coast of Scotland.  All 18 holes have stunning views of the River Clyde and the Argyll hills beyond.   The course naturally splits into two 9 hole loops each bringing you back to the clubhouse. In addition the club has a unique Indoor Simulator where you can enjoy a game on some 25+ world famous courses.   After your round relax in the comfortable lounge and take advantage of the excellent bar & catering facilities.

Title: NB Distillery (North Berwick Gin and Rum)
Description: A warm welcome awaits visitors from all over the world to “Learn, Sample & Relax” on our 5* experience at NB Distillery, North Berwick, East Lothian. Near Tantallon Castle, our eco-distillery is home to our award winning NB Gins and NB Rum. Enjoy a ‘behind-the-scenes’ tour and a ‘flight’ of drinks in our luxury tasting lounge. Tour lasts 1.5 hours. £25 pp. Bespoke tours, small/large groups and catering options available. Disabled access / lift. Ideal day trip from Edinburgh.

Title: The Bothy Tasting Room at Robertsons of Pitlochry
Description: The Bothy Tasting Room is the ideal setting to taste and learn from the award-winning team at Robertsons of Pitlochry. Choose a tasting experience from whisky, gin, prosecco and tequila. You can sample some of the world’s best whiskies (many single cask, non-chill filtered, natural colour and cask strength); indulge in the botanical delights of Scottish craft gin; fizz and frolic on a journey of prosecco discovery; or grab hold of the Mexican spirit with a tequila tasting experience.

Title: Scottish Clans and Castles Ltd
Description: Scottish Clans and Castles focuses on bespoke tours of Scotland and its castles. We offer exclusive driver-guided and personalised holidays throughout Scotland, specialising in taking people to see their ancient clan lands.  Based in Scotland since 2000, we work closely with a number of Clan Chiefs and castle owners. We have an intimate knowledge not just of the Highlands and of the top tourist attractions, but also of the roads less travelled including the Scottish Borders.  We were the first Scottish company to recognise the growing interest from Outlander fans and have organised successful Outlander Tours for the past 12 years. We are delighted by the number of clients who return again and again, enchanted by Scotland and asking us to help them to explore further.

Title: Effie's of Perth
Description:
We know our Tea... but tea is almost never enough on its own. How about a plump, floury homemade scone with lashings of clotted cream and our own strawberry jam? Or maybe you've heard about our carrot cake, widely considered to be the best in the area. Prefer something a little more substantial? How about Macaroni, made right here in our kitchen to our secret recipe with Lockerbie mature cheddar cheese and durum pasta? Handmade chips?
