Of course you can... you are assured of a warm welcome, good food and something just a little bit...magic.
Featured in Peter Irvine's Scotland the Best.

Title: Argyll Bespoke Car Tours
Description: "Argyll Bespoke Car Tours provide tailor made, privately escorted day and multi day tours and Cruise ship excursions visiting places of interest, including castles, gardens, distilleries and historic towns and cities, throughout Argyll,  and the West Highlands, we cater for the single traveller and small  groups  to a maximum number of 6 persons.  We  can also assist with booking  Restaurants and many other attractions such as tours to  Edinburgh and the  Royal Military Tattoo  as  part of your clients itinerary."

Title: Glenapp Castle Hotel
Description: Glenapp Castle is a stunning 5 Red Star, Relais & Châteaux Hotel nestled on the enchanting yet lesser-travelled Ayrshire coast in Southwest Scotland, surrounded by 110 acres of lush woodlands and gardens, overlooking the glistening seascape. Relax in one of the 22 luxurious Bedroom Suites, including the largest hotel suite in Scotland, the Castle Penthouse Suite. Guests can enjoy award-winning cuisine in the 3 AA Rosette Castle Restaurant, or the more informal Azalea, by Glenapp Castle, for a completely nature-immersed dining experience. Over 70 incredible activities are on offer, from falconry and beekeeping to boat adventures and whisky tasting.

Title: Benromach Distillery
Description: Our distillery has been making Benromach since 1898 using the same spring water rising in the nearby Romach Hills. Come and see our distillers at work as they orchestrate every second of the production by sight, sound and touch. One of our friendly tour guides will proudly show you around our boby mill, mash tun, wooden washbacks, 2 copper stills, spirit safe, filling room, dunnage warehouses and visitor centre.  And, of course, you can enjoy a tutored tasting of our gorgeous range of whiskies!

Title: V&A Dundee
Description:
The first V&A museum in the world outside London opened its doors in 2018 and is Scotland’s first ever museum dedicated to design. Visitors can experience the remarkable story of design past, present and future and the vital contribution design makes to all our lives, through permanent displays and changing exhibitions showcasing the very best of design from around the world.
High-quality facilities for visitors to V&A Dundee include an atmospheric restaurant, an outdoor terrace with stunning views across the River Tay and a shop selling the best of Scottish and international design. We offer FIT and group rates for our temporary exhibitions and guided museum tours throughout the year. Please contact us for bespoke package offers, tailored to suit your clients’ needs, including private and out of hours access as well as catering options.

Title: Seaflower Skye
Description: Luxury sea tours from Portree, Isle of Skye.  Your clients can admire our stunning coastline from the water on our purpose built 40ft catamaran.  They will enjoy some of the finest and freshest, locally caught seafood onboard, along with a glass of wine before exploring the local islands of Rona and Raasay. Also available for private charter, small weddings and evening sunset cruises.

Title: Riddle's Court
Description: Riddle's Court, where the 16th & 21st Centuries Collide! Riddle's Court is a historic jewel in Edinburgh's Old Town. Hidden away until recently it is a beautiful & atmospheric 16th century building offering a unique venue for exceptional events and spectacular entertaining. Following a £6 million refurbishment it was reopened by HRH Prince of Wales in September 2017. From tours, meetings, tourist experiences, drink gatherings, parties or dinning, the Events team will help you develop great unique visits and experiences here.

Title: 4x4 Hire (Scotland) Ltd
Description: At 4x4 Hire Scotland Ltd we have one of the UK’s ultimate collections of prestige and commercial 4x4s available for hire throughout the UK. With our ever expanding range of off-road vehicles, we are guaranteed to have the perfect all-terrain machine for your next adventure. We have established a vast client base including film companies, the Police Force, all sectors of the hospitality and tourism industry and even Royalty! 4x4 Hire (Scotland) Ltd was established in 2000 by a team of motor trade experts with over 30 years’ experience in commercial vehicle hire. Only minutes from Scotland’s main airports, our depots in Edinburgh and Glasgow can deliver or collect vehicles from anywhere in the country.

Title: Stravaigin Scotland
Description: Stravaigin Scotland offer private guided tours of Scotland for 1 to 16 people in a range of luxury vehicles. Stravaigin offer days tours, shore excursions and multi-day tours including Outlander and Whisky itineraries. We offer customised itineraries working with you to create your client's perfect tour including accommodation. We pride ourselves on the service we provide both during the planning stages and during the tour when our kilted Scottish guides show clients the Scotland we love.

Title: MGM Muthu Hotels - Muthu Ben Doran Hotel
Description: The Ben Doran surrounded by Alpine forests boasts of a gorgeous mountain view, nestled in its own sheltered seven-acre garden in the mountain village of Tyndrum on the northern edge of the Loch Lomond National Park. The hotel was built creatively with the unique feature of having the dining room and lounges on the top floor to offer guests spectacular views of the beautiful scenery. Another masterful touch can be found in the design of the bedrooms which are extremely spacious and boast all the comforts you need to make your stay at The Ben Doran as tranquil and relaxing as possible. Tyndrum is sited on the Scottish Goldfield and, in 1997, a team of geologists found a gold seam only two miles from the village.

Title: Bo'ness & Kinneil Railway
Description: Less than an hour’s drive from Edinburgh and Glasgow, we’ve got great facilities for groups. Explore Scotland’s largest railway museum, we’ll reserve a wonderfully restored carriage just for you, great discounts, free places for group leader and coach driver as well as a meal voucher for the driver in our Station Buffet. There is plenty of free parking and we can even offer Afternoon Tea on a steam train for a perfect touch of nostalgia (subject to availability). Also an Outlander location.

Title: Dalmahoy Hotel & Country Club
Description: Impressively situated in 1,000 acres of parkland lies the four-star Dalmahoy Hotel & Country Club. With spectacular views to Edinburgh Castle and the Forth Bridges, it’s a celebration of Scottish heritage. With 215 bedrooms and a range of restaurants and bars, this historic resort also features two 18-hole golf courses and a range of luxurious leisure facilities. Dalmahoy lies just 20 minutes from Edinburgh city centre and 10 minutes from Edinburgh Airport.

Title: Trump Turnberry, a Luxury Collection Resort
Description: Created in the grand style in the early years of the 20th century, Trump Turnberry, a Luxury Collection Resort is one of Scotland's national treasures and winner of Scottish Hotel of the Year at the 2018 Scottish Hotel Awards. As you approach the resort, the miles of glorious west coast of Scotland give way to the familiar soft green of the world famous golf courses, swiftly followed by your first glimpse of the unmistakable red roofs of this Edwardian era hotel.

Title: The View, Oban
Description: The View is a truly unique and versatile day into night-time venue in the heart of Oban, the ‘Gateway to the Isles.’ Overlooking Oban Bay, our waterfront terrace and Scottish restaurant and bars provide a taste of Scotland and a range of unique tasting experiences in a stunning setting. Whether you want to visit to enjoy either coffee, tea or a chilled glass of beer or wine – or sample local food and drink with a breakfast, lunch, or dinner, we have got something for you.

Title: The Borders Distillery
Description:
The Borders Distillery is the first Scotch Whisky Distillery in the picturesque Scottish Borders since 1837. Located in the centre of Hawick, a town steeped in history and heritage, known for its luxury knitwear production and as the “Home of Tweed”, it is housed in fully restored Victorian industrial buildings. 
Our tours are led by the distillers themselves and run three times a day Monday – Sunday. The shop is open from 10am to 4.30pm. These are fully accessible and are limited to 12 people per tour. For larger parties and private bespoke tours please contact us directly."

Title: Dining at Murrayshall Country Estate
Description: With Perthshire on our doorstep, we make the most of everything the land has to offer.  EOLAS is our unique refined dining experience showcasing the very best of Scottish Highland Produce. CAIRNS is cosy, cheerful and friendly. You can enjoy classic gastro food with a twist. BARROSA is situated in the heart of the hotel, and offers a relaxed and intimate bar. So whether you’re looking for your pub favourite or eclectic cuisine, you’ll find it here at Murrayshall.

Title: Murrayshall & Lynedoch Golf Course
Description: Meandering across 365 acres of land, you’ll have access to two golf courses and a total of 27-holes. For a weekend trip or a 7-day stay, you’ll never be short of options. At Murrayshall, there’s also an expansive driving range and access to our Pro Shop. No matter the season or the weather; you can play golf at Murrayshall. We also don’t require a handicap certificate for you to play, so our courses are open to all levels.

Title: Barry Mill - The National Trust for Scotland
Description: Set in a quiet river den, just outside Dundee, Barry Mill is a traditional Scottish water-powered corn mill re-built in 1814. It is a curious working rarity on 3 floors with an operational waterwheel. Visitors can hear stories about food, technology, language, sustainable energy and many little known unusual cultural stories relating to it’s long history -besides seeing the mill in action! We have a small shop & catering option but a warm welcome, ample parking and some wonderful riverside walks.

Title: Granite City Tour Company
Description: Granite City Tour Company specialise in bespoke, personalised day trip packages. Based in Aberdeen, our fleet of executive vehicles can accommodate any party size 7 days a week. Whether you are looking to book a VIP trip to sample the ‘Water of Life’ from one of the many whisky distilleries located on our doorstep, soaking up some of the 300+ famous and historic castles, or even corporate events – whatever your needs, we promise to offer something for everyone.

Title: McIntosh Tours
Description:
We are a small, independent company specialising in taking visitors into the Highlands to discover the beauty, culture and history of Scotland.
Tour in a luxury Land Rover Discovery to appreciate the magnificent lochs, glens, wildlife, history and culture with your own private guide. 
All our guides are local Perthshire residents with a thorough knowledge of all things Scottish.

Title: Edinburgh Dungeon
Description: The Edinburgh Dungeon is a unique, award-winning, immersive actor-based attraction including 2 thrilling rides and 11 live shows, taking visitors on a journey through Edinburgh's darkest history. Bringing together a cast of theatrical actors, special effects, 360 degree sets and rides in an exciting walk-through experience that visitors can see, hear, touch, smell and feel.

Title: Forbes of Kingennie Country Resort
Description:
Positioned along the Scottish coastline, Forbes of Kingennie Country Resort is the ultimate spot for golf, fishing, dining, luxury self-catering lodges and shepherd hut holidays in a peaceful setting.

Whether you are adventuring into the Angus countryside to bag some Munros or uncovering Scotland’s coolest city, the resort is an ideal base for exploring. Broughty Ferry and the City of Dundee are only minutes away, and Edinburgh, Glasgow, Perth and Aberdeen are all within easy reach.

Title: Ardconnel Court
Description: At Ardconnel Court we have eight luxury self-catering apartments overlooking Inverness Castle. The apartments sleep 2-6 people with bedrooms, bathrooms, a fully equipped open-plan kitchen and living room. Available for short or long term lets. Private parking and free WIFI.

Title: Scottish Classic Tours
Description: Looking for something a little bit different? Ideally located between Glasgow and Edinburgh Scottish Classic Tours offers personalised, private and bespoke tours of Scotland for up to five persons in classic vehicles such as a fully restored Volkswagen campervan or award winning Rover. Tours can be either of half, full or multi day duration with each itinerary being perfectly matched to client requests. Whether its castles, mountains, wildlife, whisky or Outlander locations our full Highland dress wearing expert guide with previous Royalty and Diplomatic Protection experience will ensure your customers take home unforgettable memories.

Title: SaltDog Marine
Description: We provide fast Rib Boat Seafari trips on the Tay Estuary. Seeing sights such as the V&A museum from the water, lighthouses, Bottlenose Dolphins, Grey seals and much more. Safe and comfortable boats with knowledgeable guides. Individuals as well as small and large groups can be catered for. We are the number one outdoor activity in Dundee and Angus with a 5 star rating. Our trips depart from the harbour adjacent to Broughty Ferry castle.

Title: Native Glasgow at the Anchor Line
Description: Located in the heart of Glasgow city centre, Native Glasgow is in a beautiful  Edwardian Art Deco building, an aparthotel with 64 apartments ranging from studios to penthouse spaces. Native Glasgow provides all the benefits of a hotel but with the space, flexibility and freedom of a private apartment. Facilities will include, 24-hour reception, concierge, free high-speed Wi-Fi and two popular restaurants, The Anchor Line and Atlantic. Native Glasgow is just 5 mins from Central Station and 25 mins from the Airport.

Title: Mill of Dess Lodge
Description:
The Mill of Dess Lodge is set in the heart of a privately owned estate comprising 428 acres which lies on the north bank of the world famous salmon river in Royal Deeside and just downstream from Balmoral. Recently the owners have carefully and accurately restored much of the estate to its full potential.  The Lodge can accommodate 20 guests under one roof in style and comfort not only in the generous size of each bedroom but also the sitting room and dining room which can seat a full house without feeling crammed or crowded. 
The Lodge is fully staffed and the in-house Chef prepares all meals in our state of the art professional kitchen installed as part of the conversion. The Mill of Dess Lodge offers 10 double/twin bedrooms each with a private bathroom. Private guests can book the whole house on an Exclusive Use basis which offers a luxury home-from-home for special family celebrations.

Title: Monteith Guided Salmon Fishing Services
Description: Our renowned guided salmon fishing service conveniently combines a quality pre-selected salmon fishing venue paired up with a professional salmon guide along with all of the required salmon fishing equipment (incl. waders & waterproofs) and tuition to make this easy for visitors to Scotland who wish to experience one of our most famous Scottish rural pursuits. Please visit our website for more details.

Title: West Coast Tours
Description: We operate day tours from Oban to Mull, Iona & Staffa. Choose from a range of tours, including the Three Isles Tour, that take in these unique Inner Hebridean islands, home to wildlife, stunning scenery and the world famous Fingal's Cave. Our tours include all coach, ferry and boat travel through our partners at CalMac and Staffa tours. Customers will be met with staff at each point in their tour, enjoy commentary on their coach journey but have time to self explore at each destination.

Title: MacLeod House at Trump Aberdeen
Description:
MacLeod House & Lodge is a five-star Hotel located in Balmedie, just minutes from Aberdeen.
This luxury Scottish hotel offers sumptuous accommodation and dining - and is available for exclusive use, golf, clay shooting, celebrations, private dine, groups, corporate events and weddings.

Title: Dundee Science Centre
Description: Immerse yourself in the wonders of science! With over 80 hands-on, fun and informative exhibits, along with a diverse programme of science shows/workshops and ‘meet-the-scientist’ special events throughout the year, there is plenty for everyone to enjoy.  Experience ‘Medical Marvels’ – a fascinating new and unique exhibition that includes a range of medical-themed exhibits, from interesting historical artefacts right through to virtual reality operations! Coffee shop and Gift Shop also available

Title: Ellon Castle Gardens
Description: Towering above the 7 acres of Ellon Castle Garden are the spectacular ruins of the early 15th century Ardgith Castle - once the home of the 3rd Earl of Aberdeen. The gardens themselves which date from 1715 contain many species of native and exotic trees but the crowning glory is the collection of 19 ancient yew trees which are at least 500 years old and some may be much older. The walled garden is a wonderfully tranquil place which is home to red squirrels and many species of birds.

Title: Highland Explore
Description: Highland Explore Tours offers day trips around Inverness Skye and the Highlands from Inverness and the Port of Cromarty Firth Invergordon For cruise ship tours we have a full range available at affordable group prices visit Cawdor castle, Lochness, Culloden Battlefield, Urquhart Castle, Millionaires View, Falls of Shin, Dunrobin Castle, Isle of Skye, Eilean Donan Castle, Fairy pools, Kilt rock and more

Title: The Scotch Malt Whisky Society
Description:
Since we were formed in 1983, we’ve believed in doing things differently. As unconventional whisky experts we seek out whisky in its purest form, prize flavour above everything else. We’re united and constant in our passion – to share the world’s best whiskies and bring them to life. That makes the SMWS the perfect option to start your whisky journey or take it to the next level.
Our fantastic range of private dining options within our venues suit all budgets from canape receptions to fine dining.

Title: Dun Aluinn
Description: Set on an elevated position on the edge of Aberfeldy, Dun Aluinn enjoys fabulous viewings towards the Highlands and the River Tay. Dun Aluinn is an amazing 5 star exclusive use venue, sleeping up to 18 guests. Rooms can also be booked individually; allowing independent travellers to now book and experience its rare 'private house' atmosphere. From the gated entrance, there is a sweeping driveway up to the House, guests can enjoy the easy stroll into Aberfeldy town and all the lovely restaurants, book shops and coffee shops.

Title: Private Tours Edinburgh
Description: Private Tours Edinburgh offer half day and one day tours in central Scotland and the Highlands. Tours include: Outlander tours featuring Lallybroch ;  tours of the Kelpies and  Stirling Castle ; Photo tours of Glencoe and the Highlands of Scotland; Four Castles tours including  Doune Castle (Castle Leoch) and  Stirling Castle; Whisky tours  ;  Your driver / guide is an tour guide with 8 years experience

Title: ACE Adventures & Hideaways
Description: ACE Adventures & Hideaways is based in Moray on the Logie Estate by the River Findhorn in the Highlands of Scotland. The area offers spectacular scenery and is a hidden gem of unexploited Scottish Tourism with easy access to Inverness Airport. Well positioned to access Cairngorm mountain, Moray coast and a short drive from Aviemore. We exist to enhance people’s lives facilitating physical and emotional well being through adventure in a fun environment. Also, our nearly wild glamping is a great way to detox from it all.

Title: The Hairy Coo
Description: Since 2010, our award-winning, local tour guides have been dedicated to showing you the very best of Scotland. They are famous for their knowledge, passion, humour, and poetic story-telling. Choose from our 1-Day Tours to Loch Ness (Scotland’s ONLY Loch Ness & Whisky Distillery day tour) or our: 1-Day Highland Lochs, Stirling Castle & Whisky Tour, or our fantastic 3-Day Tour to the Isle of Skye, Inverness & the Highlands. We are also experts at organising bespoke, private tours for groups.

Title: Errichel House & Thyme Restaurant
Description:
Situated on a working rare-breed hill-farm above Aberfeldy in Highland Perthshire, Thyme Deli & Bistro at Errichel recently achieved the National ‘Food Tourism Award’ at the Scottish Thistles.
Onsite, enjoy informal dining overlooking sweeping Perthshire views, fabulous Deli shopping in the former farmhouse kitchen, and delicious Scottish Cheese or Charcuterie Tastings. Farm Tours (seasonal) offer a chance to meet and feed Errichel’s ethically-reared rare-breed animals.
Errichel has 4 unique cottages, offering comfortable, stylish accommodation with woodburning stoves and majestic views.

Title: Bike Valley Scotland
Description: We are a family-run business dedicated to providing our clients with unforgettable cycling holidays in the Scottish Borders. We cater for all levels of experience, whether you are a thrill seeker or just want to experience the natural beauty of the Tweed Valley by mountain bike. We believe in working with local service providers and the knowledge and expertise which comes with it, making it easy  for you to enjoy a hassle-free holiday.

Title: Mellerstain House & Gardens
Description: Mellerstain House and Gardens is one of Britain's best stately homes. The house, formal gardens and grounds attracts visitors from across the world for a truly memorable, top-quality experience. This Robert Adam architectural masterpiece is still home to the 14th Earl of Haddington. Groups tours are available throughout the year and visitors are treated to a unique insight into the house by our friendly and knowledgeable guides.

Title: Torabhaig Distillery, Skye
Description: Single Malt Scotch Whisky Distillery accommodated in a sympathetically restored old farmstead on the Sleat peninsula in South Skye.  Open Mon-Fri 10am to 4pm with tours running every half hour with the exception of 1.30pm.  Regular tours last 45 minutes and cost £15 per person.   Included on the tour are two 15ml tastings of Torabhaig Single Malt Scotch Whisky.   Maximum of 8 people per tour.  Disabled access is available on the tour.  On-site there is a Whisky shop, and a café serving home-made soup, freshly prepared sandwiches and refreshments.   Outdoor seating is available in our courtyard.

Title: Paxton House
Description: Paxton House, a fine example of Neo-Palladian architecture, it was completed in 1763 with the primary aim of impressing a Prussian bride. Sadly the star-crossed lovers never married or lived in the house. You will be guided through 8 generations of family history including a rags to riches story, travels in America and the Caribbean to fortunes being made in sugarcane fuelled by the slave trade. Paxton House is home to Scotland’s largest private picture gallery and boasts a globally significant collection of Thomas Chippendale and William Trotter furniture. A true Borders hidden gem!

Title: Dundee Repertory Theatre
Description:
Dundee Rep Theatre is one of Scotland’s most welcoming and awarded theatres creating and showcasing world-class theatre, dance, comedy & live music. Dundee Rep sits at the cultural heart of Scotland and the City of Dundee. 
Visit our award-winning Rep Cafe Bar/Restaurant, your ideal destination for a relaxing coffee, lunch with friends or intimate dinner. All our food is freshly prepared, offering a stylish blend of classic and modern dishes.

Title: Sandman Signature Aberdeen Hotel
Description: Located in one of Aberdeen’s historic buildings at the heart of the city, Sandman Signature Aberdeen Hotel provides bold, luxurious accommodations steps away from key attractions in the Granite City. Whether visiting for business or to enjoy the city’s splendour, we welcome you to experience the elegant, relaxed, comfort of Sandman Signature.

Title: River Ness Rafting
Description: River Ness Rafting offers unique, family-friendly raft trips in Inverness. Groups of up to eight customers are taken by minibus from Inverness City centre to launch sites further up the river Ness. Trips are between one to three hours duration. Following a safety brief from their fully qualified raft guide they gently paddle down the River Ness - through history, nature and beautiful scenery. The raft guide provides an engaging commentary throughout the trip. All kit and transport is supplied.

Title: Golf View Hotel & Spa
Description:
Golf View Hotel & Spa enjoys a seafront setting in Nairn that embraces stunning coastal scenery through vast picture windows in our Hickory restaurant.
Nearby golf fairways, beach strolls and relaxing spa treatments all add to our welcoming nature. From our sea-facing guest rooms and from our open-air hot tub, the Moray Firth and Black Isle provide a stimulating backdrop. We welcome groups and FIT to the Morayshire spa hotel near Inverness which provides the perfect place to rediscover your Scotland.

Title: Badachro Distillery
Description: Badachro Distillery is a small family run, artisan distillery, the main product being Badachro Gin.  Tours & Gin Tasting Experiences are available by prior arrangement.  We also have 2 B&B rooms available on the same site - Aid Hill B&B - along with a small self-catering property.  We can offer the full package to you client with accommodation, Gin experience and fabulous west coast scenery.

Title: Lovat Mill
Description: Tweed, one of Scotland’s finest gifts to the world and originating here in Hawick. The term Tweed was coined quite accidentally in 1826 a the result of a misread label on a shipment of woven wool ‘Tweels’ (the scots word for twill) from weaver William Watson of Commercial Road in Hawick to a London cloth Merchant. Proud to be ‘The Home of Tweed’, Lovat Mill continues to tell the story of Tweed in its birthplace and produces the largest selection of stocked Tweeds in Scotland.

Title: Beyond Adventure
Description:
Beyond Adventure is a specialist provider in outdoor wilderness activities & experiences. Specialising in canoeing, kayaking & paddleboarding, hiking and mountain biking they can tailor any adventure to fit your needs. 
From day taster sessions, micro adventures and to longer, more remote wilderness expeditions - drop into the By the River base, try climbing on their wall and become inspired to start your journey!

Title: Craigmhor Lodge & Courtyard, Pitlochry
Description:
Winners of Scottish Guest House of the Year 2018, Craigmhor Lodge & Courtyard is a luxury Guest House tucked away in enchanting woodland grounds in the popular Highland Perthshire town of Pitlochry.  Offering high quality bed & breakfast accommodation  in 12 courtyard and 3 lodge bedrooms, Craigmhor Lodge is the perfect base to explore the area from.  All guest rooms are en-suite, stylishly decorated in the muted colours of Highland Perthshire and are meticulously presented with many thoughtful touches to make your client’s stay extra special.

Breakfast at Craigmhor Lodge is a delight with extensive cold and cooked options made with ingredients sourced from local suppliers.

Title: Johnstons of Elgin - Hawick
Description:
Johnstons of Elgin is a unique five star visitor centre situated on the banks of the river Teviot in Hawick.
One of the world’s leaders in luxury cashmere and fine woollens, take a guided tour around the mill to discover quality in the making.
Browse our clothing and accessories in our mill shop before heading to our taste our best accredited coffee shop and enjoy freshly baked scones, lunch or afternoon tea.

Title: Austin Coach Travel / AT Travel
Description: We are an award-winning family company offering luxury coach services for FAM trips, airport transfers, team building & sport events, group tours, tourists visiting our famous attractions etc. We aim to be the ‘go to’ coach operator in Scotland who are continually recognised for excellent & safe customer services with our range of luxury coaches, experienced drivers & knowledgeable guides. Looking for an idea for your next group experience? We are here to help & ready to welcome your group.

Title: Perthshire Treks
Description: Perthshire Treks provides individuals and groups with safe and enjoyable walking adventures in Perthshire and elsewhere in the Scottish Highlands. We can take your clients on low-level walks, taking in historic sites, viewpoints and other places, or into the hills. It can be as relaxed or as challenging as your clients want it to be. We also provide walks for corporate groups. Please contact us to find out more about what we can offer.

Title: The Doll’s House Restaurant
Description: The Doll’s House is one of St Andrew’s most recognizable spots to eat & drink.  We can cater for your clients in our private dining room upstairs with space for up to 60 guests in a comfortable and truly unique Scottish venue.  Nestled in the heart of St Andrews Old Town, The Doll’s house, with its secluded intrigue is placed in the centre of the pedestrian square behind the distinguishable Holy Trinity Church.

Title: Forgan’s St Andrews
Description: Forgan’s has a simple aim to deliver quality Scottish food and drinks in a warm and welcoming atmosphere.  Situated on the beautifully cobbled Market Street of the famous golf town, St Andrew’s.  Our semi private dining areas – or Bothies as we like to call them - offer a welcoming charm.  Suitable for large lunches and intimidate dinners Forgan’s is the ideal location for your next event.

Title: Gartmore House
Description: Stay in comfortable accommodation with your own en suite and enjoy Craft and Activity holidays throughout the year at Gartmore House. There is an extensive list that your clients can choose form whether their interest is in knitting, painting, patchwork or quilting, and that’s just to name but a few. All crafts and activities are suitable for all levels of ability and it is an opportunity to meet new friends with a high percentage of our guests returning again and again. Gartmore House is situated in Central Scotland in the beautiful countryside of the Loch Lomond and Trossachs National Park and we can also take the stress out of getting here by offering a pick up and drop off service from Stirling Train station (which has direct links to both Edinburgh and Glasgow).

Title: Mharsanta
Description: Situated in Glasgow’s Merchant City, Mharsanta brings a taste of Scotland to you. Mharsanta has a passion for using seasonal, local produce. We serve a variety of Scottish food from mussels and scallops to Scottish favourites including freshly landed fish and chips and steak and sausage pie. We can create bespoke menus for your groups and have a number of unique dining experiences on offer. There’s seating  for 80 in the main restaurant and 32 guests in our private dining room.

Title: Van Winkle
Description:
Van Winkle, Glasgow proudly serves up Scotland’s largest selection of Bourbons. Our aim is to bring real quality products, delivered by genuine people, in an atmosphere that allows you to drift and believe you are in the deepest parts of Kentucky!

Serving a variety of wee plates, home-made burgers and sandwiches, there’s something to suit all groups. You can even host your own private BBQ in our beer gardens. We also have a set Scottish menu for groups.

Title: Beaufort Hotel
Description:
The Beaufort Hotel is a family run business consisting of 34 comfortable En Suite rooms. with free parking available to the front and rear of the hotel. We have a variety of Single, Double, Triple, Accessible & Family rooms available. 

Located in the centre of Inverness, just minutes away from Inverness Castle.

At the Beaufort Hotel we have a modern furnished restaurant where we cater for all tastes using the finest local ingredients

Title: See Orkney
Description: See Orkney offers small group tours with a personal touch. Our experienced driver guides will take your guests on an unforgettable journey along scenic coastal and country roads to the Heart of Neolithic Orkney, Viking settlements and Wartime History. Up to 12 pax. Out of season discount on request.

Title: Cantick Head Lighthouse Cottages
Description: Unique self catering holiday/vacation cottages which were formerly built to house Victorian Lighthouse keepers. Set in a stunning coastal location on the Island of Hoy which notably has the spectacular sea stack The Old Man of Hoy. Your clients ideal base to explore the Orkney Islands and the Scottish Highlands.

Title: Land Rover Experience Scotland
Description: We offer a range of high quality driving experiences for individuals, and fun and exciting activity days for groups. Half day/full day programmes. Rated 5 star by VisitScotland (2024/25), Trip Advisor Certificate of Excellence, consistent 5* reviews. Experience Highland Perthshire from the comfort of a brand new Land Rover. Bespoke itineraries including off-road driving, at our specialist driving centre and out in the hills, to experience beautiful scenery and wildlife up close. Commission by arrangement.

Title: First Travel Solutions
Description: First Travel Solutions is part of Aberdeen based First Group and our friendly and professional team sources coaches, mini-busses and MPV for travel throughout Scotland and the UK, regardless of where you are starting your journey from.  We use only accredited suppliers who meet our strict criteria for quality and safety and this is backed up by our ISO Quality Standard assurance and 24/7 Control Room operation. Our buying power means that you will be offered the best rates for your requirements, with free, no obligation quotes always available or use our online ‘Quick Quote’ facility.
Address Line 1: Unit 5, Petre Court, Petre Road, Clayton-le-Moors

Title: Happy Tours Scotland Ltd
Description: Based in Inverness our friendly, experienced and fully-trained Happy Tours guides are  passionate about this beautiful location, promoting it's history and  folklore! We prefer to use 8-seater vehicles creating a much more personal tour. These tours include : Isle of Skye, Loch Ness and Culloden Battlefield, Dunrobin Castle and the Glenmorangie Distillery,Glenfinnan and Glencoe, Cairngorm Mountains, Outlander and Whisky Tour, Speyside Whisky , Private Whisky , Private Outlander and Bespoke Private Tours. Pick up from Front of the Columba Hotel, 7 Ness Walk, Inverness IV3 5NF.

Title: Adventure Carrick
Description:
With over 15 years experience of delivering high quality outdoor experiences, your clients will be in safe hands with our very own qualified and experienced staff.  Our offering ranges from watersports, mountain sports, forest activities and multi-day tours within Ayrshire and the Galloway UNESCO Biosphere. 

Adventure Carrick is situated near Girvan within South Ayrshire, which is 30 mins south of Prestwick Airport and 1 hour south of Glasgow. Commission and net rates available.

Title: The Bothy Experience
Description: The Bothy Experience in Glamis, Angus, is a free-to-visit visitor attraction and home of the award-winning Gin Bothy, ideal for group itineraries. Located near Glamis Castle and within easy reach of Dundee, it offers engaging exhibition spaces, a retail Larder shop, and pre-bookable hosted tastings for 2–56 guests. Showcasing Scottish bothy culture, local produce, and small-batch spirits, it delivers an authentic, high-quality experience. Open year-round, Thursday to Sunday or by appointment, it suits FIT and group travel programmes

Title: Braemar Highland Experience
Description:
Braemar Highland Experience, is a 5 star tour company (VisitScotland 2024/25), based in the Cairngorms, Scotland. We provide bespoke on road, off road and guided walking tours and love sharing our passion for the history, culture and wildlife of Scotland. 
We offer bespoke on road tours and guided walking in the local area and further afield in English, French and Dutch. Our off road tours are both scheduled and bespoke, travelling on private hill tracks in the Cairngorms.
Address Line 2: In The Centre Of The Village

Title: Edinburgh Zoo
Description: You and your group can book to visit Edinburgh Zoo to see over 2,500 incredible animals from around the world, including the UK’s only Queensland Koalas, Scotland’s only sloths and our tall herd of Nubian giraffes. Spend the day learning about some of our animals, from our fabulous flamingos to our cheeky chimpanzees and more with our daily keeper talks. There is on-site catering, including our newly refurbished Grasslands restaurant, boasting a menu that is full of fresh, locally sourced ingredients. Your wild day out awaits!

Title: Greyfriars Kirk
Description: Built on the site of a pre-Reformation Franciscan monastery, our iconic building offers much to see and appreciate, from reading the words of the National Covenant (signed here in the Kirkyard in 1638), right through to contemporary additions, such as our magnificent organ that dominates the sanctuary. You learn more about our past on our History and Heritage page.

Title: The Pictish Room
Description: Aberlemno is famous for its 4 Pictish Sculptured Stones. A new facility at the village hall can now enhance your visit. The pictish room is home to a collection of replica stones, carvings and interpretation boards. Small coaches can park on site. Large coaches may disembark on the road. Catering options on request. A guide is also available on request. Please contact us for further information and booking.

Title: Hotel Indigo
Description: Poised between Dundee’s waterfront and the heart of its shopping district, Hotel Indigo® Dundee reflects the fascinating heritage of this proud city. Our 102 boutique bedrooms including 17 Junior Suites are fully air conditioned with 40” LCD TV, invigorating rainfall shower, luxurious toiletries and complimentary Wi-Fi throughout. We also offer a fully-equipped gym, bar and award winning 2 AA rosette restaurant Daisy Tasker, perfect for experiencing Scotland’s finest produce and handcrafted bespoke cocktails and wines.

Title: Staybridge Suites
Description: Staying at Staybridge Suites Dundee will make you feel part of the cities past, present and future. One of Dundee’s most Iconic Jute Mills has been transformed into 85 luxury suites with kitchens, WIFI, Nespresso machine and LCD TV’s. Our guests can enjoy our fantastic gym and laundry facilities. If staying on a Mon, Tuesday and Wednesday are invited to the Staybridge Social Evening; an hour of drinks, snacks and good company. Grab a local drink or snack from our Pantry or unwind in our Den.

Title: Waxy O'Connor's
Description:
Well located between George Square & Glasgow's Style Mile
Waxy O'Connor's is a unique venue offering a feel-good menu of Homemade Irish and Scottish favourites. 
Coupled together with an extensive Scottish & Irish Whiskey collection, Waxy's can offer a welcoming and authentic experience to both visitor & local alike. 
Groups bookings from 10 to 55 guests catered for, with buffet, set and bespoke menus available.

Title: Mode Aparthotel Edinburgh
Description: Located in the very heart of the city, Mode Edinburgh is an urban chic living space in a beautifully-restored historic building. As our guest, you will enjoy close proximity to an exclusive shopper’s paradise on George Street, make use of various tour options on your doorstep or Instagram some breathtaking views of Edinburgh Castle. If you are looking to unwind and take in some green space, there is complimentary access to Queen Street Gardens West, a stunning private garden just minutes from the property. Alternatively, you can keep up with your fitness routine in our 24-hour onsite gym or unwind in our spacious guest lounge, while sipping on a complimentary coffee.

Title: Gusto
Description:
Gusto Italian has been a mainstay of elegant George St. dining for almost 15 years.  Serving the best in authentic Italian food and chic cocktails, Gusto has remained close to the heart of Edinburgh locals and tourists alike. We specialize in catering to all dietary requirements with over 30% of our menu available as Vegan. We are able to provide comprehensive information on our menu items and are adept at dealing with allergens. 
Central to our dining area is our ‘Con Amici’ table -literally meaning ‘with friends’- which can seat groups of up to 40. Our mezzanine level can sit up to 75 for a sit down meal, or up to 100 for an informal canapé or bowl food event. On street level, the main restaurant can sit up to 130 incorporating our ‘Con Amici” table. We also have a bar area which is fantastic for laid back cocktail, prosecco or champagne style events.

Title: Edinburgh First
Description: Edinburgh First is the commercial division of the University of Edinburgh, providing heritage venues, purpose built conference facilities, and flexible accommodation at various locations around the city. Whether it is a large conference of 500 delegates or a small meeting, Edinburgh First can open the doors to the City's most prestigious venues on your behalf. What's more, we have 185 en-suite bedrooms available year round plus an additional 2,000 bedrooms during the summer.

Title: Crown Apartments Limited
Description: Luxury Serviced Apartments situated in Inverness City Centre with amazing views of Inverness Castle and beyond.  Ardconnel Court is only a 30-minute drive from the airport and a few minutes walk from rail and bus connections. A jewel, in the Crown area of Inverness! Your clients can take advantage of its stunning location which is just a short walk from the city’s main attractions. Excellent shopping, fine dining, a rich array of entertainment and lively pub culture. The perfect base to explore the wider Highlands of Scotland and on the start/ finish line of the famous North Coast 500 route.

Title: Classic Britain
Description: Classic Britain specialises in creating group package tours throughout Scotland. We work with hundreds of group friendly hotels across the country from the Scottish Borders to The Shetland Isles. The best part about our tours is that you don't have to lift a finger, we book the ferries, the guides and the visitors attractions. If it’s not a full package you're after we have a dedicated team who are experts at sourcing group accommodation for both Inbound and UK groups at the best rates.

Title: Scotland's Secret Bunker
Description: For over 40 years, an innocent looking farmhouse conceals the entrance to one of Scotland's best kept secrets. Discover the twilight world of Scotland's secret underground nuclear command centre. An amazing labyrinth on two levels, 100ft below ground and encased within 15Ft thick concrete walls. This is where Central Government would have operated from in the vent of nuclear attack during the Cold War years. Onsite café and small gift shop. Coach parking, groups, private tours.

Title: Linton Collection
Description:
Linton Collection is a selection of 31 luxury apartments based in the Old Town of Edinburgh. We have a range of studio, one bed and two-bedroom apartments across two historical buildings; a converted church dating back to 1871 and the, Grade A, Listed Scotsman building. North Bridge Lofts, Lord Lyons Chambers and West Wing are housed in the former Scotsman newspaper building and retain some of the original characteristics with added boutique furnishings. Blackfriars Lofts are set in a listed, Victorian church and have a contemporary twist to create a home from home space.
The apartments are available on a nightly, weekly and monthly basis.

Title: Best of Scotland Holidays
Description: Best of Scotland Holidays is one of Britain’s longest established independent Destination Management Companies, creating tailor-made itineraries for FIT and small groups. A boutique, family-run company with over 40 years’ experience, our team create itineraries with authentic experiences for visitors to enjoy. As a Green Tourism accredited business we aim to be a Responsible Tourism DMC, allowing visitors to become temporary locals.

Title: Badger & Co. Private Dining
Description: Badger & Co. is located in the heart of Edinburgh, Castle Street and is home to where Wind in The Willows was written by Kenneth Graham. Badger & Co’s private dining room will feel like home, letting you enjoy your own playlist through our surround sound, view photos or Sky Sports on our cinema screen, play pool and have fun playing our shuffle board throughout your event. There is a small bar in the private dining room which can be operated if requested. Catering for a minimum of 8 and a maximum of 14 people seated within the private dining room, or alternatively hosting between 10-25 guests for a standing event. You can choose from set private dining menus or the lighter option of the chef’s canapés.

Title: Glen Mhor Hotel
Description: Located on the bank of the River Ness, in a beautiful, historic area of the city, our Hotel has 110 bedrooms over 10 buildings which makes us perfect for groups and Travel Trade. We are easily accessible by road, train and plane and have ample free parking onsite for coaches.  We have 2 onsite restaurants, Traditional Scottish Fayre in Nicky Tam’s and Italian in our Waterside restaurant. This makes the hotel the perfect base for exploring Inverness and the Highlands. Please call us directly on tel: 01463234308  to discuss your requirements.

Title: Glasgow Music City Tours
Description: Welcome To Glasgow Music City Tours. We offer lively and informative guided walks exploring the fascinating places, people, and performances which have shaped Glasgow’s musical landscape. Our tours bring alive tales of the legendary Glasgow music venues that have played host to everyone from Alex Harvey to Paolo Nutini. We offer two distinct tours which run each Saturday and we can also provide private tours at a time that suits your clients. We provide guided tours of the rock, pop and folk music scenes in Glasgow and Edinburgh. FIT and Group Rates available. Tours can be packaged up with meals, drinks, whisky tastings and live folk music. Easy coach access is available to start and end points.

Title: Rennie Mackintosh Station Hotel
Description: The Rennie Mackintosh design makes our hotel unique. We have recently upgraded the room facilities and breakfast selection. Your clients will have the experience of a busy city centre yet very historic with Rennie Mackintosh design, very close to most important places to visit in Glasgow. We are a city centre hotel, very near to central station, high street and all major shopping complex - St. Enoch, Buchanan Galleries etc, cinemas and surrounded by many dining options/eateries.

Title: Blair Drummond Safari & Adventure Park
Description: A world-class visitor experience that is exciting, educational and fun. Visitors come face-to-face with lions, rhinos and monkeys in drive-through reserves, take a boat ride to Chimp Island, meet Scotland's only giraffes, and learn about animals at free talks and presentations. Group friendly, easy coach parking and bespoke experiences available.
Address Line 1: Blair Drummond Safari and Adventure Park

Title: Best Western Inverness Palace Hotel & Spa
Description: Best Western Inverness Palace Hotel & Spa is located on the banks of the River Ness, opposite Inverness Castle only few minutes’ walk from the city centre.  The Palace opened in 1890 and now has 110 rooms over 2 Victorian properties and one modern cottage. After extensive investment you will enjoy a classic - contemporary hotel with sophisticated Brasserie & Bar, guest lounges with views of the River Ness and a modern leisure club with swimming pool, gym & spa.   Your guests will relax in spacious and refurbished rooms with Wi-Fi and flat screen TVs.

Title: Wildwoodz
Description: “The Highlands Most Exciting Day Out! Exhilarating activities and events set in a beautiful Highland location on the North Coast 500. Wildwoodz is owned and operated by Dave Elliott – paintball player of over 30 years experience at the highest levels of the game. He has created the Highlands most exciting outdoor venue! World class Paintball, Lasertag and Archery facilities providing unequalled 5 Star service and equipment. Axe Throwing and Bushcraft have been recently added to their exciting repertoire, so Wildwoodz truly has something for all your clients. Bespoke activities and events can also be organized to suit your client’s needs.

Title: Ibis Glasgow City Centre
Description: Our double and twin bedrooms offer an extra level of style and comfort. Our friendly team are ready to welcome guests for an unforgettable experience right in the centre of Glasgow. With Fogg's Bar & Kitchen offering everything from early breakfasts to light lunches to 24 hour snacks, we have a range of options to suit the needs of every guest. With easy access to the airport, West end and more, we’re the ideal base for exploring Glasgow.

Title: Novotel Glasgow Centre
Description: Conveniently located in the heart of Glasgow, our welcoming and family-friendly hotel is an ideal base for exploring the city. The hotel offers twin, double and family rooms furnished to a high standard, as well as a newly opened restaurant and our bar serving a variety of local delights. Guests can rejuvenate after busy days in our fitness centre, or relax completely in the sauna and steam room. Our proximity to the M8 motorway makes us an ideal base for accessing the airport, the Highlands and more.

Title: The Boat Country Inn
Description:
That warm hug after a day out and about.
This is what awaits your clients. Rustic character, rural charm is all on offer at this hotel. Overlooking the Cairngorm mountains on the platform of the Strathspey Steam Railway, they’ll will be welcomed after a day exploring.

Offering an easy alternative to hotels in Aviemore, enjoy hearty seasonal food and Scottish Craft Beers and Gins and Malt Whiskies. With cosy log fires and resident’s lounge.

Located in the heart of the Cairngorms National Park, only 5 mins from Aviemore and 40 mins from Inverness Airport, with 34 bedrooms. Accommodating groups of up to 60 for lunches.

Title: Wild West
Description: Wild West specialises in Wildlife safaris in the West Highlands, based in Fort William. On full day safaris we look for Scotland's "Big Five" of red deer, otter, golden eagle, seals and Red squirrel. My minibus can accommodate up to eight passengers. I also offer more general scenic and historic tours where clients will learn how the landscapes formed through fire and ice, hear stories of the battles and toils of the highlanders and learn about the culture and language of the people.

Title: Glen Clova Hotel and Luxury Lodges
Description: Your clients can enjoy staying in the heart of the Angus Glens in Cairngorms National Park, a perfect location for activity holidays. Glen Clova Hotel offers accommodation for up to 40 people for 1 to more night stays. The hotel also has 9 Luxury lodges bookable for longer, 3/4 night stays and sits at around 1.5 hours from Edinburgh airport . Among its amenities has an excellent restaurant serving local produce.

Title: CLA Scottish Tours Ltd
Description: CLA Scottish Tours helps make visits to the West of Scotland extra special, offering tours designed to meet individual tastes and interests. Catering for groups of up to eight people who will travel in comfort in our luxury vehicle enjoying Scotland at its very best – in cities, the countryside or for culture. Based in Paisley close to Glasgow Airport as well as Greenock’s Ocean Terminal so pick-up options are straightforward.

Title: McKays Hotel Bar and Restaurant
Description:
When your clients stay at McKays Hotel in Pitlochry, Perthshire, it’s so much more than just a place to stay.

It’s evening entertainment, it’s a place to eat in Pitlochry, it’s a pub, there’s live sport, it’s live music. McKays Hotel is more. Offering you a place to relax, enjoy live music every weekend from bands across Scotland. Then dine in one of the best places to eat in Pitlochry, using produce from across Scotland to create regular favourites and daily specials.
Located just 30 minutes from Perth and 1.5 hrs from Edinburgh Airport. Groups and FIT welcome and bespoke tours are catered for. Can accommodate up to 80 seated for lunches. Your clients will enjoy seasonal pub-food, craft beers and premium spirits.

Title: Tours Plus English
Description: We can offer your clients a range of 6-day educational touring courses, incorporating themed tours as well as the chance to improve their English skills at our language school.  Tours covered range from history, through to art & literature which take place in Edinburgh and the surrounding areas.

Title: Kimpton Charlotte Square Hotel
Description: Luxury boutique hotel fused with eclectic townhouse – perfect for the inquisitive traveller. Located in Edinburgh’s New Town. Inspired by the ‘golden age of travel’, and offering two dining experiences; BABA, the Garden Bar. The Spa offers three treatment rooms, indoor pool, sauna, steam room fully equipped gym and studio.

Title: Hampton by Hilton Hamilton Park
Description: Set amongst the beautiful grounds of Hamilton Park Racecourse, Hampton by Hilton Hamilton Park opened it's doors in  2019. When you stay with us, you can sit back and relax in one of our 118 air-conditioned bedrooms and watch over the beautiful grounds including the racetrack below. We are also just 15 miles from Glasgow City Centre. Our amenities include over 100 complimentary car parking spaces, Free Wi-Fi, casual dining and bar facility with 24h service available for residents, complimentary fitness centre access and quiet work zone.

Title: The Canyoning Company
Description: Welcome to The Canyoning Company based in Dunkeld, Perthshire. We offer a unique adventure experience for everyone. With waterfall abseils, ziplines, jumps and slides your customers are guaranteed real thrills and a true adventure experience. We provide daily tours throughout Scotland, offering high end bespoke trips using the best instructors in the UK. Giving your customers a fun, safe memorable experience. We don’t just do canyoning we share our passion.

Title: Cannonball Restaurant
Description:
Our restaurant is located on this historic 17th century building’s top floor, serving the finest Scottish food with stunning views of the city-skyline and our next-door neighbour Edinburgh Castle. Our tasting menu showcases the best seasonal Scottish produce.
Cannonball Bar in the middle, serves over 150 Scotch whiskies with views of the lively Royal Mile.
Our private dining room on the lower ground floor is suitable for groups of 15 to 40 guests. Perfect for whisky tasting and private dinners.

Title: Hebridean Adventures
Description:
Hebridean Adventures operates small-group wildlife expedition cruises aboard the MV Hjalmar Bjorge, an ex-search and rescue vessel.
Our trips range from 4 to 13 nights exploring  Scotland’s most remote islands and coastlines, focussing on birdlife, cetaceans and wild landscapes. Voyages combine expert guiding, excellent food and genuine adventure in an informal, small-ship setting. We are happy to explore partnerships with travel trade partners for FIT clients and small groups, on our scheduled departures and private charter opportunities.

Title: Highland Park
Description:
Discover Highland Park Distillery, crafting exceptional whisky for over 200 years, with bespoke options to create a memorable experience for your guests.
Bespoke Tours for FIT, groups, up to x40 pax with numerous options for your clients.
Open all year

Title: Sleigh’s Scotland
Description: We offer bespoke luxury UK tours specialising in Scotland. We pride ourselves in customising personalised packages to meet every client’s interests. From finding a castle for a family vacation, organising helicopter transport for a remote picnic or sourcing a football for an afternoon’s entertainment, we are eager to meet every client’s wishes.

Title: SCHLOSS Roxburghe
Description: An exceptional country resort with Championship Golf Course and a range of outdoor activities, located in the Scottish Borders but little more than an hour's drive from both Edinburgh and Newcastle. The elegant property includes 78 rooms and 12 two-bedroom cottages. Cuisine is top quality and varied, with an emphasis on fresh, home-grown produce. There are numerous cosy bars with roaring log fires for leisurely drinks, and a state of the art Spa with outdoor heated infinity pool.

Title: The GlenAllachie Distillery
Description: The GlenAllachie Distillery’s award-winning Visitor Centre offers a range of tours and tastings, with something to suit every level of knowledge. There is also a spacious whisky bar & tasting lounge that boasts substantial outdoor seating, ideal for an alfresco dram. Let’s not forget the well-stocked distillery shop packed full of all The GlenAllachie Distillers brands, with some hard-to-find limited editions and very special distillery-exclusive expressions, including the opportunity to hand-fill your own bottle straight from the cask.

Title: Ardnahoe Distillery
Description: Ardnahoe, the family owned distillery and the newest to open on the famous whisky Isle of Islay. The ninth distillery on the island offers a variety of tours, whisky tastings, delicious food and views over the Paps of Jura – a guaranteed unforgettable experience.

Title: Stirling Distillery
Description: Just a stone’s throw from the Castle, Stirling Distillery is the home of Stirling Gin. From our 19th Century building we host tours and experiences 7 days a week. Enjoy a gin tasting in Stirling's first legal Distillery.

Title: Inveraray Jail
Description: Do you sometimes feel like putting your clients behind bars and giving them a hard time? Now is your chance!  Bring them to Inveraray Jail and place them in our custody. The Jail has established itself as one of Scotland’s best attractions. Step back almost two centuries and discover the stories of the real men, women and children who were tried and served their sentences in this prison. Listen to dramatic true tales from the characters in the Jail’s past brought to life with our FREE interactive audio guides. Available in six languages.

Title: Assynt House
Description: A historic country house with luxury accommodation for groups of up to 14, Assynt House has seven en-suite super-king size bedrooms. Each of these bedrooms is as impressive as the next and the social spaces for dining and entertaining are both elegant and beautifully comfortable. Owner/chef, Graham Waugh, can cook for you by prior arrangement using Scotland’s plentiful larder. Daily housekeeping is a welcome addition to your stay. Your hosts are able to arrange entertainment and activities and can assist you with your itinerary. You are assured of the warmest 5 star welcome at Assynt House.

Title: Orkney Distillery
Description:
On Kirkwall’s harbour-front, the Orkney Distillery is the ideal attraction for your clients looking for a quality visitor experience in the heart of Orkney’s main town. Gin distillery tours run each day with bespoke tours available for groups. Your clients will learn about the distilling process, gin production & sample the gins before relaxing with a drink. 
Parking available, tour is suitable for children & has disabled access. 10% discount on tour for groups of 10+ (£15 adults, £8 children).

Title: Glenshee Ltd
Description: Situated on the Cairnwell pass on the A93 (highest A road in UK) and featured on 2 iconic driving routes the Snow Roads and the North East 250 we operate throughout the year. In winter we are Scotland’s largest Snowsport centre. In the summer we have a roadside T@the Shee café with home cooking and barista coffee and from April to October a sceanic 3-man chairlift accessing amazing views of the Cairngorms. We can host events, meals with ample parking to suit your requirements.

Title: WL Sleigh
Description: We are a long-established specialist chauffeur drive company. Our luxury fleet of executive saloons and people carriers is meticulously maintained for the highest standards of safety and comfort. At WL Sleigh’s, we pride ourselves in our attention to detail, and are eager to meet every client’s personal requirements for chauffer driven travel.

Title: Turin Castle
Description: Turin Castle is a fully serviced private luxury castle in the heart of Angus, built in 1659 we provide concierge service from the moment of booking delivering unique in house experiences. From butlers and private chefs, discerning guests can enjoy a taste of true Scottish Hospitality in their own Highland Home.

Title: DD Tours
Description: DD Tours run historical walking tours within Dundee City. Tours are presented by two local guides, a double-act of storytellers bringing energy and humour. We have a wide range of tours including underground vaults - all tours can be adapted to include locations and stories of interest to the group.

Title: An Talla by Loch Ness
Description: An Talla, Gaelic for "meeting place," is a café and retail destination at Dochgarroch Lock, near Inverness, also serving as a departure point for Loch Ness by Jacobite's 5-star cruises. Our menu offers freshly prepared, locally sourced cuisine, and our retail space features the exclusive Loch Ness Collection and Highland-inspired pieces. An Talla is the perfect destination for your FIT clients, and is also available for events, meetings, or exclusive use.

Title: Loch Fyne Hotel and Spa
Description: Loch Fyne Hotel & Spa welcomes leisure groups, high end tours and exclusive events. Our spectacular location makes any stay memorable. About an hour’s drive from Glasgow city centre and the airport, it’s a tranquil location that’s easy to get to. The local area is well suited to walking and maps are available for routes of different lengths and difficulties. FIT guests will enjoy spectacular views of the Loch and the best of local food and drink in popular restaurant, Cladach Mor, and the lounge bar.

Title: Thainstone House
Description:
Thainstone House is an 18th-century grand mansion in 44 acres of private parkland.  Only 10 minutes from Aberdeen International Airport.  We welcome FIT & small groups of up to 12 people with parking available for small executive coaches. 
Regional flavours influence the menu in the 1 Rosette Restaurant, The Green Lady with hearty home cooked food, local ales and malt whiskies inour Stockman’s Bar.  Explore all Aberdeenshire has to offer – rolling countryside, world-class golf, walks and distilleries.   Onsite spa which includes indoor pool, hot tub, sauna, steam room, gym and luxury Scottish spa treatments.

Title: Cairn Hotel Group – Stirling Highland Hotel
Description:
Set within the beautiful and historic city of Stirling, the Stirling Highland Hotel is a charming Victorian building and former school, which dates back to 1845. Situated a stone’s throw from the city’s medieval castle, this hotel is ideal for those ready to immerse themselves in the history of Gateway to the Scottish Highlands.
Featuring 96 bright and spacious rooms, and a range of modern facilities and amenities including a fascinating working observatory which can be hired for stargazing, spa, a heated indoor pool, gym, squash court, free Wi-Fi and flat-screen TVs.
The hotel is proud to provide unique solutions and spaces to leisure and business guests including groups & tours, FIT, and MICE.

Title: Araminta Campbell - Luxury Scottish Textiles
Description: Embracing traditional craftsmanship and timeless design, Araminta Campbell creates exceptional textiles that express Scotland’s natural beauty and weaving heritage. From our Edinburgh studio we hand weave our SIGNATURE collection of British alpaca accessories alongside our HERITAGE service for bespoke tweeds and tartans. By appointment through our partners we open our doors to guests from around the world to experience behind-the-scenes of our workshop and source the finest Scottish textiles. Please contact us if you are interested in becoming one of our selected partners.

Title: Highland Auto Campers
Description: Highland Auto Campers offer for rent a fleet of luxury campervans – the perfect way to explore the Scottish Highlands! We are a family run company based in Inverness, at the starting point of the North Coast 500, and just 20 minutes from Inverness airport. Our all-inclusive pricing means our campers are fully equipped with everything you will need for your Scottish adventure.

Title: Busta House Hotel
Description: Busta House has stood proud over the Busta coastline since the 16th century As Shetland’s leading 3* country house hotel. Ideally situated centrally on Shetland, with easy access from the main A970.  We have 22 Comfortable, well appointed & En-suite rooms. We have many years of experience working with many Trade companies from Large Tour groups to FIT.

Title: Orkney Island Tours
Description: Seeking adventures for your guests visiting Orkney? Come share our love of Orkney - it’s amazing! We offer mixed duration, guided, inclusive itineraries for 4 - 44 guests covering  Orkney’s main island and many of it’s smaller ones too. Register with us as a Trade Customer to receive a discount booking code and then tap straight into our regular three-season tour offering via our online booking systems or contact Vita and Nic. to discuss year around experiences which suit your client’s needs

Title: Shetland Knitting Tutor
Description: Embracing traditional craftsmanship, I help to inspire knitters and crafters by sharing my knitting projects and knitting history. Showing visitors Shetland through my crafting eyes, my landscape and my reflections on my crafting life. For your clients I can offer knitting workshops designed for beginners, intermediate and advanced knitters to learn or refine their knitting methods. Maximum group size is twenty, courses held throughout Shetland, all year round.

Title: Holyrood Distillery
Description: Holyrood Distillery is Edinburgh's first malt whisky distillery for nearly 100 years and is a brand-new visitor attraction, offering a variety of different tours as well as evening hospitality options. Housed in a historic B-listed former railway building, the distillery is just a 20 minute walk from Edinburgh's Royal Mile. With a focus on flavour, tours accommodate up to 22 guests. The distillery takes visitors around the experience with samples of both Gin and Whisky. There are also more in depth tours available on each spirit. Thee is a well stocked shop on site and the visitor ends their tour in the bar which offers stunning views over Holyrood Park. Group rates are available and the site is fully accessible for the disabled please note there is no coach parking but drop off is available nearby.

Title: Garleton Lodge
Description: Our hilltop position offers spectacular panoramic views across the Firth of Forth, Edinburgh & East Lothian including many golf courses along Scotland’s Golf Coast. 30 mins from Edinburgh Airport & City Centre, your guests can relax in our 5-star, 8-bedroom, luxury B&B/small hotel with restaurant, spa, BBQ hut, hot tub & golf facilities. Our restaurant showcases local produce & our bar stocks Scottish gins, whiskies & beers so guests can enjoy the best that Scotland & East Lothian has to offer.

Title: The Munro Bagging Company
Description: Our day tours, which include an expert walking guide, equipment hire, packed lunch, and full transportation, can take your clients to climb one of the iconic Scottish munros (mountains over 3,000 feet). We will tailor the climb to your clients requirements and ensure they have a fantastic experience in some of scotland’s most beautiful scenery.

Title: Cottiscarth Cottages
Description:
The complex consists of three cottages built in 2019 to an extremely high standard, offering 1 three-bedroom cottage and two 2 bedroom cottages.
This family run establishment takes pride in making your clients feel welcome with a generous welcome hamper on arrival and stunning views across the Orkney landscape.
Situated alongside a Site of special Scientific Interest and a RSPB bird reserve, your clients can watch Hen Harries hunting over Cottiscarth Dale. 
The cottages are also part of an organic farm and your clients are welcome to come along and see the cattle and sheep grazing.
Groups and FIT welcome.

Title: Anta Scotland Ltd - Fearn
Description: Bring your clients to the Highland pottery and textiles shop of the Scottish interiors company, ANTA, in Fearn, where many of its products are made. There is free easy coach parking and our tearoom seats up to 20 people offering an appetizing selection of homemade soups, scones, teas, coffees and home baked treats.

Title: The Haggis Experience
Description:
The Haggis Experience
 Unique and authentic experiences based around Scotland's iconic national dish.  Involving engaging and entertaining presentations, demonstrations and tastings and based on a working hill farm near Loch Lomond National Park. Bespoke experiences, shared sessions FIT, MICE and larger groups, available all year, by arrangement.
 Join us on a centrally located working sheep farm and explore the history, folklore and culture which surrounds this iconic food
Discover how world famous haggis is made, cooked and traditionally presented as well as new contemporary interpretations of this delicious and surprisingly versatile dish.

Title: Where Stags Roar
Description: A unique selection of 4 star self-catered properties in the heart of the Cairngorms National Park. Cosy lodges with roll-top baths and wood-burning stoves perfect for couples or families. Overlooking the golf course, the 4 properties are all presented with meticulous attention to detail and style. Winner of the Highland and Islands Tourism Awards "Best Self-catering Accommodation" category.

Title: Wild at Art Ltd
Description: Small group and bespoke art holidays and retreats – we curate unique experiences that offer your clients inspiring opportunities to get creative while holidaying in Scotland. Covering the whole of Scotland, we work with a growing team of excellent tutors. Activities include drawing and painting, photography, singing, stonecarving, pottery, weaving & more.

Title: Rothiemurchus Estate
Description: Step into traditional Highland estate life in one of the most picturesque spots in Scotland. Rothiemurchus is the jewel of the Cairngorms National Park and has been recognised throughout history as a special place for its beauty, magnificent pine forests and abundant wildlife. We provide luxury tailored experiences for your clients: tours with our Ranger team, meet our Highland cattle, feed the deer, bespoke catering in unique venues and a wide range of outdoor activities.

Title: Dewar’s Aberfeldy Distillery
Description: Come and share the Dewar family’s pursuit of whisky perfection in the only distillery they built. Take a tour and explore our interactive exhibition, before a whisky tasting from the John Dewar and & Sons Fine Scotch Whisky Emporium range. Soak up the atmosphere in our welcoming Whisky lounge and cafe. iPad & written guides in ten languages. Open all year.

Title: Luxury Hideaways
Description: Situated in between Crieff and Perth with more sites popping up across the UK, our stunning Luxury Glamping pods offer an experience and retreat like no other. A totally new type of experience completed in 2019 embeds you in the heart of nature, offering one of the most romantic getaways in Scotland and the UK. Complete with your very own Hot tub, set on a private lit decking area, a place to truly relax and enjoy each other’s company. All our pods come with a Super King size bed with Egyptian cotton, hot and cold air conditioning, underfloor heating, mood lighting, music system and many other high-tech features making it an exceptionally comfortable place to be in.

Title: WEST Brewery
Description: Housed in the iconic Templeton building in Glasgow’s biggest park, Glasgow Green, WEST is home to a working brewery and an award-winning bar, restaurant and events space. The only UK brewery to produce all of its artisan beers in accordance with the German Purity Law of 1516, everything we do at WEST can be summed up by our ethos ‘Glaswegian Heart. German Head’, infusing German principles with the renowned Glaswegian spirit. We have two dedicated private spaces and our location makes for an unforgettable event! Your clients can also enjoy a tour of the brewery, which will give them not only a glimpse of how the magic happens but a real flavour for the beer of which we are so proud.

Title: Balmoral Arms
Description: This recently refurbished five-star inn, Balmoral Arms sits in the heart of the Victorian village of Ballater, Royal Deeside, a short drive from the Royal Family’s Scottish home at Balmoral Castle.  This is a place where nature, heritage and style come together.  The inn features luxurious rooms and suites and locally inspired cuisine in the 1852 restaurant and Ghillies Bar.  The region offers an outstanding choice of outdoor activities.  Nearest airport is Aberdeen. Groups of up to 20 rooms welcome.

Title: Isle of Mull Hotel & Spa
Description: An island retreat, perfect for trips to nearby Staffa and Fingal’s Cave, wildflife spotting, Tobermory and island hopping.  45 minutes ferry ride from Oban, Isle of Mull Hotel & Spa is suitable for FIT and small groups. Many of the hotel’s 75 rooms offer sea views, as does the Sea Deck and Bistro, Oran Na Mara, which offers an array of fresh seafood and other on local produce. Our Driftwood Spa offers a pool, thermal experience, outdoor hut tub and Ishga products.

Title: Ness Walk
Description:
The 5-star Ness Walk offers the pinnacle of Highland hospitality to your clients on the banks of the River Ness in Inverness. Multi-award winning, the team deliver ‘emotional luxury’ with warmth and charm. Home to the highly regarded Torrish Restaurant; showcasing the finest local artisan producers, growers and farmers.
Ideal destination for private/bespoke groups and FIT. Offering 47 bedrooms including 2 spectacular suites. Awarded Gold by Green Tourism for Sustainability

Title: Kingsmills Hotel
Description:
Offering 147 luxurious rooms, the Kingsmills Hotel is a premier 4* hotel in Inverness. The hotel is renowned worldwide for its warmth of service and exquisite accommodation. Extensive free parking facilities, high speed Wi-Fi, leisure club, spa, private dining and two restaurant experiences all ensure your guests will be well looked after. Located 10 miles from Inverness Airport.
Contact our dedicated Travel Trade Team to see how we can bring your guests’ Scottish Highlands adventures to life.

Title: Royal Highland Hotel
Description: Heritage former Railway Property built 1856 centrally located in Inverness and offering traditional accommodation and dining including afternoon teas and meal stops. Great base to explore local areas. Ideal for individuals or groups.

Title: ACD Executive
Description: A truly executive level driver/concierge service. Serving one client group per day affords the client full flexibility to amend their plan. We assist with building/booking unforgettable itineraries, if wished for FITs or groups of up to 20. We utilise only top of the range Mercedes luxury saloon & people carriers, all of which have complimentary WiFi, chilled waters and numerous 'little-touches' to further enhance the travel experience, there is no better service.

Title: Luxury Scotland Tours
Description: Let us take care of every aspect of your tour from initial tour design to providing an unrivalled chauffeur service. Our experienced tour designers have an extensive knowledge of our beautiful country and we pride ourselves on creating the most enchanting tour itineraries. Including Scotland’s finest hotels, historic venues, traditional whisky distilleries, scenic driving routes, awe-inspiring landscapes and majestic golf courses.

Title: Inspiring Travel Scotland
Description: Inspiring Travel Scotland are the Scottish Touring experts, rated 5-star on Google. We create luxury, bespoke, private tours for your clients, all we need is the rough dates and duration. We will then create your clients dream, once in lifetime, tour of Scotland. We provide a professional full colour 15-20 page client facing Detailed Tour Itinerary for you to present to your clients, along with a one page Agent Summary for you. Tours can include luxury and unique heritage accommodation, immersive experiences and unique VIP touring. Net rates provided if preferred.
Telephone: Toll Free USA/Canada 1-888-810-0045 or +44 141 432 1770 from anywhere else

Title: Dolphin Spirit
Description: We offer 2 wildlife watching boat trips from Inverness into the Moray Firth in search of seals, dolphins, otters and other sea creatures. We run from April to October 7 days a week. Enjoy a leisurely trip onboard the 65-seat Dolphin Spirit with a Guide, or a fast RIB experience. Why not speak to us and see what we can offer you and your customers.

Title: Hebridean Hopscotch Holiday
Description: Based locally and operating for over 20 years, we specialise in Outer Hebrides island hopping packages and bespoke holidays. We offer self-drive from Oban, Uig or Ullapool or fly-drive from the major Scottish cities.  We take care of accommodation, transport and car or cycle hire. Our expert advisors all live locally and know, from first hand experience, exactly what’s on offer in the Outer Hebrides.

Title: Piper's Hut Apartment
Description: Piper's Hut is a self contained apartment for 2 adults and within a 10 min walk from the centre of Portree.  It would be an ideal for your clients to tour the island from while having a choice of restaurants and bars within walking distance.  The apartment is finished to a very high standard with a double bed, two seater sofa, 40 inch Smart TV, bespoke kitchen with hob and microwave grill (no oven), power rain shower and seating area for dining.  Basic starter pack of porridge, cereal, bread, milk and a Nescafe coffee machine are all in place for your customers.  Two night minimum stay.

Title: Odin Tours of Orkney
Description: We offer bespoke guided tours of Orkney. Our service is aimed at couples, small groups and families and we can offer your clients a day tour or multi day tours. Our touring vehicle is a 7 seater, max 6 guests, comfortable VW Caddy. Our objective is to deliver a unique experience which will make memories and highlight the very best of what Orkney can offer. Our tours offer a unique experience combining whatever the clients’ interests are.

Title: Campbell's of Beauly
Description: Established in 1858, Campbell’s of Beauly is an iconic privately owned country tailor and outfitters with two Royal Warrants, one to His Majesty The King and also to Her Majesty Queen Elizabeth II. The retail emporium is an experience in itself with a truly original and characterful charm. The alchemy of the original fixtures and fittings with the contemporary products sold today creates a unique appearance and experience. Why not give us a call and see what we can offer you and your customers during their trip to Scotland.

Title: Wilson’s Farm and Kitchen
