Description: Join us for seasonal, local Field to Fork farm tours showing our animals, crops, biodiversity and sheep dog demonstrations, using products from our, and other neighbour’s farms. Our inhouse catering takes advantage of some great artisan producers and our knowledgeable team only choose the finest ingredients. Through our monthly supper club and roast club join us for some decadence, or book privatelty. Welcoming small groups to coach parties in our converted 19th century Stables offering toilets, welly boots and wifi.

Title: Private Concierge Scotland
Description: Private Concierge Scotland offers you a one stop shop, luxury partner to ensure complete perfection for your clients. We can provide a full touring itinerary, accommodation, transport and excursions ensuring they are planned to perfection. No request is too big or too small and we love to ensure your clients get to see Scotland the way they want to, on a customised itinerary just for them.

Title: Bernera Museum & Bosta Iron Age House
Description:
The museum tells the historical local story of the small island of Bernera using story boards, photographs, artefacts and family and croft histories.
The Iron Age House is an exact replica of one of the unique Late Pictish Iron Age houses excavated at Bosta. Our local guides inform your guests how the people from the late Scottish Iron Age lived in this unique village.
Open 1st May to last Friday in September each year, out of season bookings accepted.

Title: Campsie Campers Ltd.
Description: Campsie Campers Ltd. provide late model, fully equipped campervans which are perfectly suited to your clients needs. We have a choice of vehicles in our fleet from premium VW pop-tops and high-tops to luxury Peugeot Skye-Liners. As a family owned and operated business we can provide personalised services to your clients. Our convenient location allows us to offer meet and greet transfer services from all major Scottish airports and train stations. Campsie Campers have invested in back-end booking/logistics software that guarentees accuracy of reservations. Our goal is to ensure your clients receive an unsurpassed, unique experience for their campervan holiday in Scotland.

Title: The McManus: Dundee’s Art Gallery & Museum
Description: The McManus: Dundee's Art Gallery & Museum offers a fascinating insight into Dundee and with 8 stunning galleries to explore, there is a wealth of information to discover in our exhibitions of art, history and the environment. Visitors can enjoy a tour of the permanent displays with our Audio Guide Handsets - available for hire in 6 different languages - English, French, German, Italian, Spanish and Mandarin.

Title: Great Time Scotland
Description: Visit our 17th Century hill sheep farm in Rob Roy country. Your clients can have lunch or dinner with us in MacGregor’s Barn (1604).  We will play traditional music from our family with their meal.  Or they can join us for morning coffee/afternoon tea with a sheepdog display.  We also have a Jacobite weaponry display, clay pigeon shooting, canoeing, and mountain bikes also available on farm, please contact us to discuss.

Title: Crieff Golf Club Ltd
Description: Located in the heart of Perthshire and only 6 miles from Glenagles.  Breathtaking views over the Strathearn Valley, both the Ferntower (18 holes) and Dornock (9 holes) are distinguished parkland courses catering for all levels of golfer. Excellent customer service, flexibility and friendly reception is recognized by all our visiting groups. Full golf service with ample onsite parking, practice facilities, club & buggy hire with a relaxing Clubhouse with superb catering and bar facilities. Private room hire is also available.

Title: Scottish Food and Drink Trails
Description: Scottish Food and Drink Trails offer food and drink tours and experiences. These are local, immersive and unique.  We offer full and half-day options. All tours leave from Edinburgh. Our scheduled tours and experiences operate with 2-8 people max and are bookable online. We also offer a bespoke service for the discerning traveller or small groups.

Title: In Your Element
Description: In Your Element has been offering amazing outdoor activity experiences across Scotland since 2004.  We can offer a huge range of  outdoor activities near Inverness & Loch Ness, Aviemore, Loch Lomond and Loch Tay, as well as many other places in Scotland. Please get in touch and see what unique experiences we can arrange for you and your visitors.

Title: Airport Transfers Scotland Ltd
Description: Airport Transfers Scotland is a professional and reliable online transportation service with over 10 years’ experience. We provide a reliable service at competitive fixed prices to and from airports,ferry and Train Stations in Scotland. We operate 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. We Have it covered Whisky, Lochs,Golf and Castle tours.

Title: Loyd & Townsend Rose
Description: Loyd & Townsend Rose is a leading provider of private client concierge travel services and destination management company for Scotland, England and Ireland.  We offer your clients access to the finest private houses and castles as well as organising every aspect of the most luxurious family vacations and special events.

Title: Liquid Footprints
Description: We are an outdoor guiding business that focuses on bespoke trips and experiences.  We offer canoeing, sea kayaking gorge scrambling and walking tours. We work all over the Highlands and cater each individual trip to our clients. We also have a partnership with local food suppliers bringing the best of Highland cuisine to our experiences.

Title: YOTEL Glasgow
Description: YOTEL Glasgow, located centrally for your clients, is a 257-room hotel that features Glasgow’s first destination rooftop bar with bowling alley! YOTEL offers your clients a new hotel experience using signature, cutting-edge design creating perfectly-formed cabins (YOTEL speak for bedrooms) for guests who appreciate quality but don't need the fuss of a traditional luxury hotel.

Title: YOTEL Edinburgh
Description: YOTEL Edinburgh, centrally located  for your client’s convenience on Queen Street with 276 cabins ( YOTEL speak for rooms), co-working, private meetings and a large event space. Our forward-thinking hotel boasts easy access to top city attractions and has excellent transport. A contemporary and playful design together with technology driven experiences, offers an exciting alternative to the traditional offering.

Title: Fisher's Hotel
Description: Fishers is in the heart of Pitlochry, Pitlochry is the heart of Scotland. We are part of the Castle Collection group. We are a 4 star property with 138 rooms, mixture of singles, twins, doubles, family, upgraded rooms. Our Garden room restaurant is newly decorated and the food is based on the Scottish and Perthshire Larder. We have a mix of languages spoken in the hotel. Spanish, Czech, Polish, Romanian, Ukrainian, Portugese and English.

Title: Scotlands Spa Hotel
Description: Fionn MacCumhaill, the owner of the hotel purchased the hotel in January 2019.  He has invested in the hotel to make a unique modern hotel with a touch of tradition.  The hotel after the renovations will have 75 bedrooms this will be a mix of singles, doubles, twin/family rooms, 1 restaurants, 1 bar, 1 coffee lounge, Spa and leisure facilities with treatment rooms.  Scotlands Spa Hotel is in a great location just off the main street of Pitlochry.

Title: Unique Adventure Tours Scotland
Description: Unique Adventure Tours Scotland offers high-end adventure activity tours throughout Scotland. These are small private tours, client experience focused, and customizable as required, our tours and adventure days operate with 2-6 people max and are bookable online. Our tours leave from Edinburgh, Glasgow, and Perth or a custom point of collection (discussed prior to booking).

Title: Go-Where Scotland
Description: Go-Where Scotland are a multi award-winning B2C/B2B Scotland-wide cycle guiding & package holiday tour operator offering attractive trade rates on off-road cycling itineraries for small groups of any age or ability. We work with agencies, groups and individuals around the world, we would be delighted to create unique itineraries to suit your customers or make our current tour inventory available to your company. We offer flexible, scalable commission rates commensurate for travel trade.

Title: Ossian Experiences
Description: Ossian is Scotland’s leading sporting and unique adventure specialist.  Ossian has unrivalled and exclusive access to the finest sporting estates and private properties in the country.  Our in-depth and unsurpassed knowledge of Scotland enables us to tailor each trip so that your clients fully experience the country’s sporting secrets.  We pride ourselves on creating and executing unique trips with unparalleled attention to detail.

Title: Unlock Your Past
Description: Unlock Your Past offers a tailored family history service, designed to meet your specific needs. Whether you would like us to trace your Scottish ancestry before your visit or prefer to conduct the research yourself with our help, we are here to help you. Sarah, the founder of Unlock Your Past, is a degree-qualified genealogist and an accredited member of the Association of Scottish Genealogists & Researchers in Archives (ASGRA).

Title: Blue Sky Experiences
Description: Since 2001, BlueSky Experiences has created purposeful, professionally delivered events across Scotland. From our exclusive-use Perthshire venue, Edinburgh locations and partner venues nationwide, we design tailored experiences for corporate, incentive and leisure groups. Our portfolio includes Highland Games, whisky tasting, ceilidhs, evening entertainment, Hunger Battles, Diamond Quest, GPS treasure hunts, escape challenges and tv inspired game shows. Whether the aim is to reward, connect, energise or develop a team, we combine imaginative design, expert facilitation and seamless delivery.

Title: Simpliciter DMC
Description: When travelling to Scotland, Simpliciter’s Destination Management services are tailored to your needs infused by the regions Royal heritage including Whisky, Golf, Castles and any other attraction of interest offering quality delivery.

Title: Travel Connect
Description: Your transport solutions made easy. We work with a network of transport partners who supply executive coaches, luxury minibuses and cars, providing a full tailored transport solution to suit your client. With the support of our 24 hour control room, our service will ensure you are in safe hands.

Title: DeVere Chauffeur Drive & Private Tours
Description: DeVere were established in 2004 and have fast become a leading chauffeur service throughout Scotland. Our chauffeurs are retired traffic Police officers, so clients enjoy the benefit of the highest standard of driving ensuring safety & comfort at all times.  Our tours vary to suit clients' needs and can be tailor-made to suit interests, schedules, age/ability and budget. We will provide a variety of tour options, can assist with accommodation, attractions and dining experiences. We cater for individual parties, groups or large events with single day or multi-day options.

Title: Private Chauffeur Scotland
Description: Full Service Private Tours of Scotland. Enchanting castles, breath-taking scenery, the world’s finest whisky distilleries, majestic mountains and fairy-tale stories of battles, romance and warlords all wrapped in a journey of luxury. An experience like no other. Let us take you on a journey across Scotland where you will cruise through the rich layers of Scottish history and culture in our unrivaled chauffeur service.

Title: Maclean and Bruce
Description: MacLean & Bruce is one of Scotland’s leading whisky-focused travel company, creating personalised itineraries for guests which combine luxury travel, exclusive accommodation and unique adventures throughout Scotland. MacLean & Bruce operate at the highest level for VIP guests, offering privileged access to people, places and experiences not available through other channels.

Title: Adventure Alba
Description: Private and fully customizable tours of Scotland, the Scottish Highlands and the isle of Skye. Our Day and Multi Day tours can take a maximum of 8 passengers, larger groups can be accommodated on request. See Scotland your way with Adventure Alba.

Title: Rockworks Chalets
Description: Located in St. Marys village, Holm, these newly refurbished seafront properties boast wonderful views over Scapa Flow and to the Italian Chapel. There are 5 chalets available with a max group size of 16 pax. Minimum stay – 3 night. Please note no food served on the complex, however there are eateries a short drive away and a local shop in the village. Directly located on main bus route. Free onsite parking for cars and minibuses. Your guests will enjoy this perfect retreat after exploring all that Orkney has to offer. Group bookings taken all year

Title: Dalkeith Palace and Country Park
Description: A few miles from Edinburgh you’ll find Restoration Yard Store and Restaurant, set in the perfect 1,000 acre Dalkeith Country Park for groups of 12-80. This stunning destination opened in 2016 following an £8.9million restoration project and is now the perfect stop for breakfast, tea and cake or a two course menu. Your guests can shop in The Store, an experience in itself, with a foodhall selling local Scottish produce, fashion, homewares and more or take a leg stretch on one of our waymarked walks.

Title: Edinburgh Tours and History
Description:
I offer private history walking tours of the following parts of Edinburgh;
The Old Town                         
Edinburgh Castle
Ghosts and Horrors Tour (minimum age 15)
Canongait 
Greyfriars Kirkyard (graveyard)
The New Town

Title: The Albert Hotel
Description: Located in the center of Orkney's ancient capital Kirkwall. Maximum group size 30 pax, min stay - 2 nights. Your guests will have the option of a full cooked Scottish breakfast and 2 or 3 course dinner options available. Coach may park at side of hotel for disembarkation, no overnight coach parking at hotel. All rooms are accessed by lift or stairs, no ground floor rooms.

Title: About Orkney
Description:
I offer driver-guided tours for up to four in a Ford Galaxy and tours for larger groups in a hired coach. Tours can be one day or longer and are designed around the guests’ interests. Having grown up on a small farm beside our World Heritage Site, my tours offer an insight into Orkney’s ancient and more recent past. Any family connections with Orkney can be researched before the tour, which will then be planned around my findings.

I research Orkney’s history and our connections with the wider world and give talks at the Orkney International Science Festival. American guests can learn about Orkney’s part in the American Revolution and Canadians can hear about the Hudson’s Bay Company.

Prices £440 per day for up to four people, including any entrance fees but not lunch. 
•
Prices on application for larger groups or for tours including lunch and airport transfers. £50 deposit secures the booking.

Title: Personalised Orkney Tours
Description:
Tailor-made guided tours of the Orkney archipelago in English or French from 1/2 day [4 hours] to 2 weeks, to suit clients’ interests.
World Host and STGA qualified Green Badge Guide for Orkney. Step-On Guide in your vehicle  or as a Driver Guide for F.I.T. [minimum 1, maximum 4]. Fee includes entry to all Historic Environment Scotland sites for the 1st 2 adult guests. Refreshments and other site entry fees are extra. Airport and Ferry Transfer available.

Title: The Royal Hotel
Description: Bestowed it's name by Queen Victoria this charming small hotel nestles in the riverside village of Comrie, near Crieff amidst the splendour of Strathearn and the Southern Scottish Highlands. Lovingly restored by its owners with the aim of creating "a beautiful, luxury boutique hotel in Scotland", this really is the place for that special break. A perfect location to discover the Southern Highlands, or stop off en route to explore further North or if heading to Oban to reach the Isles   Whether fishing, walking, playing golf, sightseeing or just relaxing, The Royal offers that special, intimate ambience, with eleven beautifully appointed bedrooms and  fine dining options alongside a vibrant Brasserie.

Title: Verdant Works Museum
Description:
Step back in time to discover Dundee's industrial past at Verdant Works Museum. In an 1833 jute mill, experience the history of the city's millworkers brought to life. Choose between self-led or part-guided tours, with local volunteers sharing stories through machinery demonstrations and more. Enjoy local food and beverage in the cafe, with a gift shop boasting a range of handmade produce from Dundee.
Free coach parking.
Group discounts for 15+ pax.
Recommended visit time 1.5hrs
Flexible terms

Title: Dunnottar Castle
Description: Dunnottar Castle is a dramatic and evocative ruined cliff top fortress that was once the home of the Earls Marischal, one of the most powerful families in Scotland. Steeped in history, this romantic and haunting ruin is a photographer’s paradise, a history lover’s dream and an iconic tourist destination for visitors the world over. Dunnottar Castle will provide your clients with an unforgettable experience and the opportunity to discover an impregnable fortress that holds many rich secrets of Scotland’s colourful past. Located just 2 miles outside the town of Stonehaven which is approximately 12 miles south of the city of Aberdeen, which is served by Aberdeen International Airport. Parking is available for up to 5 coaches, the Castle offers visits for FIT and groups

Title: Ogilvy Distillery
Description: Ogilvy Distillery is Scotland’s first producer of Scottish potato vodka and Scotland’s only dedicated vodka distillery tour. Located in Angus, just 2 miles from Glamis Castle.  Experience a true ground to glass spirit at our farm distillery.  Standard tours run at weekends, however, group bookings can be accommodated Monday to Sunday with advance booking.  Coach parking available.

Title: Maryculter House
Description: Only 15 minutes from Aberdeen International Airport and the AWPR, Maryculter House is ideally positioned for guests to experience all that Aberdeenshire has to offer. Our stunning 40-bedroom hotel which dates back to the 13th century, is filled with original period detail and our breathtaking location on the banks of the River Dee offers the perfect back drop for everlasting memories. From the Knights Templar to the Jacobites and beyond, Maryculter House has threads of history throughout.

Title: Peterhead Prison Museum
Description: Step into 130 years of turbulent history within “Scotland’s Toughest Jail” and experience how it would have been inside Scotland’s only “Convict” prison. Known as Scotland’s Alcatraz you will sense the tension throughout your visit and leave with memories that will last forever.

Title: The Fife Arms Braemar
Description: The Fife Arms is a former Victorian coaching inn situated in the village of Braemar, Cairngorms National Park. The hotel brings together Scottish heritage, craftsmanship, culture with world-class contemporary art and a strong sense of community. The 46 suites and bedrooms have all been individually designed with unique furnishing and décor.

Title: No 45
Description: Offering 8 ensuite bedrooms, No 45 is a 4 star property in the village of Ballater; just a few miles from Balmoral Castle.  Your guests will enjoy a delicious breakfast which showcases local and homemade produce.  There is ample parking, free wifi and pack lunches can be provided.

Title: 71 Brewing Ltd
Description: Dundee’s first brewery for 50 years crafting modern seasonal beers in a striking central location. Tour the brewhouse and learn the secrets behind the ever-expanding range of world class brews. Taproom open all week offering tastings with a variety of packages. Maximum number in group: 12 for tours and 25 for the taproom.

Title: Golf World Corporate
Description: Golf World Corporate wants everyone to experience and enjoy their golf trip in Scotland in it's truest form, playing on the best Links courses in the world, visit beautiful countryside and castles but also sample our whisky and food that makes Scotland such a unique destination for golf. We are delighted to work closely with Tour Agents as ground handlers and make sure their clients enjoy their visit to Scotland. Based in Aberdeenshire, Scotland ( 30 mins from International Airport ), we are ideally situated between St. Andrews and Inverness ( the Highlands ) so golfers can enjoy easy access to the widest variety of Links courses possible.

Title: His Majesty's Theatre - Aberdeen Performing Arts
Description: On stage at HMT we bring a variety of shows to the North East with a range of Musicals, Drama, acclaimed stage plays, family shows, ballet, dance and Opera. You can dine in our 1906 restaurant for lunch or pre-theatre supper. Our Café also open from 0930 – 1700 daily.

Title: JP Orkney - Tours
Description:
Let your guests experience and savour the magic of Orkney with our tailor-made Orcadian tours. 
Our Luxury Mercedes tour vehicle seats upto 8 passengers. It's fully electric, so not only is it comfortable, it’s also quiet and environmentally friendly. It is fully licensed, has lots of luggage space and phone charging facilities.
Our tours and guide, Paul Hudd, are fully accredited by The Scottish Tourist Guide Association and have been awarded the highest status, Gold, by Green Tourism.

Title: The Devil's Porridge Museum
Description: The Devil’s Porridge Museum is a 5-star, award-winning heritage attraction uncovering a remarkable and often hidden First World War story, alongside engaging displays on both World Wars. A typical visit lasts one to two hours, making it ideal for groups. Group rates include a free introductory talk, with catering available on request. The museum is fully accessible, offers multilingual audio and written guides, and has ample on-site coach parking.

Title: David Livingstone Birthplace
Description: The David Livingstone Birthplace, home to the history of Scotland’s famous explorer, is currently undergoing a £6.1 million transformation. This will see his birthplace redeveloped to provide a vibrant new museum, setting Scotland in a global context and celebrating the inspirational story of how a poor millworker became one of the most popular British heroes of the Victorian era and a well-known figure in some Sub-Saharan African countries today. The museum is scheduled to re-open in 2020.

Title: Wasted Degrees Brewing
Description: Wasted Degrees offer a variety of brewery-based experiences. We offer something as simple as a tour and a tasting in our onsite bar, to a bespoke brewing package – a unique opportunity to create your own beer, from recipe to production, label design and of course tasting!

Title: Red Bus Bistro
Description:
Get on board for a unique Glasgow or Edinburgh Bus Tour. Enjoy either an afternoon tea or gin tea on our vintage 1966 Routemaster Bus, while you take in the stunning sights that both Edinburgh and Glasgow have to offer.

We also cater for Evening Dining Experiences in Glasgow, Harry Potter Tours in Edinburgh and available for private hire and bespoke events.

Title: City of Aberdeen Distillery & Gin School
Description:
The City of Aberdeen Distillery is the first distillery in Aberdeen City for over 75 years.
Excite your clients and offer them the opportunity to become distillers at the Gin School where they can distil their very own bottle of Scottish Gin.
Discovery Tours, Gin Tasting Masterclass and shop (with demi-johns) are available.

Title: Mackintosh at the Willow
Description:
Mackintosh at the Willow is the only surviving Charles Rennie Mackintosh designed tea rooms.
Treat your clients to bespoke packages, combining the stunning food & surrounds of the tearooms, the immersive historical experience of the exhibition, & tours of the building. Whether a foodie or history buff - we provide unforgettable experiences for all.

Title: Primal Adventures
Description:
Primal Adventures are highly skilled professional experts delivering bespoke first-class immersive
experiences. Passionate about Scotland and everything that it has to offer, the team deliver ultimate
outdoor adventures. Facilitating large team-building corporate groups to smaller expeditions, Primal
Adventures assure to delight by exploring Scotland's hidden gems.

Title: Loganair
Description:
“Loganair, the UK’s largest regional airline, serves over 1.4 million customers yearly across a diverse route network across the United Kingdom, Republic of Ireland, the Isle of Man, Denmark and Norway. Operating lifeline routes across the Scottish Highlands and Islands to the beaches of Barra and the global connective hub at London Heathrow, Loganair’s versatile fleet has gone from strength to strength with over 60 years of aviation experience.

Fly with Loganair to discover many fantastic Scottish destinations across the Scottish Highlands, Northern Isles, Hebrides and Central Scotland, showcasing the best Scotland has to offer and connecting families and visitors alike.”
Address Line 2: Lightyear Building, 9 Marchburn Drive, Glasgow Airport

Title: ScotlandTrips International
Description: We offer super complete and varied Quality Tours so that your clients can know all the essence and feel this wonderful country. We offer ready made itineraries but can also customise tours specifically for your clients needs. We offer a full ground handling service in Scotland. We can accommodate large groups and also, FIT. Free choice and change of dates from just two people upon availability.

Title: Mercure Livingston Hotel
Description: We're easy to find, just off the M8, with complimentary onsite parking, we are ideal for exploring Scotland. Take some fresh air in the beautiful Pentland hills, see the wildlife in the hilly Beercraigs Country Park, or owls at the Scottish Owl Centre - both just a few miles from the hotel. Just 16 miles west of Edinburgh with its world-famous arts festival, the Mercure Livingston Hotel is a great base for exploring central Scotland and West Lothian's country parks.

Title: Mercure Inverness Hotel
Description: Right in the city centre with a thriving selection of shops and nightlife to choose from on the doorstep, Mercure Inverness is the perfect location for exploring the Highlands. Chill out in our stylish Church Street Bar with views over the River Ness, whether that be a warming hot chocolate, a classic Glenfiddich malt scotch whisky or a trendy pink gin. Unwind in the onsite gym with cardiovascular equipment and weights – an invigorating way to end a day in the Highlands.

Title: Mercure Perth Hotel
Description: Enjoy warm Highland hospitality in the heart of Scotland at the Mercure Perth Hotel. One of the most  unique hotels in Perth, set in a 15th century watermill, you can still watch the water trickling through the original water wheel from our garden, reception area and Lounge Bar. Perth city centre is on your doorstep and spectacular Perthshire scenery lies beyond. Explore the rich history of the surrounding area including Scone Palace, coronation site of Scottish kings, six miles away.

Title: Mercure Ayr Hotel
Description: Explore the Ayrshire coastline from your base at Mercure Ayr Hotel just a short walk from the seafront promenade and just around the corner from the bustle of Ayr High Street.  Golf lovers can tee off with more than 20 clubs on our doorstep, including the championship courses at Trump Turnberry, Royal Troon, and Prestwick Golf Club. Then it’s time to retreat to a comfy sofa in our bar for a reviving whisky, cream tea or a trendy pink gin.

Title: Holiday Inn Dumfries
Description: Holiday Inn Dumfries is located on the Crichton Estate only 1.3 miles from Dumfries city centre. Come and visit the Bankend Bar & Brasserie, where you can enjoy all your favourite food & drink.  All of our 71 bedrooms offer comfortable beds, include air-conditioning, complimentary high-speed wireless internet access, there are 200 complimentary car park spaces available for hotel guests. The Crichton Golf Club with a small nine-hole course and driving range is less than 5 minutes’ walk from the hotel.

Title: Mercure Glasgow City Hotel
Description: Located on Ingram Street this is one of the most central hotels Glasgow has to offer. Just a few minutes’ walk from Glasgow’s infamous Style Mile, Argyle and Buchanan Street makes it perfect for shopping sprees, leisure trips, theatre breaks and sightseeing weekends. The hotel is a 5-minute walk from Glasgow Central and Queen Street Stations, providing quick access to the SEC and SSE Hydro. There is easy access to the M8 motorway, only 5 minutes’ drive from the hotel.

Title: Exclusive Scotland Incentives & Experiences Ltd
Description:
360° Scotland – Exclusive Scotland Incentives & Experiences Ltd. embodies what we offer and who we are in our name: We create exclusive incentive trips and corporate events that add value throughout Scotland, Germany, and worldwide. We see ourselves as partners alongside our clients and as local experts.
We combine DMC services with the capabilities of an event agency, taking on various roles... 
We are:
- Project Managers: Coordinating all aspects of the event, from planning to execution.
- Creative Thinkers: Developing innovative concepts and ideas for the event.
- Logistics & Time Management Professionals: Organizing resources, schedules, and workflows.
- Budget Planners and Financial Experts: Responsible for financial planning and controlling the event budget.
- Problem Solvers and Crisis Managers: We possess the ability to quickly and effectively resolve unforeseen issues (Masters of Plan B).
- Trend Scouts and Innovators: Always up to date, always in tune with the times (although not necessarily following every trend).
- Hosts: We ensure the well-being and satisfaction of participants during the event and for our clients.

Title: Edinburgh Cab Tours
Description: We are a long established and trusted private tour operator based in Edinburgh. We provide short day tours and multi-day tours throughout Scotland with experienced fun guides. For added comfort on longer journeys we use our top of the range luxury Mercedes V Class or our VW Transporter.

Title: Arbroath Golf Links
Description: Arbroath Golf Links is a traditional golf course designed by champions Old Tom Morris, W. Fernie and J Braid. The course is well serviced with a driving range, practice putting course and well stocked professionals shop. Coach parking is available and the clubhouse welcomes visitors. The course is on the the main A92 road 6 miles from Carnoustie and 29 miles from St Andrews.

Title: Big Wide World
Description: Big Wide World is proud to call Scotland our home. Our focus is on creating extraordinary, sustainable adventures for families.  Drawing on our network of world-leading experts and insider knowledge, each adventure is handcrafted from the ground up ensuring an incomparable experience for even the most seasoned traveller.

Title: Stationmaster's Lodge
Description: Stationmaster’s Lodge offers stunning lochside accommodation for groups and families. Overlooking Loch Carron and only 15 mins drive to Skye bridge its Ideal group accommodation. The lodge sleeps up to 20 in 8 bedrooms half of which are ensuite. A great base for exploring nearby Isle of Skye & west coast.

Title: Edinburgh Walking Tour Company
Description:
Guided walking tours by professional, qualified and experienced tour guides who are all members of the Scottish Tourist Guide Association and Blue Badge holder.

Our walks will take your clients down the narrow alleyways off the Royal Mile; see the splendour of Edinburgh’s World Heritage New Town and show them some hidden gem villages nearby.

Title: The Ness Guest House
Description: Scottish hospitality at its best! A friendly welcome awaits your guests at our Highland guest house. Great location in Inverness city centre, only a few minutes walk to attractions, restaurants and bars. Four stylish and comfortable ensuite double rooms, private off street guest parking with an 11kw Electric Vehicle charging point for each parking space - so every guest room has a dedicated EV charging point.  Free wifi and an excellent home-cooked Scottish breakfast. Group bookings for exclusive use of the guest house are available.

Title: 1881 Distillery & Gin School
Description: 1881 Distillery is home to Scotland's largest residential Gin School. Located above the original Peebles Hydro swimming pool, guests can enjoy three-hour-long distillery experiences and extend the experience with an overnight stay in Peebles Hydro. Only 35 minutes from Edinburgh airport, this is a true Scottish Borders Experience.  The London Spirits Competition awarded The 1881 Distillery gold for its subtly smoked Rafters Gin which was inspired by the hotel’s history and a fire it suffered in 1905.  The Scottish gin brand also received silver for three gins, Hydro, Honours and Tiffin.

Title: Osprey Holidays
Description: Inspirational tailor-made holidays and short breaks to Scotland. Featuring all of Scotland nooks and crannies such as the North Coast 500, a city break to Edinburgh or a luxury castle stay in the Highlands. We can arrange any travel requirements and pick from many tours and excursions to add on.

Title: Kingsway Guest House
Description: Family-run guest house conveniently located in Edinburgh’s city centre and named the Best B&B in Scotland (Scottish Hospitality Awards 2019). Your clients will enjoy stylish, comfortable accommodation with an award winning breakfast and the warmest Scottish hospitality. We offer private off street car parking, free wifi, and exclusive use is available.

Title: voco Edinburgh - Haymarket
Description: voco Edinburgh - Haymarket is a brand new IHG hotel experience in the heart of Edinburgh City Centre. The hotel offers 150 well-appointed and comfy rooms and suites, in-house Restaurant & Bar facilities as well as fitness studio for the sport lovers.

Title: Malmaison Dundee
Description:
Handily located on Dundee's up-and-coming Waterfront along the River Tay, just a two-minute walk from Dundee Station , Discovery point and the V&A. 
Pick from 91 sumptuous rooms and suites. With a fabulous contemporary restaurant and a stylish cocktail bar, we have everything you need in a city centre hotel.

Title: Golf Concierge Scotland
Description:
Golf Concierge Scotland are experts in delivering bespoke golf tours to Scotland, The Home of Golf. 

Based in Edinburgh our packages include world famous links and undiscovered courses in St Andrews, The Highlands and Scotland’s finest regions. Packages include quality accommodation and activities including malt whisky distilleries and historic landmarks.

Title: Pentland Ferries
Description:
Orkney’s own ferry company, Pentland Ferries, operates from Gills Bay in Caithness to St Margaret’s Hope in Orkney. The service takes just over one hour on one of its vehicle and passenger ferries:  

MV Pentalina - accommodation includes seating areas and a café. 

MV Alfred - accommodation includes seating areas, a café and an indoor dog-friendly lounge.  

Environmental awareness - both vessels are greenest in their class, both in terms of fuel consumption and CO2 emissions.  

Please check our website for conditions of travel.

Title: Cadies & Witchery Tours
Description: Our outdoor tours take a light-hearted look at Edinburgh's darker side, with tales of witchcraft, torture, plague and body snatching.  Blending history with humour Alexander Clapperton (deceased) leads groups through the Old Town's haunted closes and creepy courtyards, while our "jumper-ooters" provide ghastly appearances! Tours depart from The Witchery Restaurant.

Title: The Old Millhouse
Description: The Old Millhouse, located outside Edinburgh is set on the banks of  the  River Esk amongst 3.5 acres of private gardens.  Available on a catered or self catering basis the house offers 5 double rooms, an orangery, drawing room, cosy den and an outdoor terrace with a hydro pool swim spa.

Title: Newton Farm Holidays & Tours
Description:
Join us at Newton Farm in our epic farming life to make memories to last a lifetime with award winning farm experiences and accommodation on our traditional, working, family farm in Angus on the East coast of Scotland. Our unique and authentic, bespoke tours are designed to suit your clients' every requirement. We cater for small groups and FIT, up to 5O seater coaches, 
We offer immersive, guided walking farm tours to meet and feed our animals along with seasonal experiences from grooming the highland cows, walking alpacas, bottle feeding lambs, or  enjoy a landrover safari experience to explore our 220 Hectares. All experiences can be combined with our own farm to fork food experience and/or traditional Scottish home baking and refreshments.

Title: Knockhill Racing Circuit
Description: Knockhill, Scotland’s National Motorsport Centre and hosts group activity days (or half days) that are the perfect way to enjoy the thrills of circuit driving, whether that’s rewarding staff, entertaining clients or simply a group enjoying a driving day out participating in fabulous motorsport activities. Each day will be individually tailored to suit your clients as well as budget. There are popular formats but often they are bespoke designed to match your requirements, including on site meeting facilities and catering.

Title: Teasses Estate Ltd.
Description: In the heart of Fife, Teasses Estate can provide clients with an authentic Scottish Estate Experience. The stunning 1,100 acres of prime organic pastures, offer a wealth of opportunities: garden tours, country pursuits, and seasonal events. We will work with you to create the right experience for your clients.

Title: Courtyard by Marriott Inverness Airport
Description:
130 bedroom hotel based just a 2 minute walk from Inverness Airport
All rooms have floor to ceiling triple glazed windows with views either of the airport or green spaces, air conditioning, black out curtains.
4 star hotel with bar, restaurant and gym
Coach parking avaliable

Title: Macdui Bike Adventures
Description:
Macdui Bike Adventures provides  Groups and FIT with off-road bike rides and adventures. We operate in Aberdeen City, Aberdeenshire, Royal Deeside and the Cairngorms National Park. We are qualified, insured and experienced guides that offer cycle adventures for every ability. All tours include full-suspension British mountain bikes, a guide to Aberdeenshire and riding tuition.  
Your clients will have an adventure that suits their ability, where they can learn new skills and take away memories of the landscape, culture and history.

Title: Executive Golf & Leisure
Description:
Executive Golf & Leisure have been creating luxury golf tours and Corporate events for over 33 years and have unrivalled knowledge and experience in the luxury golf travel sector.
Our luxury tours and events incorporate a personal meet & greet service on arrival, the best accommodation closest to the tour groups selected championship golf courses with private ground or air transportation throughout the tour. A dedicated tour coordinator is assigned to each client in order to create their dream tour.

Title: Isle of Bute Distillery & Bute Brew Co.
Description: Located in the heart of Rothesay, within Bute Yard, our Distillery and Brewery is the perfect spot to experience the flavours of island life. Sample our craft gin, rum, and beer — or soak up the atmosphere at one of our regular live music events. Whether you're after a casual tasting or a bespoke group experience, we offer something for everyone — from curious first-timers to seasoned gin lovers. Visitor Experiences - Tasting Flights, Guided Tastings, Private & Bespoke cocktail classes and local food pairing & tasting.

Title: Lennox of Lomond
Description:
Based just 30 minutes north of Glasgow Airport, we are a traditional working farm offering bespoke tours to suit your clients' requirements. We cater for small groups and FIT, up to 5O seater coaches, with parking and toilet facilities.
We offer Guided Walking Tours ( minimum 20 people - 2/3 hours ), Lambing Tours ( minimum 20, maximum 50 - 1.5 hours ), Quad Bike Trailer Tours ( maximum 6 to 8 people - 1 hour ), Sheep Dog and Sheep Shearing Demonstrations, plus traditional Scottish home baking with tea and coffee.

Title: Carfrae Farm
Description:
Located only 1 hour from Edinburgh Airport and 1 hour 20 minutes from Glasgow Airport, our East Lothian working farm is an ideal base for your clients to enjoy our Luxury Interiors and Wild Exteriors.
In addition to our 3 Self Catering Cottages we offer a range of activities, including Farm Tours, Introduction to Wild Swimming, Foraging Fun, Bushcraft Workshop, and Guided Walks in the Lammermuir Hills. We call also tailor-make activities to suit your clients' interests.
We also have easy parking for vehicles up to a 16 seater minibus.

Title: Pool House
Description: Nestled on the seashore and alongside a river, Pool House is a fascinating, quirky and characterful Highland home. Move through 300 years of history and discover the dramatic events that have taken place within these walls and the many notable people that visited the house over the years.  A courthouse in the 1700’s; the setting for a marital battle that scandalised Victorian society; through to becoming a WW2 headquarters, there is something to delight, engage and captivate in every room

Title: Glasgow Marriott Hotel
Description: Located in Glasgow city centre, our renovated 4-star hotel offers easy access to top attractions, with 180 parking spaces and a location just off the M8. We're a short walk from the OVO Hydro, SEC, and Buchanan Street shopping, only 15 minutes from Glasgow Airport, and 3 minutes from Anderston Rail Station. Each spacious room features premium bedding, large flat-screen TVs, and city views. Enjoy free Wi-Fi in public areas, an indoor pool, steam room, sauna, and fitness centre. Savour Scottish-inspired dishes at Cast Iron Grill, speciality cocktails at Brew Bar Lounge, or Starbucks coffee. With 24-hour room service, unwind on your schedule. Our versatile event spaces and modern design reflect Glasgow’s unique charm, inspired by its murals and bridges. Whether visiting for business or leisure, the Glasgow Marriott Hotel offers an authentic Scottish experience.

Title: Sonas Collection/Skeabost House Hotel
Description: A historic country house hotel set on the banks of the River Snizort on the Isle of Skye, Skeabost House Hotel offers elegant accommodation in 21 bedrooms, in a tranquil Highland setting. Ideal for group stays or exclusive use, it features refined dining spaces showcasing local produce, comfortable lounges and expansive grounds. Perfectly placed for outdoor pursuits, scenic exploration and authentic Hebridean experiences.

Title: At Pretium Jet Charter
Description: A Perthshire based private charter broker. Bringing the personal touch to air travel, we offer bespoke private jet and helicopter solutions to suit your needs. With our understanding of aircraft and the industry, we ensure that your clients fly from the most convenient airports, in the most suitable aircraft, at the most competitive prices. From your enquiry to when your clients return from their trip, we are here to advise and remove the stress and hassle for you.

Title: Auld Reekie Tours
Description: Since 1995, Auld Reekie Tours has offered a wide range of award-winning tours to visitors from all over the world, frequenting Edinburgh’s Old Town and the legendary underground city. Filled with fascinating stories of Scottish culture, history and paranormal activities, our tours are led by English-speaking costumed guides. Soon our tours will be available in Chinese as well.  We are also developing an online app, providing customers a new way of enjoying tours.

Title: Cairn o Mohr Berry Wines and Ciders
Description: Cairn o Mohr Winery produce Berry wines made from locally cultivated and foraged fruits, leaves and flowers. Using authentic production methods, we are true to the fruit using neither concentrates, flavourings nor colourings. All our products are also Vegan friendly and gluten free. Our winery is built on an old Pictish settlement and we utilise many of the 140 year old farm buildings, along with our very own eclectic ranch style shop, cafe, deck and play area. All fully accessible.

Title: Bellevue Farm Tours
Description:
Bellevue Farm is situated less than 2 hours from Glasgow Airport on a 6/7th generation working farm on the beautiful Isle of Arran, south west Scotland.
We provide a range of unique guided and self-guided tours which can include feeding Highland cows and alpacas.  Can also offer seasonal lambing experiences, wool craft workshops and a special bespoke whisky - “Bellevue Barley to Bottle” Tour in partnership with the award winning Lagg Distillery.
We can provide a range of food and drink offerings using local and home reared produce.
Open all year.

Title: Highlander Experience at Bogbain Farm
Description: MacGregor’s Bars offer two shows, both giving a unique experience into Scottish history and culture through music, food, and storytelling. A shorter daytime show that takes place at MacGregor's Bar in Inverness, ideal for a lunchtime activity. A full evening show with a ceilidh is held at Bogbain Farm, just outside the city, in a 17th-century farm building. Both experiences are highly rated for their engaging hosts (often the bar owner, Bruce MacGregor, a renowned musician) who weave together tales of warriors, history, and music to create a memorable insight into Highland life. More experiences coming soon to Edinburgh and Oban.

Title: Old Leckie Farm
Description:
Discover the Heart of Scottish farming… Centrally located, 7 miles west of Stirling and the M9, Old Leckie specialises in 5 star tours of our family farm, local food production and farmstay accommodation. 
From FIT’s to large coach groups we plan our tours to meet your client’s interest – whether farming, food tastings, animals (cows, sheep, hens, pigs) or the history that surrounds Old Leckie. Parking, toilets and catering available. 
Tour length 1 – 2 hours depending on numbers, content and catering.

Title: Grampian Transport Museum
Supplier Types: Cruising/Shore Excursions|Food and Drink|Private Tours|Responsible|Visitor Attraction
Description: Your clients will experience exhibits ranging from 1800’s chariots to some of the fastest cars ever made. The museum can provide tailored experiences, rides in museum vehicles and steam engine demonstrations. The museum has excellent free coach parking and is located only 45 mins from Aberdeen airport, en route to Balmoral Castle in the heart of Donside. The museum cafe is open daily and can accommodate FIT, groups, coach parties and more.

Title: Blairmore Farm & Estates Limited
Description: An exclusive or part use holiday let resort.  We can accommodate 2 - 32 people in 16 bedrooms.  Our onsite pub and catering services are designed to ensure your guests are able to explore the surrounding area without worrying about evening meals or a hearty breakfast to start their day.  Our driveway can accommodate small coaches and all size of cars.  We are 1 hour from Edinburgh and 1 hour 20 minutes from Glasgow at the gateway to the Highlands.

Title: Gairloch Canoe and Kayak Centre
Description: Beginners’ sea kayaking or canoeing from our centre, based at the Shieldaig Lodge Hotel, Gairloch.  Half day beginner’s sea kayaking experiences to view seals and other wildlife and full day canoe trips on iconic Loch Maree, following in the footsteps of Queen Victoria.  All equipment supplied. Our base has ample free parking and toilet facilities. Group friendly experiences. We also offer Stand Up Paddle board experiences and hire and can offer a range of walking experiences with guides knowledgeable in Highland culture, history, wildlife and landscape.

Title: The Garrison Hotel & Apartments
Description:
The Garrison Hotel and Apartments is situated in the town centre of Fort William, offering bed and breakfast accommodation for individuals, couples, families and groups. 4 star, metro accommodation is provided.
Groups are welcome and coach parking can be found nearby. We can also accommodate bespoke and tailored tour parties

Title: UK Rail Breaks
Description: We are rail travel experts and offer an extensive range of Scottish Rail Breaks for your customers to enjoy.We’re known for our rail expertise in the travel industry and our impartial advice and assistance can help you plan packages for your customers.  We can also offer Quality Independent Rail Breaks of England, Scotland and Wales.

Title: The Great Tapestry of Scotland
Supplier Types: Accessible|Activity|Exclusive Use|Food and Drink|Private Tours|Visitor Attraction
Description:
Discover Scotland’s history through a captivating visual story from the Ice Age to today at the Great Tapestry of Scotland, housed in a purpose-built visitor centre in Galashiels, a short journey from Edinburgh. Spanning 143 meters of hand-stitched embroidery, the tapestry was crafted by 1,000 volunteers across Scotland and explores the nation’s history. It’s a remarkable artwork, made by the nation for the nation.
Group and FIT friendly with nearby coach parking, a shop, and a café.

Title: Kitchen Coos & Ewes
Description: Authentic farm experiences which feature going on a tour amongst Scotland’s iconic Highland cows from the comfort of a purpose-built trailer. Listen to the story of how the herd benefits their natural environment from one of the farmers that care for the animals.  There is also a record breaking flock of sheep on this farm to see as well.  Finish off the experience by enjoying traditional farmhouse baking which has been prepared in the farmhouse kitchen.

Title: Above and Beyond Tours
Description: We offer personal, bespoke tours, exploring hidden gems and spectacular scenery that Caithness has in abundance.Our guides are local, friendly and passionate about their home county, sharing their knowledge and stories at a slower pace offering the opportunity to slowdown, be mindful and appreciate our beautiful area on the furthermost tip of Scotland. We are fully flexible and can organise a short walking tour or put together a complete package to optimise your clients experience.

Title: Premiership Experience
Description: Premiership Experience is an award-winning global tour operator who offer the very best of the UK. Partnered with the leading organisations in world sport & entertainment we have an exciting and diverse range of offerings. Your clients are guaranteed special memories given their quality provision & exceptional attention to detail. From watching a live match at some famous football clubs to a show at the West End Theatres, or visiting prestigious art galleries and British castles to hunting the Loch Ness Monster – we cater for all interests!

Title: North Coast Watersports
Description: North Coast Watersports is an award winning surf school located 8 miles East from Thurso on the North Coast of Scotland. We offer a range of high quality surf and stand up paddle boarding experiences. From 2 hour group lessons, to full day private surf trips and 3 night surf/ yoga retreats. Our Scottish surf champion coaches are fully trained and provide all the equipment necessary. We are super flexible and can build an itinerary that suits your clients!

Title: Downright Gabbler
Description: Good food and drink, great company and interesting stories in a former coaching inn in a charming Highland village. We explore history using the finest local produce. How beer played a key role in the creation of an empire; the humble grocer made Scotch whisky a global icon; or coffee, chocolate and tea helped drive social change. We can tailor events to suit your needs and we have four luxury self-catering suites upstairs. Small groups up to 12.

Title: Annandale Distillery
Description: Iconic “5 Star” experience at the gateway to Dumfries & Galloway. At Scotland-England border nearby GRETNA hub. Our authentic Scottish Distillery welcomes tour groups, coaches & independent travellers. Guests travel through tales of whisky since 1700 & enjoy immersive Tours of the Distillery & whisky production. Taste whisky perfection in the Bonded warehouse. Our superb Maltings Cafe in the original 1800's Malt House provides hospitality from artisan menus. Familiarisation visits available.

Title: Woodlands Glencoe
Supplier Types: Accommodation|Activity|Carrier|Food and Drink|Golf|Luxury|Private Tours|Tour Operator|Transport|Visitor Attraction
Description: Woodlands Glencoe are a passionate family business, dedicated to creating luxury experiences whilst also nurturing the land in a sustainable and considerate way. Our accommodation let’s guests enjoy magical woodland escapes. We host a range of superbly fun activities, including Segway and Archery and our all new Experiences at Woodlands Glencoe brings all of our expertise and attention to detail together to bring guided adventures and bespoke experiences to Glencoe.

Title: Mckenzie Mountaineering
Description:
Guided Walking Adventures around Scotland from the Lowlands to the Highlands and Islands. Trips can be 1 to 12 days day walking adventures. We can offer, guiding, transport and accommodation in packages or on their own.
Our aim is to promote the beauty of the great outdoors and mountain environment whilst giving your clients an inspiring experience.
We can also organise private departures and bespoke treks for your clients, as a solo walking tour, private group adventure or bespoke family walking adventure.

Title: Jacksons at Jedburgh
Description: On the ‘Highland Cow Experience' you'll immerse yourself in the wild charm of our Scottish Borders farm as you meet these majestic, iconic creatures up close. Our knowledgeable guides share fascinating insights into the cows and their unique habits. This authentic, unforgettable experience offers a true taste of Scotland and allows plenty of time for photographs with the hairy coos. Enhance your clients' itineraries with this unique and captivating adventure, options available for large groups, medium groups and FIT

Title: Auf Tour in den Highlands
Description:
I am a German Tour Guide based in Inverness and offer a range of tours in the Highlands.
My private day tours are individually designed to suit your client's wishes in order to provide a unique experience. I offer shore excursions from Invergordon in small groups and in-depth walking tours of Inverness. My services can also be booked on a hop-on-basis for coach tours, including billingual German/English commentary.

Title: North Coast Explorer Tours
Description: We offer luxury private tours of the North Highlands and North Coast 500. Endorsed with a 5-star rating from VisitScotland (2024/25), we can create tailored itineraries and standard tours to meet your clients’ needs and interests. Clients will travel in a luxury 4x4 with a personal guide, for the duration of the tour. Most of our multi-day tours start from Inverness and our aim is to provide fun, informative and bespoke tours for private groups of up to 4 people.

Title: Claireville Alpacas
Description:
Our aim is to be able to supply an educational, enjoyable and completely remarkable experience to all who visit! We offer tours, meet&greets and of course our ever-popular trekking experience. 
We are home to many beautiful and friendly animals who are always ready to put a smile on some faces all while admiring our breath-taking countryside views!
Experiences can be tailored to suit the age/ability/mobility of most clients.

Title: PDG Helicopters
Description: We own and operate the largest fleet of private charter helicopters in the UK. We provide bespoke charter solutions to fly parties of any size to your chosen destination. Our reputation for professionalism, discretion and safety makes us one of the most trusted suppliers of charter services.  With multiple aircraft available in our corporate livery, passenger transfers can be completed in style. Large corporate or private groups can arrive with complete coordinated sophistication that other charter companies simply cannot offer.

Title: Royal Dornoch Golf Club
Description: Royal Dornoch has two 18 hole golf courses with the Championship ranked 4th in the world by Golf Digest in 2020 and the Struie Course entering the Golf World top 100 in Scotland in 2021. With a wide range of practice facilities as well as a well stocked pro shop and fully serviced clubhouse we have everything required to make the perfect golfing experience. Tee times are available 7 days a week so we can accommodate the schedules of your clients.

Title: Golf Highland
Description: Golf Highland is a consortium of 31 golf clubs and courses in the Highlands of Scotland that work together to promote the quality, diversity and accesiibilty of golf in the area. From 9 hole fun courses to 18 hole Championship courses, and everything in between, there is something for every level of golfer in the Highlands. We are a central resource that can help advise you and your clients on the best way to maximise the golf experience in the Highlands of Scotland.

Title: James Campbell Tours
Description: We provide private luxury guided tours of Scotland to the best historic and cultural places. We discover hidden gems, off the beaten track beauty and support local food and craft businesses. We use luxury 8 seat VW and Mercedes people carriers equipped with a/c and wifi. We are a gold awarded Green Tourism business. We offer day and multi day tours of Scotland. James and our driver – guides are very knowledgeable about Scottish History, Culture and the Scotland of today.

Title: Eden Locke Aparthotel
Description: Set behind a grand Georgian façade, Eden Locke has just 72 apartments making it our most intimate Locke location. But what it lacks in size, it more than makes up for in style and beauty. Settle into your own meticulously designed apartment. Soak up the laid-back atmosphere of our living space, with its lush, leafy plants and soft tropical colour palette. Feel free. This is Eden Locke – a peaceful haven for sleeping, working and living, minutes from Edinburgh’s main sites.

Title: Candacraig
Description: Nestled in the heart of the Scottish Highlands and part of the Cairngorms National park, Candacraig is an inspiring, exclusive retreat. Steeped in history, our elegant 12 bedroom, 14 bathroom baronial mansion is a remarkable setting for a family celebration, a friends’ gathering, corporate retreat or golf/fishing venue. Whether you spend time indulging in the comforts of the mansion, exploring the grounds or engaging in some of the thrilling experiences available in the local area, serene and stunning Candacraig is sure to captivate you.

Title: Kinross House Estate
Description: Steeped in history and grandeur Kinross House and its fabulous estate setting provide one of Scotland’s finest exclusive use destinations.  Offering up to 24 double bedrooms with en-suite (Kinross House offering 14 and the charming Coach House a further 10).  This extraordinary country estate is perfectly suited to host luxury vacations, special gatherings, celebratory parties and corporate events. The estate and surrounding area offer many wonderful leisure pursuits, with Edinburgh and St Andrews both a 40 minute drive.

Title: Skye Lodge Dunvegan
Description:
Skye Lodge Dunvegan, Isle of Skye enjoys a secluded spot-on Loch Dunvegan. Superb, spacious guest accommodations for groups for 4 – 10 individuals on exclusive use basis to suit.  Fully catered, half board or self-catering basis we adjust to suit all needs including bed & breakfast for individual parties. True highland hospitality; local produce; local knowledge is the recipe ensuring your guests experience is not only memorable but remarkable too.  Personal service & interactive map that highlights all on our doorstep. 
3-hour driving distance from Inverness and 5-hour drive from Glasgow & Edinburgh.

Title: The Priory Hotel
Description:
Nestled in the heart of the Scottish Highlands, we are a great base for your clients to enjoy the Highland scenery which lies beyond.  All our bedrooms offer comfortable en-suite accommodation with complimentary Wi-Fi.  We are just a short 20-minute drive from Inverness and 30 minutes from Inverness international airport and are well located for visiting many attractions including the famous Loch Ness.
Both Groups and FITs are welcome. Coach parking can be found nearby. We can also accommodate bespoke and tailored tour parties

Title: Airts & Pairts
Description:
At Airts & Pairts, we have our own approach, shared values, common perceptions and an endless love for Scotland, its history, larder and traditions; paired with expertise, creativity, curiosity, passion and enthusiasm.
STGA-qualified, we offer bespoke tours, bookable day tours and our services as experienced step-on guides in English and German. Our tours are tailored to the specific interests of our guests and are delivered with Swiss precision and a warm Scottish welcome. Let us take you on an adventure!

Title: Beirhope Alpacas
Description: Nestled in the Cheviot Hills some 3 miles from the English Border Scotland really does start right here with us. We are surrounded by stunning scenery inviting guests to get away from the hustle and bustle and take a walk on one of our many Alpaca trekking routes. Visits can be arrange to suit your clients needs from meeting the Alpacas to various walking options – suitable for FIT as well as groups.

Title: 94DR
Description: An exclusive use private hotel offering accommodation for small groups up to 12. This elegant, Edinburgh Victorian townhouse is arranged over 3 floors offering 6 luxury en-suite bedrooms, comfortable public spaces; library/bar, media room, drawing room and formal dining for 12. Private walled garden, terrace and outdoor social spaces. Private off-street parking for up to 3 cars.

Title: MacAli Hotel Group Crown Court Inverness
Description: The Crown Court Town House Hotel is located in the highland capital of Inverness. The hotel originates from the 1700`s when it was used as a residence for crown court judges. However after a recent restoration the hotel now offers stylish accommodation coupled with first class service, and great food all with a highland welcome.  Dining is available in the Bistro which provides an intimate dining experience serving locally source food.  Our bar offers fine wines to complement your meal.

Title: MacAli Hotel Group Golf View Hotel
Description: The Golf View Hotel in Lossiemouth is set overlooking the famous Moray Golf Links with breath-taking views across the Moray Firth.The superior three-star hotel offers 19 well-appointed bedrooms and is well set up for both business and leisure travellers and of course golfers from across the world. The Golf View Mackintosh restaurant enjoys outstanding views. Our guests can enjoy meals using locally source produce, the hotel lounge bar has an extensively range of whisky, gin, local beers, and lagers.

Title: MacAli Hotel Group Poseidon Hotel
Description: Stay at the beautiful Poseidon Inn in Lossiemouth, the Inn is a relaxing retreat for today’s business and leisure travellers. The Inn has 12 newly refurbished rooms all are equipped with modern day comforts including flat Screen TVs, room toiletries, tea and coffee trays. Guests can enjoy a traditional Scottish breakfast as well as Lunch and Dinner made to order at her nearby sister hotel the Golf View

Title: MacAli Hotel Group The Firth Hotel
Description: The 9-bedroom 3-star Firth Hotel is set on the magnificent Moray Firth enjoying spectacular views, The Firth Hotel & Restaurant is a relaxing coastal retreat, the Firth Hotel has 9 newly refurbished rooms seven of these rooms enjoying spectacular views.Our restaurant is renowned for using local sourced produce in their seafood dishes and our chef believes in doing the simple dishes brilliantly.Enjoy a tipple from our extensive range of single malts or try one of our in-house originals.

Title: MacAli Hotel Group West End Hotel
Description: Located in the prestigious West End of Nairn, and near three championship golf courses (the Nairn Golf Course is within walking distance of the hotel). The elegant West End Hotel has undergone an extensive refurbishment.Guests can enjoy locally sourced produce and freshly caught catch are often on our menu. All served in the recently refurbished restaurant. The hotel bar serves craft beers, lagers and of course our bar has a extensive range of single malt whisky and timeless classics.

Title: Solwayconnections Guided Tours
Description: Heritage walking and driving tours with a local guide, discovering built and natural sites of the stunning Solway coast in Dumfries & Galloway in south west Scotland. Immersive experiences and authentic encounters with local culture through the people and places in a rarely touched corner of the British Isles.  Let us connect your clients with off-the-beaten-track heritage sites, local stories and stunning views of the Solway coastal waters.  Ready designed tour routes or bespoke itineraries to suit client interests.

Title: AC Group
Description: AC Group is an award winning DMC specialising in the UK, Ireland and France. For over 20 years our team have been designing and providing tailor made itineraries and experiences for Group and FIT tours across our locations working with a wide variety of independent and international service providers to create unique experiences. With offices in London, Paris & Inverness.

Title: Venture North
Description: “Looking to offer your clients unforgettable Scottish experiences? Partner with Venture North to access exclusive business relationships, tailored itineraries, and expert local knowledge. Our region's unspoiled beauty, adventure opportunities, and authentic local culture provide a perfect escape. Benefit from our strong partnerships with local businesses and our commitment to sustainable tourism. Let us help you create unforgettable Scottish adventures for your clients.”

Title: Dark Sky Spirits Ltd - Home of - the Moffat Distillery
Description: You can now book a tour at Scotland's first wood-fired distillery, we welcome groups and individuals where we make whiskies and much more to spark conversations. Set in 17 acres the Hearthland is a family friendly site. Learn about our process for making whisky and gin on our copper pot stills. Tours also include a tasting of our gin, blended malt scotch and fruit whisky liqueurs. We aspire to become Ambassadors of Scotch.

Title: Loch Leven’s Larder
Description: Loch Leven’s Larder, family-run farm, 120-seater restaurant, café, gift shop with an extensive foodhall containing a butchery/bakery/fish counter/deli and extensive range of wine/spirits, stocking a wide range of gin/whisky/beers and ciders from Scotland. Sourcing, buying and supporting local is at its heart.  A large covered outdoor seating offers impressive views over historical Loch Leven, our farm and Loch Leven’s Heritage Trail perfect for enjoying your food and exploring. Easily accessible within 1-1.5 hours of Edinburgh/Perth/Dundee/Glasgow with ample parking facilities, suitable for coaches and disabled access.

Title: The Courtyard by Marriott, Edinburgh
Description: Located in the heart of the Scottish capital, next to the Edinburgh Playhouse and the St James Quarter, the Courtyard by Marriott Edinburgh City is an ideal choice for your clients. We are within walking distance of all the major attractions including Edinburgh Castle, the Royal Mile and Calton Hill, offering a stunning 360-degree view of Edinburgh from just behind our hotel. We have a great mix of culture, architecture, art, shopping and beautiful scenery all on our doorstep.

Title: Eurowelcome
Description: Eurowelcome is a leading incoming operator into Scotland. We offer a comprehensive range of services for groups and individuals which include scheduled as well as private excursions & transfers. We offer airport transfers, private cars at disposal as well as private touring around Scotland all operated with our in house team. We also operate our own scheduled overnight tours under our Anglovision Tours brand with departures from Edinburgh.

Title: Achnagairn Estate
Description: Achnagairn Estate is ideal for groups large and small. We offer self-catering in seven properties of five or six bedrooms. They are all spacious, luxurious (five-star) and uniquely designed. Although we are nestled in the peace of the Highlands, Achnagairn is only 30 minutes from Inverness Airport, and 7 miles from the city itself. If your clients can tear themselves away, there is plenty to explore in terms of history and nature: Loch Ness, Whisky distilleries, Culloden battlefield.

Title: Achnagairn Castle
Description: Achnagairn Castle is unique. Usually, its elegance is available only for exclusive use hire, but in 2021 we open our doors to individuals or small groups. We will offer luxurious B&B accommodation in 21 individually designed en-suite bedrooms, many with four-poster beds and marble bathrooms. Guests may also enjoy the spacious reception rooms and glorious grounds. Being on the doorstep of Loch Ness and 7 miles from Inverness makes Achnagairn an obvious choice when exploring the Highlands.

Title: Anglers Jaunt
Description: We provide bespoke fly fishing experiences for those anglers looking to fish, eat and sleep in luxury or provide a service for those anglers simply looking for a days guided fly fishing. We offer a service for individuals, groups and families on rivers and lochs across Scotland for trout, salmon and grayling. A range of experiences available such as wild fishing in Scotland over multiple days or just a perfect day of fun fishing with the family.

Title: Seafield Arms Hotel (Cullen) Limited
Description:
The Seafield Arms Hotel (Cullen) is a 4 star luxury boutique hotel situated along the Moray Firth coastline of Scotland with 24 en-suite rooms and 3 self catering cottages which opened in May 2019 after a 2 million pound refurbishment.
The hotel boasts 2 dining areas - The Grant Dining Room and Bar 19 bistro Bar along with a variety of private dining rooms, The Findlater Lounge and The Grand Ballroom which is used for weddings, conferences and events.

Title: Point A Hotel Edinburgh
Description: A modern, comfy boutique-style hotel located in the, neighbouring the Edinburgh International Conference Centre and a stone’s throw from Haymarket train station.  A new Point A Hotel Edinburgh due to open July 2026 at St Andrew Square. Each room provides a homely experience for guests and comes equipped with Luxury Hypnos beds, power showers, 43-inch smart TVs featuring Chromecast connectivity, free high-speed WiFi, USB charging ports, air conditioning, hairdryers, mood lighting and flexible desk space.

Title: Dundee Museum of Transport
Description:
Dundee Museum of Transport is an independent museum which preserves the transport heritage of Dundee and the surrounding area. 
Here your clients will hear the stories of local transport pioneers and innovators, explore our diverse range of vehicles from both local and national collections, and even get up close to Chitty Chitty Bang Bang. 
Easy coach parking; group tours; central location; café on-site

Title: D&E Coaches
Description: We are the largest private hire coach and minibus operator in the North, with a reputation built on delivering an award-winning service. Our dedicated team offer quality tours departing from Inverness, showing your customers all that the Highlands have to offer. Tours are prepared with your clients in mind, with varying lengths available - whether that is spending a full day on our Outlander Experience tour or trying to spot Nessie on our Evening Loch Ness Photo Stop Tour.

Title: Cairn Hotel Edinburgh
Description: Located in Edinburgh’s city centre, comprising a mix of double and twin rooms, we’re suitable for individual travellers and smaller, bespoke groups coming to the city.  We also have a number of apartments suited to your family group clients.

Title: Links House at Royal Dornoch
Description: Links House is the northernmost Luxury destination in Scotland. Located in the charming and historic town of Dornoch, one hour north of Inverness. Links House offers your clients luxury accommodation, outstanding food and beverage and a splendid mix of Highland experiences and adventures appealing to all age groups and interests. Our thirty seat 2AA rosette restaurant, MARA, showcases the best fresh produce of the Highlands and Scotland.  It is open to both guests and non-residents seven days a week, serving breakfast, lunch, afternoon tea and dinner.

Title: Hotel Indigo Edinburgh – Princes Street
Description: Twenty is the restaurant at Hotel Indigo Edinburgh, set directly on Princes Street with views towards Edinburgh Castle. The hotel's 64 double rooms suit independent travellers and small bespoke groups, while Twenty's dining room - bright, high-ceilinged and overlooking Princes Street - is built for group lunches and dinners, from an intimate table for two to larger parties booked through DMCs and leisure operators. Central, flexible, and five minutes from Waverley Station.

Title: Tigh-na-fraoch Guest House
Description:
Tigh-na-fraoch is a small family run guest house just off of the West Highland Way beside a river in the beautiful village of Tyndrum. We have several room sizes and cater to everyone’s tastes.
Fantastic area to visit for outdoor activities such as walking, cycling, climbing, and skiing.

Title: St Andrews Shuttle
Description:
For over 14 years St Andrews Shuttle have been providing professional, efficient, and stress-free airport transfers in Scotland and the rest of the UK.  We pride ourselves on customer service and have built our reputation of ‘St Andrews' Favourite Airport Transfer Service’.
We can transfer visiting golfers around the most iconic courses. Our services also include both full and half day private tours with knowledgeable drivers.
Our fleet of vehicles include ten 8 seater minibuses, two 6/7 seaters and our All Electric VWID.4 SUV.

Title: Comrie Croft
Description: Comrie Croft is an award-winning, regenerative eco-farm on the southern edge of the Highlands. Combining a rewilding initiative with 11 nature-based micro-enterprises, visitors can experience and make a positive contribution through: a Community Supported Agriculture food and flower project; eco-lodge accommodation; farm shop; field-to-fork café; wild(ish) camping and glamping; bike trails, hire and guiding; and a barn events/conference venue. ‘Behind the scenes’ group tours and hands-on-experiences also available. Easy coach parking, just one hour’s drive from Edinburgh or Glasgow.

Title: Wild Discovery
Description: Reconnect your guests with nature. Wild Discovery is an award-winning wildlife watching, conservation-focused tour operator offering guided half or full day tours in Royal Deeside, and fully-inclusive ‘behind the scenes’ multi-day tours across Scotland. Wild Discovery offers set itineraries and departures and also bespoke tours. Experiences suitable for group and FIT clients with a ‘general interest’ or those with a specific ‘wildlife target’. Activity examples include birdwatching, night-time mammal watching, wildlife photography, woodland walks. Travel with purpose, tread lightly and experience more.

Title: Igloo
Description: Our boutique collection of self catering lodges are set in the splendour of the Cairngorm National Park.  Homely and equipped for the most seasoned of travelers, our luxury lodges will provide the most memorable and thoughtful experiences as you journey through Scotland's finest landscapes.  Ideal for slow travelers who want to immerse in local cultures, history and cuisine.  Fantastic walking, biking and outdoor sports abundantly available and many places of interest along the way.

Title: Rusacks St Andrews
Description: Scotland’s true original, the Rusacks St Andrews lives along the legendary “Old Course” and is the golf explorer’s most sought-after playground. Occupying a landmark building the hotel is a gathering place that fosters adventure and luxury, sport and culture, pleasure and play. At Rusacks, delight is paramount.

Title: Wee Scottish Tours
Description: Wee Scottish Tours offers luxury, private, bespoke tours of Scotland. We can offer tours for solo Travellers or groups of up to 16 people in our range of luxury vehicles. Wee Scottish Tours specialises in multi-day tours as well as day trips and we will work with your client to show them the Scotland that they have always dreamed of visiting!  Wee Scottish Tours can help with Accomodation, restaurant bookings and recommendations as part of your client’s itinerary.

Title: AAA Coaches Ltd
Description:
AAA Coaches provide industry leading luxury coach hire services covering the whole of the United Kingdom, suitable for many different travel purposes.
Our highly experienced travel co-ordinators will talk you through every detail of your requirements for when you decide to travel, giving the most bespoke service possible, and taking the difficulty out of arranging your booking.
Our knowledgeable and friendly drivers are always dressed in corporate style uniforms and have been trained for any eventuality which can arise.
Email: info@aaacoaches.co.uk
Telephone 01506 883000

Title: Clynelish Distillery
Description: Clynelish proudly serves as one of the Four Corners distilleries of Johnnie Walker. We distil the rich Highland Malt that is enjoyed around the world on its own and as a vital component of Johnnie Walker whiskies. We welcome small group & FIT enquiries at Clynelish

Title: Mountebank Scotland
Description: Mountebank Scotland combines the ‘hysterical and historical’ from Scotland’s history, culture, and language. The aim is simple, to make you laugh a lot while you learn about Scotland. Professional comedian Daniel Downie is your guide on the famous, completely original, and hilarious ‘Mountebank Comedy Walk of Edinburgh’ as well your ‘expert’ on the Mountebank Comedy Whisky tasting coming summer 2021.  *No liability is accepted for those guests who die laughing

Title: DoubleTree by Hilton Glasgow Westerwood Hotel
Description: The welcoming four-star DoubleTree by Hilton Glasgow Westerwood Spa & Golf Resort is a tranquil escape surrounded by countryside yet not far from the bright city lights of Glasgow, Edinburgh and Stirling. With an 18-hole golf course, first-rate leisure facilities including a spa, gym, 8 treatment rooms and a large heated indoor pool, we are the perfect destination for both leisure and business guests looking for a relaxing stay in Central Scotland.

Title: Heatherfield House
Description: A warm welcome, a place of quality and relaxation are the hallmarks of your stay at Heatherfield House.  The house is tucked peacefully into the hillside above Oban yet is only a short walk from the town centre and its many restaurants

Title: Elite Falconry
Description: We provide 5* and exclusive use birds of prey experiences and activities at any suitable/appropriate venue across the whole of Scotland including the islands.
