Our experiences are fully interactive, and offer the client group or family, the opportunity to handle and fly many species of magnificent birds of prey, not seen anywhere else in the country. Our services also include a fully accessible option at our own site in Fife. We pay 5% commission for activities at our own site and 10% for activities at other venues.

Title: The Bonnie Badger
Description: The Bonnie Badger in Gullane, East Lothian, is the award-winning hotel with a pub, restaurant, rooms and garden created by husband and wife team, Tom & Michaela Kitchin. After an extensive renovation and refurbishment undertaken by the Kitchin family, The Bonnie Badger proudly opened its doors in December 2018.

Title: The Kitchin
Description: Tom and Michaela Kitchin opened their restaurant, The Kitchin in 2006. The restaurant was awarded a Michelin star in 2007 followed by numerous awards including 'Best UK Restaurant', 'Best Restaurant in Scotland' and 'Best Restaurant Experience'. The Kitchin presents modern British seasonal cuisine influenced by French cooking techniques and an appreciation of the best quality ingredients available from Scotland's fantastic natural larder. The restaurant’s philosophy ‘From Nature to Plate’, is a reflection of Tom’s passion for the finest, freshest Scottish seasonal produce.

Title: The Scran & Scallie
Description: The Scran & Scallie, which received a prestigious Bib Gourmand from the Michelin Guide 2019 showcases a seasonal menu in line with the ‘From Nature to Plate’ philosophy of the gastro-pub. Classic signature dishes such as Ham, Egg & Chips, Fish pie, Fish & Chips and Sunday Roast are served alongside some seasonal favourites such as Asparagus & Roasted salmon and Eton mess to name a few.

Title: The North Rotunda
Description: Glasgow’s North Rotunda is a historic landmark. The stunning building, which dates back to 1890, is a one-of-a-kind venue. The North Rotunda is a multi-faceted events space. Located in Finnieston, Glasgow, our venue offers a centralised location for your event, close to various transport links. bOur function spaces are equipped with state of the art technology and versatile room layout options. Whether you are looking for a tour group lunch or a conference, our spaces are perfect for your needs. We can host groups as small as 2 in our main restaurants or larger groups from 10-140 in our private, exclusive use, events spaces.

Title: Serenity Scotland Ltd
Description: Serenity Scotland was established in 2003 and specialises in private guided tours for FIT and small groups. We offer 'tour only' services, and packaged experiences. We particularly welcome interest in cultural tours within Scotland, scenery and landscape, food and drink, walking, and educational tours. We offer low-level cultural walks, including a 4 and 10 day Fife Coastal Walk Package, and pilgrimage walks. We offer an expert, knowledgeable and personal travel service to your clients.  We can collect from/ to airports.

Title: Sixstar Coach Tours Ltd
Description: Fancy a trip to the seaside, a gin and tonic, a walk around a haunted Castle? Why not join us on a  day tour to the beautiful seaside town of North Berwick. You wil visit Tantallon Castle, NB Gin Distillery, Seabird Sanctuary  and the amazing beaches, where you can relax with ample time off coach exploring.  Or if you want to try and catch a glimpse of NESSIE the famous Loch Ness Monster and hear about the bloody battle of Glencoe then join us on our one day tour to the Scottish Highlands, you can also take a boat trip along the famous Loch.

Title: Whitebridge Hotel
Description: Whitebridge Hotel is a traditional hunting lodge set amid the monadhliath mountain range where your clients can enjoy a remote, tranquil location. Serving a range of traditional Scottish Fayre, Whitebridge Hotel has an excellent reputation for food. Suited to small/mini buses rather than coaches due to access road and parking facilities. We are happy to arrange entertainment for your clients such as whisky tasting, traditional Scottish nights including food and traditional music.

Title: Crescent House
Description:
A boutique Bed & Breakfast (five suites all with ensuite) The Georgian ‘A’ listed Arthouse is part of a crescent in Edinburgh's world famous New Town. Designed by the renowned architect Willam Burn in 1823. It has all the charm of a period property with modern luxury and designer style opened in 2018 by Scottish Artist Michael Worobec and his husband Paul Skrgatic.
We welcome FIT and small group bookings for exclusive use up to 10 PAX. We have onsite parking and car hire within 5 mins walk. 25 mins from the airport 7 mins from Edinburgh Waverley Train Station. We also offer Art Tours of the three National Galleries of Scotland in Edinburgh.

Title: Private Travel By Design
Description:
Private Travel by Design takes the concept of a travel agency to the next level. Your luxury travel designer will design and create your individual travel experience.
Working collaboratively with luxury travel club 360 Private Travel, a Virtuoso member we provide a unique curated experience built on our expert knowledge for groups travelling to the area.
By providing you with your own personal travel concierge, we do everything we can to give your group the perfect vacation.

Title: University of Dundee Botanic Garden
Description:
Located in 9.5 hectares of south-facing, gently sloping land near the banks of the River Tay, Dundee Botanic Garden is a beautifully laid out landscape featuring many species of indigenous British plants as well as representative collections of important plants from all the continents of the world.
The Garden is committed to Education for people of all ages, with self guided and blended online interactive trails which cover a wider range of topics tailored to age groups and interests. The Garden has a popular café and gift shop with plant nursery, whilst regular seasonal changes to the garden's collections ensure there is something to enjoy whatever the time of year.

Title: Shieldhill Castle
Description: Shieldhill Castle offers luxurious accommodation, event spaces, relaxing lounges, bar and restaurant serving delicious local produce, all within the beauty of a 12th century castle.  Located near Biggar in the Scottish Borders, Shieldhill Castle offers the perfect base for exploring the local area and Glasgow and Edinburgh both a short journey away.

Title: Real World Riding
Description: I can supply bespoke Mountain Bike guiding and coaching at all levels for groups of up to 6 from family valley riding to big mountain descents and multi-day trips, transport not normally included, bikes can usually be supplied by 3rd party which I will arrange. Solo operator, operating all year round across Scotland. Will add local cultural and historical knowledge as well as riding and Fun too.

Title: Amber Restaurant at The Scotch Whisky Experience
Description: Our award-winning Amber Restaurant, beside Edinburgh Castle, specialises in mouth-watering Scottish dishes, competitively-priced 2/3 course lunches/dinners and food and whisky pairings. We’re experts at serving groups within strict timeframes, ensuring you stick to touring schedules. We’ve extended restaurant capacity with 3 new private dining spaces. You can also pre-order takeaway packed lunches/refreshments. We love hosting private dinners, exclusive tutored whisky tastings and luxury bespoke events of 80 guests in one room or 240 full venue. Fully accessible. Open 364 days.

Title: Johnnie Walker Princes Street
Supplier Types: Accessible|Carrier|Events|Exclusive Use|Food and Drink|Luxury|Private Tours|Visitor Attraction
Description:
Located in the heart of Edinburgh’s West End, Johnnie Walker Princes Street is an experience like no other, bringing to life the story of the brand and its makers, creating a unique welcome for people from around the world. 
The experience, which takes visitors on an immersive journey through the 200-year old history behind the world’s best-selling Scotch whisky, as well as offering world-class food and drink, is hosted across eight floors of the transformed landmark building on one of the Scottish capital’s most famous streets.
The building also features rooftop bars, event space and retail, with an unrivalled selection of exclusive Johnnie Walker Scotch whiskies and merchandise. 
We offer preferred rates to Travel Trade and our site is fully accessible.

Title: Piries Hotel, Edinburgh
Description:
Bright and airy accommodation near the heart of Edinburgh at our budget hotel in Edinburgh...
Conveniently located just 500 yards from Edinburgh trams and Haymarket train station which takes you directly into the city centre so you can be in the middle of the action in no time.

Many of our guests take advantage of our excellent location to visit local attractions such as Edinburgh Castle, Edinburgh Dungeon and National Galleries & Museums. All a short journey away. Plan a day out at Edinburgh Zoo where you can visit over 1,000 rare and endangered animals.  Don’t miss the UK’s only Giant Pandas and make time to study the extraordinary Asiatic Lions.
t this world-famoual

Title: Fauhope Country House
Description: Fauhope Country House is a secluded, award winning ‘5 star gold’ B&B (VisitScotland 2024/25) near Melrose in the heart of the Scottish Borders, with views that have inspired artists, writers, poets and musicians over the centuries. The house has been renovated with great style and attention to detail, now offering luxurious accommodation that is elegant and inviting.  Your clients’ stay will begin with a warm welcome from owners, Sheila and Ian with a sherry or cup of tea in the drawing room.

Title: Lanarkshire Larder LTD
Description:
Lanarkshire Larder is the regional food and drink group for Lanarkshire. The fertile pastures covering much of Lanarkshire have helped produce some of the country’s best beef, venison, lamb, dairy and cured meats. Throughout the region there are entrepreneurial artisan producers, farm shops, cafes, breweries, distilleries, hospitality venues who are committed to using local produce.
Throughout the region there are quality Farm Shops, Food retail and producers that you can visit and experience the wonderful produce that comes from Lanarkshire.

Title: Dunollie Museum, Castle & Grounds
Description:
In Dunollie Museum, Castle and Grounds your clients can discover is the ancestral home and  seat of Clan MacDougall. They can explore our historic grounds, castle ruin ( best view in the region) and visit our museum, shop and garden café. 
Situated 1 mile north of Oban ( Western Highlands) with parking suitable for max. 4  coaches onsite, extra parking in town. Site can accommodate 200 people at a time although seating in the café is limited to 40.

Title: Market Street Hotel
Description:
Situated where Edinburgh’s Old and New Town meet in the heart of the city, Market Street hotel provides an urban escape for the intrepid traveller. As Scotland’s first Design Hotel, contemporary design takes centre stage, with a carefully curated Scottish twist. Think clean minimalist lines and bespoke modern tartans juxtaposed with wooden oak shutters and textured stone walls. 
Sitting above the hotel is Nor’ Loft, a rooftop champagne lounge with unrivalled city skyline views, where a tall glass is encouraged any day of the week.

Title: Edinburgh Food Safari
Supplier Types: Carrier|Cruising/Shore Excursions|Food and Drink|Private Tours|Walking Tours
Description: Edinburgh Food Safari offers two unique-off-the-beaten-track, guided food historical walking tours in the Georgian UNESCO heritage New Town (best of Scottish produce) and a more international themed one on Leith Walk all in the central of Edinburgh. Tours are three hours long – six stops so a substantial lunch. Tour groups are in small numbers; max 10, but can easily accommodate more guests as can increase guides and vary meeting points.

Title: Altogether Travel
Description:
Scotland’s leading Accessible tourism company. Ideal for elderly and disabled travellers. We can arrange accessible transport, hotels, mobility equipment, accessible bespoke tours, and itineraries for your clients.  We are the UK’s only Care registered travel company which means we can supply Care and Travel Companions to support your clients and ensure they have a memorable experience here in Scotland. 
Operating since 2011 and won awards for innovation and inclusion.

Title: Tour Guide Agent
Description:
We are Scotland’s leading tour guide booking agent. We work with the global B2B travel trade industry to source and book quality, accredited tour guides for any and all types of tours, events, and experiences anywhere in Scotland. Our guides deliver the highest quality walking tours, coach tours, driver guided tours and more for FIT, Groups, MICE, VIPs and more. 
We believe that picking the perfect guide for a tour is one of the most crucial ingredients in that tour’s success. Our passion lies here, in connecting you with the right guide for your exact requirements.

Title: Art House Apartments
Description: Art House Apartments provide 8 luxury serviced apartments in Inverness.  The apartments provide extremely comfortable and stylish accommodation for your clients, including modern-day essentials such smart TV’s, high speed internet and Nespresso coffee machines. Art House Apartments are just a couple of minutes’ walk from River Ness and further 5 minutes to the centre of Inverness with all of its restaurants, cafes and attractions. For your clients there is ample off-street private(free) parking, including two electric vehicle charge points and mini-bus parking if required.

Title: Museum of Lead Mining, Wanlockhead
Description: The Museum of Lead Mining is a unique, treasure house of information about the lead mining industry, active between the 1770s and 1950s. Walk into the extended Lochnell Mine. Learn about the harsh way of life, mining and processing the ore. Our guides will share their knowledge about the social and domestic history on a guided tour of Straitsteps Cottages, as well as the importance of education focussed in the Miners’ Library. Try your hand at gold-panning! Groups by arrangement.

Title: Whitekirk Hill
Description:
Whitekirk Hill is a unique destination, found in the heart of beautiful East Lothian, offering a warm welcome to people visiting for the day and to guests staying with us. 
We offer nine environmentally conscious luxury lodges. In addition, we serve delicious meals, catering for up to 80, in both The Orangery and our outside space, The Walled Terrace.
Your clients can choose between our relaxing Award-Winning Spa or a wander through our extensive grounds whilst our younger visitors will enjoy our children’s Play Barn.

Title: Gairloch Museum
Supplier Types: Ancestral|Exclusive Use|Food and Drink|Private Tours|Visitor Attraction
Description:
Award-winning, community-run museum offering an authentic insight into Gairloch’s cultural and natural heritage.  
Bring your groups here to enjoy our accessible displays including a reconstructed croft-house, interactive exhibits, local people on film sharing stories of Gairloch’s past, changing art exhibitions, shop with local crafts/publications and the café with local flavours and panoramic sea views. 
We also offer bespoke visits and memorable experiences themed on our local heritage.   
Located in the spectacular north-west Highlands, on the NC500 and near Inverewe Garden.

Title: Heatherlea (Scotland) Ltd
Description: We are tour operators of thirty years standing, who also own a 3-star hotel in beautiful Nethy Bridge. We hold 5 stars for ‘Wildlife experience’, and are currently expanding our activity range to also include tours of more general interest. We have extensive experience in every corner of Scotland including all outlying islands, and our dedicated operations, hotel and guiding teams are ready and waiting to welcome visitors in 2022!

Title: Dundreggan Rewilding Centre
Description:
Just 45 minutes from Inverness, the Dundreggan Rewilding Centre is a gateway to the 10,000-acre Dundreggan estate which has been rewilded by charity Trees for Life since 2008. Your clients can explore Scotland’s ancient Caledonian forest, connect with nature and take part in fun activities and events.
Facilities include a café, forest trails, accommodation for 40 people, meeting rooms, a large presentation and event space and an accessible outdoor play area.
Free coach parking and bespoke packages are available.

Title: Dunrobin Castle & Gardens
Description:
Dunrobin Castle is the most northerly of Scotland's great houses and the largest in the Northern Highlands with 189 rooms. Its the family seat of the Earl of Sutherland and the Clan Sutherland. 
Tours of Dunrobin Castle are self guided. This allows your clients to spend as much time as they would like in each room. Our Castle Guides in the main rooms are available to answer questions.
We can also include Birds of prey flying demonstrations during April, May, June, July, August and September. 
Onsite we have The Castle Tea Room as well as a Gift Shop as well as ample free parking for coaches
Located 1 mile north of Golspie and just over 1 hour from Inverness.  Your clients can also arrive by train as we have our own Railway Station.

Title: Thunderdices Ltd
Description:
Thunderdices is the immersive experiences platform for Scotland. We offer:
•	Traditional guided tours of Edinburgh: History of Edinburgh, Sherlock Holmes (with puzzles), Ghost Tours, Harry Potter, family tours
•	Immersive tours where guests take part in an activity: Food tour (with fudge making option), immersive stories, full-day as a Laird in the Borders
•	Workshops: cocktail potion making, grimoire book binding, drop-spindle, broom crafting, candle making, traditional printing
•	Touring
•	Tailor-made activities: private ghost hunts in castles, murder mysteries, treasure hunts in castles

Title: Kylesku Hotel @ Highland Coast Hotels
Description:
Highland Coast Hotels are proud to bring together a collection of unique hotels on the NC500.  
Let us introduce - Kylesku Hotel is a boutique hotel and restaurant in the northwest Scottish Highlands, specialising in ultra-local seafood, meats and produce. It’s a ideal location for your clients who are looking for a short stay or a week’s wilderness adventure in amongst Scotland’s glorious mountains and lochs.
We can arrange authentic adventure day packages for your clients via our local partners to give your clients a unique and memorable experience.

Title: Royal Golf Hotel, Dornoch @ Highland Coast Hotels
Description:
Highland Coast Hotels are proud to bring together a collection of unique hotels on the NC500.
Let us introduce –  Royal Golf Hotel, Dornoch, a golfing adventure awaits your clients. Located only 50 yards from the first tee of the legendary Royal Dornoch Golf Club, this is golfing heaven!
An ideal base to explore and to discover beaches, invigorating walks, fairy tale castles, local Scottish distilleries and much more
We can also cater for your non-golfing clients, by arranging adventure day packages in collaboration with our fantastic local partners.

Title: Royal Marine Hotel, Brora @ Highland Coast Hotels
Description:
Highland Coast Hotels are proud to bring together a collection of unique hotels on the NC500. Let us introduce –  Royal Marine Hotel, Brora. Located only an hour from Inverness, your clients can stay in our charming Highland hotel to unwind and explore the golden east coast of Scotland.  We can also arrange various Highland Experiences for your clients to explore the wild west coast with our authentic experience days in Scotland.
Please do get in touch to see what we can offer you and your clients.

Title: Newton Lodge, Unapool @ Highland Coast Hotels
Description: Highland Coast Hotels are proud to bring together a collection of unique hotels on the NC500. Let us introduce – Newton Lodge. Set amidst stunning scenery in Unapool near Kylesku in the far North West Highlands on the NC500. A special place for your clients to stay on their Highland adventure. We can also arrange various Highland Experiences for your clients to explore the wild west coast with our authentic experience days in Scotland. Please do get in touch to see what we offer you and your clients.

Title: Edinburgh Bus Tours
Description: See more of Edinburgh by open-top bus with a choice of tours and tickets to suit any length of visit. From  frequent hop-on , hop-off city tours to our inclusive Royal Edinburgh Ticket  ( guaranteed entry to Edinburgh Castle, Palace of Holyroodhouse and Britannia plus  48 hours on all three city tours) and 3 Bridges Bus and Boat Tour ( guided tour to Queensferry then a cruise of the Firth of Forth) . API connection via TOURCMS

Title: Rosslyn Chapel
Description: Rosslyn Chapel was founded in 1446. The beauty of its setting and the mysterious symbolism of its ornate stonework have inspired, attracted and intrigued artists, writers and visitors ever since. Practically every surface inside and outside this unique building is carved in an outstanding display of craftsmanship. The Visitor Centre tells the Chapel’s story – from its 15th century origins to The Da Vinci Code – and beyond. Just 7 miles from Edinburgh city centre and open all year. Information is available in English, French, Spanish, Italian, Dutch, Russian, Polish, Japanese, Mandarin, Portuguese, Slovak and Swedish. The Chapel is available for private evening visits throughout the year with catering provided by arrangement. Early entry is also possible before opening.

Title: Walk Wild Scotland
Description: A tour company offering a versatile collection of walking holidays, cultural tours and outdoor adventures throughout Scotland for FIT and small groups.  Our online bookable tours and private trips attract discerning travellers who appreciate high quality, well planned, interesting journeys in the company of an expert and qualified guide. With max 8 guests tours are perfectly sized for sharing special experiences, exploring secret places and landscapes, its wildlife and nature, heritage and history and connecting with local culture and people. We guide in German and English.

Title: National Museum of Flight
Description:
The National Museum of Flight is home to a world-class collection of aircraft set within a unique historic airfield. Your clients can learn  the history of aviation from the First World War to present day then get on board Scotland’s Concorde to discover what supersonic flight was like for its passengers and crew. They can visit the shop, café, or enjoy  the  outdoor picnic area. 
•	Free coach parking
•	Private group tours
•	40 mins from Edinburgh, easily accessible off the A1

Title: Select Scotland Tours
Description:
Select Scotland Tours, winner of multiple sustainable tourism awards, delivers tailor-made private tours of Scotland by accredited STGA Blue Badge guides driving top quality vehicles. 
Engaged by luxury agents worldwide, including Virtuoso members, our in-depth market knowledge and specialist expertise allow us to provide you with access to a wide range of unique, authentic and private experiences while delivering first-class service to your clients. 
Our experience in this field ensures for you our responsive and proactive approach.
We are a group of 10 and are based in Glasgow; Edinburgh area; Perth & Kinross and North East Scotland.

Title: Highland Folk Museum
Description:
Welcome to Britain’s first open air museum which brings to life the domestic and working conditions of earlier Highland peoples. 
Within our museum your clients can learn how our Scottish Highland ancestors lived, how they built their homes, how they tilled the soil and how they dressed, in a friendly and welcoming environment.
We are located just off the A9 in Newtonmore and south of Inverness. 
Your clients can also enjoy lunch or tea/coffee and a cake in our onsite Café. 
Ample parking for coaches.  
We are open April to October.

Title: Inverness Museum and Art Gallery
Description:
Your clients can discover more about the unique history and culture of the city of Inverness and the Scottish Highlands at Inverness Museum and Art Gallery. 
They can explore our fascinating range of artefacts and collections that celebrate Highland life and heritage. 
Our galleries feature both permanent and temporary exhibitions, which includes work from local artists and crafters in our community, to those further afield.
Your clients can also enjoy lunch or tea/coffee and a cake in our onsite IMAG Café.

Title: Inveraray Castle
Description:
Visit the romantic Inveraray Castle & Gardens on the shores of Loch Fyne and discover one of Scotland’s finest stately homes.
The ancient Royal Burgh of Inveraray is located 60 miles north west of Glasgow by Loch Fyne in an area of spectacular natural beauty. The ruggedness of the highland scenery serves as a spectacular backdrop for the sheltered tidal Loch, beside which nestles the present Castle built between 1746 and 1789. Private tours and group lunch menus available on request.

Title: Bladnoch Distillery Ltd
Description: Built in 1817, Bladnoch Distillery is Scotlands oldest Privately owned distillery. We offer a gift shop, café and distillery tours, showcasing our premium single malt scotch whisky. Our Visitor Centre is currently open Tuesday to Saturday and offers standard and bespoke experiences to smaller, more intimate groups. Our focus is on providing a first class experience and sharing our passion for whisky, Bladnoch and our local area.

Title: Infinite Scotland
Description: Infinite Scotland creates and delivers unique private tours across Scotland for couples, friends and families, each itinerary tailor-made to your clients’ individual requirements. Through our valued local partnerships, we can build a range of activities into each tour, from guided hikes to foraging walks, traditional crafts to private culinary experiences. Our highly qualified guides are with your clients throughout, taking them deep into Scotland’s stunning landscape to explore hidden gems, discover incredible history, and truly experience this magical country.

Title: KH Orkney Ltd T/A Kirkwall Hotel & Shore Hotel
Description:
The Kirkwall Hotel & Shore Hotel are situated in the heart of the historic town of Kirkwall and is one of Orkney’s finest Victorian buildings. We've made some beautiful new changes to our beloved Kirkwall Hotel. Step through our vintage revolving doors, into a world of plush new interiors. 
The hotels have 54 en-suite rooms with a great range of facilities, including a relaxing lounge, function rooms, lounge bar and public bar. For your convenience, the hotel is dog friendly. 
We cater for FIT travellers, small private groups or larger tour groups alike. All receive the same warm Orcadian welcome from our team.

Title: OLD POISON
Description:
Located in the heart of Edinburgh, Old Poison Distillery is the smallest speakeasy distillery in Edinburgh. We offer multi experience like no other, bringing to life the story of the brand and its makers, creating a unique welcome for people from around the world. The experience takes visitors on an immersive journey through. We are offering exclusive world-class food and cocktails or full tasting and is hosted in one of the most fascinating building across Edinburgh in Leith, The Biscuit Factory. 
Experience 1
A gentle introduction to a distillation processes our story and tasting.
Experience 2
3 unique cocktails paired with premium Italian cheese, dried meats, Scottish Salmon or Scottish oysters (depend from the supplier) and at the end handmade tiramisu prepared at the table.

Title: The Gordon Highlanders Museum
Description: Your clients will enjoy our essay access 5 star museum show casing over 200 years of Regimental History, audio guides / tour guides (subject to availability) bright spacious café seating up to 50, beautiful gardens, Regimental Fine Dining experiences from 10 to 40, conference and event space

Title: Scarlett Erskine Jewellery
Description: Interested in making your own piece of jewellery? Come along to Scarlett Erskine’s Jewellery workshop in Wasps Studios, Dundee, where you can learn the techniques to make your very own piece of jewellery to take home and treasure forever.Scarlett will give you the time, tuition and tools to make your desired piece.You don’t need to do a workshop on your own, you and a friend / partner can come into the studio to learn and make together.

Title: WanderWomen Scotland Ltd
Description:
Award-winning nature experiences in stunning wild places in and around Edinburgh in a unique blend of mindfulness, ecotherapy and adventure: walking, silence and reflection, meditation, wild swimming, firemaking,
nature connection, foraging, forest bathing etc.

Duration - 90mins min up to 4 hours all year round.
Your clients can arrive by car (some car parks require a small fee), but most locations are accessible by
public transport.
Tours can be requested to be run in German, too.

Move your Body. Calm your Mind. Restore & Align.
Relax in Nature. Combat the Fatigue of Daily Life.

Title: National Museum of Rural Life
Description: Explore life in the countryside at the National Museum of Rural Life’s museum, farmhouse and working farm. In the museum, your clients can learn all about Scotland’s rural history, then take a walk or tractor-trailer ride to the farm, home to the farmhouse and cows, pigs, sheep, hens and horses. Round off the day with a visit to the shop and café, or bring a picnic to enjoy in the outdoor picnic area. The Museum has free Coach Parking and is only a 30 minute drive from Glasgow.

Title: Driftwood Adventure
Description:
We are an Edinburgh based Outdoor Activities company, offering a multitude of adventurous
experiences... from Stand-Up Paddleboarding, Kayaking and Snorkelling to Hill Walking, Rock
Climbing and Mountaineering.
Founded by a Scotsman (Niall Cassidy) and a Yorkshireman (Hugo Foley) alongside a close
knit team of qualified instructors, who all share a passion for introducing people to new
activities and adventures.
We operate on a mobile basis, meeting you wherever you wish to venture across the central
belt of Scotland!

Title: Scottish Seabird Centre
Description:
A 5-star visitor attraction and marine conservation and education Charity, located in the stunning seaside town of North Berwick.
Explore the wonders of Scotland’s seas with interactive exhibits, control remote cameras on local islands zooming in on spectacular wildlife - puffins, gannets and seals. 
Introductory talks/guided wildlife walks available to groups.
Enjoy lunch in the cafe with views out to the iconic Bass Rock, the worlds largest Northern gannet colony. 
Fully accessible.
Coach parking nearby. 
Seasonal guided wildlife boat trips.

Title: Dovecot Studios
Description:
Dovecot is a world-renowned tapestry studio, housed in a grand Victorian Baths, in the heart of Edinburgh. It’s a landmark centre for contemporary art, craft and design, and available to hire for special events. Established in 1912, Dovecot continues a century-long heritage of collaboration with international artists to make exceptional handwoven tapestries and gun-tufted rugs.
Alongside the tapestry studio, Dovecot run an exciting programme of exhibitions and events to further explore contemporary art, craft and design.

Title: Angela Shanley Associates
Description: ASA is an independent company offering a complete travel solution across the British Isles with offices in Edinburgh & London. We have over 40 years experience as an Inbound specialist for FIT and Groups. We offer a range of accommodation including international chains, regional groups and independents with many contracted with static rates for use in FIT programmes. Alongside is a complete range of ground services; transfers, sightseeing, small group tours, attractions & private bespoke touring.

Title: Cruise Loch Ness
Description: Cruise Loch Ness is a 5-star ASVA graded visitor attraction based in Fort Augustus, offering year-round cruises on the world-famous Loch Ness. Our vessels accommodate up to 190 and 220 guests, with heated indoor cabins and panoramic viewing decks. The Castle Cruise Experience combines a scenic cruise on Loch Ness with admission to Urquhart Castle, with departures from both Fort Augustus and Urquhart Castle, while our 50-minute Scenic Cruise offers up to six daily departures. With dedicated options for groups, coach tours, FITs and self-drive visitors, Cruise Loch Ness provides an easy-to-book Loch Ness experience for travel trade partners. Travel trade rates and allocations available on request.

Title: Crear Weddings
Description:
Crear is a magical destination coastal wedding venue offering exclusive use in warm and stylish surroundings, with on site accommodation. With uninterrupted views overlooking the Inner Hebrides and stunning panoramic views to the iconic Paps of Jura.
Caisealrag Cottage at Crear offers Wee Wedding elopements for couples who want to escape to this beautiful place to tie the knot in complete privacy and understated luxury. With beautiful blooms, professional photography and delicious food and wine, enjoy your Wee Wedding as part of your Argyll adventure tour.
Please see https://www.weeweddings.co.uk/

Title: Muckrach Country House
Description: Our 11-bedroom luxury country house is situated in Cairngorm National Park in the Scottish Highlands (the UK’s largest National Park). The Cowap family have restored this beautiful Victorian shooting lodge to its previous glory, from a bare bone building it into a luxurious and vibrant Scottish Highland Country House which offers an exclusive and exquisite self-catering experience.

Title: Avanti West Coast
Description:
Avanti West Coast (formerly Virgin Trains) operates fast and frequent UK train services linking London, Birmingham, and destinations in the NW of England, with Glasgow and Edinburgh.
We can offer:
•	Fixed tour operator rates for FITs
•	Discounted Group rates
•	Avanti VIP exclusive carriage service
•	Charter trains
•	1st Class catering

Title: Dunnet Bay Distillers Ltd
Description: Group friendly guided tours, tutored tastings and special events available at our craft gin distillery located on the North Coast 500 and John O’ Groats to Lands’ End tourist routes. Dunnet Bay Distillery, home of the multi-award-winning Rock Rose Gin and Holy Grass Vodka range, celebrates the heritage of Caithness utilizing locally-foraged and home-grown botanicals to create exceptional, eco-friendly spirits. Our VisitScotland 5-star attraction (2024/25) is fully accessible with parking to accommodate one coach and bespoke/private group events available on request.

Title: Belhaven Brewery
Description: Established in 1719, Belhaven Brewery is the oldest working brewery in Scotland. Situated in Dunbar, the brewery nestles amongst the rolling barley fields of East Lothian, just 20 miles from Edinburgh. As the home of Scottish Brewing, we pride ourselves in producing the Nation’s No.1 Ale (Belhaven Best) and No.1 Stout (Belhaven Black), alongside our award winning range of craft beers and ales, all made using our fresh water source, local barley and unique Belhaven yeast.

Title: EasyWays Walking Scotland
Description:
EasyWays -  established in 1996 with over 25 years experience in the provision of walking holidays throughout Scotland.

Self-guided or guided, simply advise your client preference and EasyWays will take care of everything – accommodation, daily baggage transfers and information on how to join and depart from any selected walk experience.  A unique Tour Pack containing detailed GPS information of your walking route with overlay on the exact location of each overnight accommodation is part of the EasyWays first class service leaving your client free to enjoy the wonderful scenery and culture of Scotland.

Title: Down on the Farm
Description:
Your clients can take a trailer-tour of the farm, discover our unspoilt coastline, meet our animals and learn about sheep and cattle farming in North East Scotland.

Our Farm Experience provides a perfect mix of country and coast. 3 tours are available -  Sheep Shearing, Lambing and Trailer Tours. Your clients will be looked after personally by the farmer and will  end in the ‘chaumer’ (farm bothy) with hot drinks and farmhouse baking.

Bespoke personal and group experiences can also be arranged.

Title: Unbaggaged
Description: Unbaggaged are an on-demand luggage storage and transportation network operating in Edinburgh. This service offers a convenient and secure method of storing and transporting your guests luggage. Your guests simply book via our website www.unbaggaged.com . Our transport partner will pick up and return their luggage where and when they need it.  We are here to help you enhance your guests experience and visit to Edinburgh.
Address Line 1: Level 6, Graham Hills Building, The Enterprise Hub, 50 Richmond St

Title: Wild Orkney Walks
Description: Wild Orkney Walks specialise in guided wildlife walks allowing your clients to get off the beaten track and explore Orkney on foot. Our walks are for small groups of up to 6 people, ranging in length from 2 hours up to a full day. We can arrange Bespoke walks, Island trips and Wildlife Tours which can be tailored to meet your clients’ requirements. Our guided walks provide a special insight into the beauty and magic of Orkney’s wildlife and landscapes.

Title: Bikerbnb / The Highland Scramble
Description: The Highland Scramble is a meticulously curated guided motorcycle tour through the highlands exploring amazing roads, breath-taking scenery & local produce. The trip includes five nights accommodation, hearty, homecooked breakfasts, hand selected lunch locations and al-fresco, fireside diner will be provided in the package. Professional photography of your trip is included. Royal Enfield bike hire is also available. Our support truck will be nearby, to assist in the event of a breakdown and it will also transport luggage & fuel.

Title: Provost Skene's House
Description: Provost Skene’s House celebrates the pioneering people of Aberdeen and the North-East of Scotland who have shaped the city and transformed the world. Dating from 1545, the oldest surviving town house in Aberdeen is home to new interactive displays sharing the stories, discoveries and achievements of over 100 remarkable individuals: innovators, scientists, life savers, writers, sporting champions and stars of stage and screen. They range from singer and activist Annie Lennox to Robert Thomson, inventor of the pneumatic tyre, and football legend Denis Law.
Address Line 2: Guestrow (between Broad Street and Flourmill Lane)

Title: Aberdeen Maritime Museum
Description: Close to the busy harbour, Aberdeen Maritime Museum tells the story of the city’s long and often dramatic relationship with the sea, through fascinating objects and artworks associated with shipbuilding, fishing, whaling, trading and offshore energy. Highlights include models of Aberdeen-built ships, from clippers to one of the first modern warships in the Japanese navy. Take in the detail of the 9-metre scale model of the Murchison platform – as close as any of us will ever get to an offshore installation.

Title: Aberdeen Art Gallery
Description: Discover one of the UK’s finest art collections in the stunning surroundings of Aberdeen Art Gallery – Art Fund Museum of the Year 2020, Scotland’s Building of the Year 2021, and shortlisted for the European Museum of the Year 2021. Explore a dazzling array of historic and contemporary paintings, prints, sculptures, craft and jewellery, including works by acclaimed Scottish, UK and international artists, designers and makers - a must-see on any Granite City itinerary.

Title: Scotland for Golf
Description: Scotland for Golf are based in St Andrews, Scotland. Scotland For Golf is at the forefront of the golf travel business, understanding the shift in demands from potential new clients to returning clients. With the team of Golf Professionals, IT specialists and travel experts, "They strive to deliver the best golf vacation you will ever have". We are authorised providers of Old Course Tee Times and The Open Championship

Title: Glenmoriston Town House Hotel
The Highlanders’ Museum
Description: Located just 7 miles away from Inverness Airport,  Visit us at the 5 star Highlanders’ Museum (Queen’s Own Highlanders Collection) and immerse yourself in our rich and diverse history, following in the footsteps of the Highland soldier from just after the Battle of Culloden until Bespoke private events/groups, and exquiste fine dining can all be arranged within the spectacular museum. Contact for details of bespoke events just for your clients.

Title: Highland Transfers
Description:
Active and eco loving company offering outdoor lovers the chance to cycle and walk around the most beautiful country in the world - Scotland.

We offer 5, 7 and 10 Day Walking Packages on the West Highland Way, and 5,7,10 or 14 Day Packages for the cycling alternative to the North Coast 500, avoiding the busy A9 road. We also provide Baggage Transfers Only if required.

Our business is carbon conscious and we operate in the most environmentally friendly way.

Title: Virgin Hotel Edinburgh
Description: Situated in the heart of Edinburgh's Old Town, Virgin Hotels Edinburgh is a masterful marriage of 19th Century architecture and contemporary design with a local influence. Combined with heartfelt service and exclusivity for all; the 222-room hotel considers every desire and comfort. At Virgin Hotels Edinburgh, you can enjoy 4 drinking and dining experiences. Visit our coffee/wine bar Funny Library, our exquisite, high class restaurant and bar Commons Club or enjoy small bites, cocktails and late night entertainment at Eve.

Title: Norton House Hotel
Description: Tucked behind a historic stone gatehouse, Norton House Hotel & Spa offers a peaceful countryside escape just minutes from Edinburgh. Built-in 1840 for the Usher family of Glenlivet Whisky fame, it blends timeless elegance with modern luxury. Indulge in award-winning dining at The Brasserie, unwind in the spa, or relax in stylish rooms. Just 5 minutes from Edinburgh Airport with stunning grounds, tailored event spaces, and dog-friendly stays, it’s the perfect destination for weddings, business retreats, and peaceful getaways.

Title: Grampian Escapes & Tours Ltd
Description: Discover Aberdeenshire’s culture and taste the amazing produce we have in the North East of Scotland. Our tours combine the best main attractions and highlights with some of our treasured secret locations. From beautiful castles and colourful heritage, breath taking landscapes and coastline to the Aberdeen’s first City Food Tour sampling local delights. Our tours are scheduled small FIT group tours, however we can offer private tours and bespoke larger group tours can be accommodated.

Title: The Glenturret Distillery
Description: The Glenturret, Scotland’s Oldest Working Distillery, has crafted small batch single malt whisky since 1763, using time honoured traditional methods. Located in Highland Perthshire near Crieff, the distillery invites guests to discover immersive tours, bespoke whisky experiences, and the intimate Dram Bar with curated flights and retail. The estate is further distinguished by the Two Michelin Star Glenturret Lalique Restaurant and the exclusive Aberturret Estate House, a secluded 19th century residence once owned by the Murray Clan, founders of The Glenturret.

Title: Carnoustie Golf Links
Description: The finest test of championship golf found anywhere in the world. Carnoustie’s Championship is one of the courses that every golfer in the world needs to play. Voted the World's Best Golf Course in 2019, venue for eight Open Championships and two Women’s Opens. This bucket list venue, also known as the toughest venue on The Open rota, is a course that challenges each person who visits and is rightly known as Golf’s Greatest Test.

Title: Airhouses
Description: Beautiful 5 Star Lodges and Glamping Pods, each with a private decking and hot tub. Set within 600 acres of a Scottish Borders organic working farm. Wonderful views across the hills, amazing Scottish wildlife such as Roe Deer, Barn Owls, Badgers and Hares. Fenced walks around the farm, a small farm shop plus a collection of our own animals to get to know such as Dylan Donkey, Orlando Alpaca, Gerturde the Goat. Just 35min from Edinburgh in the historic Borders.

Title: Musselburgh Racecourse
Description: Musselburgh Racecourse is a horse racing venue situated 6 miles from Edinburgh City Centre. We host an average of 27 race meetings throughout the year, staged both on the flat and over jumps. Highlights of our racing calendar include our Stobo Castle Ladies Day in August and our New Years Day fixture in January, we race throughout the year and therefore we have the perfect fixture for everyone! We also offer an excellent range of hospitality packages to our guests

Title: Newhall Estate
Description: Newhall Estate lies on the outskirts of Edinburgh yet is a world away from city life. Steeped in history, this exclusive use hidden gem is known for its enchanting atmosphere and poetic elegance. Ensconced in idyllic grounds, its year-round appeal provides an ideal setting.

Title: Robert Parker Collection Ednam House
Description: Ednam House makes an ideal base for your time in Border country. A stately Georgian country house, its grand history is evident throughout: ornate plasterwork ceilings, carved doors, fireplaces and stone work crafted by the finest artisans of the late 1700s. The Robert Parker collection is all about grand buildigs in grand locations. Wherever you choose to stay, you’ll find our hotels offer something very special.

Title: ATS Atlas Travel Solutions Scotland & Ireland
Description: ATS  is a dynamic DMC offering a comprehensive ground handling service for groups in the UK & Ireland through our Scotland, London, Dublin, French and USA offices.  Our talented, multilingual team provide memorable tailored programmes offering value and expertise.  We also offer scheduled departure tours in Italian and Spanish and – new – our nature programmes working with activity guides in photography, hill walking, kayaking and wild swimming.

Title: Courtyard Edinburgh West Hotel
Description:
Localted on the outskirts of the city your guests can take advantage of all the green space around the hotel while only being a short journey from the city centre and all of Edinburgh’s famous attractions. 
Ideal hotel for groups or FIT travelers. 
The Avenue is the hotel’s onsite restaurant serving breakfast, lunch and dinner with a great outdoor terrace for the warmer weather.
The hotel has complimentary onsite parking for cars and coaches, bays can be reserved for coaches in advance.

Title: Hotel Colessio
Description:
Beautiful Victorian landmark building in Stirling has been magnificently transformed into a contemporary boutique hotel that offers elegance and comfort. Whether you are looking to enjoy an overnight stay, dine, celebrate your wedding day or host an event, Hotel Colessio is the ultimate setting.
The hotel is only a stone’s throw from the historic Stirling Castle and is the perfect location for exploring central Scotland. We look forward to welcoming you during your visit.

Title: Aboot Scotland
Description: Aboot Scotland provides day, half day and multi-day guided walking trips and outdoor experiences for FIT and small groups of up to 8 people. We can also create bespoke tours tailored for your clients across Scotland. We’ve got a range of online bookable tours for your clients, to suit all abilities – from walking trips with a knowledgeable and friendly leader to sunrise experiences or outdoor yoga sessions to awaken the senses. Explore Scotland’s outdoors and enjoy the atmosphere, flora and fauna with us. Each trip has a route plan and client pack detailing all the information required as part of our 5-star service tours.

Title: Brightside Travel LTD
Description: We are a Scottish DMC, we create tailor-made trips for both groups and individual travellers. English-speaking and French-speaking teams are based in our beautiful destination. We have the knowledge as both natives and ex-pats to create your exceptional stays, whether they are of cultural, sporting, spiritual, leisure or incentive orientation.

Title: Munro Guides
Description:
Let us guide your clients to the top of their Munro challenge. Conquer Ben Nevis, summit Beinn Eighe with it’s triple buttress or Beinn Alligin with it’s infamous Horns of Alligin. 
Whatever the weather a great day out can be had with one of our expert and experienced guides. All our guides carry emergency shelters, first aid kits, paper and electronic navigation equipment and know how to use them. They will give your clients a wonderful and safe experience on Scotland’s most iconic mountains.

Title: Loch Ness Kayak
Description:
Enjoy exploring the waters, shores and history of Loch Ness by kayak. From the Loch Ness Monster, to the story of the Caledonian Canal, highland wildlife and its culture, our local guides will ensure your clients have a fun and memorable experience on the water. 
Located only 4 miles from Inverness at Dochgarroch Loch we provide everything your clients need for their half-day beginners’ trips. For those wanting to explore and enjoy Loch Ness from the water look no further than Loch Ness Kayak.

Title: Skye Kayak Centre
Description:
We, at Skye Kayak Centre, offer two amazing beginners kayaking experiences, one at our base on the Isle of  Skye and a second, kayaking around the stunning Eilean Donan Castle. 
With our local knowledge about the isle’s history, culture and wildlife, our experienced guides will ensure your clients have a magical, enjoyable and of course, safe kayak experience on Scotland’s most romantic of isles. The views will be breath taking and the memories will last a lifetime.

Title: Glasgow Grosvenor Hotel
Description: Overlooking the Botanic Gardens, this historic hotel is located in Glasgow's fashionable, leafy West End and offers 97 contemporary & characterful bedrooms and 5 meeting and event suites. Our popular steakhouse, Bo’Vine Meats & Wines, is a local favourite and our award winning bar, beGIN, offers the chance to sample Scotland’s favourite new tipple! With the University of Glasgow and the famous Kelvingrove Art Gallery & Museum close by, we’re perfect for sightseeing too.

Title: History and Horror Tours
Description:
History and Horror Tours explore the dark side of Scottish history with costumed characters on walking tours or private storytelling at your venue. Our regular outdoor tours through Perth's dark past or the blood-soaked history of Dunkeld, and our indoor "Haunted" locations at Castle Menzies (Aberfeldy) and Bannockburn House (Stirling) can also be booked privately.
We offer bespoke packages and a variety of themes, including a Jacobite in full costume! 
*Some tours are fully accessible, contact us for details.

Title: Arbikie Distillery Experience
Description:
The Arbikie Distillery Experience is on Scotland’s sunny east coast - 2 hours from Edinburgh/Glasgow; 1 hour from Aberdeen. 
Here your clients can enjoy a range of bookable tours and experiences in our Kirkwood Suite, enjoying our award-winning whiskies, gins/vodkas, as well as locally sourced food/drink available every day. 
Our luxury Stirling Suite hosts private, bespoke groups with private dining, kitchen, cocktail bar, library and cigar room/smoking balcony. We welcome Groups/FIT, have ample parking & EV Charging.

Title: Cath's Inverness Tours
Description: Cath’s Inverness Tours was founded in 2018. Born near the historic Battle of Culloden on my family’s farm, I developed a deep appreciation for Highland heritage, culture, and traditions. As a Scottish Tourist Guide Association Green Badge holder and HOSGA member, I offer luxury private car tours and work with cruise ships visiting the Highlands. Whether leading walking tours or driving, I provide personalized experiences, weaving in local history, Scottish food, and cultural traditions for a truly authentic journey.

Title: St James Quarter
Description: St James Quarter is a game-changing new heart for Edinburgh, offering the biggest retail and leisure district Scotland has ever seen. The galleria features an enviable line up of brands, many who have arrived in Scotland for the first time.

Title: XPLORE Dundee
Description:
Dundee Hop-on/Hop-off Open Top Tour Bus
Located at the beautiful new waterfront
Visits Dundee Heritage Sites, Museums and Scenic Landmarks
Group/Family Friendly
Commentary by Headset and Wheelchair Accessible.

Title: Peel Farm
Description: We have a coffee shop, gift shop, farm shop, ice cream from Easter and luxury holiday accommodation in the beautiful Angus Glens. Plenty of parking and a nature trail in the summer.

Title: Skedaddle North
Description: Skedaddle North offer guided trail running experiences throughout Moray & Speyside. Our runs are tailored to accommodate all running abilities. Offering a variety of distances, locations of natural beauty and interest. Each experience includes food & drink, from drams, gin, craft beers, pizza or a simple coffee & cake!

Title: Enthral Experiences
Description: Our aim at Enthral Experiences, is to provide a unique and engaging perspective on the history and culture of Edinburgh, with a focus on authenticity, entertainment, and education. Our walking tours are led by an engaging character guide and provide a mix of history and great storytelling for an unforgettable experience. Our Edinburgh tours consist of ‘Witches Old Town Tour & Underground Vault’ and ‘Historical Gems & A Taste of Scottish Fudge’. We would love for your customers to join these experiences.

Title: Arbroath Signal Tower Museum
Description:
Signal Tower Museum is located near Arbroath's picturesque and busy harbour, in a complex of buildings which were originally used as the shore station and accommodation for the Bell Rock Lighthouse. Built in 1813, Signal Tower served the lighthouse until it was decommissioned in 1955 and became a museum in 1974.
Hear about the story of the magnificent Bell Rock Lighthouse and how the coastal town's connection with the sea has influenced Arbroath's social, industrial and ecclesiastical history. Using multi-media displays and historic objects, the museum tells the story of Arbroath's fishing and maritime industries.
Visitors can climb the dramatic spiral staircase and visit the tower room, for those who are unable to climb the 70 steps and ladder into the room there is an opportunity for a virtual visit, which is also available in Gaelic, Polish and Romanian.

Title: Stotfield Hotel
Description: The Stotfield Hotel is a 47 bedroom hotel, centrally located in the seaside town of Lossiemouth on the beautiful Moray Coast which is an ideal base for day trips in Moray, Grampian, Aberdeen City & Shire, The Highlands, Loch Ness and beyond.  The hotel offers a Warm Welcome from a friendly and professional team. We have a well stocked Bar, our Restaurant serves excellent quality food and our rooms offer comfort and calm surroundings to relax after an active day.

Title: North Uist Distillery
Description:
We can offer you a range of bespoke tours and tastings for your clients adapting these to suit small cosy groups, FIT, right up to large coach groups. Easy coach parking and facilities. Book ahead for tours and tastings or drop in to our Downpour Gin Shop. Enjoy a G&T in the courtyard from our Island Life Bar. 
How to get here; Benbecula airport is a 50 minute flight from Glasgow Airport. Ferry terminals Lochmaddy, Berneray, Eriskay or Lochboisdale.

Title: Long Island Retreats and Larder
Description: Based on South Uist on the Outer Hebrides we are a crofting family offering bespoke tours to suit your clients requirements and timings. Tours can include Croft Tours with Island Heritage, Shetland Pony Experience, Working Sheepdog Demonstration, Shearing and Wool Tour or Field to Fork Tour. Tour length 1 – 2 hours depending on numbers, content and catering. We cater for small groups and FIT, up to 5O seater coaches, with parking/toilet facilities. Accommodation and other venues can be arranged.

Title: More in Moray Tours and Transport
Description:
Established in 2020 by Claudia Vasto and Stephen French, More in Moray Tours and Transport is a Moray Speyside–based company specialising in bespoke private tours and ground transport services for FIT and small groups of up to six guests. Operating across Scotland, the company has particular expertise in the Moray Speyside, Aberdeenshire, and North Highlands regions.
All tours are led by a fully qualified and accredited guide, from the Scottish Tourist Guide Association (STGA). Providing year-round, bilingual services in English and Portuguese (Falamos Português), the company is committed to delivering reliable, high-quality touring and transport solutions.

Title: 42 Cycling
Description: We can arrange for your clients to cycle with other like-minded industry partners, making connections and strengthening relationships. We can facilitate guided, professional cycling tours on both mountain and road bikes across the Highlands, visiting a number of key destinations to create an unforgettable experience. Our cycling tours can be created bespoke for your clients as well as organising and assisting with transport links, meals , accommodation, support vehicles & equipment hire/transport creating a flawless hospitality experience for your clients.

Title: PE5 Sports Tours Ltd
Description: PE5 Sports Tours provide inspirational and bespoke tour opportunities for young people within the sporting and educational world. We aim to provide a unique tour experience for young people that will live long in the memory. As a team we pride ourselves on quality and are meticulous in our planning and preparation to ensure we deliver safe, enriching and enjoyable experiences which allows all our customers to experience something more than just a tour.

Title: Neth Hill Border Collies - Julie Hill
Description: Top quality sheepdog demonstrations by the only woman to have won the International Supreme Championship in both singles and brace competition. Visit a traditionally run hill farm that has sheep welfare and conservation as a high priority. Travel through the beautiful moor-foot hills to reach the farm, by Heriot. See Julie Hill's "The Natural Way" method she has pioneered over 40 years of shepherding and watch how she communicates using the dogs' own language, to build a respectful and loyal relationship.

Title: Bonnie & Wild
Description: Bonnie & Wild’s Scottish Marketplace is one of Scotland’s biggest food and drink venues. Showcasing the best of Scotland, our stylish Food Hall offers an unrivalled choice from eight restaurants, three bars, gelateria, patisserie and boutique bottleshop. A popular fixture for events and private dining, including Chef’s Table Experiences from the likes of National Chef of Scotland, Gary Maclean, it’s situated within the St James Quarter, two minutes’ walk from Waverley Station and the tramline, with easy access to parking and taxis.

Title: The Original Rosslyn Inn
Description:
The Original Rosslyn Inn is a family run business since 1837. The building and the village have a rich fascinating history.
The current custodians of the property since 1973, the Harris family are now in their third generation of service to the community.
The Inn has enjoyed centuries of culture defining guests including Robert Burns, William Wordsworth and Sir Walter Scott.
Whether you need some nourishment, a refreshment, or a place to lay your heed we invite you to be a part of our story.
Join our list of “well kent folk”.

Title: Lind & Lime Gin Distillery
Description: Lind & Lime Gin is enjoyed around the world, and produced and bottled in Edinburgh’s historic distilling district of Leith. Our distillery on Coburg Street is exactly what you might expect an urban ‘craft distillery’ to look like. On our tours visitors fill their very own miniature bottle, and learn to mix the perfect Gimlet cocktail. Just 10 minutes by foot from the Royal Yacht Britannina. Private tours available.

Title: The Port of Leith Distillery
Description: Founded by two lifelong friends with a passion for Scotch Whisky, the Port of Leith Distillery, the UK’s first vertical distillery, is a remarkable new landmark in Edinburgh taking a very modern approach to Scotland’s national spirit. A working distillery in the vibrant port of Scotland’s capital city, Edinburgh. Private, bespoke and exclusive tours available.

Title: The Pentland Hotel
Description:
Welcome to The Pentland Hotel in Thurso our family run hotel offers 42 ensuite bedrooms for your clients with a mix of options for the solo or group traveller.  Centrally located ideal for the beach or walk from the train station and journeys onto Orkney with early breakfast for the Ferry Crossings.
Our main Restaurant and Bar have home cooked Scottish delights and all rooms have Free WiFi and tea/coffee trays.   
Part of The Caithness Collection of Hotels

Title: The Norseman Hotel
Description: Welcome to The Norseman Hotel in Wick where we can offer your clients a comfortable stay at our family owned 48 ensuite bedroom hotel.  Ample free parking available for solo or group travelers and our central location is easy for walks by the river and visits to Pultney Distillery just one of the local attractions when visiting Caithness and the NE coast. Our delicious menus awaits please lets us arrange a great Scottish Experience at The Caithness Collection of hotels.

Title: The Caithness Collection of Hotels
Description: Your clients can enjoy a warm welcome at The Castletown Hotel  a family run hotel with 28 ensuite bedrooms  recently refurbished and can cater for solo or group travel.Private parking available and  ground floor accessible bedrooms . with a mix of Family Doubles with fold down sofa beds for children or your clients can upgrade to our Superior bedrooms with  bathrobes , mineral water & home made chocolates. Castle of Mey and local beaches a must when in the North East of Scotland.

Title: The Glencoe Inn
Description:
Our five-star accommodation at The Glencoe Inn is sheltered among picturesque Scottish lochs and Munros and is a natural meeting point and welcome resting place near the West Highland Way.
Our Glencoe Inn provides a welcoming environment, with spacious Lounge and Bar areas. Complemented with cosy soft furnishings, log fires and views towards Loch Leven and the surrounding mountains, our Inn offers you an invitation to relax after a day of adventure.

Title: Oban Bay Hotel
Description: Oban Bay Hotel borders the bay with views to the isles. Our Oban spa hotel is a destination as much as a base for exploring Scotland's West coast.  Seafood and prime cuts regularly appear on the award-winning Grill Room's restaurant menu.  Sunroom sea view windows watch the ferries drift by over afternoon tea or a nightcap.  Within our Oban hotel's spa, the Thermal Experience with outdoor hot tub and sauna provide natural sources of relaxation, complementing our ishga spa treatments perfectly.

Title: Maid of the Forth
Description: Come and join us on our spectacular award winning ninety minute sightseeing cruise, where you will sail under all three Forth Bridges and down towards Inchcolm Island. By far the best way to view the magnificent engineering of the Forth Bridge, The Forth Road Bridge and the Queensferry Crossing. Combine your sightseeing cruise with a visit to Inchcolm Island, explore the ancient Abbey, marvel at the magnificent wildlife, or relax on the tranquil beaches and soak in the amazing views.

Title: Quendale Water Mill
Description:
The Quendale Watermill is a beautifully restored 19th century overshot watermill complete with visitor centre and hot and cold drinks facilities.
Parking available
Your guests can browse the gift shop
Open Mid April – Mid October, 10am – 5pm
Located to the south of Mainland Shetland, the Quendale Watermill is situated in a quiet rural location surrounded by many scenic areas and outstanding historical attractions.

Title: Scalloway Museum
Description: Our museum tells the story of Scalloway and its people from the earliest settlers right up to Scalloway's position in the present day. Perhaps the jewel in the crown of the museum's displays is the section dealing with the clandestine wartime operation which became known as the Shetland Bus. Open Mondays to Fridays – 11 am – 4 pm, Saturday – Closed Sundays – 2 – 4 pm Facilities include; Disabled Toilet, Free car park, Gift shop with local crafts, Refreshments, Tourist information point, Baby changing facilities, Views of the castle and harbour, Taxi drop off area, Free WiFi

Title: Siberia Bar Hotel
Description: An Award winning independent Bar&Hotel in the heart of Aberdeen city centre.

Title: All-Star Guides
Description: Edinburgh is a beautiful city, and we want to share its extraordinary secrets with you. We collaborate with the best-rated guides in town to bring you a personable, thorough experience.

Title: Deerness Distillery
Description: Located in East Mainland Orkney, 20 minutes from Kirkwall and the airport. Currently undergoing an expansion to open in Spring 2024 comprising; larger retail area, café for 40 plus, whisky still room, cask storage and ‘The Copinsay Room’ - a unique space to hold tasting experiences, events and private functions. Within expansion plans, an ambitious goal of taking all distillery buildings ‘off-grid’ utilising a biogas system. There will be a variety of tour & tasting experiences your guests can enjoy.

Title: Highland Bike Tours
Description: Based in Highland Perthshire, together with a local tour guide you will experience all the beauty that this part of the Highlands has to offer in a unique way. Thanks to our E-Bikes, long distances or hills are no longer a problem, and you can comfortably enjoy all the stunning scenery that Perthshire has to offer. The tour guide will take you along beautiful routes full of nature and wildlife; from historical and cultural hotspots to hidden gems!

Title: Perth Food Tours
Description: A food walking tour of Perth, Scotland with a local person. Groups of max 8 will enjoy a 3 hour walking tour, learning a little of the local history and enjoying several stops for a taste of Scotland’s traditional food and drinks plus some local delicacies.

Title: Grant Arms Hotel
Description: The Grant Arms Hotel, located in Grantown on Spey in the heart of the Scottish Highlands, combines historic charm, luxury, and warm Scottish hospitality. Established in 1765, this prestigious hotel is renowned for exceptional service and for hosting both domestic and international tour groups. Set within the Cairngorms National park and Speyside whisky region, it offers outstanding wildlife experiences, distillery visits, and outdoor adventures, making it an ideal base for memorable Highland stays year-round.

Title: McLeod Golf Services
Description: A service-based company, filling missing gaps in your service provision. Anything from helping create tours, being an in-house company rep by meeting tours, to being an emergency contact and doing ballot applications. All this on a job-by-job basis making it all very cost effective within years working at an open championship venue. My high level of customer service could be invaluable for you.

Title: Tay Spirits Ltd
Description: Tayport Distillery is a family owned and operated distillery creating premium gins, vodka & liqueurs. We create quality spirits without cutting any corners. We produce our own base spirit using the finest Scottish Malt Barley. It is distilled, bottled, waxed and labelled onsite where each bottle is packaged with a hand-written note from the family, bringing our home to yours.

Title: Shetland Rural Experience Centre Ltd
Description:
Welcome to the Shetland Rural Experience Centre, where you can see working collie dog demonstrations by David and Isla and their team of dogs. 
We have dogs at different levels of ability that will give you a true sense of the process we go through when training dogs from beginners all the way through to fully fledged working dogs. 
We have traditional Shetland sheep and Ponies for you to see followed by a traditional Shetland Lunch.

Title: Royal Oak Guesthouse
Description: Welcome to Royal Oak Guest House, offering 8 fully serviced en-suite rooms, located approximately 1km from the heart of Kirkwall. We cater for FIT’s and small groups. There’s off-road parking, a breakfast room and private lounge that your guests can enjoy.  Close to all visitor attractions, pubs, restaurants, retail shops in Kirkwall. Only a short drive to the Heart of Neolithic Orkney; Skara Brae, Maeshowe, Ring of Brodgar. A warm welcome by true Orcadians awaits you.

Title: Boreland Loch Tay
Description: Self Catering Accommodation sleeping up to 110 guests in Highland Perthshire. On site activities such as Highland Games available. Boasting amazing views over Loch Tay, each property features high speeds WiFi, wood burning stoves, fire pits and BBQ’s. Good central location in Scotland within driving distance of major cities such as Edinburgh, Glasgow and Perth

Title: The Edinburgh Literary Pub Tour
Description: Join professional actors, Clart and our clean-hankied intellectual McBrain, who will lead you on a brilliant and witty dramatic romp through the wynds, courtyards and pubs of Edinburgh's Old and New Town. Your clients will enjoy a hilarious duel of wits across 300 years of great writing and colourful characters which Edinburgh is well known for. We offer both private and public tours. We can adapt the tour’s times and start or end locations to fit in with your itinerary.

Title: Isles Of Glencoe Hotel
Description:
The Isles of Glencoe couldn’t be closer to the waters’ edge: it’s built on a peninsula reaching into Loch Leven. It’s right at the heart of Glencoe too – with Fort William a short drive away, and the stunning scenery of Scotland’s west coast on the doorstep.
Everything’s designed to maximise light and space – from the generous proportions of the bedrooms to the stunning views of the loch and the mountains. The conservatory restaurant has plenty of space for large groups, with wonderful views.  The Hotel offers 59 newley refurbished bedrooms.

Title: The Park Hotel
Description: Enjoy our new bakery and butcher inspired menus, a vintage double decker bus and a gallery showcasing local artwork.  Sometimes simplicity is best. After a hard day on the mountain bike trails, or trekking through Glentress Forest, the Park Hotel in Peebles offers great value accommodation for small groups.  The Hotel has 25 newly refurbished bedrooms,  All guests have access to the leisure facilities at our sister Hotel The Peebles Hydro just across the road.

Title: Kingshouse Hotel
Description: Our crackling fires thaw the coldest of bones – with a little help from locally sourced food, beers and single malts. All served with views to tempt even the weariest to proclaim themselves ready to do it all again the next day. It's all about the views - every room has one - when you're in Glencoe, it's impossible not to. Newly refurbished, the hotel sits like an Alpine retreat. Big windows and views from the bar and restaurant, or corrie round the fireplace in the Way Inn bar. There's also a bunkhouse, and we're right on the west highland way.  The Hotel offers 57 bedrooms and take small groups up to 15 rooms.

Title: Your Scotland Tour
Description: Custom Written Private tours of up to 8 passengers. They cover the whole of Scotland from any Scottish Town, City or Airport. Anything from Half day tours to Multiple day multiple venue tours available.

Title: Netherurd Garden House
Description:
Netherurd Estate, Blyth Bridge - 20-minute drive from Peebles & 1 hour from Edinburgh and Glasgow.  Located within a two acre Walled Garden, ideal for outdoor activities, relaxation, and BBQ’s.  Enjoy Walking/Hiking, Golfing, Horse-riding and Cycling in the Tweed Valley.
Boasts 18 accessible apartments with well equipped kitchens, living room and spacious walk in wet rooms, can be hired exclusively for larger groups.
Meeting & Event space for up to 80 people to suit every occasion. Complimentary private onsite parking.

Title: The Cheese Lady
Description:
The Cheese Lady, is an award-winning specialist cheesemonger, offering a curated selection of the finest farmhouse and artisan cheeses from the British Isles and the Continent. These complex cheeses are crafted with care and precision by cheesemaking masters, matured to perfection in our new maturation room. 
We offer private bespoke tasting events/masterclasses, led by our founder and best-selling author, Svetlana. We offer tastings of European, British, Scottish cheeses, paired with our artisan wine range, whisky and/or local liqueurs for groups 6-20.

Title: The Loch Rannoch Highland Club
Description: Loch Rannoch Highland Club offers 85 beautiful self-catering properties nestled on a hillside within its own grounds of seven acres. Each boasts a stunning view of Loch Rannoch and breath-taking mountain scenery. The Lodges sleep 4, 6, or 8 guests and feature fully equipped kitchens, modern bathrooms, linen and towels, and parking. A number of lodges have their own built-in saunas, while others offer access to a shared sauna on site. The lodges are pet-friendly and feature free WIFI throughout.

Title: Backhouse Rossie Estate
Description: Walled Garden, Venue & Café set in historic landscape where your clients can enjoy a traditional Scottish Estate offering: group tours, easy coach parking, & hospitality just off A91 on way to St Andrews. Talks on the garden development & National Scientific Collection of Daffodils available inside if weather inclement.

Title: Golf Traveller
Description: Golf Traveller specialise in luxury golfing trips centred around bucket-list events and experiences. Tailored for discerning golfers, we provide our clients with the opportunity to combine golf at the most exclusive Scottish courses alongside the finest luxury accommodation and culinary experiences. We have extensive experience of dealing with the trade, and our dedicated St Andrews team are on hand to provide an unparalleled service to all of our clients. No request is out of the question, contact our team to find out how we can make a bucket-list golfing experience a reality.

Title: Kinnaird Castle
Description: A palatial castle set in 1300 acres of walled parkland, populated by red and fallow deer herds, offers holiday and corporate accommodation in a historic setting for between 2 and 30 people.  Home to the Carnegie family for 600 years and currently occupied by the Duke and Duchess of Fife, the castle lies 2 miles inland from the Montrose Basin nestled between the Angus glens and the unspoiled dune filled coastline.   Ideal for historians, golfers, nature lovers and families.  We can offer three dedicated self-catering holiday apartments with opportunities to have specialist groups of up to 36 taking over the entire castle.  Apartments can be combined to suit most party sizes and guests can enjoy antiques combined with all modern facilities.

Title: SpeyArms FlyFishing Co.
Description:
We provide salmon guiding fishing trips and salmon fishing holidays on one of the finest salmon fishing rivers in Scotland. We are very proud to have shared our knowledge and skills in fly fishing, for more than 25 years; from teaching the basics of fly fishing, fly casting, and techniques, to advance angling concepts and catching the fish.
Our goal is to increase your knowledge of Fly Fishing World and to provide you with a relaxing and pleasurable experience.

Title: Highland Wildlife Park
Description: Set in the stunning Cairngorms National Park, Highland Wildlife Park is the perfect day out for groups! The park offers breath-taking views and the chance to see a range of native animals like the Scottish wildcat, as well as species from around the world, including snow leopards, Amur tigers, Japanese macaques and Scotland's only polar bears. Your clients can also drive around the reserve, where they will see many hoofed animals, including deer, elk, vicuna and bison.

Title: Highland Safaris
Description: Highland Safaris is a five-star visitor attraction in the heart of Highland Perthshire, offering unforgettable experiences for both Groups and FIT travellers. Guests can enjoy award-winning Land Rover Safaris, Loch Tay Safaris, the Red Deer & Barn Owl Experience, Gold & Gem Panning, Café, Gift Shop and more. We are group-friendly with easy coach parking and a spacious café seating up to 80 guests. Bespoke itineraries and private group experiences are welcomed, making Highland Safaris an ideal partner for tour operators seeking authentic Scottish adventures and exceptional hospitality, just a 1.5-hour drive north of Edinburgh Airport.

Title: Loch Insh Outdoor Centre
Description: The Loch Insh Outdoor Centre offers families and school children year-round outdoor sports opportunities including equipment hire, lessons with our experienced instructors and sports clubs. We also operate 13 chalets, 2 apartments and 21 B&B rooms of various sizes. Combined with our Boathouse Restaurant, plenty of parking and activity day tickets (including our famous ‘Jungle Float’ floating waterpark), the Loch Insh Outdoor Centre has everything a family needs for a break in the Highlands.

Title: WeeCOOK
Description:
WEECOOK is small independent Multiple award winning, Pie makers & Street Food Caterers business based in Arbroath. Famous Scotland & UK wide for amazing pies, including the famous (as seen on TV) Fishwife pie! 
They sell their pies and other products from their production unit and also offer immersive, hands on pie experiences designed for food lovers, groups, and families looking for something authentic, local, social and memorable to do during their time in Angus. Open selected days -  Thursday – Sunday afternoons or evenings subject to pie production and schedules and existing events. BESPOKE EXPERIENCES WELCOME| SUITABLE FOR FIT, GROUPS & EXCURSIONS

Title: Redcastle
Description: Based in the historic birthplace of Scotland, Redcastle produce a range of award-winning craft spirits & liqueurs. With unique visitor experiences on offer, including guided tastings and blending school experiences, the knowledgeable Redcastle team offer a warm welcome and a memorable visit to Arbroath. We work with a number of partner venues to create the perfect experience for your client, whether it’s a sole traveller or a full coach party.

Title: Innes House
Description: Innes House is a historic estate in Moray, Northeast Scotland, spans 5000 acres of farmland, meadows, and woodlands. A family home since the 1600s, it offers guests a secluded retreat in the tranquil countryside. While rich in history, the house is bright, welcoming, and thoughtfully equipped with modern comforts. The house can accommodate up to 38 guests in 20 charming bedrooms (16 ensuite). Whether you choose a fully staffed or self-catered stay, you’ll have exclusive use of the castle, ensuring a truly private and memorable experience.

Title: Sgùrr Tours
Description:
Your clients can enjoy a Highland tour in absolute luxury in an 8 seater V Class Mercedes-Benz,
