Complimentary cold soft drinks throughout the trip from the onboard 12v cool box, on board wifi
connection, self rear controlled AC in the vehicle. As a Sgitheanach (Skye Person) ) at heart and
experienced tour guide, I have a vast knowledge of the Highlands, especially the west coast, and am
intimately familiar with both the main roads and backroads of the Highlands, which enables me to
customise tours to match my clients’ interests.

Title: Montrose Air Station Heritage Centre
Description: Montrose was the UK's first operational military air station dating from 1913 to 1952, but our story is not just about aircraft, we also show the human side. The museum has expanded in recent years becoming a highly rated visitor attraction on TripAdvisor and Google. A fully accredited museum run entirely by volunteers who pride themselves in being friendly and helpful. Group visits need to be booked in advance and a form can be downloaded from our website.

Title: The Tolbooth Tavern
Description:
The Tolbooth Tavern in Edinburgh is part of the original Canongate Tolbooth which was built in 1591. This medieval building was used to collect tolls from travellers entering the burgh at the Canongate. 
The ground floor became The Tolbooth Tavern in 1820. 
The Tolbooth Tavern is a cosy traditional Scottish pub full of character and charm. It boasts a fantastic spot along the Royal Mile where the small exterior gives way to a spacious bar and mezzanine dining area.

Title: The Granary Lodge Bed & Breakfast @ The Castle & Gardens of Mey
Description: The Granary Lodge bed and breakfast is the perfect Highland retreat, nestled between the Castle of Mey and the Pentland Firth. Ten luxury en-suite rooms, including two suites with lounges, are individually styled and beautifully appointed in the original 17th Century Granary Building with the Drawing Room, Dining Room and Reception in an adjacent building. Wick John O’Groats Airport is 20 miles from accommodation. Private parking and ground floor accessible bedrooms. Ideal for Groups and FITs, available for exclusive use.

Title: Brucefield Estate
Description: Brucefield Estate is a 1000-acre secluded ancient estate offering an ecotourist day experience for FIT/groups all year round. Centrally located yet superbly isolated the estate’s private tours are an exemplary insight into the medieval heritage and wildlife of central Scotland. The House of Bruce mansion tour (20 people) includes unique medieval estate artefacts with optional banquet (12). Nowhere so close to major cities offers such a diverse and authentic historic and wildlife experiences and tours (30-seater bus max).

Title: Islander Edinburgh Ltd t/a Islander UK
Description: Islander bring to you beautiful Footwear, Handbags and Accessories made with Scotland’s finest Harris Tweed®. New for 2022, the Islander Workshop opened in Edinburgh City Centre where customers can create their very own Mini Satchel handbag; selecting their own choice of coloured components and a choice of Harris Tweed® lids. We have room for up to 12 people in one sitting and workshops take approx. 45 mins – 1 hour to complete.

Title: Monkstadt 1745 Luxury Lodge
Description:
Monkstadt 1745 Luxury Lodge is located in beautiful Trotternish, where Bonnie Prince Charlie landed by boat with Flora MacDonald…all of this and more await you at Monkstadt1745. Escape to Monkstadt 1745 and bask in one of our luxurious four-poster suites, all thoughtfully designed with your comfort in mind. Think roll-top baths and all the modern luxuries you could possibly need to relax. Immerse yourself in our rooms, indulge yourself at our restaurant and bar where we offer you the best of local produce and then enjoy a wee dram. 
Our History is Your History!
Our unique experiences are suitable for individual travellers as well as groups of 12 sizes. We offer six king sized bedrooms, and our team will work with you to create and plan the best options to meet your client’s needs.

Title: Dakota Hotels
Description: Dakota Hotels: a luxury lifestyle brand, synonymous with style and impeccable service. Sophisticated yet cool, with timeless style, each of our hotel destinations across the UK surprises and delights in unexpected ways. Indulge in our effortlessly chic guest rooms and suites; immerse yourself in our luxurious Bar; or discover fabulous food in our Grill. Welcome to your home away from home; welcome to Dakota.

Title: Broomhall House
Description: Broomhall House is recognised for its unique place at the heart of Scotland's history and for its new role as a prestigious and welcoming venue for small group tours and private tours with privileged access. Lord Bruce personally hosts guests and designs uniquely special experiences. The house is also available for larger corporate events both inside the house and in the grounds as well as filming, photosheets, automotive and private gatherings.

Title: DP&L Golf Tours
Description: DP&L Golf are a leading Scottish golf tour operator based in St Andrews specialising in creating pre-packaged and bespoke golf holidays to all golfing areas of Scotland as well as being an “Authorised Provider” of Old Course Tee Times. At DP&L Golf, our goal is for you clients to have an unforgettable golfing experience, working with you to arrange every aspect of your client's trip, including non-golfing activities, we eliminate any stress you may have of planning and organising a trip to the “Home of Golf”.

Title: Ardoch Loch Lomond
Description:
Ardoch Loch Lomond is an exclusive use venue with multiple function spaces and 18-bedrooms; set in 133 acres of rolling countryside, with spectacular views over Loch Lomond. 

Ardoch can host up to 50 for seated, and 100 for standing events. It is perfect for both residential and day only events including conferences, training courses, networking, business meetings or team building activities.

Uniquely run as a profit with purpose venue, profits from all bookings go to Children's Hospices Across Scotland (CHAS).

Title: Islay Estates Company - Bridgend Hotel
Description: 11 cosy, spacious bedrooms each uniquely decorated. A good night’s sleep is guaranteed – especially after sampling Islay’s famous single malts! With hints of our Islay Woollen Mill Gillies tweed throughout, we have 4 super king size rooms, 1 family suite offering two bedrooms and two bathrooms, and 6 double rooms. Using the finest local ingredients from our Estate and beyond, our chefs create seasonal menus with a taste of Islay on every plate. What we can’t rear or grow ourselves, we work with local partner suppliers to ensure our ingredients are as fresh and local as possible.

Title: Escocia Tours
Description: Escocia Tours was made to offer quality, personalized tours with a qualified and experienced guide or driver/guide. Fully qualified and insured Blue Badge tour guide covering all of Scotland. Spanish, English or Portuguese languages. We want your trip to be memorable and special. Our philosophy focuses on promoting personalized, sustainable, local, balanced and respectful tourism.

Title: ProScot Golf Tours Ltd
Description: ProScot Golf Tours are based in the “Home of Golf” and are ready to work in partnership with you to promote and secure the ultimate golfing package. We are an “Authorised Provider” of the Old Course guaranteed tee times. Our Director is a PGA Golf Professional and Links golf specialist. Our local knowledge of golf, accommodation, restaurants, events and whisky is second to none. Wrap all that up with our own transport service makes for an unforgettable golfing experience for your clients.

Title: Ninth Wave Experience
Description: Award-winning wee gem of a restaurant offering 4 course luxury lunches on a traditional Hebridean croft on the Isle of Mull. The chef patron Carla , a Masterchef the Professionals quarter finalist, will introduce each dish and give you a personal tour of her culinary herb garden.

Title: AC by Marriott Inverness
Description:
Beautiful modern accommodation in the heart of the Scottish Highlands. Approx a 15 min drive from the airport and only a short walk from Inverness Railway Station, finest shopping and sightseeing spots. Our thoughtfully designed rooms offer free Wi-Fi, a smart TV and space to unwind. Start the day with a European-style breakfast and end it with hand crafted cocktails at the AC Lounge. The restaurant offers tapas-style bites and local flavours, perfectly paired with iconic views across the river.
We welcome groups as well as FIT travellers and look forward to welcoming your guests to one of Scotland’s most picturesque cities.

Title: The R&A World Golf Museum
Supplier Types: Carrier|Events|Exclusive Use|Food and Drink|Golf|Private Tours|Visitor Attraction
Description: There's lots to enjoy at this 5 star experience . Our immersive galleries bring the past, present and future of golf to life around you. Thousands of fascinating objects, some on display for the first time and dating back over 400 years, bring to life hidden stories of the game and it's personalities. We also have a retail shop and are just yards away from the 1st tee of the iconic Old Course.

Title: Courses for Cooks
Description: A great day out for any visitors to Scotland! Jenny Thomson welcomes private groups of up to 6 people into her home kitchen for a bespoke, hands on Scottish cookery class. Using local produce and traditional recipes with some modern twists, guests eat what they have cooked at the end of the class. 10 mins from the Forth Bridge & 45mins from St Andrews.

Title: VentureSail Holidays
Description:
VentureSail Holidays are the UK's leading skippered sailing holiday agency offering ventures to incredible destinations on board interesting vessels skippered by passionate people. Step off the beaten track and island hop around the jaw-droppingly beautiful Hebrides under sail. All on board meals are provided, usually by an experienced on board chef, with plenty of opportunities to sight see ashore, walk, hike, sample whisky and watch wildlife. All tours can be booked as private charters with bespoke itineraries if required. 

No sailing experience needed to climb aboard
Available to book by the berth, by the cabin or for whole boat private charter.

Title: Rufflets St Andrews
Description:
In the ownership of the same family for three generations, Rufflets is nestled in 10 acres of grounds just 5 minutes from the centre of St Andrews. Discover the unique warmth and intimacy that sees thousands of guests return year after year, for both golf and leisure.
With quality of experience and commitment to sustainability at it’s core, Rufflets’ mission has always been to provide the very best of Scottish hospitality based on the very best homegrown and locally-sourced products.

Title: Bespoke Hotels
Description: Bespoke Hotels have 26 hotels located in Scotland, from the Isle of Skye to Edinburgh we offer an eclectic mix of properties. You’ll find our hotels in locations well known for their culture and nightlife, whilst the Highlands and coastlines offer the most exhilarating landscapes - filled with the tallest mountains, the most magical of castles, the deepest lakes, not to mention the most elusive monsters!

Title: Kinkell Byre Ltd
Description:
Kinkell Byre Experiences, St Andrews
NATURE STAY WITH HIGHLAND COWS, WHISKY TASTING & SCOTTISH FOOD
No trip to Scotland is complete without getting up close & personal with the iconic Highland Cow washed down with a couple of drams of the very best Scotch whisky. This is a truly unique & genuinely Scottish experience in the most peaceful & atmospheric surroundings, unavailable anywhere else. This experience is only available through the travel trade & is not offered publicly. Groups of 1-30, coach parking available.
Live brochure and pricing available on website.

Title: Cairn Hotel Group – Courtyard by Marriott Glasgow Airport
Description:
Courtyard by Marriot is the perfect base for exploring Glasgow’s vibrant city centre and top attractions such as the Emirates Arena and Bellahouston Park. 
Boasting of 170 soundproofed, plush and comfortable bedrooms and features a range of modern facilities including a gym, free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs, en-suite bathrooms, and tea and coffee facilities. 
The hotel is proud to provide unique solutions and spaces to leisure and business guests including groups & tours, FIT, and MICE.

Title: Cairn Hotel Group – DoubleTree by Hilton Queensferry Crossing
Description:
Enjoy breath-taking panoramic views of the Firth of Forth and its three impressive bridges at the DoubleTree by Hilton Edinburgh Queensferry Crossing. Set on 10 acres of parkland, this hotel is a stone’s throw from North Queensferry attractions, such as Deep-Sea World and the Fife Coastal Path.
With 147 stylish, comfortable bedrooms and features a range of modern facilities and amenities including a fitness room, free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs, en-suite bathrooms. 
The hotel is proud to provide unique solutions and spaces to leisure and business guests including groups & tours, FIT, and MICE.

Title: Atholl Palace Hotel
Description: The Atholl Palace Hotel, the epitome of Scottish Baronial splendour, stands overlooking woodland parkland grounds and the town to the surrounding hills. Originally opened as the Athole Hydropathic in Victorian times, the hotel retains many features of the traditional country house, with bedroom facilities and standards which often exceed expectations and complement spacious and relaxing public areas.

Title: Glen Garioch Distillery
Description: One of the oldest operating distilleries in Scotland, Glen Garioch has been making its Single Malt Scotch Whisky in the historic market town of Oldmeldrum, near Aberdeen in North East Scotland, since 1797.

Title: Rachel's Farm
Description: Luxury and relaxation are at the heart of the Rachel’s Farm experience. Beautiful properties with private hot tubs, bespoke kitchens, exquisite living areas and bedrooms. Available from 4-bedrooms to 15 bedrooms sleeping up to 30 guests. Exceptionally well presented with full concierge options including VIP transfers and resident chefs. Perfect for any special stay from a family getaway to a large group booking. Fantastic view of the Scottish mountains and only 45mins from major airports. Specialist retreats offered as well.

Title: Calie Travel Scotland
Description:
Welcome to Calie Travel Scotland, we are a bespoke tour company based in the East Neuk of Fife. We can offer 1 to 10 day tours anywhere in Scotland travelling in comfort in our Mercedes 8 seater Vito minibus. Whether your clients are interested in history, whisky, golf, the arts, music, photography, walking, or finding out about your Scottish ancestry, we can provide a tailor-made package tour to suit them.
We also offer airport transfers, golf tours, weddings and private hire.

Title: Shorelands Orkney - Transfers - Accommodation - Meals - Tours
Description: Shorelands Orkney is the only business in Orkney that offers accommodation and tours. Transfers (if necessary) are included, however limited off-street/quiet street parking is also available. Our 'set tour' package includes two nights bed and breakfast, one tour around the Orkney mainland with lunch and transfers to and from any ferry port and the airport. Visitors can save on ferry fares by leaving vehicles on the Scottish Mainland and we offer private transfer between to and from our guest house. Small Groups, FIT, max capacity x6.

Title: Moness Resort
Description: Set in the market town of Aberfeldy, Moness Resort is a 35 acre estate that offers a wide range of hotel and self-catering accommodation, dining options and leisure activities to suit all ages. Highland Perthshire offers plenty of things to do in the area and is located 1.5 hours drive from Glasgow and 2 hours from both Edinburgh and Aberdeen. After a day of exploring the area, visitors can return to Moness and enjoy the inclusive leisure facilities, a choice of restaurants and bars and seasonal entertainment.

Title: Cluny Activities
Description: From Farming to Leisure, Cluny Activities formally known as ‘Cluny Clays’ is a family run business that has been operating for over 25 years. Niche Activities such as Footgolf and Clay Pigeon Shooting and exciting experiences like Segway riding and Archery all to be found at Cluny Activities.

Title: Loch Lomond Arms Hotel
Description: Loch Lomond Arms hotel is located in a very special setting at the gateway to the Highlands and near the banks of Loch Lomond. Easy to reach and provides the perfect place for events of every type. Distinctly Scottish, with relaxed, understated elegance within the welcoming bar, intimate library along with 15 bedrooms and self-catering cottages. Our restaurant serves the finest Scottish produce with much of our supply coming from our own farm as well as game from the surrounding hills. Experience the natural beauty of Scotland.

Title: Aviemore Ice Rink
Description:
Centrally located, Aviemore Ice Rink offers the perfect activity for your clients, both FIT and groups.
We offer Ice Skating and Curling experiences – both of these activities can be tailored to your group’s requirements and are brilliant fun for all ages.
The ice rink is housed within a large marquee with an alpine theme, where there is plenty of room for spectators. Exclusive use of the Ice Rink is available. There is ample parking for coaches.

Title: Balmacara Hotel
Description: Balmacara Hotel, a newly renovated 4-star Highland property, sits in a privileged location just 5 minutes from Skye Bridge. Currently offering 36 rooms, expanding to 58 in 2026. Most rooms feature stunning sea views and Isle of Skye vistas. Perfect for FIT and small groups. Our gourmet restaurant and bar showcase Scottish cuisine. Coach-friendly property with ample parking. Attractive commission rates for tour operators.

Title: Kyle Station Museum
Description: The Kyle Line is one of the world’s most scenic railway journeys – and no trip is complete without a visit to our museum. Located on the platform in the historic station building, the  museum uses films, archive photos and artefacts to tell the intertwined stories of Kyle Harbour, West Coast fishing and the iconic Kyle Line. There’s a gift shop and takeaway refreshments too. Your guests will enjoy a warm personal welcome and we offer group discounts and special packages.

Title: Wreckspeditions
Description:
Fancy a boat trip exploring the historic Clyde and her beautiful coastlines?
See some amazing wildlife, jump some waves and visit historical landmarks and secret locations when you jump aboard the Starfish Enterprise and let us make that adventure happen.
Here at Wreckspeditions, we tailor our tours to suit your needs.  It doesn’t matter whether you want to go fast or slow, whether you are after a story filled adventure or you just want a silent cruise, however you want it, we’ve got you covered.

Title: Edinburgh Gin Distillery at the Arches
Supplier Types: Events|Exclusive Use|Food and Drink|Private Tours|Visitor Attraction
Description: Discover the Edinburgh Gin Distillery at The Arches in the heart of Edinburgh’s Old Town, the new home of Edinburgh Gin. Step into the world of gin craftsmanship as you explore our Flavour Arch, where the rich aromas of carefully chosen botanicals come to life. Whether you’re here for a Classic Tour & Tasting, a Private Dinner with Gin pairing, or visiting our Distillery Bar or shop, each experience immerses you in the history and magic behind Edinburgh Gin.

Title: Kilmacolm Farm Tours
Description:
20 minutes drive from Glasgow Airport or 15 minutes from Greenock Ocean Terminal and your clients will learn about Scottish Agriculture and the Environment whilst enjoying the 360 degree panoramic, breath taking views of the Scottish landscape. 
With good accessibility  & parking for parties up to 28 persons, your party will have direct contact with the friendly farmer and plenty of opportunity for discussions, photographs & videos from the all-weather trailer during their farm safari.

Title: Ocean Vertical
Description: Just 40 minutes from Edinburgh tucked away in the East Lothian countryside, Ocean Vertical offer a unique base for your adventure, group get together and FITs. We lead ethical adventures in nature for individuals, large/small groups, and FITs, locally and across Scotland. We’re outdoor professionals with over 20 years experience, providing all equipment and transport. Your clients can experience paddle boarding, coasteering, surfing, climbing, mountaineering, axe throwing / archery, and overnight adventures. And we always keep the wild, wild.

Title: Deepscan Cruises
Description:
Join an intimate one-hour cruise on Loch Ness for up to 12 guests revealing the splendour of the area and the past 40 years of scientific research into the most famous Loch in the world.
Cruises depart daily from The Loch Ness Centre on an hourly basis. Available from April until October. 
Group benefits include free car and coach parking on-site, group rates, a free familiarisation visit and much more.

Title: Loch Ness Experience
Description:
Explore the stories, myths and science behind Loch Ness and its Monster. Explore by land in our signature tour or on the Loch aboard our Deepscan Cruise.
Our 1 hour signature tour accommodates 25 every 15 minutes and Deepscan 12 hourly with spectacular views of Urquhart Castle. 
Our tour is available in 9 languages, via audio guides or bespoke as a private tour.
On site enjoy free coach parking, and also discover Scotland smallest gin distillery, Gift Shops, Ice Cream Parlour and Café.

Title: The Hide at Lindores
Description: The Hide is an authentic and rare find. A bespoke BBQ cabin overlooking the longest River in Scotland and stunning countryside views. This exclusive venue allows guests to enjoy intimate Scottish eating and drinking experiences with homebred and locally sourced produce cooked by a private chef. The Hide is suitable for 2-10 guests. Designed to be enjoyed year-round. Options to sit inside by the crackling cosy fire, or outside enjoying the panoramic scenery. Bespoke experiences available with 4x4 Land Rover transport. Farm tours, painting ponies and whisky tasting with award winning Lindores Abbey Distillery are completely unique experiences.

Title: Uile-bheist Distillery & Brewery
Description:
Brewery and Distillery tours! Our tours offer a unique opportunity to explore our facilities, taste our beers and whiskies, and learn about production. Our group-friendly tours are perfect for FIT and bespoke/private groups. 
Easy coach drop-off points.
 After the tour, visit our on-site restaurant. We are conveniently located just 10 minutes from Inverness Train Centre and a 9.7-mile drive from the airport. 
Amazing riverside location. Sustainably powered! Green Tourism Gold Award!

Title: Embo House
Description: Originally a castle of the Clan Gordon, 5* Embo House, stands in 8 acres, overlooking the sea, and next to Royal Dornoch. Located just an hour from Inverness airport by car, the mansion sleeps 8-16 in eight luxurious, double, en-suite bedrooms – 7 with a sea view. Reception rooms are generous and include a grand dining room, a whisky bar/games room, and a wood-panelled library. Outside, there is a large hot-tub & golf practice pitching area, amongst other entertainments. Fine Highland food and hospitality offered via catering and housekeeping options. Should your clients wish, they can arrive by helicopter, landing on the front lawn, or by private light plane, landing at Dornoch airstrip.

Title: Knipoch House Hotel
Description: Historic country hotel near Oban with outside hot tub and beautiful loch views from our bedrooms, restaurant and garden terrace. Delicious local menus served all day or experience the Taste of Scotland menu in our new 1635 restaurant. Enjoy a local malt in our bar or cream tea by the crackling fire. Just a short drive into Oban, the seafood capital of Scotland, and a gateway to the Isles. The hotel accommodates FIT and Groups, with ample free coach parking. There are 26 bedrooms. Static FIT rates available on request.

Title: Scardroy Homes
Description: We offer a choice of 5 Self catering holidays across Scotland. They range from 1 to 7 bedroom properties on 5 acres of surrounding land. Locations include the Highland City of Inverness, Central Falkirk and Dundee. Each with central locations and ideal for using as a base to explore Scotland. Each property comes well equipped with a good mix of home comfort and personal touches.

Title: Ardross Farm
Description:
Join us for a journey from our farm to your fork, in the East Neuk of Fife. Immerse yourself in the fresh air with a walking tour of our farm, learn about farming, get your hands dirty and connect back with nature.
Meet our animals, handpick vegetables, learn about beekeeping and ancient grains, eat local food. Learn how we are making our commercial farm sustainable. Finally, browse our award winning farm shop and immerse yourself in local produce.

Title: Time Exposure Travel Ltd
Description:
Time Exposure Travel offer private small group guided sightseeing, wildlife, whisky and photography workshop tours for visitors to Scotland, but primarily in the Aberdeen and Shire area.
Travellers can choose from our offered itineraries, or they can create their own. We offer a personalised service that also includes pick up and drop off.
Currently the tours offered range from a 2-hour walking tour through to multi day multi-location.
We are fully bonded through ABTOT.

Title: Discover Britain and Ireland
Description: Discover Britain & Ireland is a bespoke tour operator specialising in tailor made group and FIT travel to Scotland. At Discover Britain & Ireland, we listen to what you are looking for and deliver personal attention, ensuring quality at all times. With over 20 years of experience in the travel industry and based in Scotland we have the knowledge and expertise to create just what you or your clients are looking for.

Title: SCOTLAND: The Big Picture
Description: SCOTLAND: The Big Picture is a nature restoration charity based in the Cairngorms National Park. We offer small group Rewilding Journeys, which are a carefully crafted blend of learning, inspiration and fun, in the company of expert guides, like-minded fellow travellers and inspirational people pushing for a wilder Scotland. Your clients can enjoy our flagship 5 night/4 day experience, which includes comfortable accommodation and wholesome locally sourced meals, alongside quality guiding, or we can create bespoke itineraries.

Title: Trail Running Scotland
Description: We are based in Aviemore, in the heart of the Cairngorms, but operate all across Scotland, providing high quality guided running experiences to suit all levels. We have a range of group departures and bespoke holidays. We are Scotland’s only guided running holiday operator and are experts in our field. We can arrange bespoke tours for individuals and large groups.

Title: Stirling Highland Games
Description: Stirling Highland Games is an authentic traditional highland games that can trace its formation back to 1818. It provides a packed day out with not just competition events to watch like tossing the caber, but also a full traders village with over 50 food and drinks producers, arts and craft makers as well as a creative arts showcase with outdoor exhibits, choirs and more.

Title: Garvock House Hotel
Description:
Garvock House Hotel stands handsomely in an elevated position overlooking historic Dunfermline.
Set amidst lush gardens, it marries the convenience of a city centre location with the peaceful feel of a countryside retreat.
The 200-year-old house has 26 ensuite bedrooms, on-site restaurant using local ingredients as well as ample car parking & complimentary wifi.

Title: Pierowall Hotel
Description: We are a licenced hotel and restaurant in Westray, one of Orkney’s outer isles. We can seat up to 32 comfortably and have plenty parking opposite hotel. We open from 10am for coffees and offer lunches and evening meals using as much local produce as we can. We have lots of wildlife and local walks and beaches around the island.

Title: Castaway Crafts
Description: An Orkney born and bred business selling handmade in Orkney products from over 140 local artisans, including beautiful Harris Tweed products handmade on the premises. You can see Fiona at work in her adjoining workshop while you browse the most comprehensive range of locally handmade products you will find. Pick your own fabric and have your own product made to order to add that special touch. Watch a work in progress on your visit or prebook for a particular experience. Groups 7-12 welcome, parking for cars, minibus, small & large coaches.

Title: Aurora Jewellery
Description: Founded in 1997 by master craftsman Steven Cooper, Aurora has grown to become one of the leading jewellery businesses in Orkney, with a reputation for producing truly unique silver and gold pieces influenced by the history, landscapes and culture of the islands. The only jewellers in the UK to have a licence from Sony Television to produce collections based on the Outlander series. Capacity for groups up 10 people, parking for minibus and cars. Workshop is open all year, Mon – Fri 9am – 5pm. Visitors are able to view work in progress from the shop.

Title: Island Smart
Description: Island Smart (incorporating Orkney Island Tours) offers Orkney based Destination Management Services and logistics support to businesses, and their clients. Our portfolio of experiences are readily available to our select range of clients, many of whom we have worked with for a decade, or longer. From delivering full ship cruise Shorex services to supporting visiting groups of luxury adventurers and providing for high-end business travellers seeking a professional introduction to Orkney we work to a consistently high standard and only contract the very best providers in Orkney. We work directly with trade clients on a one-to-one basis and provide direct quotations for work

Title: Harray Potter
Description: Owned and run by Andrew Appleby, Harry Potter is a traditional ceramic business creating a mixture of tableware and art. The pottery is a must stop on the craft trail for all ages, guests to the island and locals. Located in Harray, the pottery is also close to the nearby Standing Stones of Stenness, and the Ring and Ness of Brodgar as well as Skara Brae. Book an experience to meet the maker and hear about their craft, watch a display of the techniques used and receive an 11% discount on shop sales. Groups welcome.

Title: Michael Sinclair RPT Woodturner
Description: Michael, a local Orcadian is a registered professional turner producing one off pieces of turned wood. Small family run business with tarmac parking and easy access with a garden that visitors are welcome to explore. When visiting, customers can view our gallery and purchase finished pieces influenced by Neolithic pottery and Orkney’s historic heritage. Open April to October, 7 days per week. Closed on Sundays out-with these months. Evening bookings available by request. It would be helpful for larger groups of 10 - 12 people to prebook to help us make the visit as enjoyable as possible.

Title: Hoy Heritage Centre
Description: We are an island community heritage organisation offering an intimate heritage experience housed in an old church and set in a dramatic location. The Hoy Heritage Centre is locally developed and run and is an open all year venue where visitors let themselves in. We creatively tell the stories of Hoy through our displays and online - see Tales o Hoy podcast series. https://hoyheritage.wordpress.com/tales-o-hoy/. Open all year, can accommodate all groups sizes, parking, free entry.
Telephone: Booking secretary Olivia Thomson 07858 208120, Heritage officer 07762 570215

Title: Stromness Museum
Description: The Stromness Museum exists to promote natural science, to preserve local history and to offer an enjoyable educational and informative experience to as large a range of people as possible. We offer an exclusive guided Curator’s Tour designed to be informative, engaging and an in-depth experience, one which will enable visitors to connect with people from our past through the stories behind the artefacts. Tours take place every Wednesday at 10am and every Thursday at 2pm and take approximately 1 hour. Tours are limited to 8 persons, so booking is recommended.

Title: Orkney Highlights Tours
Description: Experienced, friendly mature tourist guide for Orkney. Touring vehicle is a comfortable Citroen Despatch, max 8 guests. Available April to end of September, out of season by arrangement. Tours can include Highlights of Orkney, archaeology, history, military, craft and food tours with stories and legends of Picts and Vikings and wicked earls’ visits, trips to the outer isles, step on tours, Kirkwall walking tours and beaches of Orkney tours. 20% reduction for solo travellers.

Title: Sheila Fleet Jewellery
Description: Sheila Fleet OBE has developed a reputation around the World for her distinctive designs. At the heart of these is her love for Orkney. Visitors can enjoy a FREE tour of our workshop and experience watching the jewellery being made as well as learning about the full making process of how Sheila brings her jewellery and designs to life. Groups of more than 4 people are highly advisable to book in advance. Some groups may be split into smaller numbers. Please allow a minimum of 45 minutes for the whole experience to visit the Kirk and workshop tour. Parking for cars, minibus, small coaches.

Title: Pier Arts Centre
Description: The Pier Arts Centre in Stromness houses a Collection of British fine art including works by Barbara Hepworth & Ben Nicholson as well as local artists such as Sylvia Wishart & Stanley Cursiter & contemporary artists Sean Scully & Eva Rothschild. The Centre also curates a year round programme of exhibitions & events. The building and facilities are fully accessible. Booking is not required but advance notice of large group visits is preferred. Guided tours available for a fee.

Title: Pomona Prefect - Boat Trips
Description: Pomona Prefect is a small, fast charter boat for hire for fishing and workboat charter for research and commercial and sports activities in Orkney. An affordable, exciting Boat hire for charter, bird watching and water taxi. Can be used for fishing, scuba diving, snorkelling, sea research diving, and small parties catered for. We take guests on fishing trips for wellness and meditative purposes. Groups up to 6 people. We can offer negotiated rates on group bookings.

Title: The Workshop Loft & Gallery
Description: The Workshop is a long established craft producers' cooperative in picturesque St. Margaret's Hope. It specialises in high quality locally produced knitwear and an impressive range of arts and crafts. Up the spiral staircase there is the Loft Gallery hosting exhibitions from local artists in a variety of media. There are monthly exhibitions from March to December in the small airy gallery. Group of 12+ welcome, parking for car/minibus/small and large coach.

Title: Toumal Art Studio
Description: Toumal Art Studio is a combined art studio and gallery with all work being Orkney themed. We sell original Orkney landscape and seascape art, prints, cards mugs, cushions and painted brooches. All work by Ingrid Grieve. Parking for minibus and small coaches, wheelchair access, small group friendly. Visitors are welcome to look around the gallery and shop with spectacular views over Scapa Flow and also see the artist at work in the studio area..

Title: Cairn Lodge
Description: Nestled in the heart of rural Perthshire, and a stone's throw from the world-famous Gleneagles golf courses, you'll find the unique experience of Cairn Lodge. Inspired by the opulence of its rich past as a baronial hunting lodge, today, it has been reimagined for the modern traveller.

Title: Great Orkney Tours
Description: I was born and brought up in Orkney and can offer a unique glimpse into life in Orkney in bygone days. I offer private bespoke tours to suit the interests of your guests. A full day tour has a lunch stop where local food and drink can be sampled. My minibus accommodates up to 8 people comfortably.

Title: The Scottish Cafe & Restaurant
Supplier Types: Events|Exclusive Use|Food and Drink|Luxury|Private Tours|Responsible|Visitor Attraction
Description: The Scottish Cafe & Restaurant is located in The National Gallery of Scotland and serves locally sourced, sustainably produced, contemporary Scottish food. The multi award-winning restaurant is well known for a commitment to using local, Artisan Scottish producers and sourcing a majority of its produce from the Contini Kitchen Garden. Serving breakfast, brunch, lunch and afternoon teas. The restaurant also offers a beautiful exclusive use events space for private functions and parties and we can host private views of art exhibitions.

Title: Contini George Street
Description: Contini George Street (formerly called Centotre) is a popular Italian restaurant set in the busy shopping and dining district of George Street in the heart of Edinburgh’s city centre. Delivering everything you want from a fabulous, authentic contemporary Italian restaurant, Contini's is open for breakfast, lunch and dinner. We source our produce direct from the markets in Italy and change our menus every month with the seasons. A plate of Italian dolce vita in the Scottish capital.

Title: Lizzie’s Orkney Tours
Description: Lizzie's Orkney Tours offer visitors a comprehensive opportunity to learn about, visit and enjoy all that Orkney has to offer. Lizzie is a Scottish Tourist Guiding Association Green Badge accredited tourist guide and your guests will enjoy the history, culture and heritage of the islands in a special Orkney Tour. Bespoke tours in a comfortable 8 seat minibus. We offer a specific Tasting Orkney Tour which offers visitors the opportunity to sample much of the local produce.

Title: Merkister Hotel
Description: Situated on the shores of Harray Loch, the Merkister hotel stands in its own grounds in the most wonderful location, commanding impressive views of this famous loch and its surroundings. Open all year, accommodation for groups up to x24 pax, parking for all vehicle sizes. Capacity for x50 pax in the Skerries restaurant, one of Orkney’s finest dining experiences, providing a real taste of Orkney.

Title: Orkney Brewery
Description:
The Orkney Brewery is based in the former schoolhouse for Quoyloo, one mile from Skara Brae, in the heart of Neolithic Orkney. With a Gift Shop, Tasting Hall serving local Orkney produce and Tours of the Brewery, we’d welcome your guests to our 4 star visitor attraction. Tours last approx. 30 mins, bespoke tours available on request. Parking for all sizes vehicles. Seating for up to x50 in Tasting Hall.  The Brewery is open April - October.

Orkney Brewery Peedie Bottle Shop is now open in Kirkwall for those who can't make it to the visitor centre in Quoyloo.

Title: Orkney Islands Hotels Ltd T/A Ferry Inn and Royal Hotel Stromness
Description: Our two Stromness Hotels provide a variety of accommodation options and offer some of the best places to stay in Orkney. Situated a short walk from Stromness ferry terminal, both The Ferry Inn and The Royal Hotel provide the ideal base for your Orkney holiday. Accommodation for over x50 pax, restaurant capacity over x50 pax. Rack rate during peak months, discount may be available for off season October – March.

Title: Stromabank Hotel
Description: Stromabank Hotel is a small family run hotel on the tranquil island of Hoy. 4 ensuite letting rooms including a disabled room with ensuite wet room. There’s a well stocked bar plus a 30 cover restaurant that can cater for coach parties large and small. Only hotel on Hoy at present offering bed & breakfast, evening meals and a bar. Parking for cars, minibus & small coaches.

Title: The Orkney Hotel
Description: Welcome to our world of food and whisky in a 17th Century hotel. Your guests can choose from over 1,000 whiskies, 160 gins and local draught ales. We serve fresh local produce in our restaurant that seats over 60, or private dining rooms up to 25 guests. Situated in Kirkwall town centre, parking for cars. Group and FIT rates available.

Title: Westraak Tours
Description: We are a locally based tour business providing bespoke day tours of the island of Westray. We offer a friendly, personal, informal and immersive introduction to life in one of the outer North Isles. We can accommodate small groups of up to 8 in our minibus and larger groups on request. Tours of Westray can vary in content and timing and can be tailored to suit. Our group rate is flexible.

Title: Kraken Diving
Description: Orkney Scuba Diving school offers group friendly snorkel and dive adventures around the amazing WWI and WWII wrecks of Scapa Flow. These sheltered sites not only provide wrecks but a variety of marine life at nice shallow depths meaning there's something for everyone. Group sizes 1-6 (up to 6 snorkellers or 3 divers in a group), operate Apr – Sept. Discounts available.

Title: Black Sheep Hotels Cabins
Description:
After a day of adventure in the Highlands, surround yourself with magnificent natural beauty in any of our unique and inviting mountain-style cabins, where rustic charm and luxurious amenities give you that ‘home away from home’ experience.
The grand cabins have sweeping picturesque views of Loch Lochy with pathways to the pebble beach on the loch’s shores. The evergreen forests on the glens across from the cabins are worth gazing at, especially when covered with a blanket of snow.
Each cosy cabin is inspired by the Highlands, beautifully furnished, and comes with outdoor patios, spacious living, dining and open-kitchen areas, bedrooms with en suite and separate baths and an electric fireplace.

Title: The Whispering Pine Lodge
Description: The Whispering Pine Lodge is a tranquil Highland retreat set against a backdrop of steep forested mountains on the banks of Loch Lochy. Enjoy the surrounding beauty as you stroll down the garden pathways to our own private pebbled beach. With an enviable location, just a short drive away from the town of Fort William, the Lodge is a perfect starting point for touring the Highlands.

Title: Rokeby Manor
Description: Rokeby Manor is an early Victorian House (1840) situated on the edge of the Highland Estate Village of Invergarry. This late Georgian-early Victorian Manor has retained its character of a country home that was built with local materials and handmade techniques. Dining in Emily’s Byre, the rustic farmhouse restaurant with its cozy bar, is a great place to relax and have a good time. This charming manor house is located en route to the Isle of Skye.

Title: The Cluanie Inn
Description: The Cluanie Inn is situated in the remote wilderness of the picturesque Glen Shiel on the way to the Isle of Skye. This mountain Inn reflects much of the Highland’s unique rustic charm with character-filled rooms that are spacious and cosy. The Inn serves hearty, scrumptious meals and the warm atmosphere of the crackling log fires in the lobby makes you feel right at home.

Title: Private Tours Scotland
Description: Private Tours Scotland offers the very best luxury tours of Scotland. Our services include bespoke itinerary creation, booking all aspects of the tour and providing luxurious transport. Our knowledgeable tour designers can create an array of itineraries that include, general sight-seeing tours, whisky tours, golf tours, family tours, heritage tours or a blend of all these aspects wrapped in with 5-star accommodation. Get an understanding of our services by requesting a draft itinerary.

Title: Laggan
Description:
Laggan is a luxury rural retreat found on the south west coast of Scotland with panoramic views of the Solway Firth. Our unique spaces; GG’s Yard (250 capacity event space), Gather (bistro), Graze (Glass dome), 18 luxury Sea View Snugs with outdoor hot tubs and The Murray Arms provide you with a place to work, connect, dine and sleep in a beautiful part of Scotland. 
Parking for 100 vehicles including coaches.

Title: Dornoch Station
Description: Re-opened in August 2023 following a full renovation, the updated Dornoch Station hotel channels the myth and rugged beauty of the Scottish Highlands and honours the rich history of its local community. Find the hotel just a short walk from the legendary Royal Dornoch Golf Club.

Title: ScotlandShop
Description: Offer individuals or groups the opportunity to explore their ancestry through tartan. They will enjoy a presentation on clans and tartans, the history behind them, traditions of weaving and fabrics. The Tartan & Clan Experience culminates with finding a family tartan or exploring connections by name and region, and the stories behind them. This Experience can be delivered in our Edinburgh store or in hotel/venue. A Tartan Design Service is also available for those who want their own unique tartan.

Title: Pitlochry Festival Theatre
Description: Founded back in 1951, Pitlochry Festival Theatre is Scotland’s Theatre in the Hills. Your clients can enjoy our café offerings, retail space, or catch a performance in our auditorium, studio or amphitheatre, all fully accessible. Your clients can have a wander through our 6-acre Explorers Garden or take a private tour with our Head Gardener.  They can enjoy snacks, hot and cold drinks and a deck chair on the riverbank at our Riverbank Hut with stunning views looking over the river and a short walk to the Pitlochry dam. The theatre is set just off the A9 with easy accessibility for coaches with a large car park and free lunches offered for bus drivers and tour guides.

Title: The Hideaway Experience
Description: Adults only 5 star self-catering accommodation. Each Hideaway has its own hot tub, double bath, sauna, and wood burning stove amongst other luxury facilities. All five Hideaways are designed exclusively for couples wishing to get away from it all and spend time in peaceful and private surroundings with panoramic views across the countryside. All are separate from each other and offer complete privacy a working farm. For a real authentic experience, a farm tour can be arranged and you can enjoy Scotch Beef from our own Aberdeen Angus and Hereford cattle.

Title: Yaldi Tours Ltd
Description:
Yaldi Tours is an Edinburgh-based tour company, with over 10 years of industry experience. We specialize in large group nightlife tours and period-dressed walking tours. In everything we do we like to keep a bit ‘Yaldi’ and break the mold a little with alternative perspectives and narratives.
We specialize in large groups and bespoke history tours.

Title: Leathan Prestige
Description: Leathan Prestige is a family operated luxury transport company located in Aberdeenshire. The business was first established in 2015. Leathan Prestige operate a fleet of luxury vehicles which are perfectly designed to cater for your luxurious travel needs, both throughout Scotland and afar. Should larger vehicles be required, this can be arranged via one of our trusted partners. Our team of drivers will make you feel at ease and assist you with any requirements during your booking

Title: Glen Dye Cabins and Cottages
Description:
We offer  luxury and unique Self Catering Cottages, along with a converted Airstream Caravan and a Showman’s Caravan.
We are located 40 minutes west of Aberdeen and have individual accommodation for 2 up to 12 or when all properties are booked up to 64.
We have a Wild Wellness and Bushcraft school on site for our guests to try their hands at something new.
We welcome enquiries from FITS, Couples, Groups, Corporate, DMC’s and anyone in between.

Title: Alvie & Dalraddy Estates
Description: We are a family-owned Highland estate spanning 13,500 acres in the Cairngorms National Park, just minutes from the A9, south of Aviemore. We offer self-catering accommodation in Alvie House apartments and cottages. On-site activities include clay pigeon shooting, fishing, farm tours (content varies by season), and bespoke tours with our laird, offering an authentic agritourism experience. Our trusted partners provide zip treks, gorge walking, quad treks, archery, and horse riding. In winter, guests can enjoy red squirrel and red deer photography and feeding. We welcome FITs, couples, groups, corporates, and DMCs year-round—get in touch to learn more.

Title: Orcadian Wildlife
Description: Wildlife, walking, and Orkney’s superb 5,000-yearold Neolithic sites always feature, and we specialise in a blend of wildlife and culture. Groups are small (5 guests only) so they see more. Our tours are all inclusive, all they need to do is get here, and we do all the rest. Accommodation booked to suit the type of group. Lastly – but most important – we really look after our guests.

Title: Rishi's Tours
Description: Welcome to Rishi's Edinburgh Tours. I'm Rishi your host, your guide & founder of Rishi's Edinburgh Tours. I have over 20 years of experience in Tourism & Hospitality. I got my degree in Tourism (BS Hons) in Edinburgh to match my love of travel. I am originally from India and I live in the alluring city of Edinburgh. However when I first came to Edinburgh many years back, I fell in love with this city. Being myself an explorer, history and nature lover, I found endless opportunities here. I conduct walking tours in this stunning city. Walking tours are the best way to discover the true beauty of Edinburgh. Discover Real Edinburgh with me. The experience I provide will become the memories of a life time for you.

Title: Bowbridge Alpacas Scotland
Description:
Your guests can choose between a 1hr or 2hr Alpaca Experience in a beautiful location in Fife with wonderful views; 15 minute drive from St Andrews or an hour from Edinburgh Airport. Our 5 Star Alpaca Experiences include our unique obstacle course and trek and are suitable for FIT or bespoke group visits. Guests will enjoy hand-feeding our mums and babies, clicker-training and walking the pet boys and learning about alpacas with a short needle-felting session included.
Easy coach parking.

Title: Local Eyes Tours Ltd
Description: Local Eyes Tours offers intimate Small Group Walking Tours & Bespoke Private Walking Tours of Edinburgh. Whether it’s the Old Town, Edinburgh Castle, the New Town or Dean Village, we cover the most enchanting locations in Scotland’s capital. We keep our small group tours small, with a maximum of 15 guests per tour. Our private tours are all unique and tailored to fit our lovely guests. Please contact us for more info. See Edinburgh with Local Eyes!

Title: Dalriada Luxury Lodges
Description: Dalriada Luxury Lodges provide 5 star, luxury self-catering accommodation in beautifully appointed lodges situated on a coastal location near Stonehaven, Aberdeenshire, Scotland. All of the lodges have two en-suite bedrooms and are decorated in contemporary style, with everything you need for a relaxing (or very active) break. The properties come fully equipped for up to four people and each has a large, private, secure kit house for four sets of golf clubs, bikes, fishing gear or walking equipment.

Title: Highland Campervans
Description: We hire and sell campervans and motorhomes near Inverness, just 5 minutes from Inverness Airport. Our hire fleet of luxury 2 & 4 berth motorhomes are compact-sized and under 6 metres in length. Ideal for exploring the Highland single-track roads. The vehicles are suitable for informal camping as the heating systems and water pump for heating can run from the gas supply.  All vehicles have fully equipped kitchens and ample space for luggage and equipment.

Title: Dunkeld Whisky Box
Description:
We’re a small, independent whisky shop in the beautiful village of Dunkeld in Highland Perthshire. We focus on smaller producers, independent bottlings, and whiskies you’re unlikely to see in the supermarket or airport.
We love talking about whisky and offer: Drop In Drams, try a dram or two from our tasting menu. Events, Join one of our regular tasting events. Private tastings, pre booked and bespoke tastings for groups, either in the shop or at another suitable venue

Title: Hillhead Hideaways
Description: Your clients can enjoy a luxurious stay in a spacious Eco Pod with stunning uninterrupted views of the surrounding area. Located on a working farm and boasting both a private BBQ house and hot tub house with views across the Moray countryside & a glass roof to allow your clients to experience the night sky at its best. All complemented with Rain shower & Coffee machine, Bathrobes & Slippers to Hair Straighteners provided, with green credentials and free EV charging this is no ordinary glamping experience!

Title: Wild Scottish Sauna
Description: At Wild Scottish Sauna, we believe in the power of relaxation and well-being. Our luxury 12 person traditional Finnish sauna with changing facility is situated on the award winning beach at Kingsbarns, St Andrews. A stunning locating beside Kingabarns Golf links & distillery out site offers free parking as well as food and toilets. We offer wellness packages, cold water sea guided swims, private sauna hire & individual social sessions. Join us & embrace the natural beauty that Scotland has to offer. Let go and breathe…

Title: Stromness Stroll: bespoke small group tours
Description:
Stromness Stroll: be a temporary Local!  
Join your native guide for a three-hour, bespoke small group tour through our unique, beautiful historic harbour town and discover life as a temporary local.  Incorporating a 45 minute bespoke curatorial tour of both the world renowned Pier Arts Centre and Stromness Museum, which gives incredible insights into our history, art and culture.  Enjoy special deals and discounts in some of our independent shops just for you using your Stromness Stroll discount card.

Title: Trimontium Museum
Description: Trimontium is the only museum dedicated to Roman & Iron Age Scotland. Based in the Melrose, the museum tells the story of the nearby site of Trimontium- the largest Roman fort north of Hadrian’s wall – using AV, touch-screen technology & the finest collection of Roman military artefacts. We offer tailored experiences, an acclaimed VR experience, hands-on workshops, bespoke group activities. Our multi award-winning museum is accessible, suitable for all ages & close to transport links & local amenities

Title: Alison Moore Designs - Jewellery Making Experiences
Description: Alison’s distinctive jewellery reflects her curiosity and passion for everything around her, with the natural world a particular inspiration. Her jewellery workshop and shop is located here in the heart of beautiful Stromness where you can watch their jewellers at work. Your clients can enjoy one of her jewellery making experiences which can be made bespoke for groups of up to 6 where they can come away with a piece of jewellery that they have made – a lasting memory of their Orkney holiday. Our shop can accommodate up to 20. Discounts available.

Title: Skaill House Falconry
Description:
Viking Falconry for All
Get up close and personal with our birds.. We engage all walks of life. We encourage people with disability and have adapted our demonstrations to accommodate. The Viking Falconry themed day would be a chance to allow participants to gain an understanding of how the Norsemen hunted with Birds of Prey on the Orkney Islands. 
A unique experience not open to the general public. We demonstrate Viking Falconry techniques, re-enactment, fact, myth and legend.

Title: Blue Coast Surf & Paddle
Description:
Blue Coast Surf & Paddle is the leading provider of coastal surf & adventure experiences in the North East of Scotland.
We specialise in Surf Lessons, SUP Lessons & Tours, SUP Yoga, Coasteering and Equipment Hire from our base in Cullen Bay on the Moray Firth coast, including locations such as Cullen, Portknockie and Sandend.
From 2-hour group lessons to full-day bespoke experiences combining activities, we can offer an unforgettable experience for your clients on the beautiful Moray Firth Coast.

Title: AC by Marriott Glasgow
Description: The AC Hotel Glasgow combines heritage architecture, contemporary design and discerning service to create a seamless experience allowing you to focus, be present & connect. Located next to iconic George Square, you’ll find everything you need moments from your doorstep. Visit our elegant restaurant Hazel to indulge your palette with locally sourced cuisine, paired perfectly with our signature AC G&T enjoyed in our bar or library for a moment of tranquillity.

Title: Seasgair Lodges
Description: Introduce your clients to Seasgair Lodges, a collection of luxury holiday homes across the Scottish Highlands. Each stay is designed for a seamless, personalised experience, supported by our Guest Services team. Guests enjoy an upgraded welcome package with local produce and exclusive use of properties for 2–24 people, many with wood-burning stoves, saunas and hot tubs. Our guestbook app and concierge service make planning bespoke itineraries effortless, from private chefs and distilleries to adventure experiences, ensuring an exceptional Highland holiday.

Title: Auld Alliance Kiltmakers
Description: Based in Edinburgh, Auld Alliance Kiltmakers is a husband-and-wife team of dedicated artisan kiltmakers, Mathilde and Jonathan. They offer their clients exceptional and authentic experiences, bespoke kilts, and stylish tartan accessories to cherish for a lifetime. Using their expertise, they offer valuable insights into Scottish crafts, culture, tartans, and kilts through private talks and workshops, taking place in charming venues within Edinburgh's Old Town and throughout Scotland. These sessions are available in both English and French.

Title: Angus Alchemy
Description:
The Moonshine Village style distillery is just outside Carnoustie, on the A92 (southbound). Featuring bespoke art by Scotland’s favourite street artist, Rebel Bear, Angus Alchemy has 5 stills producing a range of gins and moonshines.  
Open daily, the distillery welcomes visitors who’d like to learn how we craft our award-winning drinks. There’s a shop too, which sells the full range, as well as a great selection of other locally produced drinks, Cuban cigars and a great range of souvenirs.

Title: The Chester Hotel
Description: Set in the heart of Aberdeen’s fashionable west end, The Chester Hotel has 64 luxurious bedrooms and suites where you can rest your head for a blissful night’s sleep. Whether you are dining or enjoying drinks in our stylish bar, you will find a lively and sophisticated atmosphere. Commission 8% + VAT.

Title: Backcountry Survival ltd
Description: Your clients can experience a memorable bushcraft or survival experience in the middle of the Scottish Highlands near to Aviemore or north Perthshire. We offer archery, axe and knife throwing as well. We cater for all types of groups including families and kids and take bespoke and privates bookings. We have coach parking available at both our sites.

Title: Auchentoshan Distillery
Description:
Auchentoshan is situated just 15 minutes from Glasgow airport and 30 minutes from Glasgow city centre by car. 
Your clients can enjoy small group friendly tours of our distillery with our passionate experienced guides, on site  free parking; coaches/cars.
Conference facilities.
Auchentoshan has 200 years of history and is the only distillery to triple distil every single drop of spirit produced.

Title: Katrine Wheelz
Description:
Your clients can explore beautiful Loch Katrine in the Trossachs by bike. 
Coach parking; groups and FIT welcome.
We have a selection of bikes to hire including electric bikes, adult cycles, children’s bikes, trailers, and tagalongs and tandem cycles. 1, 2 and 4 hour rental options or all day.
Safety helmets included
Cycle and sail option: Steamship sail then cycle back on the private road (14 miles) 
We also offer private guided electric bike tours with local guides.

Title: Murton Farm, Tearoom and Nature Reserve
Description:
Based on the outskirts of Forfar, in the heart of Angus, Murton boasts 100 acres of a thriving nature reserve, small visitor farm and a welcoming tearoom. We can help you build the perfect experience.
Your clients can stroll our wonderful nature reserve, take part in a rural or traditional skills course or stop for a bite to eat. We are here to help your clients during their visit. We work all year round to keep our site in perfect harmony with the important work of our charitable Trust and our dual purpose – education and the environment.

Title: Manar House
Description: Manar House is a magnificent Georgian Category B listed country house set in the heart of the Don Valley, Aberdeenshire. Nestled in 65 acres of beautiful grounds overlooking the River Don, the estate is made up of manicured lawns and parkland, agricultural land and ancient woodlands. The luxury west wing suites are officially graded 5-star self catering by Visit Scotland (2024/25). The house and grounds are also available to hire for exclusive use and events.

Title: Aberdeenshire Tours
Supplier Types: Carrier|Exclusive Use|Food and Drink|Private Tours|Tour Operator
Description: Award-winning Aberdeenshire Tours creating private, bespoke day or multiple tours just for you, collecting you from, and returning you to, your local accommodation. I am a retired police officer and, as a born and bred Scot, am happy to deliver top quality customized day and multiple day tours around the north east of Scotland to castles, coastline, distilleries, gardens, stone circles and much more. Each day tour is a unique holiday experience with Aberdeenshire Tours.

Title: Rosebank Distillery
Description:
Rosebank Distillery is offers a world-class visitor experience. Take a guided tour of the working still house and see the unique whisky production techniques for which Rosebank is famed. Get ready for tutored tastings in the spectacular tasting rooms which can hold groups up to 42, unique private experiences in our Academy and Lounge, both with a capacity of 18. Coaches welcome. Please get in touch for 2025-26 group and private booking queries.

https://www.rosebank.com/visit-us

Title: Wemyss School of Needlework
Description: Founded in 1877, the Wemyss School of Needlework began in order to teach local girls a skill from which to earn a living. Today we supply needlework materials, designs, kits (both ready to go and bespoke), and teach. Visitors can have a private visit our museum to see our collection of textiles, designs and other artefacts, dating from the 17th century to contemporary and hear about our fascinating history or book a private full or half day class.

Title: Laphroaig Distillery
Description: Laphroaig Distillery is steeped in over two centuries of history, so you might say we have more than a few tales to tell. Pour yourself a dram and dig into the rich stories surrounding our peaty past.

Title: Lynnfield Hotel & Restaurant
Description:
The Lynnfield Hotel is situated on the outskirts of Kirkwall, next to Highland Park Distillery. The hotel has 20 bedrooms. 10 original antique furnished bedrooms and 10 new modern bedrooms with an ‘Orkney twist’ all having modern ensuites. A dog friendly hotel, complete with Archie, our own spring-a-doodle. 
The restaurant looks  over Kirkwall to the isles, and serves  only local seafood and meats – including North Ronaldsay mutton. Our lounge is the perfect place for relaxing before and after dinner.

Title: Hillgoers
Description: A family-owned outdoor experience provider specialising in all level guided walks throughout Scotland with help from our excellent team of highly qualified guides. Operating since 2016, we love to share Scotland with our clients. We welcome individuals or groups and experiences can last from 4 hours to multi-day, from mountains to sea. With our basecamp is in Royal Deeside we are perfectly placed for the Cairngorm National Park, only a 45min drive from Aberdeen International Airport.

Title: Farm Stop
Description:
Farm Stop is ideally situated just 10 minutes from Aberdeen and easily accessible from the A92. Farm Stop is an all-weather purpose-built attraction and offers a unique, fun-filled and interactive farm experience for all ages.
A Farm Stop experience will give you the opportunity to get up close, pet, cuddle and feed a wide range of farm animals. We have sheep, cattle, goats, pigs, donkeys, bunnies, ducks, chickens and alpacas all waiting to meet you!
Pre-book at: www.farmstop.co.uk

Title: The National Wallace Monument
Description: The National Wallace Monument is one of Scotland’s boldest architectural expressions of national pride. It was completed in 1869 as a memorial to William Wallace. There are three exhibition galleries inside which feature the legendary Wallace Sword, an animation film, and interactive displays. Visits are self-guided and information is provided in 8 different languages. At the top of the Monument is a panoramic viewing platform. Bespoke after-hours experiences for group and individual travellers can also be booked at the attraction.

Title: Craufurdland Ltd
Description: Craufurdland Castle Estate, rooted in an 800-year history, guided by the 29th Laird, Simon Houison Craufurd, offers captivating tours, luxurious teas, and exquisite dining. The Craufurds, entwined with luminaries like Mary Queen of Scots, Robert Burns, and Sir William Wallace, embody Scotland's rich heritage. As the cherished family residence, Craufurdland ensures an authentic, unmatched experience crafted by the Laird, fostering an unforgettable connection with Scotland's history.

Title: Reel Time Events
Description:
We help lots of companies visiting Scotland to help put a Scottish twist on their groups stay. 
Whether with some of our masterclasses; Bagpipe masterclass; Highland dancing workshop
Highland games to Whisky tasting; Scottish shows and a range of other entertainment.

Title: Ardardan Estate Ltd
Description:
Ardardan is a family run Agri-Tourism business comprising of  various elements including main area all based around giving a warm welcome:
Ardardan Farm Deli & Gift Shop alongside a Tearoom full of homemade goodies .Monty’s Farm Park highlighting the best of animal and indoor & outdoor play for children. Farm experiences to encounter our highland cattle coupled with great Scottish fare

Title: Byres Farm
Description: Nestled on the banks of the River Spey, Byres Farm invites you to experience the magic of a real working farm up close, but in a safe environment. Our unique facility is designed to provide customers with an authentic glimpse into the inner workings of a busy farm. It’s more than just a visit – it’s a beautiful on farm venue providing an opportunity to connect with the land, learn about food production, and immerse yourself in the beauty of Scottish farming traditions.

Title: Perle Hotels
Description:
A unique collection of hotels for the discerning traveller.
Located in the heart of the best highland hot-spots our design led hotels aim to bring guests  closer to nature by offering contemporary interiors that mimic the locations we are in. We also focus on giving guests that something special with extra touches like Bose sound systems, Nespresso coffee machines and the best quality bedding and toiletries.

Title: Cameron House on Loch Lomond
Description: Standing on the peaceful southern shores of Loch Lomond occupying over 400 acres of magnificent woodland, Cameron House is an 17th century baronial mansion offering deluxe accommodation, award winning cuisine, superb leisure and outdoor pursuits. In addition, our championship golf course "Carrick on Loch Lomond" and exclusive spa provides an inspirational setting. With interiors that are almost as dramatic as the exterior of the manor, our stunning residence evokes character and comfort at every turn.

Title: Scalloway Hotel
Description: The Scalloway hotel is a family run business, with 23 ensuite rooms, a mix of single, doubles, twins and a suite, some with sea views. Suitable for FIT and groups. Lounge bar and restaurant, serving local produce where possible. Free parking & wifi. Your guests will enjoy a stay at this friendly, welcoming hotel. Groups rates available on request.

Title: Hilton Aberdeen TECA
Description: Hilton Aberdeen TECA offers a sophisticated stay ideal for both business and leisure travelers. State-of-the-art meeting facilities cater to various group sizes, while diverse dining options and wellness amenities enrich the guest experience. Hilton's commitment to exceptional service and the Hilton Honors program provides additional incentives. With a focus on community engagement and sustainability, the hotel aligns with the values of socially conscious travelers, ensuring a comfortable and rewarding stay for those attending events at P&J Live or exploring Aberdeen.

Title: Aloft Aberdeen TECA
Description: A trendy hotel brand under the Marriott International umbrella, known for its modern design, vibrant atmosphere, and tech-forward amenities. Revel in a diverse culinary experience with enticing street food offerings that cater to a variety of tastes, accompanied by a selection of refreshing beverages. Whether you're a local looking for a midweek escape or a traveler seeking a taste of the city's vibrant culture, Live @ Aloft Thursdays is where great food, drinks, and music converge for a truly delightful evening.

Title: Glen Moray Distillery
Description:
Glen Moray is a small authentic distillery in Elgin where your guests can enjoy a friendly and welcoming tour and whisky tasting. We accept 2 coaches a day and have a dedicated coach parking space next to the Visitor Centre.  For FIT client groups up to 10pax we can organize bespoke options including private tours and tastings.
35 miles from Inverness, 65 miles from Aberdeen, Glen Moray Visitor Centre has relationships in Elgin with a number of group friendly accommodations/caterers.

Title: Europcar
Description:
Europcar is a global leader in car and van hire. At Europcar you can rent a car or van from over 120 locations in the UK, or from any one of our 3500+ worldwide locations.
With over 70 years of providing mobilty services, you can be sure that whether you are looking for an economy or luxury car for a visit to Inverness or Edinburgh, Europcar will not be beaten on service.

Title: London North Eastern Railway (LNER)
Description:
London North Eastern Railway (LNER) is one of the UK's leading long-distance train operators with services linking London to North East England and Scotland. Our Azuma trains travel on the East Coast Mainline and are designed to connect our destinations in a more comfortable, faster, and eco-friendly way. Our top destinations include York, Newcastle, Edinburgh, and Inverness.
We work closely with the trade and offer several ways to market for our B2B partners including:
•	FIT Rates
•	Group Rates
•	Private Hire

Title: Scottish Canals
Description:
The Falkirk Wheel is our flagship destination featuring the world's only rotating boat lift.
Sail through the sky in the rotating boat lift with group rates available for boat bookings with 15 passengers or more.
Or join us on a truly unique experience, behind the scenes as we explore this engineering marvel.
The tours include a short presentation, a look in our control room and then around the site providing a fascinating insight into the historic significance this iconic structure has made to those using Scotland’s canals before heading inside.

Title: Hush Highlands
Description: Bespoke luxury planner for the Highlands & Islands of Scotland, specialising in proposals & elopements, whisky tours and adventure travel. We unlock access to the highlands and provide experiences like no other by organising unforgettable moments with tailor made luxury itineraries .Breathtaking wedding locations, intimate proposals, exclusive whisky experiences &  - Hush Highlands is your personal concierge service for Scotland

Title: Hoswick Visitor Centre - 100 years of textiles and creativity in Hoswick
Description: On arrival your guests will hear from local ‘Hoswick Ambassadors’ about the Shetland Woolen Co with tea/coffee and homemade shortbread. Followed by a guided walking tour of the historic small coastal village of Hoswick. The walk follows the coastline, along a burn, among wild flowers. On returning to the Centre, visit three unique retail outlets: Nielanell Design Studio, Karlin Anderson Jeweller and Shetland Woollen Co. A traditional Shetland lunch will then follow.  Available all year/weekdays. Parking for small coaches.

Title: Radical Weavers Limited
Description: Step into the enchanting world of weaving at our independent charity studio in Stirling. Immerse yourself in craft courses where heritage and culture intertwine, offering a chance to learn the art of weaving and explore Scotland's textile history. Discover the joy of creating your own tartan-inspired treasures, a perfect gift experience beyond the ordinary. Weaving experiences such as Design and Weave Your Own Tartan, Weave A Woolly Scarf in a Day, and more!

Title: Inverness Castle Experience
Description: The Inverness Castle Experience is a new year-round attraction in the heart of Inverness, celebrating the spirit of the Highlands. It’s the ideal starting point for your guests’ Highland adventure. From next year, we’ll offer groups of 20+ exclusive early access with a meet-and-greet host. Winter slots are 9am and 9.30am for up to 60 visitors. From April 2026, slots will be 8am, 8.40am, and 9:20am.

Title: Loch Ard Adventure
Description: Nestled in the heart of Lomond and Trossach's National Park, Loch Ard Adventure Centre offers a great starting point for adventure breaks, holidays, trips, tours and activities that create lifelong memories. Based on the Northern shores of Loch Ard, 4 miles from Aberfoyle and within one hours drive from Glasgow, Edinburgh and Stirling. Visitors can enjoy immersive experiences outdoors and empowered adventures, relaxing and enjoy a hot drink or snack. Loch Ard Adventure welcome families, groups, tours and operators.

Title: Loch Ness by Jacobite
Description: Loch Ness by Jacobite offers tours and cruises on Loch Ness, ranging from 30 minutes to two-hour sailings. Cruise the Caledonian Canal from Dochgarroch to explore Loch Ness and visit Urquhart Castle. Depart from Dochgarroch Lock (4 miles from Inverness), Clansman Harbour (9 miles from Inverness), or Urquhart Castle (groups only). Our Dochgarroch base hosts An Talla, a cafe and retail destination on the Caledonian Canal. Loch Ness by Jacobite helds a VisitScotland five-star accreditation (2024/25), and is open year-round.

Title: Bracken Hide
Description:
The Bracken Hide is a wilderness hotel consisting of 27 en-suite Hides scattered across the hillside with stunning views of Portree. The hotel benefits from a more remote location but is also walking distance from the town of Portree.
On-site there is the hub which consists of a superb restaurant, a Whisky bar and a lounge

Title: Marmalade Hotel
Description:
Set majestically in mature gardens, commanding views over the village of Portree, the loch and the Cuillin Mountains you will find Marmalade, the perfect location to enjoy everything Skye has to offer.
Each room offers bold statement styles with Nespresso coffee machines, Bose sound systems and 300 thread count sheets. The hotel, only a 5-minute walk away from the centre of Portree, sits up high in a quiet area with breath-taking views of the coastlines.

Title: The Bosville
Description:
The Bosville is contained within a trio of 19th-century cottages that have been lovingly restored and converted. Switch off from the daily grind and coorie up in one of our 20 relaxed rooms.
Our refined but cosy accomodation  is situated right in the centre of Portree, opposite the harbour with some of the best views in town. Downstairs we have our lively award-winning Dulse & Brose restaurant and Merchant Bar filled with residents and non-residents alike

Title: GoOrkney Tours
Description:
Established luxury destination management and executive hire company with a proven track record in consistently providing high-class tours, customer experiences and other DM services.
Supported by professional, STGA-accredited and entertaining local tour guides, who will bring Orkney's history alive, working from unbranded executive Mercedes V Class or similar, and/or comfortable 15-seater vehicles. We understand that each client is unique. No matter how detailed your requirements we are ready to go that extra mile. 
Private/Bespoke, FIT and small/medium-sized groups accommodated.

Title: Cairn Hotel Group – Holiday Inn Express, Aberdeen City Centre
Description: A 155 modern bedroomed hotel, only 200 yards from the shops and restaurants and just a 15-minute walk to the bustling centre of Aberdeen. The hotel is proud to provide unique solutions and spaces to leisure and business guests including groups & tours and MICE.

Title: Cairn Hotel Group – The Station Hotel Aberdeen
Description:
The Station Hotel Aberdeen with 115 bedrooms, built in 1890, is a late period Victorian building that fuses traditional décor and furnishings with modern in-room amenities.  Including a bar, lounge and brasserie that uses seasonal and locally sourced produce to create dishes steeped with traditional Scottish flavours.  
Conveniently located, the hotel is close to the main shopping street and within walking distance to some of the city's most popular tourist attractions, such as the botanical gardens, the various museums, and stunning parks.
The hotel is proud to provide unique solutions and spaces to leisure and business guests including groups & tours, FIT, and MICE.

Title: Glencoe House
Description:
The Glencoe House Suites are situated in the mansion house. One or two-bedroom suites are available all boasting lavish bathrooms and a substantial sitting room, which encompasses an array of period features.
A distinguishing feature of the Glencoe House suites is the unique dining experience. Breakfast and a candle lit three-course dinner are served at your private dining room table located in your suite, The Strathcona Lodges  at Glencoe House reside in a characterful building located just 50 metres from the mansion house. The Strathcona lodges contains 6 x one-bedroom suites where the ground floor comprises a comfortable sitting room with a wood-burning stove, a fully equipped kitchen complete with Range Oven and a luxurious bathroom

Title: Maynes Coaches Ltd
Description: We are an award winning, family-run coach company who have successfully operated in the North East of Scotland since 1947. Our dedicated team offers luxury transport for all occasions from bespoke tours to sporting events with experienced drivers working from our depots in Buckie, Elgin and Orkney. No matter your travel requirements our experienced team is available to help craft your itinerary and our 100% Euro6, ‘Green Tourism’ awarded fleet is there to help you discover the best of Scotland.

Title: W Edinburgh
Description: W Edinburgh does more than put you at the centre of Scotland’s historic and culturally rich capital city, it immerses you in the spirit of the festival capital of the world. Unique rooms and suites that are anything but expected.
