Breath-taking dining and specialty bars bring inspired new flavours to the city from our signature restaurant SUSHISAMBA and intimate cocktail bar, Joao’s Place, to our W Lounge and unique rooftop deck with the finest 360-degree views of Edinburgh and beyond.

Title: BWH | Hotels Great Britain
Description: BWH Hotels is a leading global hospitality enterprise comprising three hotel companies including WorldHotels™, Best Western® Hotels & Resorts and Sure Hotels®. Wherever your group's next adventure leads - our independent hotels offer a welcoming blend of comfort, flexibility and attentive service. With a wide choice of locations across GB, you'll find spacious accommodation, dedicated facilities and tailored experiences to suit your group's needs. Let our experienced teams take care of the details, so you can focus on bringing people together.

Title: Trossachs Ebike Tours
Description: Clients can explore dramatic lochside and mountain scenery in the Loch Lomond and Trossachs National Park, letting ebikes take the strain on mainly traffic-free routes! Tours include Loch Katrine Explorer, Sail and Cycle, Goat Ice Cream and Evening options. Basic level of fitness required. Small groups (2–6 people, age 14+) and FIT are accompanied by a friendly local guide and will hear about Clan legends, Victorian history, Outlander locations, folklore and nature. Easy drive from Glasgow (1 ¼ hr) and Edinburgh (1 ¾ hr) with ample paid parking at Trossachs Pier.

Title: Aberdeenshire Sheepdogs
Description: Aberdeenshire Sheepdogs offers a unique opportunity to experience sheepdogs at work. Join us as we share our experiences working Border Collies and stories about life on a sheep farm. You will meet the dogs and have the opportunity to see them at work, gaining first hand experience of what it’s like to work with these intelligent and highly skilled animals.

Title: Coeur Sauvage Ltd
Description: Our foraging courses encompass the most sought after activities - food and outdoor activities.  We predominantly operate in the central belt, offering terrestrial and coastal foraging experiences within 20 to 30 min from Glasgow and Edinburgh. Our courses are safe, suitable for average mobility guests onwards and can host up to 15 guests per event.  Guests can attend our pre-designed and pre-scheduled courses although we offer bespoke foraging opportunities as per guests requirements.

Title: Scotland Folk Tours
Description: We’re a tour operator who specializes in bringing music lovers from all over the world to Scotland to enjoy the traditional folk music scene, led by notable North American musicians - often the two playing together, this sees the blending of musical genres. Our tours include cultural events, activities, walking tours, visits to historical sites, local dining experiences along with the near nightly private concerts. We promote Scotland’s unique sound while supporting local musicians and small businesses. Tours begin and end within 45 minutes of Glasgow or Edinburgh Airport."

Title: INTX – Excellence in Travel
Description:
INTX have over 25 years’ experience in the transportation industry. 
From golf tours and airport transfers to multi-day conferences; we are available to ensure that no matter where your clients need us, they arrive at their desired destination with efficiency and according to their itinerary. 
Our chauffeur hire and coach hire services as well as expert knowledge of transport coordination have helped strengthen our position as one of the Scotlands’ top transport providers.

Title: Graham’s Orkney Tours
Description:
Graham’s Orkney Tours is a new tour guiding service based in Kirkwall, Orkney. As an Orcadian and high school History teacher, I am uniquely placed to share my passion for and knowledge of the history, culture, and heritage of these wonderful islands with clients in my own comfortable 8-seater vehicle. 
We offer a variety of small group tours or private, personal tours tailored to your clients’ wishes and interests.  
Tours often include mystery detours: your clients can enjoy some of my favourite haunts often off the beaten track.

Title: Ayre Hotel
Description: With over 60 rooms, The Ayre Hotel is one of the largest in Orkney, located in the capital Kirkwall. Your guests can relax with a pre-dinner drink in the newly refurbished lounge bar or dine in the Orcadian Restaurant & Bar, serving local produce where possible. Group & FIT rates available. Parking. Ideally situated for ferry & bus links. Visitor Information Centre just a short walk from the hotel.

Title: Italian Chapel
Description: The Italian Chapel is a highly ornate Catholic chapel on Lamb Holm in the Orkney Islands. It was built during World War II by Italian prisoners of war, who were housed on the previously uninhabited island while they constructed the Churchill Barriers to the east of Scapa Flow. Small Groups and FIT welcome, parking, open all year.

Title: Barrier View Cafe@Celina Rupp Jewellery
Description:
More than just an Orkney café. Aside from our amazing home-made meals and freshly-baked sweet treats, we have an extra special something up our sleeve. Barrier View Café features stunning solid silver jewellery incorporating semi-precious gemstones, all hand-crafted by Orkney jeweller, Celina Rupp.
Your guests can sit and relax with a coffee & scone, overlooking the Churchill Barriers, down towards The Italian Chapel. Plus browse the retail area with jewellery and crafts which make ideal gifts! Parking, groups welcome, open all year.

Title: Edinburgh Food Tour
Description:
For a decade, we have offered public, private and luxury tailored food and drinks experiences. Aside from public tours which you can send your guests to, we do private and bespoke experiences for groups as small as 2. 
We introduce guests to traditional but contemporary Scottish food and drink (whisky, gin, beer etc) focusing on provenance and passion for the food. We couple this with an informative but light introduction to Edinburgh’s history and how that influenced our culinary landscape.

Title: Lost Loch Spirits
Supplier Types: Accessible|Carrier|Cruising/Shore Excursions|Food and Drink|Private Tours|Responsible|Visitor Attraction
Description: We are a small craft distillery in rural Aberdeenshire making gin, rum, whisky liqueurs and Scotland’s first absinthe. We use all natural botanicals in our spirits, sourcing locally where possible. We offer tours and tastings of the distillery as well as Spirits Schools where visitors can distil their own gin or rum, using traditional copper stills. Large car park with coach parking, café/restaurant next door. Tours suitable for 2 – 50 people, Spirits Schools 2 – 15 people, can be private.

Title: Perth Museum
Description:
Perth Museum is a new £26.5 million refurbishment of a beautiful historic building in Perth City, featuring a purpose-built interior designed to house the Stone of Destiny, the most powerful surviving symbol of Scotland’s royal history.  
Opening spring 2024, the museum offers visitors a 5*, accessible experience inspiring them to explore Scotland’s past through its display of exceptional objects ranging from fine and decorative art to items representing natural & social history, and world cultures. 
Perth Museum will feature a programme of unique experiences for DMCs, groups and FITs, including private guided tours of the museum and the Stone out with normal opening hours.

Title: Summerhall Distillery
Supplier Types: Events|Food and Drink|Private Tours|Visitor Attraction|Walking Tours
Description:
Housed within the historic walls of the old Vet college of the University, Dick's Vet, our distillery provides a unique and immersive setting for gin and whisky enthusiasts to experience our offerings. Our gin and whisky experiences are designed to delight visitors, whether they are locals or from far away. 
Our offerings go beyond just tastings. We believe in the power of storytelling and history, and we incorporate these elements into our experiences. Our knowledgeable guides will take the visitors through the fascinating history of gin and whisky in Edinburgh and Scotland through the ages.

Title: The Resident Edinburgh
Description:
The Resident Edinburgh, located in the city’s thriving New Town and West End district, a neighbourhood known for its Georgian architecture. With 164 elegant rooms ranging from sleek Standard Rooms to expansive Junior Suites, featuring panoramic views across the city’s characterful skyline and even a glimpse of Edinburgh Castle.
Guests can relax in a series of stylish shared spaces including a lounge and reading room to enjoy a drink, catch up on work or meet up with people.

Title: Bothies & Bannocks
Description: Bothies & Bannocks provides bespoke, guided tours, cookery classes and outdoor experiences in Aberdeenshire, Moray and Cairngorms national park. Abedreen Airport – 45 minutes, Edinburgh Airport – 2.5hrs. We also provide a range of transport services including a specialist adventure sports transport service, carrying your clients and kit to and from their adventures. Let us share our passion for Scotland’s finest food, landscape and culture with your clients. We cater for FIT’s and small groups from 1 -16 people.

Title: Paparwark Croft & Coastal Tour
Description: 2-hour experience, meet the animals, Paparwark studio tour, scenic walk and refreshments. Guests will start at the farmhouse for a scenic coastal walk with views of St Ninian’s Isle, with crofter and crafter Cecil. Encounter Shetland sheep in ancient colours, hand-feed friendly animals, and explore a beautiful cove. Afterward, tour the Paparwark Furniture workshop and Showroom featuring bespoke furniture, wood gifts, and knitting accessories. Buy fleeces and yarn spun from our sheep. Enjoy tea, coffee and home bakes upon return to the farmhouse. Unique free handmade gift to take home. Small Groups; min 10pax, max 15pax. Parking.

Title: Aura Journeys Scotland (Glasgow)
Description: Aura Journeys are an established provider of Chauffeured Private Day Tours and Luxury Transfers in Scotland. Journeys are completed using Luxury Mini Vans with an experienced Scottish local in traditional Tweed Suit and Cap, with complimentary Wi-Fi and Water. Services available from Glasgow and Edinburgh, journeys are private with door to door service tailored to your request. We work with you to create an outstanding experience for travellers building your and our reputation for high end bespoke travel in Scotland.

Title: Fonab Castle Hotel
Description: Nestled in the heart of Highland Perthshire, Fonab Castle Hotel & Spa is a truly unique five star hotel. Lovingly restored, it draws inspiration from its historic past and breath-taking surroundings whilst adding the odd contemporary twist. Enjoy a drink on the terrace before a 3 AA Rosette awarded meal or simply sit back and enjoy the tranquility of the stunning landscape.

Title: Dunkeld House Hotel
Description: This four-star luxury country house hotel and spa sits on 280 acres of well-maintained and natural woodland and overlooks the wide and fast-flowing River Tay, renowned for its famous salmon fishing. Escape the hustle and bustle of city life and enjoy nature, tranquillity and Scottish scenery at its very best.  From a romantic weekend getaway to short breaks full of fantastic outdoor activities, the hotel holiday resort can be as relaxing or as action-packed as you wish it to be.

Title: Galloway and Southern Ayrshire UNESCO Biosphere
Description: The Galloway & Southern Ayrshire UNESCO Biosphere is recognised worldwide as a world class destination for meaningful travel. Biosphere Experiences are led by members of the organisation’s officer team who share their expertise with guests on small group tours, exploring Scotland’s ancient temperate rainforest and watching the incredible annual wildfowl migrations from the Biosphere’s beautiful nature reserves. Bespoke tours are also available with walks and talks that cater to special interest groups and which incorporate local heritage, culture and food and drink.

Title: LERWICK BREWERY
Supplier Types: Activity|Food and Drink|Private Tours|Tour Operator|Visitor Attraction
Description:
Give your guests a deep-dive into Lerwick Brewery and how Shetland craft beer is made. Our friendly, experienced guides will lead you from raw ingredient to finished product. Our tour ends where it should, with a beer tasting in our cosy taproom.
Bespoke, premium package tours for larger groups with local entertainment and Shetland themed nibbles.
Gift shop with a selection of our craft beers, merch and other Shetland products. Other facilities: toilets, disabled toilet, free Wi-Fi, parking.

Title: The Silly Sheep Fibre Company
Description:
Croft tour by Becky Pritchard   crofter & owner of wool business.   
2 hour croft experience;  meet Shetlands beautiful native sheep, feed them & the hens & if visiting in May - June your  guests may even get to hold or feed a new lamb.
Whilst guests enjoy tea, coffee & home baked cakes, they will hear about crofting life, the triumphs & challenges & how the Silly Sheep came to be. 
There will also be the chance to visit the onsite shop for The Silly Sheeps own hand dyed yarn, sheepskin rugs & tweed & local crafts.

Title: Anderson Scottish Tours
Description: Anderson Scottish Tours specialise in luxury, bespoke tours and shore excursions around Scotland. Travel with ease and comfort, guided by an experienced and knowledgeable driver who will show you the very best of what Scotland has to offer.

Title: Wild Skies Shetland
Description:
3-hour exclusive Wild Skies experience in Unst, UK’s most northerly island. Visits to: Viking Longship and Longhouse, viewing the short film ‘An Asteroid Called Unst’;  Sky Trail stops, including Saxa Vord (seeing Muckle Flugga lighthouse) and Hermaness; Unst Heritage Centre, showcasing crofting, traditional crafts, geology and history.
Tea/coffee and cake provided.
Personal guide from Unst - guests will gain valuable insights about island life. 
£90pp – trade price
Min 8pax – Max 10
Half day version available, with light lunch.  £115.

Title: Do It Outdoors
Description: Do It Outdoors is a small woodland outdoor activity provider delivering high quality and custom and themed events .  We deliver Woodland Olympics, The Woodland Warrior. Survivalist days, Outlander days along with archery, axe throwing.  We take on one customer group  per time slot to make it personal.

Title: Handmade Fish Company – Tastings in the Smoke House
Description:
New Tasting session at the Smoke House, Shetland. Daytime and Early Evening tasting sessions in the heated classroom. Available year round. Min. 2 persons/6 persons max. Wheelchair accessible. Parking.
1 & ½ hour session exploring Davids unique method of smoking salmon. Learn about the salmon farming in Shetland, how he prepares the fillets for smoking and produces his own sawdust for the smokers.
During the presentation he’ll touch on the science of taste, smell and flavour. Your guests will sample the salmon and discuss the various flavours and textures.

Title: Cruise Loch Linnhe
Description: Offer your clients an unforgettable cruise from Fort William, showcasing stunning views of Ben Nevis, the Caledonian Canal, the Corpach Shipwreck and Seal Island. Our group-friendly cruises feature live commentary, wildlife spotting and onboard refreshments for an engaging experience. We welcome group bookings, tour operators, FIT bookings and private charters, tailored to your needs.  Operating year-round, we offer something for everyone.

Title: Happy Tours Scotland
Description: Based in Inverness our kilted, friendly, experienced and fully-trained Happy Tours guides are passionate about the Scottish Highlands and promoting it's history and folklore! We use 8-seater luxury minibuses or executive Land Rovers.  All tours leave from Inverness and visit destinations like Isle of Skye, Loch Ness and Culloden Battlefield, Dunrobin Castle and the Glenmorangie Distillery, Glenfinnan and The Great Glen, Cairngorm Mountains, Loch Ness 360 and Speyside Whisky Tours. Personalised tours are our speciality for your clients.

Title: Murrayshall Country Estate
Description:
Located in the evergreen heart of Perthshire, set in 365 acres of beautiful countryside in Scone, yet only three miles from Perth city centre, Murrayshall dates back over 400 years. The former home of Lord Lynedoch is not only a stately house, but a landmark on the Scottish landscape. With 40 sophisticated rooms and suites, you’ll find a luxury boutique hotel that’s full of natural tranquillity. 

Centrally located 50 minutes from Edinburgh Airport and only 45 minutes from St Andrews.

Title: Meet Orkney
Description: NEW FOR 2024 - ‘Meet the Locals’ experience, exclusive for the travel trade. An intimate and authentic experience that brings your guests together with locals in an informal setting to hear first-hand the islands’ vernacular history and heritage. Expect amusing anecdotes, great tales, lots of laughs, Orkney food and drink - a real close-up of island life now and in days gone by. Venue is Skaill House, Orkney’s finest 17th Century mansion. Early evening and weekend tours. 1 and ½ hrs. Small Groups, min 10 – max 15, parking

Title: Scottish Tea House
Description: Discover the essence of Scottish tea culture with our immersive tour. Wander through our tranquil tea garden, where Camellia Sinensis bushes flourish, and learn about tea cultivation from our knowledgeable guide. Indulge in a homemade afternoon tea featuring locally sourced delights, perfectly paired with our exquisite teas. Then, embark on a sensory tea tasting journey, exploring delicate white tea to robust black tea.  Immerse yourself in the beauty, flavour, and tradition of Scottish tea. Book your tour today for a memorable culinary experience.

Title: King Street Aparthotel
Description:
King Street Aparthotel is situated in the heart of Stirling's city centre. 
Our charming B-Listed building offers a boutique self service hotel; 15 guest suites with modern amenities. The facility is equipped with high tech access control for car park, building and room access. Each room offers comfort heating and air conditioning as well as high speed internet and smart TVs. Tea/Coffee making facilities are available in all rooms.
All guests have access to our fitness room and changing facilities, as well as use of our car park, high speed EV charging and cycle storage.
Vending machines for snacks as well as high quality bean to cup coffee are available in our communal areas.

Title: Landscape Lore
Description: Bespoke history and folklore walks and storytelling sessions around the western Cairngorms. Tailored journeys uniquely blend history and storytelling with the environment. From clans and Jacobites to haunted glens, our clients delve into the heart of the Highlands to explore landscapes rich in untold narratives. Regional and specialty themes offer a timeless connection to Scotland's past and future and allow visitors to connect with the Highlands in a meaningful way. Perfect for groups up to 12 people,  seeking off-the-beaten-track experiences.

Title: Affinity Sterling Mills
Description: Affinity Sterling Mills Outlet Shopping Centre is a totally unique shopping destination. Located at the foot of the stunning Ochil Hills, not far from Stirling, and an easy car or bus ride from most of Central Scotland. You will find big brand names with up to 60% off RRP. With accessible access, free parking, free coach parking and meet and greet service, free Wifi and outdoor play area for children. Shopping at Affinity Mills Sterling is a breath of fresh air.

Title: University of St Andrews
Description:
During the summer months, the University becomes one of the biggest suppliers of bedrooms within the St Andrews area.  With over 1200 en suite rooms as well as standard accommodation, you can choose from a selection of residences within town to suit your requirements.  All accommodation is graded as 3 star campus rooms.
Our customers include groups, sports groups, summer schools, academics attending conferences as well as FIT, golf and leisure guests.  With a range of catering options you can also tailor your stay to suit your own personal requirements.  Free parking suitable for coaches is available at two of our main residences. As well as accommodation the university boasts a range of venues for conferences and meeting purposes, as well as gala dinners, weddings and social events.

Title: Sumburgh Head Lighthouse, Visitor Centre And Nature Reserve
Description: Sumburgh Head is a world class visitor attraction, located at the southern tip of Shetland Mainland, within 2 miles of the main airport. Here, your clients can discover the story of Shetland’s oldest Stevenson Lighthouse and its Keepers. Our Marine Life Centre offers a fantastic introduction to Shetland’s incredible wildlife, including Puffins and Guillemots, which nest on cliffs beneath the Lighthouse during the summer months. The centre can offer bespoke visitor experiences, from self-guided visits with welcome talks, to guided tours of the Engine Room, Smiddy, Marine Centre, WWII Radar Hut, and Nature Reserve. Open from April to October. Can open at other times for booked groups. Facilities include coach and disabled parking, gift shop and accessible toilets.

Title: Suie Hunting Lodge
Description: Suie Hunting Lodge is the former shooting lodge of the Suie Estate, built in 1780. This is now a small boutique style hotel with a passion for eclectic design, it has an eye for the traditional with a contemporary, design focused edge. The lodge mixes vintage pieces with industrial for their signature look. It is focused on great food, with a small menu of the highest quality and is expanding all the time.

Title: Stewart Tours
Description:
Founded in April 2023, Stewart Tours is a family run Coach Tour Operator based in the Edinburgh & Lothians offering one day coach tours, day trips, private tours and coach hire.
Customer service is at the very heart of the business and we are committed to providing our guests with a cost-effective service of the highest quality.
We invested heavily in new vehicles for the 2024 season. All driven by one of our knowledgeable and friendly driver guides.

Title: Burrell Collection
Description:
The world-renowned Burrell Collection in Glasgow opened its doors to the public in 1983. Located in
the lush green landscape of Pollok Country Park, this unique collection of art and antiques contains
thousands of objects collected over a lifetime by Sir William Burrell. This collection,  includes medieval and Renaissance art, Chinese ceramics, and ancient artefacts. 
The Burrell Collection reopened in 2022 following a major refurbishment and in July 2023 won
Art Fund Museum of the Year.

Title: Kelvingrove Art Gallery & Museum
Description: Kelvingrove Art Gallery and Museum, an iconic landmark in Glasgow's west end since 1901, offers a captivating experience with 22 galleries showcasing diverse treasures. From classic European art to contemporary Scottish works, Egyptian mummies, armour, Asian and African artefacts, to natural history specimens, the museum is a cultural gem. Marvel at this rich collection in the stunning setting of one of Glasgow's beloved buildings, creating an unforgettable experience for both locals and visitors alike.

Title: Riverside Museum
Description: The award-winning Riverside Museum, on the banks of Glasgow's River Clyde, showcases transport history in a modern structure by Dame Zaha Hadid. With a 3,000-strong collection, it highlights Glasgow's global contributions to heavy industries. Interactive exhibits, a Victorian street, and diverse artifacts, from trains and trams to vintage cars and model ships, offer a captivating journey through time. This purpose-built museum is a tribute to Glasgow's pivotal role in shipbuilding, train manufacturing, and engineering, creating an immersive experience for visitors.

Title: The University of Edinburgh Conferences & Events
Description:
The University of Edinburgh boasts outstanding conference and event services via its Hospitality & Events Collection. From purpose built conference facilities for 300pax to venues steeped in history -ideal for AGMs, exclusive dinners and receptions - we have the space, the team, and the technical ability to meet a broad range of event requirements.
Our full portfolio comprises 12 venues across Edinburgh with 70+ meeting rooms, as well as award-winning catering service, event management, and a variety of accommodation options.

Title: The Scholar Hotel
Description:
The Scholar is a 4-star hotel beside Holyrood Park, a short walk from Edinburgh’s Old Town. Its bright, modern spaces offer friendly service for both business and leisure stays.
The hotel features 72 well-appointed bedrooms with large TVs, espresso machines, tea facilities, spacious desks, and en-suite rainfall showers with Laura Thomas Co. toiletries. Complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi is included throughout.
Dining is centred on Abacus Restaurant & Bar, blending Scottish and Mediterranean cuisine for relaxed breakfasts, lunches, or evenings. The Living Room hosts meetings and private events for up to 30 guests, with flexible layouts, catering, and AV support available.

Title: KM Hotel
Description: Located a short walk away from Edinburgh’s Old Town and Waverley railway station, KM Hotel is the perfect base to explore the city from. Featuring 44 compact double bedrooms with contemporary design and modern en-suite bathrooms, the hotel offers your clients all the amenities they need during their stay. All guests get access to The University of Edinburgh’s facilities at Pleasance Sports Complex & Gym, located only a 5 minute walk away. 24-hour secure parking is available at NCP nearby.

Title: KM Apartments
Description:
KM Apartments offers modern serviced open-plan studios in Edinburgh’s vibrant Southside, a short walk from the Royal Mile, Old Town, and Waverley Station. The property blends self-catering flexibility with comfort—ideal for business or leisure stays, short or long.
Studios range from compact to spacious layouts, each with a fully equipped kitchen, dining area, and en-suite shower with complimentary Sense of Arran toiletries. In-room amenities include free Wi-Fi, a workspace, safety deposit box, hairdryer, iron, and tea/coffee.
Services include 24-hour reception, on-site laundry, and Circa Breakfast Restaurant. Guests also enjoy free access to the University of Edinburgh’s Pleasance Gym.

Title: The Scott Hotel
Description:
The Scott is a boutique four-star hotel beneath Arthur’s Seat in a restored 1750s baronial mansion. It blends historic charm with modern luxury, featuring original fireplaces, oak paneling, and a Thomas Bonnar fresco, framed by tranquil gardens.
Each of the 37 individually designed bedrooms includes a king bed, premium linens, and a marble en-suite with a rainfall shower. Guests enjoy a pillow menu, espresso machines, robes, and Wi-Fi.
Bonnar’s Restaurant, beneath the fresco, celebrates Scottish produce. The Gallery Bar is the perfect spot for unwinding. Close to Edinburgh’s Old Town, The Scott combines heritage, comfort, and personalised service.

Title: Jack ‘O’Bryan’s Bar & Restaurant
Description: Enjoy lunch in Dunfermline, the ancient capital of Scotland, with the best of Scotland’s larder, including the finest locally sourced meat and seafood. Relax in an intimate restaurant, set in Dunfermline’s Heritage Quarter, with the experience enhanced by the curated menu of father and son head chefs, Jack & Bryan, bringing each flavour plate of art to life! With pastry chef, Jack and storyteller father, Bryan ready to share 40 years of food stories, this is a lunch that will be involve sharing the family’s lifetime in hospitality.

Title: Argyll Cruising
Description: Argyll Cruising offers ten unique Scottish Cruises, visiting the inlets and islands of Argyll, Arran and the Hebrides, including Mull, Islay, Jura and Skye and the Small Isles. The spectacular cruises run from three to thirteen nights, amongst the beautiful islands and stunning sea lochs of Argyll. With a maximum of 8 guests on board, these are highly personalised cruising experiences within an idyllic maritime setting.

Title: Cromlix
Description: Cromlix is the five-star country house hotel owned by tennis player Andy Murray and his wife Kim. Situated in the Scottish central belt, close to Edinburgh and Glasgow, Cromlix sits in 34 acres of private woodland and gardens. The hotel was totally refurbished in 2023, injecting style, colour and warmth into the bedrooms, bathrooms and common areas of the hotel as well as the bar and restaurant, the Glasshouse. The hotel also has a tennis court, private loch and chapel.

Title: Sarah Kay Arts – Studio & Garden Tour
Description: New and exclusive for the travel trade: 1 hour experience. Starting inside the art studio, guests can browse a large selection of artwork, jewellery, small gifts and underwater photography, all made by Sarah. Followed by a garden tour, finishing up with refreshments in the new Polycrub, with stunning views over Scalloway.  Available during summer months on Monday / Wednesday / Fridays, 10-4pm 1st May-15th October. Available for bookable private tours/group visits - Tuesday, Thursday, Saturdays. For groups of 4 - 6 people.

Title: The Gordon Arms - Restaurant with Rooms
Description: The Gordon Arms Restaurant with Rooms, is nestled in the serene Yarrow Valley, between Selkirk and Moffat, approx. 31 miles from Edinburgh and 57 from Glasgow Airports.  This 'food destination' is a multi-award-winning sustainable establishment run by chef-owner, Bryn and Oxana Jones.  Your clients can immerse themselves in our rich history and enjoy award-winning dining, incorporating produce from our organic kitchen garden and many local suppliers. We have five rooms for a max of 10 people and restaurant /private dining for up to 24.  Open all year around: Thursday – Sunday (except Sunday eve).
Address Line 1: The Gordon Arms Restaurant with Rooms

Title: Yarrow Cookery School
Description: We believe in the power of food to connect people, nourish communities, and create lasting memories. Our travel experiences celebrate Scottish produce and can be easily tailored to meet unique wishes. Each session provides the joy of hands-on cooking, where guests craft every dish from scratch. Located 12 miles from Edinburgh and a two-minute walk to the train station, the Yarrow Cookery School offers easy access. The school has parking with E.V charging stations.

Title: Solsgirth Home Farm Ltd
Description: Solsgirth Home is located near Dollar, with easy access to Stirling, Edinburgh, Glasgow and Perth. We plan to share our sustainable farming journey and are delighted to welcome your clients to hear our story. We offer farm tours, seasonal events (lambing experience), craft workshops as well as catering and accommodation depending on numbers. With great accessibility, toilet facilities and parking for coaches, we cater for small groups, FITS and coaches up to 30 people.

Title: Westerton
Description: At Westerton, we welcome groups of any size to our farm – with parking for over 100 cars and room for coaches.  Visitors can visit our animals, enjoy a drink, snack or lunch in our farm shop and learn all about life at Westerton.  We have two bespoke walking tours available – one based around Scotland's larder and our local foods. The other is based around whisky and sees us work with Fettercairn Distillery.  These are private and exclusive to your travellers.

Title: Seabirds-and-Seals - The Original Noss Boat Tours
Description: From April through to October, we provide daily wildlife tours around Bressay & Noss National Nature Reserve.  We can get your guests up close & personal to the awe-inspiring sights and sounds of this extraordinary seabird metropolis, one of Britain’s most sensational reserves.  A fun varied informative excursion with enthusiasts passionate about our local wildlife, heritage, geology, history and much more…our Supreme tours tick all the boxes.

Title: The Inn at Charlestown
Description: The Inn has been transformed into a beautiful country hotel situated in the tranquil and picturesque village of Charlestown. Stay in one of our newly refurbished rooms, many of which have stunning views over the Firth of Forth, The Pentland Hills and the World famous Forth Bridges. Explore the lovely villages of Charlestown and Limekilns or travel to Edinburgh and Stirling, making it an ideal base to explore Scotland.

Title: The Hickory Golf Workshop
Description: The Hickory Golf Workshop offers visitors a journey back in time to the roots of golf. Participants immerse themselves in the vintage charm of hickory-shafted clubs, learning about their history and craftsmanship. Under expert guidance, learn how to grip, whip and play with these classic clubs, experiencing the unique feel and challenges they present on the course. Through hands-on activities and discussions, attendees gain a deeper appreciation for the heritage and traditions of golf in a nostalgic setting.

Title: Scottish Odyssey
Description: Scottish Odyssey offers unforgettable day trips across Scotland, blending adventure, culture, and natural beauty into immersive experiences. Our tours cater to groups of up to 8 people, whether for private or group bookings. From hiking misty glens, to kayaking on tranquil lochs and exploring historic castles, our expert guides ensure each journey is personalized and memorable. Partner with us to provide your clients with bespoke Scottish adventures they'll never forget.

Title: Orca Ventures
Description: Boat Tours in Orkney by Orca Ventures - your guests will be welcomed on board Boy Ryan on our wildlife cruises; 3&1/2 hrs, one in morning, one in afternoon, departs from St Margaret's Hope pier. Why not upgrade & stay overnight (B&B) with a full day cruise. Boat can also be hired for fishing trips and events. Hot tub & BBQ on board! A trip your quests will NEVER forget.

Title: Cairngorm Mountain (Scotland) Ltd
Description:
Discover Scotland’s favourite mountain destination, just 10 miles from Aviemore. Cairngorm Mountain Resort offers spectacular Highland views, unique experiences, and activities for all ages.
Take a trip on Scotland’s only Mountain Railway to the UK’s highest restaurant, featuring an extensive outdoor terrace with breath-taking panoramic views.
Enjoy a range of outdoor adventures, including Mountain Carting, Mountain Biking Trails, Tubing Slides and an Adventure Play Park, alongside excellent visitor facilities. From independent travellers and small groups to large coach parties, Cairngorm Mountain Resort offers a memorable Highland experience for everyone.

Title: Brewhemia
Description: Our story is one steeped in adventure, a love of great food, drinks and a passion for theatrics. A haven for those with a thirst for discovery, tank fresh beer, artisan coffee, fresh Scottish scran, cocktails and super fine wine. With seven bars across five rooms and two floors there is an abundance of bookable options to discover. We offer seven days live entertainment so indulge your senses and share in the wonder of Brewhemia.

Title: Crail Museum & Heritage Centre
Description:
Explore Crail's rich history spanning from the Bronze Age to the present day, including the granting of the first Royal Charter in 1311 by Robert the Bruce. 
Discover the captivating history of Crail's Airfield Room, which served as a significant training hub during WWI and WWII, notably as HMS Jackdaw, the primary air torpedo training school. Learn about its transition from a naval training base to hosting the Black Watch battalion and later the University Air Squadron and Joint Services School of Linguistics.
If you enjoy a visit to Crail, why not spend your time taking a walk round the town with one of our knowledgeable Museum Guides? Did you know that there has been a settlement here since early times see the standing stone in Victoria Gardens and the cross slab in the Church.

Title: Shawfern Group Limited
Description: This is a small family run and operated group of boutique hotels in Speyside (The Dowans Hotel in Aberlour and Hotel 1881 Archiestown). They are fully renovated and cater to a luxury market including local, national and international markets.

Title: The Dram Queen
Description:
The Dram Queen, Ann Miller, a Master of the Quaich, offers inspiring, entertaining whisky tasting experiences which complement and add value to distillery visits. Based in the heart of Moray Speyside and well-connected to major transport hubs, her whisky experiences are ideal for FITs and private groups seeking memorable insights and industry expertise.
Her DRAM ROOM TASTINGS offer a range of exclusive independent whisky experiences in her Dram Room. They can be tailored to the interests of clients and are perfect for novices and enthusiasts.
She also offers BESPOKE PRIVATE WHISKY EXPERIENCES, creating memorable tasting events which are perfect for celebrations, reunions, conferences, or incentives wherever convenient throughout Scotland.

Title: Bowhouse
Description:
Bowhouse is a food & drink hub and rural event venue in the East Neuk of Fife. We are located 20-minutes from St Andrews and 1 hour from Edinburgh. 
Your clients can enjoy bespoke estate tours of the organic farmland of Balcaskie, that Bowhouse resides within. A tractor-trailer tour which accommodates up-to 40 people, allows guests to immerse in the beautiful landscape, wildlife and natural environment. They can then return to Bowhouse for a seasonal, BBQ meal (lunch or dinner.) Booking is subject to availability. T&Cs apply.

Title: Papple Steading Ltd
Description:
Papple Steading is a beautiful and sympathetically restored historic farm steading, nestled in the heart of East Lothian's countryside. It offers a unique and luxurious environmentally sensitive exclusive retreat powered sustainably by renewable energy.
The property includes the Farmhouse, Grieves' Cottage and to Bothies, totalling 10 elegantly styled bedrooms with meticulous attention to detail. Ideal for large groups seeking a private venue for business or pleasure. 
Guests have access to extensive woodlands, meadows and gardens, ensuring an unforgettable and serene experience.

Title: Aye Tours Scotland
Description:
Founded by John McGillivray Coleman, a well-respected Tour Guide in Inverness.  A local Highlander whose passion lies on anything Highland from clans, kilts, tartans, history, folk-lore  to hidden gems that only a handful of locals are aware of.   
We offer Private Day-Tours from Inverness within the Highlands from a minimum of 2 Guests to a maximum of 7. We aim to give our Guests as much time as they want to fully immerse themselves to appreciate their Highland experience.

Title: Davochfin Farm
Description:
Visitors can experience the outdoors in the beautiful setting of Davochfin Farm, Dornoch. Located 1hr from Inverness and 1 mile from Dornoch town centre.
Davochfin farm is a 150 acre working farm and can host FITs and groups of up to 10 with guided rainbow trout fishing in one of our 4 fishing lochans. Groups of up to 20 can meet the animals on the farm up close and learn about livestock farming from the farmers themselves.
In addition, we also have a 9 hole pitch & putt golf course, as well as a driving range.
Activities are family friendly, and all abilities are welcome.

Title: The Marcliffe Hotel and Spa
Description: Set in eight acres of picturesque grounds, The Marcliffe Hotel and Spa, is a luxurious, relaxing and welcoming family-owned five-star Scottish country hotel. At the gateway of the scenic Royal Deeside route in the North East of Scotland, the hotel offers generous private car parking. With 40 guest bedrooms and suites, 6 event spaces hosting from 2-500, spa and gym, and a lounge bar and restaurant offering the best of home-made Scottish cuisine, you'll feel at home with every visit.

Title: E-Tour Orkney
Description:
E-Tour Orkney offers unique GUIDED ELECTRIC BICYCLE TOURS empowering customers to unplug, explore and experience. Transport to and from the tour destination. Use of high-quality Ampere Electric assisted pedal bikes. Locally sourced packed lunches. 6 hour guided tour conducted by local resident Daniel.
E-tour Orkney adheres to the growing demand for sustainable tourism through its use of electric bikes. By reducing their carbon footprint but also promoting eco-friendly methods of travel to all clients. By utilising green energy, they aim to be a part of Orkney’s inspiring renewable culture.

Title: Salmon Fishing Holidays Scotland
Description: Salmon Fishing Holidays Scotland specializes in crafting bespoke Scottish salmon fishing experiences tailored to your preferences, drawing on over thirty-five years of expertise. Whether it's a single day's guided fishing or a week-long touring excursion, we cater to all needs. Corporate outings are also available. Partnering with exclusive rivers across Scotland, from intimate Highland streams to renowned ones like the Dee, Spey, and Tay, we offer diverse fishing opportunities. All our beats are private, ensuring utmost relaxation and solitude for our clients.

Title: Hike & Bike Hub, Galashiels
Description: A 3-4hr guided e-bike tour – maximum of 4 adults. (Wednesdays only). The 20-mile tour starts in Galashiels, taking in iconic views around Melrose, Trimontium, Leaderfoot Bridge Scott’s View, the Wallace Statue and Dryburgh. Your clients will enjoy a relaxed, informative tour with the option to spend time at the locations en-route. Galashiels is 1-hour from Edinburgh, easily accessible by road and rail. Hike & Bike Hub is within short walking distance of Galashiels Transport Interchange and public car parking.

Title: Scottish Food Studio
Description: Embrace Scotland’s unique food culture with award-winning Scottish Food Guide's Wendy Barrie for a Taste Adventure by the shore. Charming venue on Fife’s Coastal Path, panoramic views of Edinburgh skyline. Wendy runs sustainable food experiences in her seaside studio, cooking off grid on a log stove. Slow Food cook & food writer, Wendy personally guides you on an exclusive gastronomic experience, creating wonderful forever food memories. Her enthusiasm & knowledge offer a delicious, entertaining experience with meticulously sourced ingredients.

Title: Ricky’s Bicycle Tours
Description: Ricky’s Bicycle Tours offer guided bike tours of Edinburgh and the Highlands. We operate daily scheduled tours for FITs, but we also arrange private tours and customized itineraries for groups and FITs. The bike tours suit all ages and abilities, and we offer a choice of standard or electric bikes. Why should you book a guided bike tour? An environmentally friendly way to explore Scotland. Highly trained and insured guides, who will share their stories and passion for Scotland. Guaranteed departures (no minimum number required) - Departure point address in front of the Waldorf Astoria

Title: Aberdeen Countryside Rangers Service
Description: Explore the outdoors like a local! The Aberdeen Countryside Rangers offer three unique excursions available to FIT and groups, including a Seabird Safari Tour, Woodland Walk and Minibeast Hunt, and Bat and Moth Evening. The rangers will share their expert knowledge on an array of wildlife native to Aberdeen and the North East of Scotland. Discover seabirds, wildflowers, trees and minibeasts all a stone’s throw from the streets of the Granite City, in spots known and loved by local people.
Address Line 1: Aberdeen City Council Countryside Ranger Service

Title: Pocket House Studio
Description: Starting in  2025 - Come and visit our ethical rug weaving studio and croft, try your hand at spinning, weaving and plant dyeing. Meet the rare and rescue sheep (including the three St Kilda breeds) that live here in a no-kill flock. We have a traditional Island croft where we grow our own foods as well as lots of natural dye plants. Our rugs are exported all over the world and are inspired by the beauty of the Hebrides. Come and sit at a traditional  wooden loom and feel the threads that link us with the weavers that worked in our old weaving shed for generations. Share a Highland tea with us and let us share our island life.

Title: Loch Ness Inn
Description: Discover The Loch Ness Inn, a cosy and stylish retreat in Drumnadrochit near Loch Ness. With 11 comfortable bedrooms, a fantastic restaurant, and a modern bunkhouse for groups, we cater to FITs and groups. Ample free parking, EV charging, and a welcoming Brewery Bar complete the experience. Open year-round, we offer favourable rates for travel trade partners.

Title: Orrin Restaurant and Bar
Description:
Orrin is a relaxed fine dining restaurant serving beautifully crafted dishes made with the highest quality local produce. Our team’s warmth and charm have made customers feel at home since 2019, offering unparalleled service and genuine, heartfelt hospitality.
Orrin is 50km (31 miles) from Inverness Airport, around 45 minutes by car. Less than 1km (just over half a mile) from Elgin Train Station – a short, comfortable walk.
Our Private Dining menus offer traditional Scottish dishes with a contemporary edge. We have curated three set menus, all offering quality, exceptional flavour and outstanding value. Our team would be delighted to discuss bespoke menu options on request.

Title: Archaeology Tours and Experiences in the Scottish Borders
Description: HARP provide bespoke tours and experiences for small groups in the Scottish Borders. We offer unique activities for guests to experience archaeology for themselves and ‘have a go’ at recording monuments and handling real archaeological objects. Our 'off the shelf' activities can be bundled together to create itineraries ranging from 1 to 5 days, or we can design an itinerary to allow your guests to experience heritage sites in a way that isn't possible on regular history and archaeology tours.

Title: Prestonfield
Description:
Opulence, theatre and luxury combined in this unique 5-star hotel in one of Edinburgh's finest historic buildings.  Just five minutes from Edinburgh's Old Town and Waverley Station and 30 minutes from Edinburgh Airport , James Thomson's Prestonfield is Edinburgh's most exclusive luxury hotel,  a country estate right in the heart of Edinburgh. 
Our 23 luxury bedrooms and suites are furnished in our trademark opulent and individual style with expansive views over Prestonfield’s 20 acres of gardens and parkland.

Title: Progression Bikes
Description: Progression Bikes offer bespoke packages and cycling experiences across Perthshire. No other company is more integrated with the landscape, environment and adventure. Guided, and self-guided trips with picnics, catered lunches, whisky and cheese tasting are all available. They can co-ordinate with local activity outfits as part of a day, or week of adventure for your clients
Address Line 2: The Industrial Shed, St Ninians Wynd

Title: Crossbasket Castle
Description: Nestled in the very heart of Scotland, within the estate’s acres of natural beauty sits Crossbasket Castle - a stunning 17th century castle and one of the most Iconic 5 star venues in Scotland. Flexible accommodation choices are offered in the form of 64 beautifully appointed bedrooms across the estate, 6 event spaces hosting from 2-250 and dining perfection in restaurants overseen by Michel Chef Michel Roux Jnr. With generous private car and coach parking, Crossbasket Castle is pure escapism.

Title: Old Town Chambers, an Autograph Collection
Description:
Situated on Edinburgh’s famous Royal Mile, Old Town Chambers has 82 luxurious residences in the heart of the city’s historic Old Town. Just a few minutes’ walk from Edinburgh Castle, surrounded by a wide selection of restaurants and attractions. 
Some bedrooms look directly onto the Royal Mile and St Giles’ Cathedral, others boast views of Princes Street Gardens and the city’s New Town. Each residence has its own living space and kitchen. A daily breakfast is served in Luckenbooth’s restaurant.

Title: The Edinburgh Grand, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Edinburgh
Description: Superbly located in the centre of Edinburgh’s New Town, The Edinburgh Grand offers uniquely decorated residences housed in a restored bank. This grand building on St Andrew Square has range of room types, from studios to three-bedrooms, all with their own kitchen and living space. A gym is housed in the bank’s former vault. Breakfast is served in The Register Club with Hawksmoor steak and seafood restaurant, and all-day café and late-night bar, Lady Libertine occupying the ground and basement levels.

Title: Blackness Bay Distillery
Description:
Blackness Bay Distillery is located 25 mins from Edinburgh, and only a few hundred yards from the famous Blackness castle known to millions from Outlander. Situated in the beautiful location on the Firth of Forth.
They can cater for 20 people for their tour of this unique small craft distillery producing whisky and rum. The Distillery has it's own adjoining Pub/Restaurant to cater for those that wish to dine before or after a tour.

Title: Caol Ila Distillery
Description: Caol Ila distillery is situated on the North-Eastern shores of Islay with magnificent views across the Sound of Islay to the spectacular Paps of Jura. Offering a range of experiences, including a travel trade exclusive group tour for 12-32pax, an ‘Express tasting’ for 12-28pax and a FIT rate on our flagship Flavour Journey Tour. Parking is available in our car park for small coaches, larger coaches to drop guests off at the turning circle prior to reaching the distillery, approx. 3 mins walk.

Title: Cardhu Distillery
Description: Discover the warm-hearted spirit of the Speyside home where premium whisky is created, evoking ripe orchard fruit, fresh grass, and mellow cereal. Come experience the warmest of welcomes, the heartfelt embrace of Cardhu. Offering FIT rates on our Distillery Tours up to 16pax plus a trade exclusive ‘Express tasting’ for up to 20pax

Title: Cragganmore Distillery
Description:
From its beautiful Spey Valley location to its unique flat top stills, Cragganmore distillery is well worth a visit. 
Offering FIT rates on the ‘Taste of Speyside’ Tour and ‘The Pinnacle’ Warehouse tasting, both up to 12pax. Please note that Cragganmore is a very small distillery, we can accommodate a maximum of 14pax on site at one time.

Title: Royal Lochnagar Distillery
Description: Royal Lochnagar Distillery is situated just one mile from Balmoral Castle and sits at the foot of the Cairngorm mountains, fed by the crystal clear water of the Scarnock springs. Offering FIT rates on our distillery tour up to 16pax and a trade exclusive Express Tasting for 16-32pax

Title: Made in Stirling
Description: Made in Stirling offers two unique experiences for Travel Trade. One is a meet the maker experience where your clients can come into the store after hours and have an exclusive conversation with one of our talented artists or makers, where they tell them about their practices and the inspiration of their art. The second is a Make your own keepsake workshop, in  which your clients will make a Scotland inspired keepsake to commemorate their travel.

Title: Dabton House
Description: Dabton House, the perfect base for exploring South Scotland, offers outstanding hospitality in a historic setting. Newly opened, it boasts 11 ensuite bedrooms, including one accessible room, and elegant living spaces such as a Games Room, Drawing Room, Library, and Dining Room. Guests can self-cater or enjoy meals from our Michelin-trained chef. Guest can enjoy extensive private gardens featuring a grass tennis court, and a sauna and treatment room. Experiences available include private tours of Drumlanrig Castle, country pursuits, and bespoke whisky tastings.

Title: Rox Madeira
Description:
Private foraging walks are available throughout Scotland.
An easy walking route to discover the hidden gems of the Scottish countryside: Wild Food and Wild Medicine.  A different way to connect with Scotland, its history and culture, learning plant folklore, history of plant use in Scotland and current usage.  
I will to travel to a venue near you to create a tailor-made experience for your group.

Title: Mayen Estate
Description: A sustainable collection of reimagined holiday cottages on a beautiful 700 acre Highland Estate in the North East of Scotland.  The ideal secret escape for your clients to retreat and relax, our 4 cottages and A-Frame cabin offer the ultimate Estate experience where they can explore undisturbed nature at its finest and explore the stunning Banffshire coast.  Each cottage comes fully furnished with a hot tub, pizza oven, barbeque and peaceful privacy.

Title: Curious in Nature
Supplier Types: Accessible|Activity|Events|Exclusive Use|Food and Drink|Luxury|Private Tours|Responsible|Walking Tours|Youth
Description:
Guided Foraging and Nature Connection Sessions: Walks, picnics, creative workshops and more, tailored to your needs.
Find joy in wild places with Curious in Nature’s bespoke Wild Adventures. Suitable for couples, individuals, and small to mid-size groups, a session with Curious in Nature adds a touch of magic to any itinerary! Expertly led by a fully qualified and insured practitioner, our Wild Adventures bring together the best of Scotland’s natural and cultural heritage with playful curiosity and creative magic.

Title: Luxury Scotland
Description: Luxury Scotland is a marketing consortium of some of the finest hotels in Scotland. Our 21 unique properties cover the whole country, from 5- star hotels in the beating heart of Edinburgh to a castle in the foothills of Ben Nevis and a luxury hotel at the edge of the world, at Loch Torridon. The collection also includes The Royal Scotsman train, a small cruise ship, The Hebridean Princess and we have carefully curated Partners including Little’s Chauffeur Drive & Johnnie Walker Whisky Experiences.

Title: Blairquhan Castle
Description: Set in over 200 acres of private parkland and gardens, Blairquhan Castle is one of the top exclusive use venues in Scotland. Featuring 15 luxurious Castle bedrooms and 4 stunning function rooms, BlairquhanCastle is an ideal venue for all types of events including corporate retreat, small incentive groups, golfing groups, weddings, product launches, private house parties, etc. Furthermore, there is also 8 self-catering cottages on the Castle estate, providing additional accommodation for larger parties.

Title: Go Wild Scotland
Description: Go Wild Scotland is a small woodland outdoor experience provider delivering high quality, value for money activities in the Scottish Borders. We offer woodland and river guided walks, red squirrel viewing, nature tracking, bespoke corporate events and much more.  Your clients can enjoy an experience built with their needs and requests at the centre of its design.  All income received is invested in our outdoor education programme for schools and groups in the community.

Title: Braemar Cabins
Description:
Cosy self catering cabins located in the scenic village of Braemar, in the heart of the Cairngorms National Park. 
4 cabins located on site with an outdoor clothing and country wear shop, café and restaurant on their doorstep. Braemar has something for everyone whether you are into exploring outdoors or browsing the shops. It is the perfect base for exploring other areas such as Royal Deeside, Aberdeen, Aviemore and Perthshire.

Title: EET
Description:
EET has become a venerable and reliable provider of chauffeur-driven transport that is tailored to each and every person who steps into our fleet of prestigious vehicles. We are dedicated to offering a truly personal travel service across the UK.
Our origins may lie in the majestic capital of Scotland, but the depth of resources we have at our disposal allows us to accommodate bookings wherever you may be across mainland Britain. We offer a full range of transport services from airport transfers and bespoke multi-day tours to specialist golf services and secure transport.

Title: Hinidas
Description:
For the discerning traveller looking to nourish their wellbeing in the Scottish outdoors. Bespoke
outdoor fitness & wellness retreats in central Scotland situated on idyllic smallholding: guests
have exclusive use of the woodland gym, glasshouse studio & surrounding grounds with
overnight stays in a stunning eco-chic cabin.
Expert-led activities include: core-strength & body-conditioning, Pilates & yoga based exercise,
guided walks, hikes & cycles. Sessions tailored to the individual’s needs & fitness levels.
Bespoke packages available; for couples, friends or solo FIT groups.

Title: Lowlander Bespoke Tours
Description: Lowlander offers either tailor made or off the peg driver guided tours of the Scottish Borders.  We at Lowlander are born and bred Borders people who know their way around the area.  Guests can relax and enjoy the tour as we escort them in comfort and style.  We offer a door to door service, including all entrance fees, lunch and afternoon refreshment.  Tours unique to  Lowlander include the Thoroughbred Tour, visiting a racehorse trainer, Kelso Racecourse and a thoroughbred stud.

Title: Groam House Museum
Description: Groam House, located on the Black Isle, offers intimate, exclusive experiences tailored for small groups. Ideal for up to 20, we can arrange in-depth talks on Pictish history, engaging storytelling sessions, and private tours. For a truly unique visit, we can also organise behind-the-scenes tours with object handling for up to 12 guests. These experiences must be booked in advance and are subject to availability. Please note, both, museum and collection store are spread over two floors with no lift.

Title: Loch Ness Hub & Travel
Description: Loch Ness Hub and Travel is a community benefit company in Drumnadrochit. Offering baggage and shuttle transfers for the Great Glen Way, e-bike hire, highland coo tours and visitor information services, along with tickets to Urquhart Castle & Jacobite Cruises. Loch Ness Hub and Travel is a one-stop shop for visitors exploring Glen Urquhart and Loch Ness.

Title: Ballintaggart
Description:
Ballintaggart is an award winning refined rural hospitality destination in Highland Perthshire. 
Offering luxury self-catering accommodation, a boutique hotel with a Michelin Guide recommended restaurant and bar, Ballintaggart Farm also has a Cook School and beautiful event and wedding space. 
Ballintaggart offers private catering, have developed their own product range and run three shops in Perthshire. 
Seasonal and sustainable ingredients are at the heart of the business, along with a passion and dedication to providing guests with an unforgettable experience.

Title: Firthside House Ltd
Description: A recently renovated Victorian beach-front property offering luxury bespoke, self-catered or fully staffed accommodation in the heart of Nairn. Nine bedrooms (18 guests) each with en-suite or private bathroom, vast ocean views and several reception rooms including formal dining room, billiard room and bar.  A five minute walk to cafes and shops or the Nairn Golf Club and an easy drive to all major tourist attractions - perfectly located to explore the Scottish Highlands and the whisky distilleries of Speyside.

Title: Lunan Bay Farm - Scottish Cashmere Goats
Description: Immersive farm experiences featuring our adorable Cashmere goats, led by the farmer & locals. Enjoy a hands-on tour of Scotland’s only Regenerative Scottish Cashmere farm, visit historic Red Castle and take a guided sea dip at our stunning beach, includes a Farm-to-Table dining experience - combining Scottish history, nature, textiles, local food & sustainable farming in one unforgettable adventure. Due to our location, we welcome small groups of up to 20 guests arriving in mini/midi-buses. Exclusive, bespoke & private tours welcomed. On East Coast of Scotland. Driving time from nearest airports; Dundee (50min), Aberdeen (60min) & Edinburgh (110min).
Address Line 1: Lunan Bay Farm - Scottish Cashmere Goats

Title: Dundee Community Craft CIC
Description: DCC is an inspiring community interest company that seeks to support those with experience of substance use and poor mental health into the workplace whilst also providing therapeutic creative interventions through craft. We provide a unique hands-on experience delivered by locals in which the travel/tourism trade can learn traditional craftsmanship and leave with a product of their choice. Our workshops are the perfect way to engage in a relaxing activity, helping you to switch off and feel energetically revived whilst hearing about local stories of Dundee.

Title: Wild Cairns
Description: Wild Cairns, a 5-star rated outdoor adventure destination, offers your clients exhilarating, group-friendly activities, including a zombie-themed airsoft gun range, a challenging assault course, axe throwing, and the unique Mini Highland Games. Located in North Berwick, we specialise in bespoke/private groups, making us perfect for corporate events, school trips, and tour groups. With a large car park for coaches and customisable packages, we cater to both FIT and group itineraries, ensuring a memorable experience for all.

Title: Edinburgh Printmakers
Description:
Edinburgh Printmakers is a creative centre for printmaking and the visual arts in the Fountainbridge area of Edinburgh. It has a large light-filled printmaking studio, two galleries, a shop selling original prints and handmade products, a venue for meetings, events and learning activities, a café, a courtyard, and community garden.
We can provide private printmaking workshops for groups with bespoke designs on fine art paper or bags, as well as fascinating tours of a building rooted in Edinburgh’s industrial history.

Title: Aldourie Castle
Description: Aldourie Castle is an exclusive use venue nestled on the beautiful banks of Loch Ness, surrounded by 500 acres of gardens, woodland and meadows. The castle sleeps up to 24 guests in 12 elegant bedrooms, as well as an array of communal rooms for everyone to relax and enjoy. In addition, guests have access to our Boathouse which is the perfect spot for lunch and our recently renovated steadings which have extra dining space, dance hall and whisky tasting room!

Title: Lost Shore Surf Resort
Description:
Lost Shore is Europe’s largest inland surf resort. It offers your group or FIT clients a unique and exciting experience near Edinburgh.
We offer surf lessons for beginners & improvers and more advanced sessions. Boards and wet suits are provided. Built with sustainability in mind, the resort has a range of 53 luxury self-catering units, an on-site café bar with group spaces, a sauna and the option of surf skating. Surfers benefit from heated changing rooms and a safe environment in our stunning Cove . 
Located very close to Edinburgh airport, we offer free onsite parking and we are open all year.

Title: House of the Northern Gate
Description: Set atop sweeping moors at the most northerly point of mainland Scotland, this Highland estate, with the House of the Northern Gate at its helm, has been recently and extensively renovated to a very high standard of comfort and sustainability, recently receiving the GOLD level award from Green Tourism. The House of the Northern Gate is an ideal location for family reunions, holidays with friends and weddings, with nine bedrooms, a 22-person dining room and a jaw-dropping view of the coastline.

Title: Archerfield Walled Garden
Description: Archerfield Walled Garden is a unique destination set in the beautiful East Lothian Countryside. With lovingly tended Gardens, extensive grounds, Garden Café, Shop and foodmarket, there is lots to see and do. Families will love the woodland Fairy Trail and enclosed play area. With a large tarmac car park, we have plenty of space to accommodate visitors. Whether you are a garden enthusiast looking for inspiration or a foodie looking for a delicious brunch this is the perfect day out.

Title: Traverse Theatre
Description: The Traverse is one of Scotland's leading new-works theatres that has been producing award-winning, exciting new plays. Located at the heart of the city centre, you can join us in the Bar or see a thrilling new work, with groups of 8 or more receiving discounted bookings. You can also join us for discussions, gigs, panels and industry events offering insights to the sector. Should you need to host a large group, our venue is flexible and fully-equipped for events.

Title: The Royal Edinburgh Military Tattoo
Description: The Royal Edinburgh Military Tattoo is a world-class event, rooted in Scottish tradition, offering audiences an experience like no other. Performed to a global live audience of 220,000 each year in August on the iconic Edinburgh Castle Esplanade, the Tattoo showcases creativity through music, precision performances and dance from military and cultural acts from around the world. With an almost 9,000 capacity arena and 24 Shows across the run in August, the Tattoo can accommodate both large and small bookings.

Title: Scotland's Highland Tours
Description:
Your clients will enjoy a personalised and professional private tour of Scotland with our hand picked driver/guides. Local family business based in Inverness offering tours across the whole of Scotland. Easy pick up from all main airports inc. Edinburgh, Glasgow & Inverness.
Itinerary created for your client by Catherine. Regular communication. 1 to 8 pax. Attention to detail, unusual requests, hidden wonders, above and beyond is what we will do for you and your client. Attention to detail, unusual requests, hidden wonders, above and beyond is what we will do for you and your client.

Title: Naughty Sheep
Description:
The wholesome charm of unpredictable pet sheep meets Mindfulness, Wellness expertise and home-baking. Quirky Experiences rooted in kindness and set in beautiful Loch Lomond National Park.  Tea Retreat with Naughty Sheep 3.5 hour, max 6 pax, Trade exclusive extras.
Stirling Castle 30 minutes, Edinburgh/Glasgow airports 60 minutes, all year round.
Highland Yoga Flow- A mountain view accessible yoga practice. Tea with Naughty Sheep- Chaotic fun making friends with sheep, traditional afternoon tea. Ethical animal ambassador, sustainable food chain, therapeutic rescue sheep, Celtic Sound Healing Meditation- Wholesome relaxation in a cosy upstairs studio

Title: The Oak Tree Inn
Description: The Oak Tree Inn in Balmaha, Loch Lomond, is a 42-bedroom hotel, pub, restaurant, coffee shop, and village shop on the West Highland Way. Established in 1997, this family-run business offers an authentic, friendly welcome and has twice been named Scotland’s best pub. Adjacent St Mocha Coffee Shop roasts Loch Lomond Coffee on-site. With 300+ solar panels and a focus on sustainability, The Oak Tree Inn leads the way in eco-friendly innovation, community investment, and creating Loch Lomond’s ultimate destination

Title: MYB Textiles Ltd
Description:
Renowned textile artisans exclusively weaving Scottish lace and madras sheers since 1900. 
The sights, sounds and smells will transport you back in time to the world of manufacturing, see 120 year old lace machines weaving the most delicate sheer and Vamatex Madras loom producing a clipped face fabric. 
Meandering around the mill you’ll experience history repeating itself when cloth is woven, darned, mended by hand and made into a finished product. 
Approx. 60-90 minutes finishing up in our mill shop.

Title: The Leddie
Description: The Leddie is a boutique Hotel and Restaurant in Aberlady, perfectly situated to give access to East Lothian’s stunning coastline and golf courses. From comfort and deluxe rooms to a variety of suites, each of our 27 rooms boasts their own unique personality, offering a perfect blend of elegance, luxury and relaxation to your clients. Our warm and welcoming Restaurant promises the best of locally sourced produce combined with the finest Scottish hospitality. We welcome groups and FITs and can also offer exclusive use of our venue.

Title: Nether Glenny Farm
Description: Embark on a thrilling off-road adventure around our farm and the scenic hills in a Kawasaki Buggy. Located within the Loch Lomond National Park your clients can get an up-close encounter with the iconic Highland Cows, and take in breath taking views of the Lake of Menteith. Enjoy a peaceful stroll through our tree planting areas, while learning about the rich history of Menteith Hill’s ancient inhabitants. Discover how we preserve the environment through sustainable land management practices. The tour concludes with a delicious lunch and homemade cake in our cosy cabin.

Title: Aquila Wildlife & Nature CIC
Description: We are a community interest company which provides opportunities for groups and individuals to reconnect with wildlife and nature through engaging guided walks, tours, events, and inclusive experiences that inspire a love for nature, as well as helping people develop their awareness of the importance of biodiversity and environmental protection for all life on Earth.

Title: Knockinaam Lodge
Description: Knockinaam is a multi-award winning property and Dumfries & Galloway's only Luxury Boutique Hotel. Knockinaam was voted the Best Hotel in Scotland by The Good Hotel Guide in 2024 and have also recently been awarded full UNESCO Accreditation for their ongoing efforts in support of the circular economy/responsible tourism & sustainability. They are the only Luxury property to receive this accreditation. Knockinaam is nestled in it's own private cove with spectacular views across the North Channel to Ireland.

Title: Alba Experiences
Description: Alba Experiences is a family-owned tour company dedicated to providing authentic, immersive Scottish tours that showcase the rich culture, stunning landscapes, and hidden gems of Scotland. Founded by James McKinlay, our company combines deep knowledge, personal passion and exceptional customer service to create unforgettable journeys throughout Scotland.

Title: Inglewood House & Spa
Description:
From your first sight of Inglewood House, you know you have arrived somewhere truly special. Set in 25 acres, this stunning Jacobean mansion house has been sympathetically transformed into a luxurious, award winning, boutique hotel and spa. Located in Alloa, just 10 minutes from the historic city and attractions of Stirling, it is the perfect base to explore Scotland’s Forth Valley, Edinburgh and Glasgow.

Inglewood House offers food and drink experiences, including ‘A Scottish Laird’ - an immersive Scottish experience, travel back to 1901 and join John Forrester Paton (actor) in his family home as he tells you about his life, his home and beloved Scotland.

Title: THATco (Tasting History Ayrshire Tours)
Description: THATco offers unique and engaging walking tour experiences for your clients. Our knowledgeable guides bring Ayrshire's rich history to life. Using captivating storytelling and memorable encounters with historical figures, your clients will not only learn about the region's past, but also have the opportunity to savour delicious local food and drink. Tours are suitable for groups between 8 and 20 people. Bespoke arrangements available upon request.

Title: Fasque Castle
Description:
Fasque Castle is an exclusive-use wedding and events venue in Aberdeenshire, Scotland. Set on a 400-acre estate with private Deer Park, the castle offers a number of striking event and reception spaces, with minimum capacity at 20 and maximum capacity at 160.
Accommodating up to 38 overnight within 19 bedrooms, an additional 6 bedrooms can be found within three cottages in the castle grounds.
Fasque boasts an in-house chef team who deliver a range of formal and informal dining options.

Title: Cycle Hire Scotland
Description:
Cycle Hire Scotland is a specialist bicycle hire company.
We cater for any type of group or event and have up to 300 bikes available for delivery to any location in Scotland. We provide bespoke cycle hire packages to accommodation providers, cycle events, corporate groups and cycle tour operators, all tailored to suit your client’s needs.
We have over 25 years’ experience of providing high-quality tailor-made cycle hire packages and pride ourselves on delivering exceptional customer service every time.

Title: BlueWild Nature Boat Tours
Description:
BlueWild sails daily to iconic nature reserves, to protected islands, through every period of Scottish history from coastline, past maritime disasters, epoch defining geology to castles, Outlander and World War II locations.  See 100 000 Puffins, the world’s largest northern Gannet colony, seals and marine wildlife.
BlueWild is a small, friendly company run by local people - sailing private charters and scheduled tours from the historic fishing town of Dunbar and from North Berwick - only 45 minutes from Edinburgh.

Title: Wilderness Folk School
Description: Wilderness Folk School specialises in offering Bushcraft Courses and Nature-Based Education from the heart of highland Perthshire. Courses include Bushcraft, Wildlife Tracking, Craft Courses, Canoe Expeditions, Basketry Courses & Private Events.

Title: Rae's
Description: We offer private chef services, catering and foodie-favourite bookable experiences. Discover our larder’s hidden gems and get hands-on with our local produce, together with a classically trained chef, foraging experts, mixologists and food producers on our bespoke foraging walks, outdoor dining experiences and cookery classes for groups of 4-20. We travel to clients and have flexible locations with parking and toilet facilities. Based in Montrose, 25 miles from Dundee and 45 miles from Aberdeen and able to travel across Scotland.

Title: The Scottish Homecoming Show
Description:
Our Scottish Homecoming Show is a true, authentic, straight from the heart evening of anecdote, fact and folklore that includes recitals from Robert Burns together with live Scottish music and hearty homemade Scottish food.
Join us at our unique Scottish Homecoming Show and enjoy a home-cooked three course meal, a taste of haggis, wine and a wonderful evening of true authentic Scottish hospitality and all in the historic village of Torphichen, 10-minutes drive from the Royal Burgh of Linlithgow.

Title: TwinPeakes Fly Fishing Limited
Description:
TwinPeakes Fly Fishing is a leading provider of guided fly-fishing adventures on the Rivers Dee, Don, and Deveron.  
We specialize in unforgettable salmon and trout fishing experiences, offering both stillwater and river options, as well as group packages.
Our all-inclusive service provides premium tackle, waders, and everything you need for a seamless experience. 
With expert instructors to teach casting techniques and offer support, you’ll enjoy a thrilling, hands-on journey. 
Get ready to create memories on the water like never before!

Title: Swirl Sip Socialise
Description:
Elevate your clients’ trip to Scotland with an exclusive, private guided culinary experience showcasing the very best of Edinburgh’s culinary scene. Guests dine across three award-winning restaurants, each championing exceptional Scottish produce.

We curate the entire experience, delivering expert pairings, rich storytelling, and a true taste of Scotland’s food traditions. This is a refined epicurean adventure — blending insider access, premium gastronomy, and a sommelier-led masterclass crafted for discerning travellers.

Suitable for couples, or small groups. Experiences are available over lunch or dinner and can be tailored to suit your needs.

Title: Hebridean Island Cruises
Description: Operators of 3 boutique cruise ships sailing the Western Isles of Scotland and the Caledonian Canal, all perfect for small groups and private charters.  Whether for an incentive, reunion, celebration or as part of a broader package, each of our three elegant ships provide a small number of people with a unique backdrop for an unforgettable experience. Variable durations, route planning service, on board guides, all inclusive fares, free places for group leaders and net or commissionable rates available.

Title: In2Scotland.com
Description:
Your DMC for Unforgettable Scottish Experiences
In2Scotland.com is your expert Destination Management Company (DMC), crafting bespoke travel experiences across Scotland for the global travel trade. We specialize in incentive travel, conferences, group tours, and individual leisure. Our unparalleled local knowledge, strong supplier relationships, and seamless collaboration ensure every itinerary is meticulously designed and flawlessly executed. Beyond Scotland, we also manage programmes across England, Wales, and Ireland. Partner with us for exceptional journeys tailored to your clients' every need.

Title: Anderson Black Executive Travel
Description:
Anderson Black Executive Travel is a female-owned, family-run luxury transport operator with over 
20 years’ experience supporting tour operators, DMCs and travel agents. We provide high-quality, 
responsible group travel in executive luxury minibuses seating 16–29 passengers, ideal for small to 
medium-sized groups. Operating a modern Euro 6 fleet with Green Tourism Award-accredited 
practices, we deliver seamless airport transfers, multi-day touring and bespoke itineraries across 
Scotland

Title: Strachan Tours
Description: Based near St Andrews (home of Golf) and City of Dundee, Strachan Tours has operated since 2004 with an excellent track record providing Private Driver Guided Tours of Scotland for individuals and small groups to 8 persons. Choose from a wide range of detailed itineraries on our website, all designed to ensure clients experience the best of Scotland in a short period of time or ask for a bespoke itinerary. Either way, a Journey of Relaxation and Delight is assured.

Title: Gallus Pedals
Description: Gallus Pedals is all about “making locals feel like tourists and tourists feel like locals.” We offer authentic bike, e-bike, and walking tours, including food and drink experiences, showcasing Glasgow’s rich history, culture, and hidden gems. We accommodate groups, private bookings, FIT clients, and create bespoke tours tailored to your needs. Passionate about sustainability, we collaborate with local charities and institutions. With a mobile service, we can cover events in Glasgow and Edinburgh.

Title: Stories of Stone
Description: Uncover the hidden stories of the past with Stories of Stone.  Take a guided walk with experienced geologists on our Arbroath Cliff top walking tour where you can delve into the fascinating world of local geology, geomorphology and local history.  Immerse yourself in the stunning coastal landscapes as we explore the cliffs, beaches and rock formations, gaining a deeper understanding of the land beneath your feet.  By the end of the walk you will have gained a deeper understanding of the cultural and geological history of the region.

Title: Voyages Photo Ecosse
Description:
Photography tours in French.
I am a French professional photographer living in Scotland and I offer 1 day or multi-days photography tours in the Highlands of Scotland.
Whether your clients are beginners looking to learn the basics of photography or experienced photographers looking for new inspiration, this is a tour for improving their photography while photographing the best of Scotland’s landscapes.
