I can pick up your clients from their accommodation for a private tour in the Highlands. Please note that I can also travel to the Islands of Scotland on request.

Title: Meldrum House Country Hotel & Golf
Description: Meldrum House Hotel, part of Apex Hotels, is one of the Sunday Times Top 100 UK hotels, set in 240 acres, it offers 51 bedrooms, two restaurants, four luxury dining domes, Titan Sky Bar, and the 800-year-old Cave Bar with 120+ whiskies. Hotel residents can play the private Knights Golf Course, ranked among Scotland’s Top 100. The estate features 24 acres of practice facilities, including a Toptracer-equipped driving range, 12 target greens, and short-game areas.

Title: Broad Bay House
Description: Broad Bay House is a luxury, boutique Guest House perfectly situated to give access to the whole of the Isle of Lewis and Harris and the only 5 star gold guest house (VisitScotland 2024/25) in the Outer Hebrides. From comfort and deluxe rooms, each of our 4 rooms boasts their own unique personality, offering a perfect blend of elegance, space and relaxation to your clients. Our menus promise the best of locally sourced produce, all showcasing the islands rich food and drink scene; combined with the finest hospitality. We welcome small groups, FITs and can also offer exclusive use. Sea view guaranteed.

Title: Kirsteen's Art Workshops
Description:
Kirsteen’s Art Workshops offer immersive, hands-on art experiences and gallery tours in Edinburgh, perfect for travellers seeking creativity. Led by an expert artist, sessions include mixed media and drawing, catering to all skill levels. Ideal for individuals and
groups, these unique workshops and tours provide a memorable, artistic addition to any itinerary.

Title: Bairnkine Farm
Description: Give your clients an authentic Scottish farm experience with our immersive tours, including Meet the Farmer, Sheepdog Demonstrations, Guided Farm Walks, and Nature & Conservation experiences featuring native tree planting, allowing guests to leave a lasting legacy in Scotland. We also offer hands-on oatcake making experiences with a Scottish taster platter, and farm tours paired with a lamb tasting platter. Throughout the year, we share the realities of farm life—from winter cattle feeding to spring lambing—alongside our conservation journey, whatever the season or weather

Title: Campbells Bakery Baking Experiences
Description: We are an 8th generation family bakers inviting small groups of up to 10 people to join us in our working bakery in Crieff, Perthshire, where we share our heritage, recipes and tricks of the trade to make melt-in-your-mouth shortbread, hearty oatcakes and traditional Bannocks.

Title: Abbey Strand Apartments, at Holyrood
Description: Located at the foot of Edinburgh’s famous Royal Mile and steps from the gates of the Palace of Holyrood house, the nine prestigious apartments at Abbey Strand Apartments offer a boutique living experience, for any length of stay. Immerse yourself in more than 500 years of history with all the modern luxuries you need to make the most of a visit to Scotland’s capital. Designed with a nod to the colourful assortment of former inhabitants, the collection of open plan, one- and two-bedroom apartments are totally unique and intriguingly unconventional.

Title: Glen Tanar Estate
Description:
Scottish Highland Estate
Glen Tanar Estate is situated in Royal Deeside, one hour from Aberdeen and under three hours from Edinburgh. It is a perfect destination for groups and is accessible by coach.  Your clients can enjoy an exclusive tour of the estate’s grounds and Ballroom. 
Marvel at the magnificent Victorian Ballroom .Tours led by knowledgeable and local guides. Discover the Wildlife, History & Royal connections of the estate. Experience Scottish culture through Highland Dancing, Whisky Tasting & Highland Cow Feeding

Title: Craighall Steading
Description: We offer comfortable modern bed and breakfast accommodation with stunning views of the countryside and Lomond Hills. Situated in a semi-rural location on the edge of Ceres Village next to Craighall Den and close to the site of Craighall Castle. At Craighall your clients’ comfort is our first priority; our rooms are all superbly decorated with en-suite showers, complimentary toiletries, fluffy towels, and hypnos mattresses with high quality 100% cotton bedding. We hold a Green Tourism Gold award, the only B&B in Fife to do so; using local sourced or home grown produce from our garden and eggs from our hens. We are accessible assessed aware and part of Scotland's Best B&Bs

Title: Monarch Tours
Description: Monarch Tours offers private, expertly guided journeys through Scotland, tailored to your interests. From historic castles to breath taking landscapes, we take you beyond the usual tourist routes to uncover hidden gems and rich stories. With a focus on personal service, flexible itineraries, and a deep love for Scotland, we ensure a truly immersive experience. No crowds, no rush—just authentic exploration at your pace. Discover Scotland with a guide who knows it best.

Title: Ooshka Bar
Description: Showcasing Scotland's small, independent producers, our innovative spirits tasting company educates through immersive experiences. We offer luxury packages and affordable options, flexible for groups up to 20 (short notice) and 40 (with notice). Guests explore hand-selected, unique distillery spirits. Through these experiences, we connect drinkers with the stories, communities, and craftsmanship behind each bottle, fostering a deeper appreciation for Scotland's rich distilling heritage.

Title: Camera Obscura & World of Illusions
Description: Bring your group to Camera Obscura & World of Illusions, a truly unique experience in the heart of Edinburgh, just 30 minutes from the airport. It is the oldest visitor attraction in Edinburgh! Discover 100+ hands-on illusions, experience our fascinating 172-year-old Camera Obscura show, and enjoy stunning 360° city views from our Rooftop Terrace. A fun, interactive, and educational visit, ideal for groups, FIT, and bespoke tours. A central location right beside Edinburgh Castle, it’s a must-see for any Scotland itinerary! Open all year round, early until late every day.

Title: Dunninald Castle and Gardens
Description:
Our tours are personally led by the owner and tailored to your group's interests, ideal for smaller groups of up to 24 guests. Discover the rich history of Dunninald Castle, the collections of Scottish furniture, artwork, and fine needlework and how Dunninald has been home to generations of our family. You'll also explore our acclaimed walled garden and scenic woodland walks.
Garden only, tours welcome. We can also arrange refreshments, a traditional bagpiper, or a whisky tasting experience.

Title: McArthur Manor
Description: McArthur Manor isn’t just a venue - it’s a home away from home. With exclusive hire, tailored itineraries, catering, entertainment, and warm, personal hospitality, we treat guests like extended members of the family. Organisations booking with us enjoy a rare, all-in-one luxury experience. Featuring 15 en-suite rooms, on-site activities, and full or part-board catering.

Title: Thorabella Farm
Description: We are a working farm in Dallas, Morayshire where we offer self-catering accommodation in our straw bale cabins which are surrounded by the animals on the farm. We also provide Farm tours, experiences and events as well as selling our own and other local produce through our shop.

Title: Glenkilrie Larder Cook School
Description:
Embark on a unique culinary journey as we showcase our red meat, lovingly reared on our land for over 60 
years. Lauren will guide you through its provenance and demonstrate how to cook various cuts of venison, 
beef, and lamb. While embracing the rich history of the Houstoun family’s sustainable farming, you’ll savor 
each mouthwatering dish. From land to larder, experience Glenkilrie’s true essence. Our cook school 
guarantees you’ll leave inspired and ready to recreate the dishes at home

Title: Dundonald Castle & Visitor Centre
Description: Explore Dundonald Castle in Ayrshire, Scotland—a medieval fortress with 3,500 years of history. Linked to the Stewart Dynasty and other families including the Cochrane and Wallace, the site offers tailored experiences for groups and individuals. Enjoy guided tours, artefact handling, coffee, cake, light lunches, local retail crafts, woodland walks, and more. Operated by the Friends of Dundonald Castle in partnership with Historic Environment Scotland, the castle welcomes FIT and/or bespoke bookings for all visitors and ages.

Title: Language Travel Tours
Description:
At Language Travel Tours, we have over 30 years of expertise in delivering immersive English language homestays and cultural programmes for FITs, overseas schools and private groups in Stonehaven, North East Scotland 
Passionate about Aberdeenshire’s linguistic heritage, our exclusive Doric in Dunnottar tour transports your clients into Scotland’s past, uncovering folklore, myths, and legends passed down through generations 
Ideal for half-day or full-day guided tours, we also include authentic coastal villages for a rich and memorable Scottish experience.

Title: Gael & Grain
Description: Gael & Grain is a charming, atmospheric Scottish pub & kitchen located in Glasgow’s vibrant West End. At Gael & Grain, we celebrate Scotland’s rich culinary heritage with a unique twist on classic dishes. Our menu features home-cooked Scottish classics made with locally sourced ingredients, paired with a fantastic selection of local beers and whiskies. Enjoy live traditional Scottish music in a warm and welcoming atmosphere.

Title: Kirk O'The Lochs
Description: Nestled in the heart of the picturesque Loch Lomond and The Trossachs National Park. Our unique venue, set in a historic church, offers authentic Scottish food in an atmospheric dining setting just a short distance away from the shores of the loch. Discover the best of Scottish cuisine at Kirk O’The Lochs, where tradition meets modern culinary flair. Our menus celebrate Scotland’s finest locally sourced ingredients, from hearty classics to indulgent sweet treats. We offer coffee and cake stops, lunch, afternoon tea and dinner.

Title: Hebrides People Visitor Centre
Description:
Hebrides People tells the story of the people of the Isles of Harris and St Kilda. It offers an authentic insight into the rich heritage of these islands, their changing populations over the centuries, from people to sheep, their struggles for survival, their language and culture, and how they are today. 
Learn about life on the islands over the last 9,000 years via a bespoke tour of our exhibitions from one of our Heritage Team or explore the exhibitions self-guided.

Title: Duncarron Medieval Village
Description:
An open-air museum and event venue which takes centre stage in
Outlander Season 7 as Fort Ticonderoga, and has graced numerous other television productions.
They can offer your clients guided Outlander Tours of their site as well as bespoke experiences
such as "Highlander for a Day." Participants can revel in activities like axe throwing, archery,
Jacobite combat training, plaid-wearing demonstrations, weapons displays, led by experienced tutors.
Their private car park can accommodate up to 6 coaches simultaneously. One hour from both Edinburgh/Glasgow Airport

Title: Lews Castle by Together Travel
Description:
Perched on an ancient incline, with unbeatable views over the waters of Stornoway, this inspiring, gothic-revival style castle hails from the mid-1800’s. Commissioned by Sir James Matheson, its historic walls have harbored nobility, WW2 hospital patients, college and school students, but now, after a dedicated restoration, has opened its doors to worldwide visitors to enjoy a range of self-catering apartments.
Lews Castle is home to a delicately restored ballroom for Events and Weddings,  Storehouse Café and Outfitters gift shop.

Title: Harris Hotel
Description: Well established hotel, family owned and run for over 100 years. We offer Hebridean Hospitality at it’s best – quality accommodation, superb food, outstanding service and a relaxing atmosphere. The hotel has twenty-two-en-suite bedrooms ranging from standard to deluxe.

Title: Dumfries Tours
Description: Dumfries Tours offers exclusive private guided historic and cultural tours in the South of Scotland, specialising in Dumfries and Galloway. We provide bespoke, small group, excursions. We can arrange day and multi day tours including researching family ancestry. We are passionate about this region and look forward to sharing its rich history and amazing scenery with your clients. Our tours will suit those looking to get off the beaten track, to explore the roads less travelled.

Title: Mountain Marcus
Description:
Qualified Mountain Leader offering hiking trips in Edinburgh and the Scottish Highlands. Perfect for solo travellers, couples, and groups.  
Arthur’s Seat Sunset Hikes - a great way to do something adventurous in Edinburgh (tours start and finish in the city centre on the Royal Mile).   
Cairngorms Hiking Day Trips By Train – the best way to experience the Scottish Highlands. For adventurous travellers who want to visit the mountains in the Cairngorms National Park. Tours start and finish at Edinburgh Waverley Railway Station.

Title: Scenic Scottish Transfers
Description:
Private door to door premium transfers, private tours or vehicle support for those experiencing the great Scottish outdoors.
At Scenic Scottish Transfers we will collect your group and all baggage and equipment and transport you to where you need to go, door to door, no changes to worry about. Whether you’re going to a remote village, city centre, golf course, or airport we’ll make your journey unforgettable.
We also specialise in private tours, shore excursions and film crew transport.

Title: Clayton Hotel Glasgow
Description: Located on the banks of the River Clyde, a short stroll from Buchanan Street and some of Scotland’s best known music venues: it’s a place with everything from food, culture and entertainment. With 303 bedrooms and 7 meeting rooms, Clayton Hotel Glasgow is perfectly designed for your every need. We look forward to welcoming your clients and customers.

Title: Stuart's Bicycle Tours
Description: Stuart’s Bicycle Tours offers guided bike and e-bike tours in St Andrews, Stirling, and Glasgow, providing an active, sustainable way to explore Scotland’s history, culture, and landscapes. As the only dedicated bicycle tour provider in St Andrews and Stirling, we offer a unique perspective, reaching beyond city centres to hidden gems and local highlights. Ideal for FIT and small groups, our tours combine expert guidance, local knowledge, and memorable experiences for visitors of all abilities.

Title: Nomadic Scotland
Description:
Nomadic Scotland is an Adventure Travel business providing a fleet of premium Land Rover’s for hire
packaged with bespoke itineraries, activities and places to stay; tailored to each guests unique needs.
Guests can hire a vehicle, go on a camping trip or let us organize a full package for them.

Title: Paisley Tours
Description: Paisley Tours is a registered social enterprise offering immersive walking tours and indoor AV storytelling sessions exploring the town’s rich history. Located just 10 minutes from Glasgow Airport, we cover royal burials, witch trials, the Paisley Pattern, and world-changing inventions. Fully accessible, with group and FIT options available.

Title: Heritage Guides
Description:
We are a group of award-winning historians and tour guides who specialise in exploring the sites and history of Scotlands built heritage. Our team provide storytelling, tours and talks for all ages and abilities in Edinburgh and beyond.

We select our guides for their passion and skill. Unscripted, each brings energy to the stories of our past, in our nations most iconic sites.
Our expert team of Museum and Heritage specialists will be delighted to look after your clients.

Title: West Highland Museum
Description: Discover over 100 years of history at the West Highland Museum in Fort William. Founded in 1922, this award-winning museum brings the dramatic story of the Scottish Highlands to life. Explore fascinating exhibits on Bonnie Prince Charlie, the Jacobite’s, and everyday Highland life. With rare artifacts, engaging displays, and a unique local perspective, it’s a must-visit destination for history lovers and curious minds alike. Step into the past and experience the spirit and heritage of the Highlands like never before.

Title: The Japanese Garden at Cowden
Description: “Sha Raku En” the place of pleasure and delight.  The Japanese Garden at Cowden created in 1910 by Scottish adventurer and explorer Ella Christie, is within easy reach of Edinburgh airport (35 miles), Glasgow airport (46 Miles) and the city of Stirling (16 miles). Your clients can relax and immerse themselves in the tranquil surrounds of a traditional Japanese garden and encircling woodlands.  We offer exclusive experiences, from Garden tours to Afternoon Teas for small groups.  Easy on site parking for coaches.

Title: Attaché Tours Ltd
Description:
Attaché Tours offers curated, small-group (1–6 guests), private journeys through Moray and the Highlands of Scotland. Each experience is led by a qualified guide with a military background and designed for discerning clients. Tours focus on cultural heritage, military history, textiles, and dramatic landscapes.
Based near Inverness and well-connected to major transport hubs, Attaché Tours provides seamless logistics, expert storytelling, and bespoke itineraries ideal for FITs and private groups seeking depth, authenticity, and exceptional care.

Title: Strathnaver Museum
Description: Strathnaver Museum offers a powerful and immersive experience looking at 8,000 years of life in northwest Sutherland. Your client will gain an insight into the Highland Clearances through oral testimonies and a recreated 1800s blackhouse. Housing a rich collection of artifacts in a beautifully restored former church your client will discover Pictish Stones, Bronze Age relics and Clan Mackay memorabilia. Run by a team of volunteers, whose passion and local knowledge creates a warm, authentic, engaging visitor experience. We offer a range of Welcome Talks, Curator Led Tours and Object Handling sessions for groups and FIT’s. Located on the popular NC500 driving route with Clachan Café on site

Title: Newburgh Handloom Weavers
Description:
Newburgh Handloom Weavers invites you to travel back in time to experience one of Scotland’s oldest skilled trades.
Our Weaving Shed is in the Fife town of Newburgh, 40 miles from Edinburgh Airport. We specialise in the sustainable production of high quality, handwoven tweed, and blankets, woven on traditional wooden handlooms built in the 1800s.
Join us for a unique weaving experience through our Weaving Talks and Demonstrations. Classes can be arranged for a more in-depth and exclusive weaving experience.

Title: Eat, Sleep, Ride
Description: Eat Sleep Ride is an off-grid equine and nature-based experience provider located in the Scottish Borders, 10 minutes from Berwick-upon-Tweed (East Coast Mainline rail) and 1 hour from Edinburgh and Newcastle. We offer bookable half-day and full-day equine-led experiences for groups and FIT travellers. Products combine gentle horse interaction, riding (where selected), local food and outdoor learning. Ideal for wellbeing, multigenerational travel and small group itineraries. Groups welcome year-round by arrangement.

Title: Chiya and Chai Tea Tasting
Description:
Uncover Scotland’s surprising tea story in this relaxed, story-led tasting experience led by a certified tea expert. Taste exceptional loose-leaf teas - including a unique whisky blend - and hear fascinating tales of Scottish adventurers who shaped the global tea trade. 
This 90-minute experience offers flavour, history and connection, with optional gift bags and venue sourcing. 
Also available: the History of Afternoon Tea storytelling experience. 
A perfect cultural add-on for FITs, small groups or anyone curious about Scotland’s rich, untold tea heritage.

Title: Up ‘n About Scotland
Description: Based between Glasgow and Edinburgh we offer tours all over the Scottish Highlands guided by one our experienced driver/guides for sightseeing tours or our carefully selected Mountain Leaders for hiking trips. Whether it be a leisurely minibus tour of castles, distilleries, cathedrals and lochs or an active few days away, walking the hills, or taking in the solitude of the mountains. Up n About Scotland can help. All our guides are fully qualified for the activity we provide.

Title: Ness Social Club and Taigh Dhonnchaidh Arts & Music Club
Description: Your clients will be warmly welcomed to the Ness FC Social club with a dram of local whisky and some homemade shortbread while being entertained by Highland Dancers in traditional dress. Talented musicians from Taigh Dhonnchaidh, North Lewis’ music school, will treat you to some traditional music and beautiful Gaelic song, while also learning traditional Scottish Country Dancing: feel free to watch a demonstration or give it a go yourself!

Title: Clan MacQuarrie Community Centre & The Niseach Chef
Description: An experience filled with mouth-watering delicacies, refreshing drams and heartwarming stories of local traditions, accompanied by the call of the bagpipes. One of our expert local chefs, Allan Macritichie (The Niseach Chef), will showcase a delicious six-course tasting menu featuring some of North Lewis’ famous dishes, interspersed with the chef’s personal stories behind their dishes. The experience is accompanied by live traditional Scottish music, including your very own personal piper.

Title: Spòrsnis
Description: Immerse yourself in the North Lewis community while getting off the tourist trail by E-bike to witness beautiful scenery. Depending on ability, highlights include cycling through a peat cut moorland to the remote Filiscleitir church or exploring the coastline away from the roads. This is a guided ride with a local knowledgeable member of the community who will share stories of the past and present.

Title: Air an Lot (Donald ‘Sweeny’ MacSween)
Description: The local historical society and ‘Air an Lot’ have joined forces to bring you an intriguing insight into life in the past, as well as how these traditions are incorporated into life today. Visit Donald MacSween and his nearest and dearest four-legged friends by a peat-smoked fire and move on to meet the friendly team at Comunn Eachdraidh Nis who will invite you in to showcase their hub of charming and important artefacts and stories of the past.

Title: Comunn Eachdraidh Nis
Description: Steeped in fascinating local history and cultural traditions, North Lewis offers visitors an intriguing insight into life in the past, as well as how these traditions are incorporated into life today. The friendly team at Comunn Eachdraidh Nis, the oldest historical society in the Western Isles, invite your clients to join them in their cultural hub showcasing charming and important artefacts and stories of the past. Choose from a range of different packages,

Title: Eden Mill St Andrews
Supplier Types: Carrier|Exclusive Use|Food and Drink|Luxury|Private Tours|Visitor Attraction
Description: Situated on the banks of the Eden Estuary overlooking the picturesque town of St Andrews, Eden Mill distillers of premium gin and Single Malt Scotch Whisky. Our new visitor center will provide 5-star experiences and an excellent venue for visitors from all over the world to enjoy the Spirit of St. Andrews.

Title: Number 10 Hotel
Description:
Located in Glasgow’s Southside, only 10 minutes from the city centre, Number 10 Hotel is the perfect base whether you are visiting Glasgow for business or pleasure.
Feel at home in one of our beautifully appointed rooms with views over Queen’s Park or garden. We have various rooms to choose from and you’ll find every modern convenience in these comfortable, yet elegant rooms – from comfy beds and lovely bathrooms with luxury toiletries to wi-fi and tea and coffee making facilities.

Title: Clyde Charters
Description:
Clyde Charters, based in Kip Marina, Inverkip, less than an hour from Glasgow Airport, is the premier provider of boat tours and private charters on the stunning Clyde. Offering a unique perspective of Scotland’s historic west coast, your guests will experience the natural beauty, maritime heritage, and wildlife of the region from the water.
All trips are weather-dependent, Clyde Charters is known for their friendly, accommodating service and local knowledge. Hot drinks and a toilet are available on board.
Trips range from 2 hours to full day trips to full day bespoke trips to Holy Isle, Lochranza, Tarbert, Arrochar and Portavardie.

Title: John O’Groats Mill
Description: Experience traditional Scottish milling at the John O’Groats Mill, a community-owned working watermill in the far north of Scotland. Boasting 1000 years of history, this unique heritage site offers friendly and engaging guided tours where your clients can learn about local foods and crofting, while witnessing the mill’s historic machinery come to life. On the route of the popular NC500, just a stones-throw from the John O’Groats signpost, we are fully accessible, with hot drinks, craft gifts, and coach parking.

Title: Glad Rags Events
Description:
Glad Rags Events is an Aberdeenshire based entirely mobile activity provider working alongside clients creating bespoke, unique, fully managed immersive fun experiences and packages for groups all over Scotland. 
Product Offerings - Highland Games - In “clans” enjoy the famous Scottish traditions of tossing the caber, throwing the hammer etc.  Archery, Axe Throwing, Air Rifle, Air Pistol Shooting, Clay Shooting, Whisky and Gin Tasting. All the interactive activities work well for multigenerational, small or large groups. Full Event Management available.

Title: Scottish Citylink Coaches
Description: Citylink is Scotland’s leading coach operator, connecting over 200 towns, cities, and communities. From bustling hubs like Glasgow and Edinburgh to the Highlands and Islands, Citylink makes it easy to explore Scotland in comfort and at great value. With spacious seating, generous luggage allowance, and frequent services, it’s the best way to travel for both short breaks and longer adventures. Whether for sightseeing, events or visiting friends and family, Citylink helps you see more of Scotland.

Title: Lerwick Hotel
Description:
Central Modern 34 bedroom hotel with Bay Brasserie Restaurant overlooking Breiwick Bay. International and local cuisine. Situated on the scenic shoreline, Lerwick Hotel. Enjoy spectacular views, stunning coastal walks and amazing wildlife including seals, seabirds and occasionally orcas.
Ample free parking

Title: Jerusalem Farm Pods
Description: Four luxury, self-catering glamping pods offer your clients tranquil stays on this working farm in the heart of East Lothian. Accommodating two adults max, each is equipped with all your clients require. They are ideally situated for access to all East Lothian attractions; distilleries, market towns etc. Within an hour of Edinburgh Airport, and approximately 2.5hours from DFDS Newcastle. They offer your clients free high speed satellite Wi-fi, free parking, including minibuses and bike storage facility. The farm caters for FITs and small groups of up to eight adults.

Title: Alainn Tours
Description: Founded in 1991, Alainn Tours crafts journeys where every detail tells a story. Specialists in bespoke holidays for French-speaking travelers, we design experiences steeped in charm, from castle stays to cozy B&Bs and elegant hotels. Each partner is handpicked for excellence, ensuring comfort, warmth, and authenticity. Guided by passion and decades of expertise, our devoted team weaves unforgettable memories, offering attentive care seven days a week: before, during, and after your enchanting Scottish escape.

Title: Wild Hebridean Swimming
Description: Emma runs wild swimming retreats on the Isles of Mull, Iona and Islay, curating itineraries that brings together people from all over the world with a common love of open water swimming At the heart of her retreats is a deep connection to nature, wellbeing and community. A qualified experienced coach, she welcomes all abilities from cold water dippers to experienced adventure swimmers. Getting to Mull is via a scenic train ride or drive from Glasgow and Edinburgh airports and a short ferry crossing from Oban.

Title: Action Adventure Activities Ltd
Description:
Action Adventure Activities is a family run Outdoor Centre on the edge of the Loch Lomond & Trossachs National Park. We provide a variety of experiences including Climbing, Abseiling, Archery, Air Pistols, Crossbow, Axe Throwing, Gorge Walking, River Tubing, Canyoning, 4x4 Off Road Driving, Quad Biking, Highland Games and Team Building for FITs, groups and corporate clients.
Many activities take place at our base at Easterhill Farm and we provide transport from our base for all our off site activities.
Centrally located around 40 minutes from Glasgow, 30 minutes from Stirling and just over an hour from Edinburgh.

Title: Scottish Guided Tours
Description:
Scottish Guided Tours is an independent, family-run operator offering private day and multi-day tours
across Scotland. With generations of local knowledge, we craft authentic, flexible itineraries for travel
professionals. Our expert driver-guides and brand-new touring vehicles deliver seamless, high-quality
experiences, showcasing iconic sights, hidden gems, history and folklore for your clients. Slàinte!

Title: Scottish Rogue
Supplier Types: Carrier|Events|Food and Drink|Private Tours|Tour Operator|Walking Tours
Description:
Scottish Rogue are creators of unique whisky experiences, with a distinctly Glaswegian vibe.
Through our whisky tours, tastings, and events, we connect whisky lovers and the whisky curious with fantastic Scottish culture.
Delivered by locals, passionately promoting Glasgow and Scotland as unique visitor destinations..
No visit to Scotland is complete without first-hand experience of Scotch whisky, and there’s no better place to connect than Glasgow. Scottish Rogue are the perfect hosts for a unique Glaswegian whisky experience.

Title: Luss Distillery
Description: Located in the picturesque village of Luss on the shores of Loch Lomond, Luss Distillery is home to Ben Lomond Gin and Loch Lomond Whiskies, offering group-friendly experiences for tour operators and FIT travellers. With easy coach parking and a welcoming café for multiple groups, it’s ideal for bespoke or private visits. Less than an hour from Glasgow Airport, the distillery lets clients enjoy immersive gin distillery tours and whisky tastings in one of Scotland’s most accessible scenic destinations.

Title: East Neuk Seaweed
Description: East Neuk Seaweed runs tide-led seaweed-foraging and wild-cooking experiences on the Fife coast, twenty minutes from St Andrews, led personally by forager and chef Jayson Byles. Guests walk out onto a shore that only exists at low tide, harvest it with their own hands, and eat what they gathered cooked over fire on the beach. Formats run from the 90-minute Seaweed Taster for coach groups of up to 40 to the four-hour on the Rocks for up to 12, plus the indoor Coastal Dram whisky masterclass, year-round. Bookable on FareHarbor with trade codes; 25% commission; FAM visits welcome.

Title: Kilmartin Museum
Description:
We provide a friendly and knowledgeable welcome for clients wishing to experience 12,000 years of history! Explore our museum and the 800 prehistoric and historic monuments in the surrounding landscape. We are group and FITs friendly, with drop off areas for coaches. Offering bespoke museum and walking tours and object handling sessions to enhance your clients’ visit to a fully accessible building.
Situated on the A816 road between Oban and Lochgilphead within easy reach of Glasgow, Stirling and Fort William.

Title: Take to the Water
Description: I am thrilled to introduce you to Take to the Water where we specialize in cold water dipping. Your guests will take away the euphoric memories from their journey of discovery of themselves, the history, culture and culinary delights Scotland has to offer. Based in the Scottish Borders our wild swim adventures range from 1 hour to full day trips around the Lothians, Borders or Fife but with our extensive knowledge of swim options around Scotland a bespoke trip further afield can be easily arranged.

Title: Tartan Viking Tours
Description:
Tartan Viking Tours, based in Edinburgh, offers completely bespoke private tours throughout the United Kingdom. Our kilted driver guides have a genuine passion for their country and will make every journey a truly memorable one. We offer bookings in groups of up to 16 people, all ages, and itineraries are designed with the client’s needs and interests at heart. 
We pride ourselves on being the highest-rated private tour company in Scotland on TripAdvisor.

Title: Largo Castaway Sauna
Description: Largo Castaway Sauna is a wood-fired outdoor sauna set by the sea on the Fife coast. Offering breath-taking coastal views, it provides a relaxing, authentic sauna experience that combines heat, fresh sea air and optional cold-water dips. Ideal for wellness seekers, couples, small groups and FIT, the sauna is perfect year-round for unwinding, recharging and enjoying Scotland’s natural beauty in a unique, tranquil setting.

Title: Supercity Aparthotels, Forth House Edinburgh
Description: Forth House by Supercity is a newly opened, premium aparthotel in Edinburgh’s New Town, offering spacious studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom suites, many with terraces. Each apartment features a fully equipped kitchen, washer/dryer, fast Wi-Fi, air conditioning, and access to a 24-hour reception, with limited parking available. Just steps from St James Quarter, Edinburgh Waverley, Princes Street, and major cultural landmarks. Guests praise the modern design, cleanliness, and convenience, making it ideal for both short and long stays. Whether you’re visiting for business, a city break, or an extended stay, our stylish and contemporary apartments provide the perfect base to experience the best of Edinburgh.

Title: Upper Dysart Larder
Description:
At Upper Dysart Larder, we offer an immersive farm experience that blends hands on animal encounters, a guided farm tour and a field to fork tasting of our flavoured potato mash — made right here on our family farm overlooking Lunan Bay.
Right off the A92 between Montrose and Arbroath we are group friendly with easy coach parking. We offer hot drinks and hot meals from our Larder Kitchen with indoor seating for up to 24 with potential for multiple sittings.

Title: Rebel Row by Prickly Thistle Mill
Description:
Rebel Row is the flagship store of Prickly Thistle Mill, based in the heart of Old Inverness. Our Mill was established in 2018, where we design and weave beautiful tartans and design and sew zero waste stunning women’s clothing. Proudly local, we also offer immersive experiences including weaving workshops, mill tours, talks, personal shopping and designing your own tartan. Some exclusive to tour partners. 
 Our work has travelled far beyond Inverness, with commissions for Sam Heughan’s Sassenach, The Witches of Scotland, Fendi, and appearances on screen from My Happy Place to The Traitors.

Title: Paisley Museum - OneRen
Supplier Types: Ancestral|Carrier|Exclusive Use|Food and Drink|Private Tours|Visitor Attraction
Description:
Paisley Museum has been transformed into a radical new cultural attraction - an architectural marvel offering an authentic and interactive experience celebrating the bold spirit of Paisley.
From the globally iconic Paisley pattern to local hero William Wallace and the poetry of Robert Burns, the museum weaves together Scottish stories of creativity, rebellion, and heritage. Located minutes from Glasgow Airport and 10 minutes from Glasgow’s city centre, it’s the heartbeat of a town alive with history, art, and community.

Title: Orkney Seaglass Crafts
Description:
New for 2026 – Seaglass Safaris!
Your guests will love this opportunity to scavenge & gather some precious sea-glass and beach pottery from our fabulous shores here in Orkney!
Small Groups – 6 max
£30 pp, 90min, will include refreshment & snack 
Summer months: June/July & Aug, time depends on tide!

Title: Tour Partner Group
Description: Tour Partner Group is a leading DMC for Scotland, England, Wales, Ireland, the Nordics and Baltics. We bring together 500 destination specialists, designing B2B travel for Groups and FIT. We are experts in creating authentic, impact conscious experiences and memories that last a lifetime. With offices in Edinburgh, London, Dublin, and Copenhagen, we proudly serve as destination specialists within the regions we promote. Our mission is to deliver personally tailored, authentic tours. Perfectly.

Title: voco Grand Central
Description: voco Grand Central is a premium leisure hotel located within Glasgow’s landmark Central Station, offering direct access to the city’s key attractions, shopping districts, and transport links. Combining heritage architecture with modern design, the hotel provides comfortable accommodation, refined dining, and a high standard of service. Ideal for city breaks and weekend travel, voco Grand Central delivers a seamless, well-connected stay for leisure guests seeking convenience, comfort, and an authentic Glasgow experience.

Title: Kimpton Blythswood Square Hotel & Spa
Description: Kimpton Blythswood Square is a distinguished luxury hotel in the heart of Glasgow, known for its exceptional leisure experience and refined service. Housed in a historic building, it combines elegant design with contemporary comfort and world-class amenities. Perfectly positioned near premier shopping, cultural attractions, and city highlights, the hotel appeals to discerning leisure travellers seeking sophistication and relaxation. With acclaimed dining, a luxurious spa, and personalised hospitality, Kimpton Blythswood Square delivers an outstanding, memorable stay in Glasgow’s most vibrant district.

Title: Orkneyinga Tours
Supplier Types: Carrier|Cruising/Shore Excursions|Exclusive Use|Private Tours|Tour Operator|Walking Tours
Description:
Private, bespoke tours across the Orkney Isles for small groups, families, couples, and solo 
travellers. Your clients will enjoy unforgettable experiences with an expert local guide as they 
explore Orkney’s rich past and present. Drawing on a lifetime of local knowledge, itineraries 
are carefully tailored to suit your clients’ interests, pace, and requirements. 
We can also work discreetly with clients to plan a surprise proposal, creating their perfect 
island love story.  
Available year-round as a driver-guide or step-on guide.

Title: Cranachan Cafe
Description: Cranachan Café is an independent, family-run restaurant in the heart of Glasgow, celebrating Scottish produce and culinary tradition. Well suited to group operators and FIT, the café offers flexible menus and efficient service for pre-booked groups and independent travellers. Group menus available as well as private use for us to 40 guests.  Enjoy traditional Scottish dishes alongside breakfasts, light lunches, and quality coffee. Located within 5 minutes walk from both Central and Queen Street train stations.

Title: Blackwoods Distillery
Supplier Types: Carrier|Cruising/Shore Excursions|Exclusive Use|Food and Drink|Private Tours|Visitor Attraction
Description:
Crafting authentic Scottish Dry Gin and Vodka since 2003, Blackwoods Distillery offers a range of experiences including: Tours & Tastings, Cocktail Masterclass or distilling a personalised bottle of gin at our Gin School.
Our gift shop stocks a wonderful selection of thoughtful gifts and exclusive limited-edition bottlings alongside our drinks lounge offering a wide range of cocktails.
Based on the historic Bankfoot Farm, Blackwoods Distillery is a 35-minute drive from Glasgow Airport and 15 minutes from Greenock Cruise Terminal.

Title: Borderland Food Tours
Description: Borderland Food Tours are culinary & cultural experiences led by local award-winning restauranteurs. Set in the Borders, one hour south of Edinburgh, the tours celebrate the region’s rich agricultural heritage, turbulent history, and stunning landscapes through locally sourced food and drink. Guests can enjoy insider access to local producers, authentic Borderlands hospitality, and engaging stories that connect the food & drink to the land, waters, and people of this distinctive England–Scotland frontier. Tastes & tales from where Scotland begins.

Title: Senja-Art
Description: Based on The Isle of Arran, ‘Scotland in Miniature’, Senja Art provides bespoke art experiences led by expert seascape artist Senja Brendon. With 40 years of expertise, Senja offers intimate workshops ranging from half day sessions to multi-day “plein air” journeys. Guests receive professional tutelage in a private studio or stunning coastal locations. These all-inclusive experiences cater to individuals or small groups, including all materials and refreshments.

Title: Space to Stay
Description: A collection of premium self-catering studios and apartments, for stays in St Andrews. We offer a range of fully furnished ensuite accommodations, including Signature Studio, Double Bedroom, Large King Studio, Large Twin Studio, One Bedroom Apartment, Two Bedroom Apartment, and Four Bedroom Apartment options.

Title: Errington’s Barn Ltd
Description: Home to our award‑winning farmhouse sheep and goat’s milk cheeses, Errington’s Barn is a sustainable, family‑run farm offering an authentic rural experience in the heart of Scotland. Visitors can enjoy guided farm tours, tastings and cheesemaking demonstrations, alongside a café and retail space showcasing local producers. Ideal for food‑focused itineraries and cultural excursions, we accommodate private FIT visits and larger coach groups seeking a distinctive, high‑quality farm‑to‑table attraction. T

Title: The Mount Royal Hotel Edinburgh
Description:
Located on Edinburgh’s iconic Princes Street, overlooking Edinburgh Castle our hotel boasts a prime city-centre location that appeals to incentive, leisure, and corporate guests. Featuring 169 newly refurbished bedrooms, ranging from Cosy Comfort to Superior Castle View, guests can enjoy uninterrupted vistas of Edinburgh’s historic skyline.
By spring 2026, the hotel looks forward to unveiling a newly designed destination bar and restaurant, offering guests an enhanced breakfast experience alongside a vibrant, timeless venue to enjoy a classic cocktail or unwind.

Title: Lindores Abbey Distillery
Description: Lindores Abbey Distillery stands on the historic site of an ancient abbey in Fife, around an hour’s drive from Edinburgh. Long regarded as the spiritual home of Scotch whisky, it is where the first recorded whisky was made in 1494. The distillery produces award-winning single malt whiskies and is home to a popular visitor experience that celebrates history, craft, and place. Guided tours of the distillery and historic ruins are available for small or large groups, including private visits.

Title: The Forfar Witches Story – Guided Walk
Description:
Explore Forfar’s dark past and experience the shocking true story of the Forfar Witches. The Forfar Witch Trials took place between 1661-1663. 42 of the town’s inhabitants were imprisoned and tortured on suspicion of witchcraft, and 22 women were found guilty and executed. 

Forfar is close to Dundee along the eastern route to the Angus Glens and Highlands in the North. The Forfar Witches Story guided walk is a one-of-a-kind experience, starting and ending in the historic Meffan Museum, where your clients can enjoy the exhibits and galleries featuring contemporary art exhibitions.

Title: Forfar Meffan Museum & Art Gallery
Description:
The Meffan Museum & Art Gallery is in the centre of Forfar opened in 1898. We welcome groups and FIT. Your clients can explore the narrow and cobbled Vennel, and step back in time. Catch a glimpse of Peter Reid’s sweet shop, or the baker removing the famous Forfar bridies from the oven. Find out about the Forfar witch trials and view the mysterious Pictish sculptured stones, Goosecroft log boat dated to 1090AD and fascinating archaeology found in the area.
The gallery displays the work of local, national and internationally renowned artists making up an exciting programme of changing exhibitions throughout the year.

Title: Montrose Museum
Description:
Montrose Museum, one of Scotland’s earliest purpose-built museums, is a unique experience for art lovers and those looking for an authentic heritage experience. 
Four galleries display an array of historical artefacts featuring tales of the Jacobite uprisings, Napoleonic Wars and Scottish witch trials. Your clients can view artworks including a recently verified portrait by Allan Ramsay, a stunning landscape painting by Edward Baird and two beautifully preserved Pictish stones.
Suitable for Groups and FIT and ideally situated on the scenic coastal route midway between Dundee and Stonehaven. Guided tours are arranged to suit your clients’ needs.

Title: Cairngorm Gin Distillery
Supplier Types: Exclusive Use|Food and Drink|Private Tours|Visitor Attraction
Description: Located in Aviemore within the breathtaking Cairngorms National Park, Cairngorm Gin Distillery offers an authentic Highland experience for groups and independent travellers. Home to Cairngorm Gin Company, the distillery features a welcoming tasting room and shop where guests can sample award-winning gins and purchase locally inspired spirits. Visitors can also enjoy views into the working distillery, gaining insight into the craft behind every bottle in one of Scotland’s most scenic destinations.

Title: MEININGER Hotels Edinburgh Haymarket
Description: MEININGER Hotels is excited to open doors in Edinburgh’s vibrant Haymarket area from October 2026! Already a highly successful and rapidly expanding brand, we currently operate in 12 countries, across 31 cities with 41 hotels. Our unique hybrid hotel concept emphasizes ensuite multi-bedded and private rooms at great rates. We specialize in educational groups, but welcome leisure groups, event stays, and beyond. With 157 rooms and 549 beds, we expect to be a great addition to the Edinburgh accommodation list.

Title: Monikie Country Park
Description:
Monikie Country Park, located close to Dundee, boasts beautiful woodland and parkland with a variety of activities for your clients to enjoy, including the new Angus Aqua Splash, an inflatable obstacle course, adventurous land and water activities, self-led and guided trails, BBQ hire and an adventure play park for the kids.
Activities available within the park include rafting, windsurfing, sailing, kayaking, canoeing, paddleboarding and mountain biking. Qualified staff can offer guided sessions, and watersports equipment can be hired throughout the summer.
Denfind Bird Sanctuary is also an ideal place to view a variety of wetland birds throughout the year.

Title: Crombie Country Park
Description: Nestled in the rolling Angus countryside, 25 minutes from Dundee, Crombie Country Park is a peaceful rural escape centred around a beautiful freshwater loch. Known for its tranquil atmosphere, abundant wildlife and big skies, it offers your clients the chance to slow down and reconnect with nature. Whether it’s a quiet walk through woodland, lochside fishing, birdwatching or simply enjoying the stillness, Crombie stands out for its unspoilt setting and sense of space. It’s an authentic slice of rural Scotland – understated, welcoming and refreshingly uncrowded – ideal for visitors seeking calm, nature and time outdoors away from the main tourist trail.

Title: Folkerton Mill
Description: Folkerton Mill is a private, exclusive-use retreat located just over 30 minutes from Glasgow in South Lanarkshire. We specialise in high-quality wellness and experiential programmes for FIT travellers and small private groups, offering privacy, comfort, and a strong sense of place. Our trade-only experiences range from short immersive visits to multi-day retreats and are ideal for premium itineraries seeking unique Scottish culture, tranquillity, and curated, high-touch experiences delivered through trusted travel trade partners.

Title: The Lost Close
Supplier Types: Carrier|Events|Food and Drink|Private Tours|Visitor Attraction|Walking Tours
Description: The Lost Close is one of Edinburgh’s most intriguing underground discoveries located behind St Giles’ Cathedral. Once Scotland’s first purpose-built bank vault in the 18th century and one of the few structures to survive the Great Fire of 1824. Today, this historic venue forms a subterranean space offering premium, storytelling led whisky and gin tasting experiences, blending heritage, character, and craftsmanship in an atmospheric setting. There are two unique spaces plus an intimate whisky bar. The Close (capacity 6 pax). The Vault (capacity 12 pax). Private groups - travel trade information pdf available with latest net rates.

Title: Dalnaglar Castle
Description: Dalnaglar Castle is the perfect exclusive-use venue for groups seeking both privacy and accessibility. Set within the stunning Cairngorms National Park, the castle offers a breathtaking Highland backdrop for corporate retreats, incentive trips, and private events, while still being conveniently close to Scotland’s major transport hubs. Guests can combine productive meetings or team-building activities with the natural beauty and adventure of the estate, creating a truly memorable experience that blends business, leisure, and the timeless charm of a historic Scottish castle.

Title: Birchwood Pitlochry
Description:
Birchwood Pitlochry is an intimate Victorian baronial boutique hotel set within two acres of woodland in the heart of Highland Perthshire. Recently restored with great care, it blends traditional character with contemporary comfort, offering beautifully renovated bedrooms and a strong sense of place. 
With resident only dining focused on Scottish seasonal produce, the hotel provides a warm, homely atmosphere. Ideal for two  or three night stays, it suits travellers seeking authentic Highland experiences, nature, heritage, and relaxed cultural exploration.

Title: Bothy Distillery
Description: Set on a historic whisky smuggling route in the Angus Glens, the Bothy Distillery is newly established, small-batch distillery offering intimate, story-led visitor experiences rooted in landscape, heritage and rural tradition. Guests are welcomed into a working distillery where craft, history and sense of place come together. With small group size tastings, tours and tailored experiences, it provides an authentic, immersive Scottish whisky and spirits experience for both FIT and specialist travel trade programmes.

Title: The Tall Ship Glenlee
Description: The Tall Ship Glenlee is a beautifully preserved Clyde-built sailing vessel berthed at Riverside Glasgow. Offering a rare blend of maritime heritage, hands-on experiences, and distinctive event spaces, Glenlee is a stand out attraction for travel trade clients seeking authentic, immersive Scottish experiences. Ideal for groups, FIT travellers, and special events. Glenlee combines history, education, and hospitality in a truly unforgettable setting on the River Clyde. Central Glasgow location with coach parking nearby.

Title: R Robertson and Son Ltd
Description:
We're Shetland's largest tour and transport operator, driven by experience since 1947. Our fleet ranges from 4 to 57 seats, allowing us to offer transport services to individuals and groups of all sizes.
In addition to our transport services, we offer shore excursions and shorex handling, executive services for visiting officials, executives and high-end travellers, private, group, and FIT tours, package coach holidays to Shetland and a full range of destination management services for tour operators visiting Shetland.”

Title: Taymouth Marina
Description: Your clients can experience a unique Loch side Spa resort on the banks of Loch Tay featuring self-catering accommodation, Houseboats, wild wellness spa’s, floating and cruising sauna, Ferryman’s restaurant and seasonal watersports.

Title: Summit to Sea Adventures
Description:
Summit to Sea Adventures offers bespoke private guided kayaking, walking and driver-guided history tours in English and Dutch in the breathtaking Orkney Islands. 
Whether your customers are independent travelers,  families, or part of a group, our private bespoke tours and scheduled trips are designed to connect with the spirit of these stunning islands; their wild coastlines, rich heritage and hidden stories. Our kayaking trips are for all levels of experience, from complete beginners to seasoned paddlers.

Title: Carronvale House
Description: Carronvale House in Larbert is a charming historic Scottish country house offering comfortable hostel-style accommodation and mini golf on the front lawn, all with traditional character. Ideal for group stays of 10 guests or more, it features 19 ensuite rooms with capacity for up to 40 guests. Guests enjoy a warm Scottish welcome, catering options available, car and coach parking. Conveniently located between Edinburgh and Glasgow, blending accessibility with tranquillity for an authentic and memorable Scottish group experience stay.

Title: The House in the Hill
Description:
The House in the Hill is a new luxury, off-grid holiday property perfect for small private groups (up to 4) or couples visiting the south of Scotland. With 360° views of the Scottish Borders that will blow your clients away and a rooftop terrace for stargazing up at Dark Skies, the property is a 10-minute drive from the historic town of Jedburgh, 
mere yards from the Roman road ‘Dere Street’ and located in what was once wild 
Border Reiver country.

Title: Jainvoyagers Limited
Description:
JainVoyagers is a travel trade-ready destination management company supporting Scotland 
programmes for FIT, private groups, and special-interest travel. We work with tour operators, travel 
advisors, and group organisers to deliver tailor-made itineraries, transfers, guided touring, attraction 
bookings, and culturally aware meal planning. Programmes can be arranged across key Scottish 
gateways including Edinburgh, Glasgow, and Inverness, with flexible support for bespoke journeys and 
trade-ready pricing on application.

Title: MacGregor and MacDuff
Description: We are the world’s leading highland wear supplier, specialising in kiltmaking and kilt hire since 1979. We offer your clients a completely bespoke and unique experience depending on their requirements. Groups will be welcomed into our flagship store in Glasgow’s city centre to discover the craft of kiltmaking and the fascinating history of tartan. A member of the group will be offered to try on a full highland wear outfit, making for an excellent photo opportunity. Attendees can also explore their Scottish ancestry to find their family tartan.

Title: JA Mar Hall
Description: JA Mar Hall is a five-star sanctuary of Scottish luxury, located just a 10-minute drive from Glasgow Airport. Set within 240 acres of tranquil estate, the hotel offers a blend of comfort and elegance across 65 luxurious bedrooms. Guests can enjoy beautifully reimagined dining spaces, distinctive event venues, indulgent spa treatments, and an 18-hole championship golf course.

Title: JA Bruntsfield
Description: JA The Bruntsfield Hotel overlooks the leafy Bruntsfield Links park and is just a 15-minute walk from Edinburgh’s city centre. This stylish boutique townhouse features 74 bedrooms in a range of categories and sizes, making it ideal for city breaks. In addition to its comfortable accommodation, the hotel offers versatile event spaces and a welcoming “Neighborhood” restaurant and bar, serving the best of Scottish cuisine.

Title: ArmstrongTours
Description: ArmstrongTours offers immersive, story-driven private tours across the Scottish Borders and beyond, led by Adam Armstrong-Crisp, a proud member of Clan Armstrong. Blending history, heritage, and personal storytelling, each tour brings the Border Reivers to life through authentic locations and lived connection. With over eight years of experience and outstanding reviews, ArmstrongTours provides a unique, off-the-beaten-track journey into Scotland’s past, guided with passion, knowledge, and the spirit of the Lone Reiver.

Title: Rothes Glen
Description: Rothes Glen in Speyside, Scotland, is a stunning exclusively-use castle retreat with 14 en suite king bedrooms. Guests can enjoy elegant living spaces, a library, snooker and tasting rooms, a whisky vault, and a tower room. Explore nearby distilleries to a rich whisky heritage, or enjoy outdoor activities like fishing, falconry, shooting, and scenic countryside walks.

Title: Uan Wool
Description:
Uan Wool offers hands-on wool experiences and authentic wool wares.  Introducing visitors to Scottish wools through a range of creative, accessible crafting activities such as wet and dry needle felting.  Experiences are fully flexible and can be tailored for individual travelers or small groups, from informal farm encounters to guided demonstrations and practical workshops.
Uan wool provides an accessible way to explore local craft culture, rural heritage and create a unique item to take home 
Located between Lintrathen Loch and the Backwater Reservoir by Glen Isla, Angus.   Edinburgh Airport 80 minutes, Aberdeen Airport 90 minutes and Dundee 45 minutes

Title: Auch Estate
Description: Traditional Hill Farm at Auch Estates offers peaceful self-catering accommodation in the Scottish countryside, with cozy cabins and cottages surrounded by nature. Home to 9,000+ Blackface sheep, 50 friendly Highland Cows and stunning rural landscapes, it’s the perfect escape for couples, families and those looking to relax and unwind. For shorter breaks, enjoy our Trail Cabin en-suite rooms, while our secluded cottages are ideal for longer countryside stays.

Title: Provan Hall Community Management Trust
Description: Provan Hall is one of Glasgow’s oldest buildings. With 500 years of history and notable residents including royal courtiers, bewitched poets and Titanic survivors, Provan Hall has fascinating stories to tell. More recently used as a filming location for the Outlander series. Journey through 16th century dressed rooms, explore the formal gardens and watch out for ghosts. And with our trade specific workshop “the witches brew” , we have  created a fantastic experience for your clients. Open Thursdays – Sundays 10am – 4pm with free entry. Bespoke private tours and workshops available. Private hire available. Coach friendly. Gift shop.

Title: Glenstriven House
Description: Glenstriven House sits in 500 acres of pristine woodlands and moors on the banks of Loch Striven. The Victorian hunting lodge was elegantly and extensively restored in 2020 and offers 7 luxurious, ensuite bedrooms, numerous entertaining spaces and even a private pub on the estate. Watersports, hill-walking, stalking and shooting are all available at Glenstriven making this the perfect home-from-home for discerning guests looking for refined tranquility in an idyllic setting. Self-catering, or a private chef is available by arrangement

Title: Jackton Distillery
Description: This family-run gem in the Scottish Lowlands was originally a barley store, later a community sports hall, now a fully accessible site hosting immersive distillery tours (1-60 guests), tastings, overnight stays, VIP experiences and lively events. Get hands-on taste barley, try milling, nose casks and breathe in the angel’s share in the whisky bond! The Tasting Bar serves everything from coffee to cocktails, suiting all tastes. Open 7 days. Winners of TripAdvisor Travellers’ Choice 2026, Green Tourism and Scotch Whisky Awards, with 5-star ratings across major platforms - Jackton Distillery offers an unmissable experience for guests, guides and drivers alike.

Title: Wild Shore Dundee
Description:
Located at City Quay in the heart of Dundee, Wild Shore is the perfect day out for families, groups of friends and individuals. Whether learning to wakeboard, taking on our floating Aqua Park course, or exploring the City Quay on a SUP board, Wild Shore has something for all ages and abilities. 
We can accommodate private groups of up to 60 on Aqua Park, or public sessions for smaller groups. Wakeboarding lessons will always be exclusive for your clients.

Title: Foxlake Adventures
Description:
Located in the heart of East Lothian, Foxlake is set within the beautiful wooded John Muir Way. 
Foxlake is the ideal adventure destination for family fun, unforgettable days out with friends, and thrill seekers. Time to reset? Relax lakeside with our wood-fired Sauna & Cold Plunge, or take in the views from our café deck. 
Your clients can dive head-first into their chosen activity, fully immersed in our natural landscape, guided every step of the way by our expert team.

Title: The Experience Golf
Description: The Experience Golf, part of Lyvera Group, is a specialist Scottish golf travel operator delivering curated, high-quality itineraries across iconic courses. Through a long-standing agreement with St Andrews Links Trust, it offers guaranteed Old Course tee times. Working with international tour operators and agents, it provides comprehensive planning, including tee times, luxury accommodation, transport and concierge services. Programmes are tailored to client interests, combining championship golf with culture, gastronomy and sightseeing, supported by expert local knowledge through their on-the-ground team and trusted partners.

Title: The Scottish Craft School
Description: Nestled in rural Scotland, the Central Scotland School of Craft offers discerning travellers an opportunity to experience Scotland through exceptional craftsmanship, cultural connection, and immersive creativity. Based in the historic cathedral town of Dunblane, near Stirling and within easy reach of Edinburgh and Glasgow, our inspiring studio hosts hands-on workshops rooted in heritage, sustainability, and contemporary Scottish craft. Led by skilled artisans, experiences include bookbinding, printmaking, textiles, and traditional making techniques, creating memorable and authentic souvenirs of Scotland.
Address Line 1: Central Scotland School of Craft, Craft Central,

Title: Luxe Scot
Description:
Based in Aberdeenshire, Luxe Scot is a premium Scottish transport specialist, delivering luxury chauffeur-driven transfers, bespoke experiences and event solutions across the country.  Our diverse fleet ranges from exclusive 4-seater Jet-Class vehicles to a 34-seater VIP coach, enabling us to cater for a wide variety of requirements. 
Beyond transport, Luxe Scot offers fully bespoke touring and event services. Our private experiences showcase Scotland’s North and East Coast and our dedicated events team delivers everything from luxury transport integration to full event execution.

Title: Jetlogic
Description: Based in Edinburgh, Jetlogic provides private jet and helicopter charter solutions throughout Scotland and worldwide, helping you create seamless and memorable journeys for your clients. Whether arranging airport transfers, access to remote destinations, scenic flights or transport for larger groups, we work closely with you to deliver tailored aviation solutions that enhance itineraries, maximise time in destination and create exceptional travel experiences.

Title: Go Travel Scotland Ltd
Description: Go Travel Scotland is a family-run luxury coach tour operator, providing high-quality sightseeing, transport services, and wedding car hire across Scotland and the wider United Kingdom. We offer comfortable, modern coach travel designed for seamless touring, with a strong focus on reliability, professionalism, and guest experience. We work closely with trade partners and welcome both organised groups and individual independent travellers, including bespoke and private group travel. All services operate exclusively within the United Kingdom, delivering well-organised, memorable travel experiences with flexible options and easy coach access.

Title: The Wee Kitchen Cookery School Limited
Supplier Types: Activity|Carrier|Cruising/Shore Excursions|Food and Drink|Private Tours|Visitor Attraction
Description: The Wee Kitchen Cookery School offers hands-on Scottish cooking experiences in Leith, Edinburgh, suitable for FIT travellers, private groups and shore excursions. Guests prepare traditional Scottish recipes before enjoying a shared meal in a relaxed, small-group setting. Located around 15 minutes from Edinburgh city centre, the experience is available as scheduled public classes or private departures, with vegetarian and other dietary requirements accommodated.
Address Line 1: Cyrenians Flavour and Haver Cook School

Title: Tomb of the Eagles
Description:
Your clients can enjoy visiting two prehistoric monuments, enjoy Orkney’s beautiful landscape through a 1.5km nature walk to the Neolithic Tomb, and a visitor centre with museum, toilet facilities and light refreshments available.
The site is open daily between 10:00 and 17:00, with last admissions at 3.30pm. We welcome small to medium (32 seat maximum) coaches with dedicated parking and upon request, a tour of the site. Visitors at Tomb of the Eagles can expect to enjoy archaeology, stunning landscapes and Scottish hospitality.

Title: St. Andrews Coach Houses
Description: Discover St. Andrews Coach Houses, a luxury countryside retreat on a fourth-generation family farm just 10 minutes from the world-famous town of St Andrews. Offering four beautifully appointed properties sleeping up to 18 guests, it's ideal for groups, golfing breaks and wellness escapes. Guests can reconnect with nature while enjoying modern comforts, with an activity barn, hot tub, and exciting new wellness facilities launching later in the year -including saunas and a cold-water bucket shower creating an unforgettable Scottish rural experience. Can accommodate up to 18 people across the four properties.

Title: GLA Transfers
Description: GLA Transfers provide pre-booked private airport, cruise, golf and bespoke transfers across Scotland and the UK. Your clients can travel with licensed drivers, flight tracking, child seats on request in saloon, estate, executive, Mercedes V-class or minibus options, subject to availability.

Title: Aberlour Distillery
Description:
Aberlour Distillery is nestled in the heart of Speyside, boasting a quaint charm, heritage and history.
Here, we offer intimate tasting experiences, for both the curious tourist and dedicated whisky advocate. We are undergoing exciting renovations on our tour route, meaning our tour experiences will reopen in 2028. In the interim, we welcome up to 16PAX for our tastings, for both public and private sessions, lasting between 30-75 minutes, with a preferential trade rate available for supplier clientele.

Title: Scapa Distillery
Description:
Founded in 1885 overlooking the calm historic “Scapa Flow”, Scapa is one of the northern most distilleries in Scotland, located in the Orkney Islands. 
 We are delighted to offer tours and tastings (up to 16PAX) and more recently, food-whisky pairing experiences (up to 10PAX). At Scapa Distillery, you will embark on a journey of craft and heritage, indulge in the magic of our sea-facing production, and sample the goods of local Orcadian cuisine, through both our complex whiskies and delicious cuisine.

Title: Strathisla Distillery
Description:
Our Strathisla Distillery is the oldest distillery in Speyside, boasting a range of tour experiences, tastings and even, a whisky blending class! We are the home of such brands as Chivas Regal, Royal Salute and Strathisla’s Single Malt range.
With both public and private tour experiences available to book, we are delighted to offer a preferential trade rate. We also offer special experiences for large group tours – Strathisla Distillery Tour and Tasting (48PAX); Love Strathisla Tasting (40PAX).

Title: The Glenlivet Distillery
Description:
We invite you to the heart of Scotland's whisky-making country to experience our history, and learn how our founder, George Smith, established the first licensed distillery in the Livet Valley against all odds. 
The Glenlivet Distillery will take you on a path paved in history, heritage and some great drams to boot! We offer private and public tour experiences to smaller groups (under 16PAX), and a large coach-friendly experience for up to 40PAX. Preferential trade rates available.

Title: Scottish Tour Guides Association (STGA)
Description:
The Scottish Tourist Guides Association (STGA) trains and accredits professional guides to deliver engaging, memorable experiences across Scotland.
Each guide is extensively trained and assessed, and carry full professional indemnity and public liability insurance.
With over 500 members across Scotland, our guides bring a wealth of knowledge and local expertise to every tour.
The Find Your Guide feature on the STGA website will connect you with the perfect guide for your client.

Title: The Kithmore
Description:
The Kithmore is St Andrews’ newest luxury boutique hotel, just moments from the Old Course, the beach, the heart of the town and the East Neuk of Fife. The hotel features 44 bedrooms, each with subtle heritage touches focussing on relaxed luxury.
Bennie's bar and restaurant is built around good food, focussing on best produce from the local area and Scotland. 
Inspired by the Scots word kith, meaning friendship. We welcome groups and FITs we also offer exclusive use .

Title: Scotland Soul Journeys
Description: Scotland Soul Journeys is an inbound Scottish tour operator specialising in bespoke and small group journeys to Scotland’s sacred sites, landscapes and heritage. Led by experienced Celtic Priestesses, we create authentic itineraries featuring Celtic celebrations, handfasting ceremonies, memorial experiences and immersive cultural tours. Services include private departures, escorted tours, accommodation, transport and expert local guiding throughout Scotland.

Title: International Vehicle Hire
Description: International Vehicle Hire is an independent Scottish company delivering hassle-free car and van hire across Central Scotland, with transparent pricing. Our fleet is under 12 months old and LEZ-compliant, offering hatchbacks, estates, saloons, SUVs, MPVs (6, 7 and 9 seats), plus SWB, LWB and XLWB vans. Our meet & greet service at Glasgow and Edinburgh airports ensures your client’s chosen vehicle is ready on arrival, so they can start their journey through Scotland without delay.

Title: Seaton House
Description: Seaton House is a five-star, 42-bedroom luxury hotel beside the first tee of the Old Course in St Andrews. Rooted in the rich heritage of Scotland’s Home of Golf, it blends contemporary design with a strong sense of place, offering guests a unique connection to one of Scotland’s most iconic coastal towns. Food and drink are at the heart of the experience, with the renowned Ondine Oyster & Grill and the elegant Bow Butts Bar, where guests can enjoy exceptional dining, cocktails, and fine whiskies while celebrating the best of St Andrews.

Title: Benriach Distillery
Supplier Types: Carrier|Exclusive Use|Food and Drink|Private Tours|Visitor Attraction
Description: Benriach Distillery is a premium Single Malt Whisky Distillery located just outside Elgin, in the heart of Speyside. Located within comfortable driving distance of Inverness and Aberdeen for flight or cruise links. Renowned for our creative cask maturation and three distinct spirit styles, classic unpeated, highland peated, and triple distilled. We offer immersive visitor experiences from our boutique Visitor Centre. Benriach offers tailored travel trade experiences, from introductory guided tours and warehouse visits to expertly tutored tastings featuring rare and exclusive expressions. We actively welcome partnerships, offering out-of-hours access, private bookings, and custom itineraries upon request.

Title: Moka Holidays
Description: Moka Holidays is an Edinburgh-based Scottish tour and transport partner for tour operators, DMCs and incoming agents. We provide bespoke private tours, group touring and transport for FITs, small groups and larger programmes, with a versatile 6–53 seat fleet. Close to Edinburgh Airport, we offer one flexible partner for tailor-made itineraries, private driver services and group travel throughout Scotland.

Title: Dream to Dram Tours Ltd
Description: I am a luxury golf, whisky and sightseeing transport supplier to tour operators. I own my own Mercedes sprinter bus with 8 passenger seats and act as the tour driver / guide for all my clients. I am a Scottish Thistle Award winner (Tourism & Hospitality Hero), ambassador for my region (Fife) and founder of Kingsbarns Distillery too.

Title: Roslyn House Loch Ness
Description: Roslyn House Loch Ness is an adults-only, 11-bedroom boutique guest house in Drumnadrochit, minutes from Loch Ness. Individually designed rooms combine Highland character with contemporary comfort, with seamless smart self check-in, in-room breakfast hampers, a private guest lounge and honesty bar. Ideally placed for FIT, multi-room and small-group Highland itineraries, with Inverness, Urquhart Castle and the Great Glen within easy reach.

Title: Travel Mhor Ltd
Description:
I’m Dave, owner and driver at Travel Mhor, based near Edinburgh, serving clients 
across Scotland. I provide day tours, multi-day touring, airport transfers, golf transport 
and shore excursions. My Mercedes V-Class carries one to six passengers, with four 
recommended for extra comfort. I share local knowledge and help plan routes and 
stops. Mobility and vehicle access requirements can be discussed before booking. I work directly with travel agents, tour operators and DMC's.

Title: Hopscotch Travel Limited
Description: Hopscotch Travel is an award-winning private tour operator offering bespoke, fully private guided tours across Scotland. Every tour is exclusively yours — your party, your pace, your itinerary. Whether you're exploring Scotland for the first time, tracing family roots, visiting from a cruise ship or planning a multi-day Highland adventure, we tailor every detail around you. Travel in a private luxury Mercedes V-Class or Sprinter with an expert local guides who bring Scotland's history and stories to life.

Title: Moray Tours, Trips & Transfers
Description: Moray Tours, Trips and Transfers offers year-round private hire, scenic trips, and Scottish airport transfers for 1-4 passengers. Based in Elgin, we are ideal for Speyside whisky tours. What makes us unique is our German-speaking driver, custom Scottish snack boxes with Scottish playlist postcards, and on-board tablet entertainment featuring Netflix and noise-cancelling headphones. Additionally, our spacious Vauxhall Combo Life XL effortlessly accommodates client luggage alongside outdoor adventure gear like our rental bikes or golf clubs for seamless itineraries.
